```
302: /// Scopes a `TaskCell` into `Lua::app_data` for one task, restoring
303: /// the previous on drop. Async work must use `scope_future` because
304: /// concurrent tasks on the same executor overwrite app_data between yields.
305: pub(crate) struct TaskScope {
306:     lua: Lua,
307:     handle: TaskHandle,
308:     prev: Option<TaskHandle>,
309: }
310: 
311: impl TaskScope {
312:     pub(crate) fn new(lua: &Lua, cell: TaskCell) -> Self {
313:         let handle: TaskHandle = Arc::new(Mutex::new(cell));
314:         let prev = lua.set_app_data::<TaskHandle>(Arc::clone(&handle));
315:         Self {
316:             lua: lua.clone(),
317:             handle,
318:             prev,
319:         }
320:     }
321: 
322:     /// The shared Lua keeps the last task's handle around, so system
323:     /// callbacks need a fresh scope or the interrupt hook kills them
324:     /// (stale handle looks cancelled). Prefer [`run_detached`] or
325:     /// [`LuaRuntime::call_sync_detached`] over raw scopes.
326:     pub(crate) fn detached(lua: &Lua) -> Self {
327:         Self::new(lua, TaskCell::new(CancelToken::none(), None, None))
328:     }
329: 
330:     pub(crate) fn handle(&self) -> &TaskHandle {
331:         &self.handle
332:     }
333: 
334:     pub(crate) fn scope_future<F>(&self, inner: F) -> ScopedFuture<F> {
335:         ScopedFuture {
336:             lua: self.lua.clone(),
337:             handle: Arc::clone(&self.handle),
338:             inner,
339:         }
340:     }
341: }
342: 
343: /// Runs an async system callback under a [detached] scope so callers
344: /// can't forget to set one up.
345: ///
346: /// [detached]: TaskScope::detached
347: pub(crate) async fn run_detached<F: std::future::Future>(lua: &Lua, fut: F) -> F::Output {
348:     let scope = TaskScope::detached(lua);
349:     let out = scope.scope_future(fut).await;
350:     drop(scope);
351:     out
352: }
353: 
354: impl Drop for TaskScope {
355:     fn drop(&mut self) {
356:         {
357:             let mut cell = lock_cell(&self.handle);
358:             cell.jobs.kill_all();
359:             cell.jobs.clear(&self.lua);
360:             cell.bufs.clear();
361:         }
362:         match self.prev.take() {
363:             Some(p) => {
364:                 self.lua.set_app_data(p);
365:             }
366:             None => {
367:                 self.lua.remove_app_data::<TaskHandle>();
368:             }
369:         }
370:     }
371: }
```

```
pub(super) fn start_from_queue(&mut self, msg: &QueuedMessage) -> Vec<super::Action> {
        self.status = super::Status::Streaming;
        if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
            handle.fire_autocmd("TurnStart", serde_json::json!({}));
        }
        self.main_chat()
            .show_user_message(format_with_images(&msg.text, msg.images.len()));
        vec![super::Action::SendMessage(Box::new(
            self.build_agent_input(msg),
        ))]
    }
}
```

```
#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TokenUsage {
    /// Non-cached input tokens. Total input = `input + cache_read + cache_creation`.
    #[serde(rename = "input_tokens")]
    pub input: u32,
    #[serde(rename = "output_tokens")]
    pub output: u32,
    #[serde(rename = "cache_creation_input_tokens")]
    pub cache_creation: u32,
    #[serde(rename = "cache_read_input_tokens")]
    pub cache_read: u32,
}

impl From<StoredTokenUsage> for TokenUsage {
    fn from(s: StoredTokenUsage) -> Self {
        Self {
            input: s.input,
            output: s.output,
            cache_creation: s.cache_creation,
            cache_read: s.cache_read,
        }
    }
}

fn parse_usage(u: &Value) -> TokenUsage {
    let input_tokens = u["input_tokens"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32;
    let output_tokens = u["output_tokens"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32;

    let cached = u["input_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"]
        .as_u64()
        .unwrap_or(0) as u32;

    TokenUsage {
        input: input_tokens.saturating_sub(cached),
        output: output_tokens,
        cache_read: cached,
        cache_creation: 0,
    }
}
```

```
    history: &mut History,
    event_tx: &EventSender,
    compact_start: std::time::Instant,
    model: &Model,
) -> TokenUsage {
    let _ = event_tx.send(AgentEvent::TurnComplete(Box::new(TurnCompleteEvent {
        message: response.message.clone(),
        usage: response.usage,
        model: model.id.clone(),
        context_size: Some(response.usage.output),
    })));

    let new_history = vec![
        Message::user("What did we do so far?".into()),
        response.message,
    ];
    history.replace(new_history);
    info!(
        model = %model.id,
        duration_ms = compact_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
        "compaction completed"
    );

    response.usage
}

//! Cooperative cancellation with parent-to-child propagation.
//!
//! `CancelTrigger` fires on Drop, so cleanup happens even if the trigger is forgotten.
//! `cancelled()` uses a double-check around the listener to close the TOCTOU window between flag read and listener registration.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::future::Future;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use event_listener::Event;

struct Shared {
    cancelled: AtomicBool,
    event: Event,
}

impl Shared {
    fn fire(&self) {
        self.cancelled.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        self.event.notify(usize::MAX);
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CancelToken(Arc<Shared>);

pub struct CancelTrigger(Arc<Shared>);
```

```
435:     app.queue.set_focus_at(0);
436:     app.help_modal.toggle();
437:     let (_tx, rx) = flume::bounded::<crate::components::btw_modal::BtwEvent>(1);
438:     app.btw_modal.open("q", rx);
439:     let actions = app.reset_session();
440:     assert!(matches!(&actions[0], Action::NewSession));
441:     assert_eq!(app.status, Status::Idle);
442:     assert_eq!(app.state.token_usage.input, 0);
443:     assert_eq!(app.chats[0].context_size, 0);
444:     assert_eq!(app.state.mode, Mode::Build);
445:     assert_eq!(app.state.plan, PlanState::None);
446:     assert!(app.queue.is_empty());
447:     assert_eq!(app.chats.len(), 1);
448:     assert_eq!(app.chats[0].name, "Main");
449:     assert_eq!(app.active_chat, 0);
450:     assert!(app.chat_index.is_empty());
451:     assert!(app.queue.focus().is_none());
452:     assert!(!app.help_modal.is_open());
453:     assert!(!app.btw_modal.is_open());
454: }

948: fn edge_scroll_direction(zone: Rect, down: (u16, u16), drag: (u16, u16), expected: Option<i32>) {

960:         drag.0,
961:         drag.1,
962:     ));
963: 
964:     let state = app.selection_state.as_ref().unwrap();
965:     let edge_dir = match state {
966:         SelectionState::Dragging { edge_scroll, .. } => edge_scroll.as_ref().map(|es| es.dir),
967:         _ => None,

1505: #[test]
1506: fn cd_command_behavior() {
1507:     let mut app = test_app();
1508:     app.execute_command(ParsedCommand {
1509:         name: "/cd".into(),
1510:         args: "/tmp".into(),
1511:     });
1512:     let flash = app.status_bar.flash_text().unwrap();
1513:     assert!(flash.starts_with("cd /tmp"), "flash={flash:?}");
1514:     // Use `canonicalize_clean` (resolves symlinks like the OS does) rather
1515:     // than `absolute` which preserves symlinks. On macOS `/tmp` is a symlink
1516:     // to `/private/tmp`; production `cmd_cd` reads back `current_dir()` which
1517:     // returns the resolved form, so the test expectation must match.
1518:     let resolved = maki_storage::paths::canonicalize_clean(Path::new("/tmp"));
1519:     assert_eq!(app.state.session.cwd, resolved.to_string_lossy());
1520: 
1521:     app.execute_command(ParsedCommand {
1522:         name: "/cd".into(),
1523:         args: "/nonexistent_path_12345".into(),
1524:     });
1525:     let flash = app.status_bar.flash_text().unwrap();
1526:     assert!(flash.starts_with("cd: "), "error flash={flash:?}");
1527: }
```

```
635: /// under a Mutex, readers get a cheap Arc clone via `read_if_dirty()`.
636: pub struct SharedBuf {

641:     /// itself, not on any one handle, so every handle wrapping this buf,
642:     /// even a foreign wrapper in another task, reaches the same handler.
643:     click: Mutex<Option<Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>>>,
644:     notifying: AtomicBool,
645: }
646: 
647: impl SharedBuf {
648:     pub fn new() -> Self {
649:         Self {
650:             committed: Mutex::new(Arc::new(Vec::new())),
651:             dirty: AtomicBool::new(false),

653:             click: Mutex::new(None),

655:         }

674:     pub fn set_on_change(&self, f: impl Fn() + Send + Sync + 'static) {
675:         *self.on_change.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some(Arc::new(f));
676:     }

678:     /// A watcher keeps everything it captured alive for as long as it is

772:     }

774:     pub fn plain_text(text: String) -> Self {
775:         Self::from_arc(Arc::new(vec![SnapshotLine::plain(text)]))
776:     }
777: 
778:     pub fn first_line_text(&self) -> String {
779:         self.lines
780:             .first()
781:             .map(|l| l.spans.iter().map(|s| s.text.as_str()).collect())
782:             .unwrap_or_default()
783:     }
784: 
785:     /// Search matches against this, so it must mirror exactly what the UI
786:     /// renders.
787:     pub fn text(&self) -> String {
788:         let mut out = String::new();
789:         for (i, line) in self.lines.iter().enumerate() {
790:             if i > 0 {
791:                 out.push('\n');
792:             }
793:             for span in &line.spans {
794:                 out.push_str(&span.text);
795:             }
796:         }
797:         out
798:     }
799: }

876: pub struct EventSender {

878:     run_id: u64,
879: }

881: impl EventSender {
882:     pub fn new(tx: Sender<Envelope>, run_id: u64) -> Self {
883:         Self { tx, run_id }
884:     }
885: 
886:     pub fn send(&self, event: impl Into<AgentEvent>) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
887:         self.tx
888:             .try_send(Envelope {
889:                 event: event.into(),
890:                 subagent: None,
891:                 run_id: self.run_id,
892:             })
893:             .map_err(|_| AgentError::Channel)
894:     }
895: 
896:     pub fn send_envelope(&self, envelope: Envelope) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
897:         self.tx.try_send(envelope).map_err(|_| AgentError::Channel)
898:     }
899: 
900:     pub fn try_send(&self, event: impl Into<AgentEvent>) {
901:         let _ = self.tx.try_send(Envelope {
902:             event: event.into(),
903:             subagent: None,
904:             run_id: self.run_id,
905:         });
906:     }
907: 
908:     pub fn run_id(&self) -> u64 {
909:         self.run_id
910:     }
911: 
912:     pub fn raw_tx(&self) -> &Sender<Envelope> {
913:         &self.tx
914:     }
915: }

946:         let buf = SharedBuf::new();
947:         let fired = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
948:         let f = Arc::clone(&fired);
949:         buf.set_on_change(move || {
950:             f.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
951:         });
952:         buf.append(SnapshotLine { spans: vec![] });
953:         assert_eq!(fired.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
954:         buf.clear_on_change();

956:         assert_eq!(fired.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
957:     }

1242:     #[test]
1243:     fn shared_buf_lifecycle() {
1244:         let buf = SharedBuf::new();
1245: 
1246:         assert!(buf.is_empty());
1247:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none());
1248: 
1249:         for i in 0..3 {
1250:             buf.append(line(&format!("l{i}")));
1251:         }
1252:         assert_eq!(buf.len(), 3);
1253: 
1254:         let snap = buf.read_if_dirty().expect("dirty after appends");
1255:         assert_eq!(snap.len(), 3);
1256:         assert_eq!(snap[0].spans[0].text, "l0");
1257:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none(), "clean after read");
1258: 
1259:         buf.append(line("l3"));
1260:         let _ = buf.take();
1261:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none(), "take clears dirty");
1262:     }

1272:         let snap2 = buf.read_if_dirty().unwrap();
```

```
1007: fn map_tool_names_in_content(content: &Value) -> Value {
1008:     match content {
1009:         Value::Array(blocks) => {
1010:             let mapped: Vec<Value> = blocks
1011:                 .iter()
1012:                 .map(|block| {
1013:                     if block.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("tool_use")
1014:                         && let Some(name) = block.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str)
1015:                     {
1016:                         let mut b = block.clone();
1017:                         b["name"] = Value::String(maki_to_claude_tool_name(name).to_string());
1018:                         return b;
1019:                     }
1020:                     block.clone()
1021:                 })
1022:                 .collect();
1023:             Value::Array(mapped)
1024:         }
1025:         other => other.clone(),
1026:     }
1027: }
```

```
34:     pub fn matched(line_nr: usize, text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
35:         Self {
36:             line_nr,
37:             text: text.into(),
38:             is_match: true,
39:         }
40:     }
41: 
42:     pub fn context(line_nr: usize, text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
43:         Self {
44:             line_nr,
45:             text: text.into(),
46:             is_match: false,
47:         }
48:     }
49: }
50: 
51: impl GrepMatchGroup {
52:     pub fn single(line_nr: usize, text: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
53:         Self {
54:             lines: vec![GrepLine::matched(line_nr, text)],
55:         }
56:     }
57: 
58:     pub fn match_count(&self) -> usize {
59:         self.lines.iter().filter(|l| l.is_match).count()
60:     }
61: }
62: 
63: impl GrepFileEntry {
64:     pub fn match_count(&self) -> usize {
65:         self.groups.iter().map(|g| g.match_count()).sum()
66:     }
67: }

150: fn append_instructions(out: &mut String, blocks: &[InstructionBlock]) {
151:     for block in blocks {

164:     /// Structured plugin state saved with the session, so `restore` never
165:     /// has to re-parse its own llm output.

170: impl From<String> for TextOutput {

176:         }
177:     }

180: impl From<&str> for TextOutput {
181:     fn from(text: &str) -> Self {

183:             text: text.to_owned(),
184:             instructions: None,
185:             state: None,
186:         }
187:     }

190: impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for TextOutput {
191:     fn deserialize<D: Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {
192:         #[derive(Deserialize)]
193:         #[serde(untagged)]
194:         enum Raw {
195:             Legacy(String),
196:             Full {
197:                 text: String,
198:                 #[serde(default)]
199:                 instructions: Option<Vec<InstructionBlock>>,
200:                 #[serde(default)]
201:                 state: Option<serde_json::Value>,
202:             },
203:         }
204:         match Raw::deserialize(deserializer)? {
205:             Raw::Legacy(text) => Ok(text.into()),
206:             Raw::Full {
207:                 text,
208:                 instructions,
209:                 state,
210:             } => Ok(Self {
211:                 text,
212:                 instructions,
213:                 state,
214:             }),
215:         }
216:     }
217: }

219: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
220: pub enum ToolOutput {
221:     Plain(TextOutput),
222:     Markdown(TextOutput),
223:     ReadCode {
224:         path: String,
225:         start_line: usize,
226:         lines: Vec<String>,
227:         #[serde(default)]
228:         total_lines: usize,
229:         #[serde(default)]
230:         instructions: Option<Vec<InstructionBlock>>,
231:     },
232:     ReadDir(TextOutput),
233:     Diff {
234:         path: String,
235:         before: String,
236:         after: String,
237:         summary: String,
238:     },
239:     TodoList(Vec<TodoItem>),
240:     WriteCode {
241:         path: String,
242:         byte_count: usize,
243:         lines: Vec<String>,
244:     },
245: 
246:     GrepResult {
247:         entries: Vec<GrepFileEntry>,
248:     },
249:     /// Only here so legacy sessions still deserialize. Batch is a Lua
250:     /// plugin now and stores per-child `entries` plus a `text` payload.
251:     Batch {
252:         #[serde(default)]
253:         entries: Vec<BatchToolEntry>,
254:         text: String,
255:     },
256:     Instructions {
257:         blocks: Vec<InstructionBlock>,
258:     },
259:     Image {
260:         source: maki_providers::ImageSource,
261:         /// Caption for the tool_result block, e.g. "[image: slack.jpeg 222KB]";
262:         /// the pixels ride separately as a `ContentBlock::Image`.
263:         text: String,
264:     },
265: }
266: 
267: /// Saturating arithmetic so callers can't overflow with any combination of inputs.
268: fn lines_remaining_after(total: usize, start_line: usize, shown: usize) -> usize {
269:     let end = start_line.saturating_add(shown).saturating_sub(1);
270:     total.saturating_sub(end)
271: }
272: 
273: impl ToolOutput {
274:     /// Short header suffix summarizing the output, e.g. `12 lines`.
275:     /// The UI uses it on tool completion, and `maki.agent.call_tool` falls
276:     /// back to it when the tool's reply has no annotation of its own.
277:     pub fn annotation(&self) -> Option<String> {
278:         match self {
279:             Self::ReadCode {
280:                 lines, total_lines, ..
281:             } => {
282:                 let shown = lines.len();
283:                 if *total_lines > shown {
284:                     Some(format!("{shown} of {total_lines} lines"))
285:                 } else {
286:                     Some(format!("{shown} lines"))
287:                 }
288:             }
289:             Self::WriteCode { byte_count, .. } => Some(format!("{byte_count} bytes")),
290:             Self::GrepResult { entries } => {
291:                 let matches: usize = entries.iter().map(|e| e.match_count()).sum();
292:                 let files = entries.len();
293:                 let f = if files == 1 { "file" } else { "files" };
294:                 Some(format!("{matches} matches in {files} {f}"))
295:             }
296:             Self::ReadDir(t) => {
297:                 let n = t.text.lines().count();
298:                 Some(format!("{n} entries"))
299:             }
300:             Self::Plain(text) | Self::Markdown(text) if !text.text.is_empty() => {
301:                 let n = text.text.lines().count();
302:                 Some(format!("{n} lines"))
303:             }
304:             Self::Image { text, .. } => Some(
305:                 text.strip_prefix("[image: ")
306:                     .and_then(|t| t.strip_suffix(']'))
307:                     .unwrap_or(text)
308:                     .to_string(),
309:             ),
310:             _ => None,
311:         }
312:     }
313: 
314:     /// Only here for old persisted sessions that still have `WriteCode`/`Diff` variants.
315:     /// New code should use `ToolDoneEvent::written_path` instead.
316:     pub fn written_path(&self) -> Option<&str> {
317:         match self {
318:             Self::WriteCode { path, .. } | Self::Diff { path, .. } => Some(path),
319:             _ => None,
320:         }
321:     }
322: 
323:     pub fn instructions(&self) -> Option<&[InstructionBlock]> {
324:         match self {
325:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => t.instructions.as_deref(),
326:             Self::ReadCode { instructions, .. } => instructions.as_deref(),
327:             _ => None,
328:         }
329:     }
330: 
331:     pub fn owned_instructions(&self) -> Option<Vec<InstructionBlock>> {
332:         self.instructions()
333:             .filter(|b| !b.is_empty())
334:             .map(|b| b.to_vec())
335:     }
336: 
337:     pub fn is_markdown(&self) -> bool {
338:         matches!(self, Self::Markdown(_))
339:     }
340: 
341:     pub fn state(&self) -> Option<&serde_json::Value> {
342:         match self {
343:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => t.state.as_ref(),
344:             _ => None,
345:         }
346:     }
347: 
348:     pub fn structured_display_text(&self) -> Option<String> {
349:         match self {
350:             Self::Diff { .. }
351:             | Self::ReadCode { .. }
352:             | Self::ReadDir(_)
353:             | Self::WriteCode { .. }
354:             | Self::GrepResult { .. }
355:             | Self::TodoList(_) => Some(self.as_display_text()),
356:             _ => None,
357:         }
358:     }
359: 
360:     pub fn is_empty_result(&self) -> bool {
361:         match self {
362:             Self::GrepResult { entries } => entries.is_empty(),
363:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => t.text.is_empty(),
364:             _ => false,
365:         }
366:     }
367: 
368:     pub fn as_text(&self) -> String {
369:         match self {
370:             Self::Diff { summary, .. } => summary.clone(),
371:             Self::TodoList(_) => "ok".into(),
372:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => {
373:                 let mut out = t.text.clone();
374:                 if let Some(blocks) = &t.instructions {
375:                     append_instructions(&mut out, blocks);
376:                 }
377:                 out
378:             }
379:             Self::ReadCode { instructions, .. } => {
380:                 let mut out = self.as_display_text();
381:                 if let Some(blocks) = instructions {
382:                     append_instructions(&mut out, blocks);
383:                 }
384:                 out
385:             }
386:             _ => self.as_display_text(),
387:         }
388:     }
389: 
390:     pub fn as_display_text(&self) -> String {
391:         match self {
392:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => t.text.clone(),
393:             Self::ReadCode {
394:                 start_line,
395:                 lines,
396:                 total_lines,
397:                 ..
398:             } => {
399:                 let mut out: String = lines
400:                     .iter()
401:                     .enumerate()
402:                     .map(|(i, line)| format!("{}: {line}", start_line + i))
403:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
404:                     .join("\n");
405:                 let remaining = lines_remaining_after(*total_lines, *start_line, lines.len());
406:                 if remaining > 0 {
407:                     out.push_str(&format!(
408:                         "\n\n...\n\nTruncated lines: {}-{}. Use offset={} to read further.",
409:                         start_line + lines.len(),
410:                         total_lines,
411:                         start_line + lines.len(),
412:                     ));
413:                 }
414:                 out
415:             }
416:             Self::Diff {
417:                 path,
418:                 before,
419:                 after,
420:                 summary,
421:             } => crate::diff::unified_text(
422:                 before,
423:                 after,
424:                 summary,
425:                 &crate::tools::relative_path(path),
426:             ),
427:             Self::TodoList(items) => {
428:                 if items.is_empty() {
429:                     return "No todos.".into();
430:                 }
431:                 items
432:                     .iter()
433:                     .map(|t| format!("{} ({}) {}", t.status.marker(), t.priority, t.content))
434:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
435:                     .join("\n")
436:             }
437:             Self::WriteCode {
438:                 path, byte_count, ..
439:             } => {
440:                 let display = crate::tools::relative_path(path);
441:                 format!("wrote {byte_count} bytes to {display}")
442:             }
443:             Self::GrepResult { entries } => {
444:                 let mut out = String::new();
445:                 for (i, entry) in entries.iter().enumerate() {
446:                     if i > 0 {
447:                         out.push('\n');
448:                     }
449:                     out.push_str(&entry.path);
450:                     out.push(':');
451:                     let has_context = entry.groups.iter().any(|g| g.lines.len() > 1);
452:                     for (gi, group) in entry.groups.iter().enumerate() {
453:                         if gi > 0 && has_context {
454:                             out.push_str("\n  --");
455:                         }
456:                         for line in &group.lines {
457:                             let sep = if line.is_match { ":" } else { " " };
458:                             let _ = write!(out, "\n  {}{sep} {}", line.line_nr, line.text);
459:                         }
460:                     }
461:                 }
462:                 out
463:             }
464:             Self::Batch { text, .. } | Self::Image { text, .. } => text.clone(),
465:             Self::Instructions { blocks } => {
466:                 let mut out = String::new();
467:                 append_instructions(&mut out, blocks);
468:                 out
469:             }
470:         }
471:     }
472: }

486: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
487: pub struct ToolDoneEvent {
488:     pub id: String,
489:     pub tool: Arc<str>,
490:     pub output: ToolOutput,
491:     pub is_error: bool,
492:     pub annotation: Option<String>,
493:     pub written_path: Option<String>,
494: }
495: 
496: const UNKNOWN_TOOL: &str = "unknown";
497: 
498: impl ToolDoneEvent {
499:     pub fn error(id: String, message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
500:         let message: String = message.into();
501:         Self {
502:             id,
503:             tool: Arc::from(UNKNOWN_TOOL),
504:             output: ToolOutput::Plain(message.into()),
505:             is_error: true,
506:             annotation: None,
507:             written_path: None,
508:         }
509:     }
510: 
511:     pub fn written_path(&self) -> Option<&str> {
512:         if self.is_error {
513:             return None;
514:         }
515:         self.written_path
516:             .as_deref()
517:             .or_else(|| self.output.written_path())
518:     }
519: 
520:     pub fn wrote_to(&self, plan_path: &Path) -> bool {
521:         self.written_path()
522:             .is_some_and(|wp| Path::new(wp) == plan_path)
523:     }
524: }
525: 
526: pub fn tool_results(results: Vec<ToolDoneEvent>) -> Message {
527:     let mut content = Vec::with_capacity(results.len());
528:     let mut images = Vec::new();
529:     for r in results {
530:         content.push(ContentBlock::ToolResult {
531:             tool_use_id: r.id,
532:             content: r.output.as_text(),
533:             is_error: r.is_error,
534:         });
535:         if let ToolOutput::Image { source, .. } = &r.output {
536:             images.push(ContentBlock::Image {
537:                 source: source.clone(),
538:             });
539:         }
540:     }
541:     // Anthropic wants every tool_result before other content in the user
542:     // message, so images go after all results.
543:     content.extend(images);
544:     Message {
545:         role: Role::User,
546:         content,
547:         ..Default::default()
548:     }
549: }

634: /// Append-only buffer for streaming tool output to the UI. Writers append
635: /// under a Mutex, readers get a cheap Arc clone via `read_if_dirty()`.
636: pub struct SharedBuf {
637:     committed: Mutex<Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>>,
638:     dirty: AtomicBool,
639:     on_change: Mutex<Option<Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>>>,
640:     /// Opaque click handler owned by the Lua layer. It lives on the buffer
641:     /// itself, not on any one handle, so every handle wrapping this buf,
642:     /// even a foreign wrapper in another task, reaches the same handler.
643:     click: Mutex<Option<Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>>>,
644:     notifying: AtomicBool,
645: }
646: 
647: impl SharedBuf {
648:     pub fn new() -> Self {
649:         Self {
650:             committed: Mutex::new(Arc::new(Vec::new())),
651:             dirty: AtomicBool::new(false),
652:             on_change: Mutex::new(None),
653:             click: Mutex::new(None),
654:             notifying: AtomicBool::new(false),
655:         }
656:     }
657: 
658:     pub fn set_click(&self, f: Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>) {
659:         *self.click.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some(f);
660:     }
661: 
662:     pub fn click(&self) -> Option<Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>> {
663:         self.click.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone()
664:     }
665: 
666:     pub fn clear_click(&self) {
667:         *self.click.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = None;
668:     }
669: 
670:     /// Fires synchronously after every `append`/`set_lines`, on the
671:     /// mutating thread. The callback must not mutate this buffer; recursive
672:     /// notifications are silently dropped. One slot only: a second call
673:     /// replaces the previous watcher.
674:     pub fn set_on_change(&self, f: impl Fn() + Send + Sync + 'static) {
675:         *self.on_change.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some(Arc::new(f));
676:     }
677: 
678:     /// A watcher keeps everything it captured alive for as long as it is
679:     /// installed, so owners must clear it once the watching task retires.
680:     pub fn clear_on_change(&self) {
681:         *self.on_change.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = None;
682:     }
683: 
684:     fn notify_change(&self) {
685:         if self.notifying.swap(true, Ordering::AcqRel) {
686:             return;
687:         }
688:         let cb = self
689:             .on_change
690:             .lock()
691:             .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
692:             .clone();
693:         if let Some(cb) = cb {
694:             cb();
695:         }
696:         self.notifying.store(false, Ordering::Release);
697:     }
698: 
699:     pub fn append(&self, line: SnapshotLine) {
700:         let mut guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
701:         Arc::make_mut(&mut guard).push(line);
702:         drop(guard);
703:         self.dirty.store(true, Ordering::Release);
704:         self.notify_change();
705:     }
706: 
707:     pub fn set_lines(&self, lines: Vec<SnapshotLine>) {
708:         let mut guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
709:         *guard = Arc::new(lines);
710:         drop(guard);
711:         self.dirty.store(true, Ordering::Release);
712:         self.notify_change();
713:     }
714: 
715:     pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
716:         self.committed
717:             .lock()
718:             .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
719:             .len()
720:     }
721: 
722:     pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
723:         self.len() == 0
724:     }
725: 
726:     pub fn read(&self) -> Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>> {
727:         let guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
728:         Arc::clone(&guard)
729:     }
730: 
731:     pub fn read_if_dirty(&self) -> Option<Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>> {
732:         if !self.dirty.swap(false, Ordering::AcqRel) {
733:             return None;
734:         }
735:         let guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
736:         Some(Arc::clone(&guard))
737:     }
738: 
739:     pub fn take(&self) -> BufferSnapshot {
740:         self.dirty.store(false, Ordering::Release);
741:         let guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
742:         BufferSnapshot::from_arc(Arc::clone(&guard))
743:     }
744: }
745: 
746: impl Default for SharedBuf {
747:     fn default() -> Self {
748:         Self::new()
749:     }
750: }
751: 
752: impl std::fmt::Debug for SharedBuf {
753:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
754:         f.debug_struct("SharedBuf").finish_non_exhaustive()
755:     }
756: }
757: 
758: impl Serialize for SharedBuf {
759:     fn serialize<S: serde::Serializer>(&self, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
760:         s.serialize_unit()
761:     }
762: }

764: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize)]
765: pub struct BufferSnapshot {
766:     pub lines: Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>,
767: }
768: 
769: impl BufferSnapshot {
770:     pub fn from_arc(lines: Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>) -> Self {
771:         Self { lines }
772:     }
773: 
774:     pub fn plain_text(text: String) -> Self {
775:         Self::from_arc(Arc::new(vec![SnapshotLine::plain(text)]))
776:     }
777: 
778:     pub fn first_line_text(&self) -> String {
779:         self.lines
780:             .first()
781:             .map(|l| l.spans.iter().map(|s| s.text.as_str()).collect())
782:             .unwrap_or_default()
783:     }
784: 
785:     /// Search matches against this, so it must mirror exactly what the UI
786:     /// renders.
787:     pub fn text(&self) -> String {
788:         let mut out = String::new();
789:         for (i, line) in self.lines.iter().enumerate() {
790:             if i > 0 {
791:                 out.push('\n');
792:             }
793:             for span in &line.spans {
794:                 out.push_str(&span.text);
795:             }
796:         }
797:         out
798:     }
799: }

904:             run_id: self.run_id,

1242:     #[test]
1243:     fn shared_buf_lifecycle() {
1244:         let buf = SharedBuf::new();
1245: 
1246:         assert!(buf.is_empty());
1247:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none());
1248: 
1249:         for i in 0..3 {
1250:             buf.append(line(&format!("l{i}")));
1251:         }
1252:         assert_eq!(buf.len(), 3);
1253: 
1254:         let snap = buf.read_if_dirty().expect("dirty after appends");
1255:         assert_eq!(snap.len(), 3);
1256:         assert_eq!(snap[0].spans[0].text, "l0");
1257:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none(), "clean after read");
1258: 
1259:         buf.append(line("l3"));
1260:         let _ = buf.take();
1261:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none(), "take clears dirty");
1262:     }

1269:         let snap = buf.read_if_dirty().unwrap();
1270:         buf.append(line("c"));
1271:         assert_eq!(snap.len(), 2, "held Arc must not see new appends");
1272:         let snap2 = buf.read_if_dirty().unwrap();

1276:     #[test]
1277:     fn shared_buf_poisoned_mutex_recovery() {
1278:         let buf = Arc::new(SharedBuf::new());
1279:         let buf2 = Arc::clone(&buf);
1280:         let h = std::thread::spawn(move || {
1281:             let _guard = buf2.committed.lock().unwrap();
1282:             panic!("intentional poison");
```

```
20: /// Stream a summary of `history` under the compaction system prompt using

122:         message: response.message.clone(),

162: /// Generate a session name from user messages using an isolated LLM call.
163: /// Emits `AgentEvent::RenameResult` with the trimmed title, or nothing if the
164: /// response is empty. Does not mutate history and does not emit `Done`.
165: pub async fn rename_session(
166:     provider: &dyn maki_providers::provider::Provider,
167:     model: &Model,
168:     messages: &[Message],
169:     event_tx: &EventSender,
170: ) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
171:     use maki_providers::ProviderEvent;
172: 
173:     let system = include_str!("../prompts/session_name.md");
174:     let (prov_tx, prov_rx) = flume::unbounded::<ProviderEvent>();
175:     let _ = provider
176:         .stream_message(
177:             model,
178:             messages,
179:             system,
180:             &serde_json::Value::Null,
181:             &prov_tx,
182:             RequestOptions::default(),
183:             None,
184:         )
185:         .await;
186:     drop(prov_tx);
187: 
188:     let mut title = String::new();
189:     while let Ok(event) = prov_rx.try_recv() {
190:         if let ProviderEvent::TextDelta { text } = event {
191:             title.push_str(&text);
192:         }
193:     }
194:     let title = title.trim().to_string();
195:     if !title.is_empty() {
196:         let _ = event_tx.send(AgentEvent::RenameResult { title });
197:     }
198:     Ok(())
199: }

201: /// Emit a re-anchoring checkpoint: stream a CHECKPOINT-mode delta summary and
202: /// append it to history, keeping the full conversation intact — unlike `compact`,
203: /// which replaces it. Checkpoints are append-only (interleaved), so each new one
204: /// covers only new work and the prompt cache prefix is never invalidated.
205: pub async fn checkpoint(
206:     provider: &dyn maki_providers::provider::Provider,
207:     model: &Model,
208:     history: &mut History,
209:     event_tx: &EventSender,
210:     target_tokens: Option<usize>,
211: ) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
212:     let usage =
213:         checkpoint_history(provider, model, history, event_tx, &CancelToken::none(), target_tokens)
214:             .await?;
215: 
216:     event_tx.send(AgentEvent::Done {
217:         usage,
218:         num_turns: 1,
219:         stop_reason: None,
220:     })?;
221: 
222:     Ok(())
223: }

225: /// Stream a CHECKPOINT-mode delta summary and append it to `history`
226: /// (append-only: nothing is removed, so the cached prefix stays intact). Sends
227: /// unstripped history so the request rides the main conversation's prompt cache.
228: /// Emits the labeling `CompactionStart` but not `Done`, so it is safe to call
229: /// mid-run (unlike `checkpoint`).
230: pub(super) async fn checkpoint_history(
231:     provider: &dyn maki_providers::provider::Provider,
232:     model: &Model,
233:     history: &mut History,
234:     event_tx: &EventSender,
235:     cancel: &CancelToken,
236:     target_tokens: Option<usize>,
237: ) -> Result<TokenUsage, AgentError> {
238:     let _ = event_tx.send(AgentEvent::CompactionStart { checkpoint: true });
239:     let response = run_summary_stream(
240:         provider,
241:         model,
242:         history,
243:         crate::prompt::CHECKPOINT_USER,
244:         false,
245:         event_tx,
246:         cancel,
247:         target_tokens,
248:     )
249:     .await?;
250: 
251:     history.push(Message::user(CHECKPOINT_INTRO.into()));
252:     history.push(response.message);
253: 
254:     Ok(response.usage)
255: }

257: pub(super) fn is_overflow(usage: &TokenUsage, model: &Model, compaction_buffer: u32) -> bool {
258:     let usable = model.context_window.saturating_sub(compaction_buffer);
259:     usage.context_tokens() >= usable
260: }

262: fn strip_images(messages: &mut [Message]) {
263:     for msg in messages {
264:         for block in &mut msg.content {
265:             if matches!(block, ContentBlock::Image { .. }) {
266:                 *block = ContentBlock::Text {
267:                     text: IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER.into(),
268:                 };
269:             }
270:         }
271:     }
272: }
273: 
274: fn strip_thinking(messages: &mut [Message]) {
275:     for msg in messages {
276:         msg.content.retain(|block| {
277:             !matches!(
278:                 block,
279:                 ContentBlock::Thinking { .. } | ContentBlock::RedactedThinking { .. }
280:             )
281:         });
282:     }
283: }
284: 
285: const TOOL_RESULT_PLACEHOLDER: &str = "[tool result]";
286: const KEEP_LAST_TOOL_RESULTS: usize = 3;
287: 
288: fn strip_old_tool_results(messages: &mut [Message]) {
289:     let total: usize = messages
290:         .iter()
291:         .flat_map(|m| &m.content)
292:         .filter(|b| matches!(b, ContentBlock::ToolResult { .. }))
293:         .count();
294: 
295:     let mut seen = 0;
296:     for msg in messages {
297:         for block in &mut msg.content {
298:             if let ContentBlock::ToolResult { content, .. } = block {
299:                 if seen < total.saturating_sub(KEEP_LAST_TOOL_RESULTS) {
300:                     *content = TOOL_RESULT_PLACEHOLDER.into();
301:                 }
302:                 seen += 1;
303:             }
304:         }
305:     }
306: }
307: 
308: fn truncate_oldest_round(messages: &mut Vec<Message>) {
309:     if messages.len() <= 1 {
310:         return;
311:     }
312: 
313:     let mut remove_count = 1;
314: 
315:     if matches!(messages.first().map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::Assistant)) {
316:         let has_tool_calls = messages[0].has_tool_calls();
317:         if has_tool_calls {
318:             let next_has_tool_results = messages.get(1).is_some_and(|m| {
319:                 matches!(m.role, Role::User)
320:                     && m.content
321:                         .iter()
322:                         .any(|b| matches!(b, ContentBlock::ToolResult { .. }))
323:             });
324:             if next_has_tool_results {
325:                 remove_count = 2;
326:             }
327:         }
328:     } else if matches!(messages.first().map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::User))
329:         && matches!(messages.get(1).map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::Assistant))
330:     {
331:         // Dropping a lone user message would leave assistant-first, which some providers reject.
332:         // Remove the assistant too to keep the conversation well-formed.
333:         remove_count = 2;
334:     }
335: 
336:     messages.drain(..remove_count);
337: 
338:     // After draining, the first message might still be an assistant (e.g. consecutive
339:     // assistant messages). Keep draining until the first message is user or we're empty.
340:     while messages.len() > 1 && matches!(messages.first().map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::Assistant)) {
341:         let mut drop = 1;
342:         if matches!(messages.get(1).map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::User)) {
343:             drop = 2;
344:         }
345:         messages.drain(..drop);
346:     }
347: }

351:         .map(|v| v != "1" && v != "true")
352:         .unwrap_or(true)
353: }

485:                 .unwrap();
486:             assert_eq!(history.len(), 4, "original 2 kept + intro + summary");
487:             assert_eq!(history.as_slice()[2].user_text(), Some(CHECKPOINT_INTRO));
488: 
489:             // Second checkpoint: append-only — prior checkpoint is NOT removed, so
490:             // the prefix is unchanged and the cache stays warm.
491:             checkpoint(&*provider, &model, &mut history, &tx, None)
492:                 .await
493:                 .unwrap();
494:             assert_eq!(history.len(), 6, "checkpoints interleave, not supersede");
495:             let intros = history
496:                 .as_slice()
497:                 .iter()
498:                 .filter(|m| m.user_text() == Some(CHECKPOINT_INTRO))
499:                 .count();
500:             assert_eq!(intros, 2, "both checkpoints retained in order");
501:             // Original turns still at the front — prefix preserved.
502:             assert_eq!(history.as_slice()[0].user_text(), Some("first"));
503:         });
504:     }
```

```
13: pub(super) const CONTINUE_AFTER_COMPACT: &str = "Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed. If the summary contains a todo list, restore it with todo_write and keep it updated. If you learned important project context during this session, consider saving it to memory before it's lost.";

16: pub(super) async fn compact_history(
17:     provider: &dyn maki_providers::provider::Provider,
18:     model: &Model,
19:     history: &mut History,
20:     event_tx: &EventSender,
21:     cancel: &CancelToken,
22: ) -> Result<TokenUsage, AgentError> {
23:     let compact_start = std::time::Instant::now();
24:     let mut compaction_history: Vec<Message> = history.as_slice().to_vec();
25:     strip_images(&mut compaction_history);
26:     strip_thinking(&mut compaction_history);
27:     strip_old_tool_results(&mut compaction_history);
28:     compaction_history.push(Message::user(crate::prompt::COMPACTION_USER.to_string()));
29: 
30:     let empty_tools = serde_json::json!([]);
31:     let max_attempts = 3;
32:     let mut last_error = None;
33: 
34:     for attempt in 0..max_attempts {
35:         match stream_with_retry(
36:             provider,
37:             model,
38:             &compaction_history,
39:             crate::prompt::COMPACTION_SYSTEM,
40:             &empty_tools,
41:             event_tx,
42:             cancel,
43:             RequestOptions::default(),
44:             None,
45:         )
46:         .await
47:         {
48:             Ok(response) => {
49:                 if attempt > 0 {
50:                     info!(
51:                         attempt,
52:                         "compaction succeeded after truncating oldest rounds"
53:                     );
54:                 }
55:                 return Ok(finish_compact(
56:                     response,
57:                     history,
58:                     event_tx,
59:                     compact_start,
60:                     model,
61:                 ));
62:             }
63:             Err(e) if e.is_context_overflow() && attempt < max_attempts - 1 => {
64:                 last_error = Some(e);
65:                 truncate_oldest_round(&mut compaction_history);
66:             }
67:             Err(e) => return Err(e),
68:         }
69:     }
70: 
71:     Err(last_error.unwrap())
72: }
73: 
74: fn finish_compact(
75:     response: StreamResponse,
76:     history: &mut History,
77:     event_tx: &EventSender,
78:     compact_start: std::time::Instant,
79:     model: &Model,
80: ) -> TokenUsage {
81:     let _ = event_tx.send(AgentEvent::TurnComplete(Box::new(TurnCompleteEvent {
82:         message: response.message.clone(),
83:         usage: response.usage,
84:         model: model.id.clone(),
85:         context_size: Some(response.usage.output),
86:     })));
87: 
88:     let new_history = vec![
89:         Message::user("What did we do so far?".into()),
90:         response.message,
91:     ];
92:     history.replace(new_history);
93:     info!(
94:         model = %model.id,
95:         duration_ms = compact_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
96:         "compaction completed"
97:     );
98: 
99:     response.usage
100: }
101: 
102: pub async fn compact(
103:     provider: &dyn maki_providers::provider::Provider,
104:     model: &Model,
105:     history: &mut History,
106:     event_tx: &EventSender,
107: ) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
108:     let cancel = CancelToken::none();
109:     let usage = compact_history(provider, model, history, event_tx, &cancel).await?;
110: 
111:     event_tx.send(AgentEvent::Done {
112:         usage,
113:         num_turns: 1,
114:         stop_reason: None,
115:     })?;
116: 
117:     Ok(())
118: }
119: 
120: pub(super) fn is_overflow(usage: &TokenUsage, model: &Model, compaction_buffer: u32) -> bool {
121:     let usable = model.context_window.saturating_sub(compaction_buffer);
122:     usage.context_tokens() >= usable
123: }
124: 
125: fn strip_images(messages: &mut [Message]) {
126:     for msg in messages {
127:         for block in &mut msg.content {
128:             if matches!(block, ContentBlock::Image { .. }) {
129:                 *block = ContentBlock::Text {
130:                     text: IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER.into(),
131:                 };
132:             }
133:         }
134:     }
135: }
136: 
137: fn strip_thinking(messages: &mut [Message]) {
138:     for msg in messages {
139:         msg.content.retain(|block| {
140:             !matches!(
141:                 block,
142:                 ContentBlock::Thinking { .. } | ContentBlock::RedactedThinking { .. }
143:             )
144:         });
145:     }
146: }
147: 
148: const TOOL_RESULT_PLACEHOLDER: &str = "[tool result]";
149: const KEEP_LAST_TOOL_RESULTS: usize = 3;
150: 
151: fn strip_old_tool_results(messages: &mut [Message]) {
152:     let total: usize = messages
153:         .iter()
154:         .flat_map(|m| &m.content)
155:         .filter(|b| matches!(b, ContentBlock::ToolResult { .. }))
156:         .count();
157: 
158:     let mut seen = 0;
159:     for msg in messages {
160:         for block in &mut msg.content {
161:             if let ContentBlock::ToolResult { content, .. } = block {
162:                 if seen < total.saturating_sub(KEEP_LAST_TOOL_RESULTS) {
163:                     *content = TOOL_RESULT_PLACEHOLDER.into();
164:                 }
165:                 seen += 1;
166:             }
167:         }
168:     }
169: }
170: 
171: fn truncate_oldest_round(messages: &mut Vec<Message>) {
172:     if messages.len() <= 1 {
173:         return;
174:     }
175: 
176:     let mut remove_count = 1;
177: 
178:     if matches!(messages.first().map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::Assistant)) {
179:         let has_tool_calls = messages[0].has_tool_calls();
180:         if has_tool_calls {
181:             let next_has_tool_results = messages.get(1).is_some_and(|m| {
182:                 matches!(m.role, Role::User)
183:                     && m.content
184:                         .iter()
185:                         .any(|b| matches!(b, ContentBlock::ToolResult { .. }))
186:             });
187:             if next_has_tool_results {
188:                 remove_count = 2;
189:             }
190:         }
191:     } else if matches!(messages.first().map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::User))
192:         && matches!(messages.get(1).map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::Assistant))
193:     {
194:         // Dropping a lone user message would leave assistant-first, which some providers reject.
195:         // Remove the assistant too to keep the conversation well-formed.
196:         remove_count = 2;
197:     }
198: 
199:     messages.drain(..remove_count);
200: 
201:     // After draining, the first message might still be an assistant (e.g. consecutive
202:     // assistant messages). Keep draining until the first message is user or we're empty.
203:     while messages.len() > 1 && matches!(messages.first().map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::Assistant)) {
204:         let mut drop = 1;
205:         if matches!(messages.get(1).map(|m| &m.role), Some(Role::User)) {
206:             drop = 2;
207:         }
208:         messages.drain(..drop);
209:     }
210: }
211: 
212: pub(super) fn auto_compact_enabled() -> bool {
213:     env::var("MAKI_DISABLE_AUTOCOMPACT")
214:         .map(|v| v != "1" && v != "true")
215:         .unwrap_or(true)
216: }
```

```
239: /// Saturating arithmetic so callers can't overflow with any combination of inputs.
240: fn lines_remaining_after(total: usize, start_line: usize, shown: usize) -> usize {
241:     let end = start_line.saturating_add(shown).saturating_sub(1);
242:     total.saturating_sub(end)
243: }

245: impl ToolOutput {
246:     /// Only here for old persisted sessions that still have `WriteCode`/`Diff` variants.
247:     /// New code should use `ToolDoneEvent::written_path` instead.
248:     pub fn written_path(&self) -> Option<&str> {
249:         match self {
250:             Self::WriteCode { path, .. } | Self::Diff { path, .. } => Some(path),
251:             _ => None,
252:         }
253:     }
254: 
255:     pub fn instructions(&self) -> Option<&[InstructionBlock]> {
256:         match self {
257:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => t.instructions.as_deref(),
258:             Self::ReadCode { instructions, .. } => instructions.as_deref(),
259:             _ => None,
260:         }
261:     }
262: 
263:     pub fn owned_instructions(&self) -> Option<Vec<InstructionBlock>> {
264:         self.instructions()
265:             .filter(|b| !b.is_empty())
266:             .map(|b| b.to_vec())
267:     }
268: 
269:     pub fn is_markdown(&self) -> bool {
270:         matches!(self, Self::Markdown(_))
271:     }
272: 
273:     pub fn structured_display_text(&self) -> Option<String> {
274:         match self {
275:             Self::Diff { .. }
276:             | Self::ReadCode { .. }
277:             | Self::ReadDir(_)
278:             | Self::WriteCode { .. }
279:             | Self::GrepResult { .. }
280:             | Self::TodoList(_) => Some(self.as_display_text()),
281:             _ => None,
282:         }
283:     }
284: 
285:     pub fn is_empty_result(&self) -> bool {
286:         match self {
287:             Self::GrepResult { entries } => entries.is_empty(),
288:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => t.text.is_empty(),
289:             _ => false,
290:         }
291:     }
292: 
293:     pub fn as_text(&self) -> String {
294:         match self {
295:             Self::Diff { summary, .. } => summary.clone(),
296:             Self::TodoList(_) => "ok".into(),
297:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => {
298:                 let mut out = t.text.clone();
299:                 if let Some(blocks) = &t.instructions {
300:                     append_instructions(&mut out, blocks);
301:                 }
302:                 out
303:             }
304:             Self::ReadCode { instructions, .. } => {
305:                 let mut out = self.as_display_text();
306:                 if let Some(blocks) = instructions {
307:                     append_instructions(&mut out, blocks);
308:                 }
309:                 out
310:             }
311:             _ => self.as_display_text(),
312:         }
313:     }
314: 
315:     pub fn as_display_text(&self) -> String {
316:         match self {
317:             Self::Plain(t) | Self::Markdown(t) | Self::ReadDir(t) => t.text.clone(),
318:             Self::ReadCode {
319:                 start_line,
320:                 lines,
321:                 total_lines,
322:                 ..
323:             } => {
324:                 let mut out: String = lines
325:                     .iter()
326:                     .enumerate()
327:                     .map(|(i, line)| format!("{}: {line}", start_line + i))
328:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
329:                     .join("\n");
330:                 let remaining = lines_remaining_after(*total_lines, *start_line, lines.len());
331:                 if remaining > 0 {
332:                     out.push_str(&format!(
333:                         "\n\n...\n\nTruncated lines: {}-{}. Use offset={} to read further.",
334:                         start_line + lines.len(),
335:                         total_lines,
336:                         start_line + lines.len(),
337:                     ));
338:                 }
339:                 out
340:             }
341:             Self::Diff {
342:                 path,
343:                 before,
344:                 after,
345:                 summary,
346:             } => crate::diff::unified_text(
347:                 before,
348:                 after,
349:                 summary,
350:                 &crate::tools::relative_path(path),
351:             ),
352:             Self::TodoList(items) => {
353:                 if items.is_empty() {
354:                     return "No todos.".into();
355:                 }
356:                 items
357:                     .iter()
358:                     .map(|t| format!("{} ({}) {}", t.status.marker(), t.priority, t.content))
359:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
360:                     .join("\n")
361:             }
362:             Self::WriteCode {
363:                 path, byte_count, ..
364:             } => {
365:                 let display = crate::tools::relative_path(path);
366:                 format!("wrote {byte_count} bytes to {display}")
367:             }
368:             Self::GrepResult { entries } => {
369:                 let mut out = String::new();
370:                 for (i, entry) in entries.iter().enumerate() {
371:                     if i > 0 {
372:                         out.push('\n');
373:                     }
374:                     out.push_str(&entry.path);
375:                     out.push(':');
376:                     let has_context = entry.groups.iter().any(|g| g.lines.len() > 1);
377:                     for (gi, group) in entry.groups.iter().enumerate() {
378:                         if gi > 0 && has_context {
379:                             out.push_str("\n  --");
380:                         }
381:                         for line in &group.lines {
382:                             let sep = if line.is_match { ":" } else { " " };
383:                             let _ = write!(out, "\n  {}{sep} {}", line.line_nr, line.text);
384:                         }
385:                     }
386:                 }
387:                 out
388:             }
389:             Self::Batch { text, .. } => text.clone(),
390:             Self::Instructions { blocks } => {
391:                 let mut out = String::new();
392:                 append_instructions(&mut out, blocks);
393:                 out
394:             }
395:         }
396:     }
397: }

503:     /// so the UI can label the resulting block. `checkpoint` selects the label.

551: /// Append-only buffer for streaming tool output to the UI. Writers append
552: /// under a Mutex, readers get a cheap Arc clone via `read_if_dirty()`.
553: pub struct SharedBuf {
554:     committed: Mutex<Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>>,
555:     dirty: AtomicBool,
556: }
557: 
558: impl SharedBuf {
559:     pub fn new() -> Self {
560:         Self {
561:             committed: Mutex::new(Arc::new(Vec::new())),
562:             dirty: AtomicBool::new(false),
563:         }
564:     }
565: 
566:     pub fn append(&self, line: SnapshotLine) {
567:         let mut guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
568:         Arc::make_mut(&mut guard).push(line);
569:         drop(guard);
570:         self.dirty.store(true, Ordering::Release);
571:     }
572: 
573:     pub fn set_lines(&self, lines: Vec<SnapshotLine>) {
574:         let mut guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
575:         *guard = Arc::new(lines);
576:         drop(guard);
577:         self.dirty.store(true, Ordering::Release);
578:     }
579: 
580:     pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
581:         self.committed
582:             .lock()
583:             .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
584:             .len()
585:     }
586: 
587:     pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
588:         self.len() == 0
589:     }
590: 
591:     pub fn read_if_dirty(&self) -> Option<Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>> {
592:         if !self.dirty.swap(false, Ordering::AcqRel) {
593:             return None;
594:         }
595:         let guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
596:         Some(Arc::clone(&guard))
597:     }
598: 
599:     pub fn take(&self) -> BufferSnapshot {
600:         self.dirty.store(false, Ordering::Release);
601:         let guard = self.committed.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
602:         BufferSnapshot::from_arc(Arc::clone(&guard))
603:     }
604: }
605: 
606: impl Default for SharedBuf {
607:     fn default() -> Self {
608:         Self::new()
609:     }
610: }
611: 
612: impl std::fmt::Debug for SharedBuf {
613:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
614:         f.debug_struct("SharedBuf").finish_non_exhaustive()
615:     }
616: }
617: 
618: impl Serialize for SharedBuf {
619:     fn serialize<S: serde::Serializer>(&self, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
620:         s.serialize_unit()
621:     }
622: }
623: 
624: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize)]
625: pub struct BufferSnapshot {
626:     pub lines: Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>,
627: }
628: 
629: impl BufferSnapshot {
630:     pub fn from_arc(lines: Arc<Vec<SnapshotLine>>) -> Self {
631:         Self { lines }
632:     }
633: 
634:     pub fn plain_text(text: String) -> Self {
635:         Self::from_arc(Arc::new(vec![SnapshotLine::plain(text)]))
636:     }
637: 
638:     pub fn first_line_text(&self) -> String {
639:         self.lines
640:             .first()
641:             .map(|l| l.spans.iter().map(|s| s.text.as_str()).collect())
642:             .unwrap_or_default()
643:     }
644: }

720: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
721: pub struct EventSender {
722:     tx: Sender<Envelope>,
723:     run_id: u64,
724: }
725: 
726: impl EventSender {
727:     pub fn new(tx: Sender<Envelope>, run_id: u64) -> Self {
728:         Self { tx, run_id }
729:     }
730: 
731:     pub fn send(&self, event: impl Into<AgentEvent>) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
732:         self.tx
733:             .try_send(Envelope {
734:                 event: event.into(),
735:                 subagent: None,
736:                 run_id: self.run_id,
737:             })
738:             .map_err(|_| AgentError::Channel)
739:     }
740: 
741:     pub fn send_envelope(&self, envelope: Envelope) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
742:         self.tx.try_send(envelope).map_err(|_| AgentError::Channel)
743:     }
744: 
745:     pub fn try_send(&self, event: impl Into<AgentEvent>) {
746:         let _ = self.tx.try_send(Envelope {
747:             event: event.into(),
748:             subagent: None,
749:             run_id: self.run_id,
750:         });
751:     }
752: 
753:     pub fn run_id(&self) -> u64 {
754:         self.run_id
755:     }
756: 
757:     pub fn raw_tx(&self) -> &Sender<Envelope> {
758:         &self.tx
759:     }
760: }

986:     #[test]
987:     fn shared_buf_lifecycle() {
988:         let buf = SharedBuf::new();
989: 
990:         assert!(buf.is_empty());
991:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none());
992: 
993:         for i in 0..3 {
994:             buf.append(line(&format!("l{i}")));
995:         }
996:         assert_eq!(buf.len(), 3);
997: 
998:         let snap = buf.read_if_dirty().expect("dirty after appends");
999:         assert_eq!(snap.len(), 3);
1000:         assert_eq!(snap[0].spans[0].text, "l0");
1001:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none(), "clean after read");
1002: 
1003:         buf.append(line("l3"));
1004:         let _ = buf.take();
1005:         assert!(buf.read_if_dirty().is_none(), "take clears dirty");
1006:     }

1013:         let snap = buf.read_if_dirty().unwrap();
1014:         buf.append(line("c"));
1015:         assert_eq!(snap.len(), 2, "held Arc must not see new appends");
1016:         let snap2 = buf.read_if_dirty().unwrap();
1017:         assert_eq!(snap2.len(), 3);
1018:     }
```

```
162:     pub async fn run(&mut self, input: AgentInput) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
163:         self.rollback_len = self.history.len();
164:         let msg = Message::user_with_images(input.message.clone(), input.images);
165:         self.history.push(msg);
166:         self.mode = input.mode;
167:         self.opts = RequestOptions {
168:             thinking: input.thinking,
169:             fast: input.fast,
170:         };
171: 
172:         info!(
173:             model = %self.model.id,
174:             mode = ?self.mode,
175:             message_len = input.message.len(),
176:             "agent run started"
177:         );
178: 
179:         let result = self.run_loop().await;
180: 
181:         if matches!(result, Err(AgentError::Cancelled)) {
182:             sanitize_cancelled_history(self.history, self.rollback_len);
183:         }
184: 
185:         result
186:     }
187: 
188:     async fn run_loop(&mut self) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
189:         loop {
190:             if let Some(max) = self.config.max_turns
191:                 && self.num_turns >= max
192:             {
193:                 self.emit_done(None)?;
194:                 return Ok(());
195:             }
196:             match self.turn().await? {
197:                 TurnOutcome::Continue => {}
198:                 TurnOutcome::Done(stop_reason) => {
199:                     self.emit_done(stop_reason)?;
200:                     return Ok(());
201:                 }
202:             }
203:         }
204:     }
205: 
206:     async fn turn(&mut self) -> Result<TurnOutcome, AgentError> {
207:         if self.cancel.is_cancelled() {
208:             return Err(AgentError::Cancelled);
209:         }
210:         let response = match stream_with_retry(
211:             &*self.provider,
212:             &self.model,
213:             self.history.as_slice(),
214:             &self.system,
215:             &self.tools,
216:             &self.event_tx,
217:             &self.cancel,
218:             self.opts,
219:             self.session_id.as_deref(),
220:         )
221:         .await
222:         {
223:             Ok(r) => {
224:                 self.reauth_attempts = 0;
225:                 r
226:             }
227:             Err(e) if e.is_auth_error() => {
228:                 return self.wait_for_reauth(e).await;
229:             }
230:             Err(e) => {
231:                 error!(error = %e, model = %self.model.id, self.num_turns, "stream_message failed");
232:                 return Err(e);
233:             }
234:         };
235:         self.num_turns += 1;
236: 
237:         let has_tools = response.message.has_tool_calls();
238:         let stop_reason = response.stop_reason;
239:         info!(
240:             input_tokens = response.usage.input,
241:             output_tokens = response.usage.output,
242:             cache_creation = response.usage.cache_creation,
243:             cache_read = response.usage.cache_read,
244:             has_tools,
245:             self.num_turns,
246:             model = %self.model.id,
247:             stop_reason = stop_reason.map_or("none", Into::into),
248:             "API response received"
249:         );
250: 
251:         self.emit_turn_complete(&response)?;
252:         let usage = response.usage;
253:         self.total_usage += usage;
254:         self.context_size = usage.total_input();
255: 
256:         if has_tools {
257:             let history_len_before = self.history.len();
258:             self.process_tool_calls(response).await?;
259:             self.context_size +=
260:                 estimate_message_tokens(&self.history.as_slice()[history_len_before..]);
261:         } else {
262:             self.history.push(response.message);
263: 
264:             if stop_reason == Some(StopReason::MaxTokens)
265:                 && self.num_turns <= self.config.max_continuation_turns
266:             {
267:                 warn!(
268:                     self.num_turns,
269:                     "response truncated (max_tokens), re-prompting"
270:                 );
271:                 return Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue);
272:             }
273:         }
274: 
275:         if self.try_auto_compact().await? || self.handle_queued_command().await? {
276:             return Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue);
277:         }
278: 
279:         if has_tools {
280:             Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue)
281:         } else {
282:             Ok(TurnOutcome::Done(stop_reason))
283:         }
284:     }
285: 
286:     async fn wait_for_reauth(&mut self, err: AgentError) -> Result<TurnOutcome, AgentError> {
287:         if self.reauth_attempts >= MAX_REAUTH_ATTEMPTS {
288:             error!(error = %err, attempts = self.reauth_attempts, "max re-auth attempts reached");
289:             return Err(err);
290:         }
291:         let Some(rx) = &self.user_response_rx else {
292:             error!(error = %err, model = %self.model.id, self.num_turns, "stream_message failed");
293:             return Err(err);
294:         };
295:         self.reauth_attempts += 1;
296:         warn!(error = %err, attempt = self.reauth_attempts, "auth error, waiting for re-authentication");
297:         self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::AuthRequired)?;
298:         let rx = rx.lock().await;
299:         match futures_lite::future::race(rx.recv_async(), async {
300:             self.cancel.cancelled().await;
301:             Err(flume::RecvError::Disconnected)
302:         })
303:         .await
304:         {
305:             Ok(_) => {
306:                 self.provider.refresh_auth().await?;
307:                 Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue)
308:             }
309:             Err(_) => Err(AgentError::Cancelled),
310:         }
311:     }
312: 
313:     fn emit_turn_complete(&self, response: &StreamResponse) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
314:         self.event_tx
315:             .send(AgentEvent::TurnComplete(Box::new(TurnCompleteEvent {
316:                 message: response.message.clone(),
317:                 usage: response.usage,
318:                 model: self.model.id.clone(),
319:                 context_size: Some(response.usage.context_tokens()),
320:             })))
321:     }
322: 
323:     fn emit_done(&self, stop_reason: Option<StopReason>) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
324:         info!(
325:             self.num_turns,
326:             total_input = self.total_usage.input,
327:             total_output = self.total_usage.output,
328:             "agent run completed"
329:         );
330:         self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::Done {
331:             usage: self.total_usage,
332:             num_turns: self.num_turns,
333:             stop_reason,
334:         })
335:     }

372: 
373:     async fn try_auto_compact(&mut self) -> Result<bool, AgentError> {
374:         if !self.auto_compact
375:             || !compaction::is_overflow(
376:                 &TokenUsage {
377:                     input: self.context_size,
378:                     ..Default::default()
379:                 },
380:                 &self.model,
381:                 self.config.compaction_buffer,
382:             )
383:         {
384:             return Ok(false);
385:         }
386:         info!(context_size = self.context_size, "auto-compacting");
387:         self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::AutoCompacting)?;
388:         self.do_compact().await?;
389:         Ok(true)
390:     }
391: 
392:     async fn do_compact(&mut self) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
393:         let (compact_provider, compact_model) =
394:             resolve_compaction_model(&self.provider, &self.model, self.timeouts);
395:         self.total_usage += compaction::compact_history(
396:             &*compact_provider,
397:             &compact_model,
398:             self.history,
399:             &self.event_tx,
400:             &self.cancel,
401:             None,
402:         )
403:         .await?;
404:         self.rollback_len = self.history.len();
405:         self.history
406:             .push(Message::synthetic(CONTINUE_AFTER_COMPACT.into()));
407:         Ok(())
408:     }
409: 
410:     async fn do_checkpoint(&mut self) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
411:         let (provider, model) =
412:             resolve_compaction_model(&self.provider, &self.model, self.timeouts);
413:         self.total_usage += compaction::checkpoint_history(
414:             &*provider,
415:             &model,
416:             self.history,
417:             &self.event_tx,
418:             &self.cancel,
419:             None,
420:         )
421:         .await?;
422:         Ok(())
423:     }
424: 
425:     async fn handle_queued_command(&mut self) -> Result<bool, AgentError> {
426:         let Some(ref source) = self.interrupt_source else {
427:             return Ok(false);
428:         };
429:         let Some(cmd) = source.poll() else {
430:             return Ok(false);
431:         };
432:         match cmd {
433:             ExtractedCommand::Interrupt(mut input, _) => {
434:                 self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::QueueItemConsumed {
435:                     text: input.message.clone(),
436:                     image_count: input.images.len(),
437:                 })?;
438:                 for msg in std::mem::take(&mut input.preamble) {
439:                     self.history.push(msg);
440:                 }
441:                 self.mode = input.mode.clone();
442:                 let display = input.message.clone();
443:                 let wrapped = format!(
444:                     "<user-interrupt>\nThe user sent a new message while you were working. Address it and continue.\n\n{display}\n</user-interrupt>"
445:                 );
446:                 self.history.push(Message::user_display(wrapped, display));
447:             }
448:             ExtractedCommand::Compact(_) => {
449:                 self.do_compact().await?;
450:             }
451:             ExtractedCommand::Checkpoint(_) => {
452:                 self.do_checkpoint().await?;
453:             }
454:         }
455:         Ok(true)
456:     }
457: }
458: 
459: const CHARS_PER_TOKEN: usize = 4;
460: 
461: fn estimate_message_tokens(messages: &[Message]) -> u32 {
462:     let total_bytes: usize = messages
463:         .iter()
464:         .flat_map(|m| &m.content)
465:         .filter_map(|b| match b {
466:             ContentBlock::Text { text } => Some(text.len()),
467:             ContentBlock::ToolResult { content, .. } => Some(content.len()),
468:             ContentBlock::ToolUse { input, .. } => Some(input.to_string().len()),
469:             _ => None,
470:         })
471:         .sum();
472:     (total_bytes.max(CHARS_PER_TOKEN) / CHARS_PER_TOKEN) as u32
473: }
```

```
60: pub(crate) fn hint_line<K: AsRef<str>, V: AsRef<str>>(pairs: &[(K, V)]) -> Line<'static> {
61:     let t = crate::theme::current();
62:     let mut spans = Vec::with_capacity(pairs.len() * 3);
63:     for (key, desc) in pairs {
64:         spans.push(Span::raw("  "));
65:         for (i, part) in key.as_ref().split('/').enumerate() {
66:             if i > 0 {
67:                 spans.push(Span::styled("/", t.tool_dim));
68:             }
69:             spans.push(Span::styled(part.to_string(), t.keybind_key));
70:         }
71:         spans.push(Span::styled(format!(" {}", desc.as_ref()), t.tool_dim));
72:     }
73:     Line::from(spans)
74: }

115:             ..Self::new()
116:         }
117:     }
118: 
119:     pub fn reset(&mut self) {
120:         let auto_scroll = self.auto_scroll;
121:         *self = Self::new();
122:         self.auto_scroll = auto_scroll;
123:     }
124: 
125:     pub fn offset(&self) -> u16 {
126:         self.offset
127:     }
128: 
129:     pub fn update_dimensions(&mut self, total: u16, viewport_h: u16) {
130:         self.viewport_h = viewport_h;
131:         self.max_offset = total.saturating_sub(viewport_h);
132:         if self.auto_scroll {
133:             self.offset = self.max_offset;
134:         } else {
135:             self.clamp();
136:             if self.offset >= self.max_offset {
137:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
138:             }
139:         }
140:     }
141: 
142:     pub fn scroll(&mut self, delta: i32) {
143:         self.offset = apply_scroll_delta(self.offset, delta);
144:         self.clamp();
145:         self.auto_scroll = self.offset >= self.max_offset;
146:     }
147: 
148:     pub fn handle_key(&mut self, key_event: KeyEvent) -> bool {
149:         use keybindings::key;
150:         match key_event.code {
151:             KeyCode::Up => self.scroll(1),
152:             KeyCode::Down => self.scroll(-1),
153:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(self.half_page()),
154:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-self.half_page()),
155:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(1),
156:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-1),
157:             _ if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key_event) => {
158:                 self.offset = 0;
159:                 self.auto_scroll = false;
160:             }
161:             _ if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key_event) => {
162:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
163:                 self.offset = self.max_offset;
164:             }
165:             _ => return false,
166:         }
167:         true
168:     }
169: 
170:     fn half_page(&self) -> i32 {
171:         (self.viewport_h / 2).max(1) as i32
172:     }
173: 
174:     fn clamp(&mut self) {
175:         self.offset = self.offset.min(self.max_offset);
176:     }
177: }
```

```
82: fn merge_batch(
83:     available: &Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>>,
84:     batch: maki_providers::provider::ModelBatch,
85:     warn_tx: &flume::Sender<String>,
86: ) {
87:     for w in batch.warnings {
88:         let _ = warn_tx.try_send(w);
89:     }
90:     if batch.models.is_empty() {
91:         return;
92:     }
93:     let mut merged = available.load().as_deref().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
94:     for spec in &batch.models {
95:         if !merged.contains(spec) {
96:             merged.push(spec.clone());
97:         }
98:     }
99:     available.store(Some(Arc::new(merged)));
100: }
101: 
102: fn spawn_model_fetch(model_slot: &Arc<ArcSwap<ModelSlot>>, timeouts: Timeouts) -> BackgroundModels {
103:     let available: Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>> = Arc::new(ArcSwapOption::empty());
104:     let bg = Arc::clone(&available);
105:     let (warn_tx, warn_rx) = flume::unbounded::<String>();
106:     let warn_tx_bg = warn_tx.clone();
107:     let model_slot = Arc::clone(model_slot);
108:     let task = smol::spawn(async move {
109:         let warn_tx = warn_tx_bg;
110:         let done = Box::new(move || {
111:             let spec = model_slot.load().model.spec();
112:             let mut resolved = match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
113:                 Ok(m) => m,
114:                 Err(e) => {
115:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to resolve model after discovery");
116:                     return;
117:                 }
118:             };
119:             let provider = match from_model(&mut resolved, timeouts) {
120:                 Ok(p) => p,
121:                 Err(e) => {
122:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to create provider after discovery");
123:                     return;
124:                 }
125:             };
126:             model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
127:                 model: resolved,
128:                 provider: Arc::from(provider),
129:             }));
130:         });
131:         fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&bg, batch, &warn_tx), Some(done)).await;
132:     });
133:     BackgroundModels {
134:         available,
135:         warn_rx,
136:         warn_tx,
137:         task,
138:     }
139: }

372:     fn poll_and_handle_input(&mut self, had_agent_msg: bool) -> Result<()> {

393:     fn translate_input(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Msg>> {
394:         let raw = event::read()?;
395:         match raw {
396:             Event::Key(key) if key.kind == KeyEventKind::Press => Ok(Some(Msg::Key(key))),
397:             Event::Key(_) => Ok(None),
398:             Event::Paste(text) => Ok(Some(Msg::Paste(text))),
399:             Event::Mouse(mouse) => Ok(self.translate_mouse(mouse)),
400:             _ => Ok(None),
401:         }
402:     }
```
