404:     fn translate_mouse(&mut self, mouse: CtMouseEvent) -> Option<Msg> {
405:         match mouse.kind {
406:             MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
407:                 let (scroll, extra) = aggregate_scroll(
408:                     mouse.column,
409:                     mouse.row,
410:                     scroll_delta(mouse.kind, self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines),
411:                     self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines,
412:                 );
413:                 if let Some(extra) = extra {
414:                     let actions = self.app.update(scroll);
415:                     self.dispatch(actions);
416:                     Some(extra)
417:                 } else {
418:                     Some(scroll)
419:                 }
420:             }
421:             MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left) => {
422:                 let (drag, extra) = coalesce_drag(mouse);
423:                 let actions = self.app.update(Msg::Mouse(drag));
424:                 self.dispatch(actions);
425:                 extra
426:             }
427:             _ => Some(Msg::Mouse(mouse)),
428:         }
429:     }

542:             }
543:             Action::EditInputInEditor => {
544:                 let current_text = self.app.input_box.buffer.value();
545:                 match terminal::edit_temp_content(&current_text, self.terminal) {
546:                     Ok(edited) => self.app.input_box.set_input(edited),
547:                     Err(e) => self.app.flash(e),
548:                 }
549:             }
550:             Action::EditSystemPrompt => {
551:                 match maki_storage::paths::config_dir() {
552:                     Ok(config_dir) => {
553:                         let path = config_dir.join("system.md");
554:                         if !path.exists()
555:                             && let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&path, maki_agent::prompt::SYSTEM_PROMPT)
556:                         {
557:                             self.app.flash(format!("Failed to create system.md: {e}"));
558:                             return;
559:                         }
560:                         if let Err(e) = terminal::open_in_editor(&path, self.terminal) {
561:                             self.app.flash(e);
562:                         }
563:                     }
564:                     Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Failed to get config directory: {e}")),
565:                 }
566:             }
567:             Action::RunLogsCommand => {
568:                 let settings = crate::components::settings_picker::UserSettings::load();
569:                 let log_path = self.app.storage.path().join("maki.log");
570:                 let log_path_str = log_path.to_string_lossy();
571:                 let cmd_string = match &settings.log_command {
572:                     Some(cmd) if !cmd.trim().is_empty() => cmd.clone(),
573:                     _ => "less +G {}".to_string(),
574:                 };
575:                 let cmd_string = cmd_string
576:                     .replace("<path>", &log_path_str)
577:                     .replace("alog", &log_path_str)
578:                     .replace("{}", &log_path_str);
579: 
580:                 if let Err(e) = terminal::run_view_log_command(&cmd_string, self.terminal) {
581:                     self.app.flash(e);
582:                 }
583:             }
584:             Action::Btw(question) => {
585:                 let slot = self.model_slot.load();
586:                 self.app
587:                     .start_btw(question, Arc::clone(&slot.provider), slot.model.clone());
588:             }
589:             Action::RenameSession(messages) => {
590:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Rename {
591:                     messages,
592:                     run_id: self.app.run_id,
593:                 });
594:             }
595:             Action::Suspend => terminal::suspend(self.terminal),
596:             Action::RefreshModels => self.refresh_models(),
597:             Action::Quit => {}
598:         }
599:     }
600: 
601:     fn change_model(&mut self, spec: String) {
602:         match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
603:             Ok(mut new_model) => match from_model(&mut new_model, self.timeouts) {
604:                 Ok(new_provider) => {
605:                     self.app.update_model(&new_model);
606:                     self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
607:                         model: new_model,
608:                         provider: Arc::from(new_provider),
609:                     }));
610:                 }
611:                 Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Failed to create provider: {e}")),
612:             },
613:             Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Invalid model: {e}")),
614:         }
615:     }
616: 
617:     fn refresh_models(&self) {
618:         let available = Arc::clone(&self.available_models);
619:         let warn_tx = self.warn_tx.clone();
620:         available.store(None);
621:         smol::spawn(async move {
622:             fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&available, batch, &warn_tx), None).await;
623:         })
624:         .detach();
625:     }
626: 
627:     fn refresh_provider(&mut self, slug: String) {
628:         let current = self.model_slot.load();
629:         let current_model = &current.model;
630: 
631:         if current_model.provider.to_string() == slug {
632:             let mut m = current_model.clone();
633:             if let Ok(provider) = maki_providers::provider::from_model(&mut m, self.timeouts) {
634:                 self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
635:                     model: m,
636:                     provider: Arc::from(provider),
637:                 }));
638:             }
639:         } else if let Some(builtin) = maki_config::providers::builtin_provider(&slug) {
640:             let spec = builtin.default_model.to_string();
641:             self.change_model(spec);
642:         }
643:     }
644: 
645:     fn shutdown(mut self) -> (Option<String>, i32) {
646:         let settings = crate::components::settings_picker::UserSettings::load();
647:         settings.save();
648: 
649:         let exit_code = self.app.exit_request.code();
650:         let session_id = self
651:             .app
652:             .has_content()
653:             .then(|| self.app.state.session.id.clone());
654:         maki_agent::mcp::kill_process_groups(&self.handles.mcp_reader().load().pids);
655:         self.app.cmd_tx = None;
656:         self.app.answer_tx = None;
657:         drop(self.app);
658:         self.handles.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3));
659:         match Arc::try_unwrap(self.storage_writer) {
660:             Ok(writer) => writer.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3)),
661:             Err(_) => {
662:                 warn!("storage writer has outstanding references, skipping graceful shutdown")
663:             }
664:         }
665:         (session_id, exit_code)
666:     }
667: }
668: 
669: fn scroll_delta(kind: MouseEventKind, lines: u32) -> i32 {
670:     if kind == MouseEventKind::ScrollUp {
671:         lines as i32
672:     } else {
673:         -(lines as i32)
674:     }
675: }
676: 
677: fn aggregate_scroll(
678:     column: u16,
679:     row: u16,
680:     mut delta: i32,
681:     scroll_lines: u32,
682: ) -> (Msg, Option<Msg>) {
683:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
684:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
685:             match next.kind {
686:                 MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
687:                     delta += scroll_delta(next.kind, scroll_lines);
688:                 }
689:                 _ => return (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, Some(Msg::Mouse(next))),
690:             }
691:         } else {
692:             break;
693:         }
694:     }
695:     (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, None)
696: }
697: 
698: fn coalesce_drag(mut latest: CtMouseEvent) -> (CtMouseEvent, Option<Msg>) {
699:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
700:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
701:             if matches!(next.kind, MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left)) {
702:                 latest = next;
703:             } else {
704:                 return (latest, Some(Msg::Mouse(next)));
705:             }
706:         } else {
707:             break;
708:         }
709:     }
710:     (latest, None)
711: }

353:     pub fn update(&mut self, msg: Msg) -> Vec<Action> {
354:         match msg {
355:             Msg::Key(key) => self.handle_key(key),
356:             Msg::Paste(text) => {
357:                 let text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace('\r', "\n");
358:                 if text.is_empty() {
359:                     if self.is_main_chat() && self.image_paste_rx.is_empty() {
360:                         self.start_image_paste();
361:                     }
362:                 } else {
363:                     let mut any_image = false;
364:                     if self.is_main_chat() {
365:                         for line in text.lines() {
366:                             if let Some((path, mt)) = image::try_parse_image_path(line) {
367:                                 self.start_file_image_paste(path, mt);
368:                                 any_image = true;
369:                             }
370:                         }
371:                     }
372:                     if !any_image {
373:                         self.route_text_paste(&text);
374:                     }
375:                 }
376:                 vec![]
377:             }
378:             Msg::Mouse(event) => {
379:                 self.handle_mouse(event);
380:                 vec![]
381:             }
382:             Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta } => {
383:                 self.clear_selection_unless_pending_copy();
384:                 self.handle_scroll(column, row, delta);
385:                 vec![]
386:             }
387:             Msg::Agent(envelope) => self.handle_agent_event(*envelope),
388:         }
389:     }

391:     fn send_answer(&self, answer: String) {
392:         if let Some(tx) = &self.answer_tx {
393:             let _ = tx.try_send(answer);
394:         }
395:     }
396: 
397:     fn send_to_agent(&self, subagent_id: Option<&str>, answer: String) {
398:         let routed = subagent_id.and_then(|id| self.subagent_answers.get(id));
399:         if let Some(tx) = routed {
400:             let _ = tx.try_send(answer);
401:         } else {
402:             self.send_answer(answer);
403:         }
404:     }
405: 
406:     fn handle_scroll(&mut self, column: u16, row: u16, delta: i32) {
407:         if self.btw_modal.is_open() {
408:             self.btw_modal.scroll(delta);
409:             return;
410:         }
411:         if self.help_modal.is_open() {
412:             self.help_modal.scroll(delta);
413:             return;
414:         }
415:         let pos = Position::new(column, row);
416:         if self.float_mgr.is_open() && self.float_mgr.contains(pos) {
417:             self.float_mgr.scroll(delta);
418:             return;
419:         }
420:         macro_rules! try_picker {
421:             ($picker:expr) => {
422:                 if $picker.is_open() {
423:                     if $picker.contains(pos) {
424:                         $picker.scroll(delta);
425:                     }
426:                     return;
427:                 }
428:             };
429:         }
430:         try_picker!(self.session_picker);
431:         try_picker!(self.rewind_picker);
432:         try_picker!(self.goto_picker);
433:         try_picker!(self.task_picker);
434:         try_picker!(self.model_picker);
435:         try_picker!(self.file_picker);
436:         if let Some(zone) = self.zone_at(row, column) {
437:             self.scroll_zone(zone.zone, delta);
438:         }
439:     }
440: 
441:     fn open_tasks(&mut self) {
442:         let entries: Vec<TaskEntry> = self
443:             .chats
444:             .iter()
445:             .enumerate()
446:             .map(|(i, c)| TaskEntry {
447:                 name: c.name.clone(),
448:                 finished: (i > 0).then_some(c.is_finished()),
449:             })
450:             .collect();
451:         self.task_picker_original = Some(self.active_chat);
452:         self.task_picker.open(entries, " Tasks ");
453:         self.task_picker.select(self.active_chat);
454:     }

456:     /// Ctrl shortcuts that apply when no overlay owns input.
457:     fn handle_ctrl(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Option<Vec<Action>> {
458:         if !is_ctrl(&key) {
459:             return None;
460:         }
461:         if key::DELETE_CURRENT_SESSION.matches(key) {
462:             let session_id = self.state.session.id.clone();
463: 
464:             // 1. Delete the session from storage
465:             if let Err(e) = AppSession::delete(&session_id, &self.storage) {
466:                 self.status_bar.flash(format!("Failed to delete session: {e}"));
467:             } else {
468:                 self.status_bar.flash("Session deleted".into());
469:                 self.session_picker.remove_entry(&session_id);
470: 
471:                 // 2. Open the sessions list popup window directly
472:                 self.open_session_picker();
473:             }
474:             return Some(vec![]);
475:         }
476:         if key::TOGGLE_GLOBAL_SESSIONS.matches(key) {
477:             let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
478:             settings.global_sessions = !settings.global_sessions;
479:             settings.save();
480:             if settings.global_sessions {
481:                 self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions enabled".into());
482:             } else {
483:                 self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions disabled".into());
484:             }
485:             if self.session_picker.is_open() {
486:                 self.open_session_picker();
487:             }
488:             return Some(vec![]);
489:         }
490:         if key::QUIT.matches(key) {
491:             self.command_palette.close();
492:             return Some(if !self.is_main_chat() || self.input_box.is_empty() {
493:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
494:                     return Some(self.handle_cancel());
495:                 }
496:                 self.quit()
497:             } else {
498:                 self.input_box.discard();
499:                 vec![]
500:             });
501:         }
502:         if key::HELP.matches(key) {
503:             self.help_modal.toggle();
504:             return Some(vec![]);
505:         }
506:         if key::TOGGLE_VERBOSE.matches(key) {
507:             self.verbose = !self.verbose;
508:             let verbose = self.verbose;
509:             for chat in &mut self.chats {
510:                 chat.set_verbose(verbose);
511:             }
512:             return Some(vec![]);
513:         }
514:         if key::TASKS.matches(key) {
515:             self.open_tasks();
516:             return Some(vec![]);
517:         }
518:         if key::PREV_CHAT.matches(key) {
519:             self.active_chat = self.active_chat.saturating_sub(1);
520:             return Some(vec![]);
521:         }
522:         if key::NEXT_CHAT.matches(key) {
523:             self.active_chat = (self.active_chat + 1).min(self.chats.len() - 1);
524:             return Some(vec![]);
525:         }
526:         if key::SCROLL_HALF_UP.matches(key) {
527:             let half = self.chats[self.active_chat].half_page();
528:             self.active_chat().scroll(half);
529:             return Some(vec![]);
530:         }
531:         if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key) {
532:             let half = self.chats[self.active_chat].half_page();
533:             self.active_chat().scroll(-half);
534:             return Some(vec![]);
535:         }
536:         if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key) {
537:             self.active_chat().scroll_to_top();
538:             return Some(vec![]);
539:         }
540:         if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key) {
541:             self.active_chat().enable_auto_scroll();
542:             return Some(vec![]);
543:         }
544:         if key::PLAN_TOGGLE.matches(key)
545:             && self.state.mode == Mode::Plan
546:             && self.state.plan.is_ready()
547:         {
548:             self.plan_form.toggle();
549:             return Some(vec![]);
550:         }
551:         None
552:     }
553: 
554:     /// Routes input to whichever overlay currently owns focus.
555:     /// Returns `Some` when an overlay is open (consuming the key),
556:     /// `None` when no overlay is active and input should continue.
557:     fn dispatch_overlay(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Option<Vec<Action>> {
558:         if self.permission_prompt.is_open() {
559:             if let Some(answer) = self.permission_prompt.handle_key(key) {
560:                 let subagent_id = self.permission_prompt.subagent_id().map(str::to_owned);
561:                 let encoded = answer.encode();
562:                 self.permission_prompt.close();
563:                 self.send_to_agent(subagent_id.as_deref(), encoded);
564:             }
565:             return Some(vec![]);
566:         }
567: 
568:         // plan_form is non-modal: Passthrough falls through to the rest of dispatch
569:         if self.plan_form_active() {
570:             let action = self.plan_form.handle_key(key);
571:             if action != PlanFormAction::Passthrough {
572:                 return Some(self.handle_plan_form_action(action));
573:             }
574:         }
575: 
576:         if self.help_modal.is_open() {
577:             self.help_modal.handle_key(key);
578:             return Some(vec![]);
579:         }
580: 
581:         if self.plugins_modal.is_open() {
582:             match self.plugins_modal.handle_key(key) {
583:                 PluginsAction::EditPlugin(path) => {
584:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
585:                 }
586:                 PluginsAction::None => {
587:                     return Some(vec![]);
588:                 }
589:             }
590:         }
591: 
592:         if self.skills_modal.is_open() {
593:             match self.skills_modal.handle_key(key) {
594:                 SkillsAction::CreateSkill(path) => {
595:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
596:                 }
597:                 SkillsAction::EditSkillsJson(path) => {
598:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
599:                 }
600:                 SkillsAction::EditSkill(path) => {
601:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
602:                 }
603:                 SkillsAction::None => {
604:                     return Some(vec![]);
605:                 }
606:             }
607:         }
608: 
609:         if self.export_picker.is_open() {
610:             match self.export_picker.handle_key(key) {
611:                 ExportPickerAction::Select(entry) => {
612:                     let settings = UserSettings::load();
613:                     let base_path = settings.resolved_export_path(std::path::Path::new(&self.state.session.cwd));
614:                     match entry.export_type {
615:                         ExportType::MarkdownClipboard => {
616:                             let text = self.export_session_to_markdown();
617:                             match self.clipboard.copy_text(&text) {
618:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Copied) => {
619:                                     self.flash("Copied transcript to clipboard".into());
620:                                 }
621:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Noop) => {}
622:                                 Err(e) => {
623:                                     self.flash(format!("Copy failed: {e}"));
624:                                 }
625:                             }
626:                         }
627:                         ExportType::MarkdownSave => {
628:                             let text = self.export_session_to_markdown();
629:                             let filepath = if base_path.is_file() {
630:                                 base_path
631:                             } else {
632:                                 let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&base_path);
633:                                 base_path.join(format!("session-{}.md", self.state.session.id))
634:                             };
635:                             match std::fs::write(&filepath, text) {
636:                                 Ok(_) => self.flash(format!("Saved transcript to {}", filepath.display())),
637:                                 Err(e) => self.flash(format!("Failed to save transcript: {e}")),
638:                             }
639:                         }
640:                         ExportType::JsonClipboard => {
641:                             let text = self.export_session_to_json();
642:                             match self.clipboard.copy_text(&text) {
643:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Copied) => {
644:                                     self.flash("Copied JSON session to clipboard".into());
645:                                 }
646:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Noop) => {}
647:                                 Err(e) => {
648:                                     self.flash(format!("Copy failed: {e}"));
649:                                 }
650:                             }
651:                         }
652:                         ExportType::JsonSave => {
653:                             let text = self.export_session_to_json();
654:                             let filepath = if base_path.is_file() {
655:                                 base_path
656:                             } else {
657:                                 let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&base_path);
658:                                 base_path.join(format!("session-{}.json", self.state.session.id))
659:                             };
660:                             match std::fs::write(&filepath, text) {
661:                                 Ok(_) => self.flash(format!("Saved JSON session to {}", filepath.display())),
662:                                 Err(e) => self.flash(format!("Failed to save JSON session: {e}")),
663:                             }
664:                         }
665:                     }
666:                 }
667:                 ExportPickerAction::Consumed => {}
668:                 ExportPickerAction::Close => {}
669:             }
670:             return Some(vec![]);
671:         }
672: 
673:         if self.btw_modal.is_open() {
674:             self.btw_modal.handle_key(key);
675:             return Some(vec![]);
676:         }
677: 
678:         if self.float_mgr.handle_key(key) {
679:             return Some(vec![]);
680:         }
681: 
682:         if self.search_modal.is_open() {
683:             match self.search_modal.handle_key(key) {
684:                 SearchAction::Consumed => {
685:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
686:                     let texts = chat.segment_search_texts();
687:                     self.search_modal.update_matches(&texts);
688:                     sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, chat);
689:                 }
690:                 SearchAction::Navigate => {
691:                     sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, &mut self.chats[self.active_chat]);
692:                 }
693:                 SearchAction::Select(idx) => {
694:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
695:                     chat.scroll_to_segment(idx);
696:                     chat.set_highlight_segment(None);
697:                     self.search_modal.close();
698:                 }
699:                 SearchAction::Close(saved) => {
700:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
701:                     chat.set_highlight_segment(None);
702:                     if let Some((top, auto)) = saved {
703:                         chat.restore_scroll(top, auto);
704:                     }
705:                     self.search_modal.close();
706:                 }
707:             }
708:             return Some(vec![]);
709:         }
710: 
711:         if self.file_picker.is_open() {
712:             return Some(match self.file_picker.handle_key(key) {
713:                 FilePickerModalAction::Consumed => vec![],
714:                 FilePickerModalAction::Select(path) => {
715:                     self.file_picker.close();
716:                     if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) =
717:                         self.input_box.handle_paste_with_spaces(&path)
718:                     {
719:                         self.command_palette.sync(&val);
720:                     }
721:                     vec![]
722:                 }
723:                 FilePickerModalAction::Close => {
724:                     self.file_picker.close();
725:                     vec![]
726:                 }
727:             });
728:         }
729: 
730:         if self.queue.focus().is_some() {
731:             match key.code {
732:                 KeyCode::Up => self.queue.move_focus_up(),
733:                 KeyCode::Down => self.queue.move_focus_down(),
734:                 KeyCode::Enter => {
735:                     self.queue.remove_focused();
736:                 }
737:                 KeyCode::Esc => self.queue.unfocus(),
738:                 _ if key::QUIT.matches(key) => self.queue.unfocus(),
739:                 _ if key::POP_QUEUE.matches(key) => {
740:                     self.queue.remove(0);
741:                 }
742:                 _ => {}
743:             }
744:             return Some(vec![]);
745:         }
746: 
747:         if self.task_picker.is_open() {
748:             if key::TASKS.matches(key) {
749:                 self.task_picker.close();
750:                 return Some(vec![]);
751:             }
752:             return Some(match self.task_picker.handle_key(key) {
753:                 PickerAction::Consumed | PickerAction::Toggle(..) => vec![],
754:                 PickerAction::Select(idx, _) => {
755:                     self.task_picker_original = None;
756:                     self.active_chat = idx;
757:                     vec![]
758:                 }
759:                 PickerAction::Close => {
760:                     self.active_chat = self.task_picker_original.take().unwrap_or(0);
761:                     vec![]
762:                 }
763:             });
764:         }
765: 
766:         if self.session_picker.is_open() {
767:             return Some(match self.session_picker.handle_key(key) {
768:                 SessionPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
769:                 SessionPickerAction::Select(id) => self.load_session(id),
770:                 SessionPickerAction::ConfirmDelete => {
771:                     self.status_bar.flash(format!(
772:                         "Press {} again to confirm delete",
773:                         key::DELETE.label()
774:                     ));
775:                     vec![]
776:                 }
777:                 SessionPickerAction::Delete(id) => self.delete_session(id),
778:                 SessionPickerAction::Close => vec![],
779:             });
780:         }
781: 
782:         if self.rewind_picker.is_open() {
783:             return Some(match self.rewind_picker.handle_key(key) {
784:                 RewindPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
785:                 RewindPickerAction::Select(entry) => self.rewind_to(entry),
786:                 RewindPickerAction::Close => vec![],
787:             });
788:         }
789: 
790:         if self.goto_picker.is_open() {
791:             return Some(match self.goto_picker.handle_key(key) {
792:                 GotoPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
793:                 GotoPickerAction::Select(entry) => self.scroll_to_turn(entry),
794:                 GotoPickerAction::Close => vec![],
795:             });
796:         }
797: 
798:         if self.theme_picker.is_open() {
799:             return Some(match self.theme_picker.handle_key(key) {
800:                 ThemePickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
801:                 ThemePickerAction::Closed => vec![],
802:             });
803:         }
804: 
805:         if self.settings_picker.is_open() {
806:             return Some(match self.settings_picker.handle_key(key) {
807:                 SettingsPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
808:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowSystemPrompt(val) => {
809:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
810:                     settings.show_system_prompt = val;
811:                     settings.save();
812: 
813:                     self.state.session.meta.show_system_prompt = val;
814:                     for chat in &mut self.chats {
815:                         chat.set_system_prompt(val, self.state.session.meta.system_prompt.clone());
816:                     }
817:                     self.save_session();
818:                     vec![]
819:                 }
820:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleApiLogging(val) => {
821:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
822:                     settings.api_logging = val;
823:                     settings.save();
824: 
825:                     maki_config::LOG_API.store(val, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
826:                     self.save_session();
827:                     vec![]
828:                 }
829:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowReasoning(val) => {
830:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
831:                     settings.show_reasoning = val;
832:                     settings.save();
833: 
834:                     self.state.session.meta.show_reasoning = val;
835:                     self.save_session();
836:                     for chat in &mut self.chats {
837:                         chat.set_show_reasoning(val);
838:                     }
839:                     vec![]
840:                 }
841:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowTokenStats(val) => {
842:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
843:                     settings.show_token_stats = val;
844:                     settings.save();
845:                     self.show_token_stats = val;
846:                     vec![]
847:                 }
848:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleGlobalSessions(val) => {
849:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
850:                     settings.global_sessions = val;
851:                     settings.save();
852:                     if val {
853:                         self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions enabled".into());
854:                     } else {
855:                         self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions disabled".into());
856:                     }
857:                     vec![]
858:                 }
859:                 SettingsPickerAction::EditLogCommand => {
860:                     self.settings_picker.close();
861:                     if let Ok(path) = crate::config::config_path() {
862:                         vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]
863:                     } else {
864:                         vec![]
865:                     }
866:                 }
867:                 SettingsPickerAction::Closed => vec![],
868:             });
869:         }
870: 
871:         if self.model_picker.is_open() {
872:             return Some(match self.model_picker.handle_key(key) {
873:                 ModelPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
874:                 ModelPickerAction::Select(spec) => {
875:                     vec![Action::ChangeModel(spec)]
876:                 }
877:                 ModelPickerAction::AssignTier(spec, tier) => {

883:                 ModelPickerAction::Close => vec![],

887:         if self.login_picker.is_open() {

889:                 LoginPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
890:                 LoginPickerAction::Close => vec![],
891:                 LoginPickerAction::Authenticated { model_spec } => {
892:                     vec![Action::ChangeModel(model_spec), Action::RefreshModels]
893:                 }
894:                 LoginPickerAction::Configured { slug } => {
895:                     vec![Action::RefreshProvider { slug }, Action::RefreshModels]
896:                 }
897:             });

899: 
900:         if self.mcp_picker.is_open() {

902:                 McpPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],

904:                     server_name,
905:                     enabled,

913:         None

916:     fn handle_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Vec<Action> {
917:         self.clear_selection_unless_pending_copy();
918: 
919:         if key::SUSPEND.matches(key) && cfg!(unix) {
920:             return self.suspend();
921:         }
922: 
923:         if let Some(actions) = self.dispatch_overlay(key) {
924:             return actions;
925:         }
926: 
927:         if let Some(actions) = self.handle_ctrl(key) {
928:             return actions;
929:         }
930: 
931:         if self.dispatch_plugin_keymap(key) {
932:             return vec![];
933:         }
934: 
935:         if !self.is_main_chat() {
936:             return match key.code {
937:                 KeyCode::Tab if !self.is_bash_input() => self.toggle_mode(),
938:                 KeyCode::Esc if !self.chats[self.active_chat].is_finished() => {
939:                     if let Some(t) = self.last_esc.take()
940:                         && t.elapsed() < self.status_bar.flash_duration
941:                     {
942:                         self.handle_subagent_cancel()
943:                     } else {
944:                         self.last_esc = Some(Instant::now());
945:                         self.status_bar.flash(FLASH_CANCEL.into());
946:                         vec![]
947:                     }
948:                 }
949:                 _ => vec![],
950:             };
951:         }
952: 
953:         self.handle_main_chat_key(key)
954:     }
955: 
956:     fn dispatch_plugin_keymap(&self, key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
957:         let snap = self.keymap_reader.load();
958:         for entry in &snap.entries {
959:             if entry.key == key.code && entry.modifiers == key.modifiers {
960:                 if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
961:                     handle.run_keybind_callback(entry.id);
962:                 }
963:                 return true;
964:             }
965:         }
966:         false
967:     }
968: 
969:     fn handle_main_chat_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Vec<Action> {
970:         if key::EDIT_INPUT.matches(key) {
971:             return vec![Action::EditInputInEditor];
972:         }
973:         if key::OPEN_EDITOR.matches(key) {
974:             return match self.state.plan.path() {
975:                 Some(p) => vec![Action::OpenEditor(p.to_path_buf())],
976:                 None => {
977:                     self.flash(FLASH_NO_PLAN.into());
978:                     vec![]
979:                 }
980:             };
981:         }
982:         if key::EDIT_SYSTEM_PROMPT.matches(key) {
983:             return vec![Action::EditSystemPrompt];
984:         }
985:         if key::SESSIONS.matches(key) {
986:             return self.open_session_picker();
987:         }
988:         if key::SHIFT_SESSION_DOWN.matches(key) {
989:             return self.shift_session(true);
990:         }
991:         if key::SHIFT_SESSION_UP.matches(key) {
992:             return self.shift_session(false);
993:         }
994:         if is_ctrl(&key) {
995:             if key::POP_QUEUE.matches(key) {
996:                 self.queue.remove(0);
997:             } else if key::SEARCH.matches(key) {
998:                 let top = self.chats[self.active_chat].scroll_top();
999:                 let auto = self.chats[self.active_chat].auto_scroll();
1000:                 self.search_modal.open(top, auto);
1001:             } else if key::FILE_PICKER.matches(key) {
1002:                 self.file_picker.open(&self.state.session.cwd);
1003:             } else if key.code == KeyCode::Char('v') && self.image_paste_rx.is_empty() {
1004:                 self.start_image_paste();
1005:             } else if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) = self.input_box.handle_key(key) {
1006:                 self.command_palette.sync(&val);
1007:             }
1008:             return vec![];
1009:         }
1010: 
1011:         match self
1012:             .command_palette
1013:             .handle_key(key, &self.input_box.buffer.value())
1014:         {
1015:             CommandAction::Consumed => return vec![],
1016:             CommandAction::Execute(cmd) => return self.execute_command(cmd),
1017:             CommandAction::Complete(text) => {
1018:                 self.command_palette.sync(&text);
1019:                 self.input_box.set_input(text);
1020:                 self.input_box.buffer.move_to_end();
1021:                 return vec![];
1022:             }
1023:             CommandAction::Passthrough => {}
1024:         }
1025: 
1026:         let streaming = self.status == Status::Streaming;
1027:         match self.input_box.handle_key(key) {
1028:             InputAction::Submit(sub) => self.handle_submit(sub),
1029:             InputAction::PaletteSync(val) => {
1030:                 self.command_palette.sync(&val);
1031:                 vec![]
1032:             }
1033:             InputAction::Passthrough(key) => {
1034:                 if key.code != KeyCode::Esc {
1035:                     self.last_esc = None;
1036:                 }
1037:                 match key.code {
1038:                     KeyCode::Up if streaming => {
1039:                         self.active_chat().scroll(1);
1040:                         vec![]
1041:                     }
1042:                     KeyCode::Down if streaming => {
1043:                         self.active_chat().scroll(-1);
1044:                         vec![]
1045:                     }
1046:                     KeyCode::Tab if !self.is_bash_input() => self.toggle_mode(),
1047:                     KeyCode::Esc => {
1048:                         if let Some(t) = self.last_esc.take()
1049:                             && t.elapsed() < self.status_bar.flash_duration
1050:                         {
1051:                             if streaming {
1052:                                 self.handle_cancel()
1053:                             } else {
1054:                                 self.open_rewind_picker()
1055:                             }
1056:                         } else {
1057:                             self.last_esc = Some(Instant::now());
1058:                             self.status_bar.flash(
1059:                                 if streaming {
1060:                                     FLASH_CANCEL
1061:                                 } else {
1062:                                     FLASH_REWIND
1063:                                 }
1064:                                 .into(),
1065:                             );
1066:                             vec![]
1067:                         }
1068:                     }
1069:                     _ => vec![],
1070:                 }
1071:             }
1072:             InputAction::ContinueLine | InputAction::None => vec![],
1073:         }
1074:     }
1075: 
1076:     fn suspend(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1077:         vec![Action::Suspend]
1078:     }
1079: 
1080:     fn quit(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1081:         self.save_session();
1082:         self.save_input_history();
1083:         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Success;
1084:         vec![Action::Quit]
1085:     }

1089:     pub fn reload_config(&mut self) {
1090:         let user_settings = UserSettings::load();
1091:         self.state.session.meta.show_system_prompt = user_settings.show_system_prompt;
1092:         self.state.session.meta.show_reasoning = user_settings.show_reasoning;
1093:         maki_config::LOG_API.store(user_settings.api_logging, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
1094:         for chat in &mut self.chats {
1095:             chat.set_system_prompt(
1096:                 user_settings.show_system_prompt,
1097:                 self.state.session.meta.system_prompt.clone(),
1098:             );
1099:             chat.set_show_reasoning(user_settings.show_reasoning);
1100:         }
1101:         self.show_token_stats = user_settings.show_token_stats;
1102:         self.status_bar.flash("Configuration reloaded".to_string());
1103:     }
1104: 
1105:     fn start_rename(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1106:         let user_texts: Vec<String> = self
1107:             .state
1108:             .session
1109:             .messages
1110:             .iter()
1111:             .filter_map(|m| m.user_text().map(str::to_string))
1112:             .take(3)
1113:             .collect();
1114: 
1115:         if user_texts.is_empty() {
1116:             self.flash("Nothing to rename yet — send a message first".into());
1117:             return vec![];
1118:         }
1119: 
1120:         let mut total_words = 0usize;
1121:         let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
1122:         'outer: for text in &user_texts {
1123:             let mut words: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
1124:             for word in text.split_whitespace() {
1125:                 if total_words >= 200 {
1126:                     break 'outer;
1127:                 }
1128:                 words.push(word);
1129:                 total_words += 1;
1130:             }
1131:             parts.push(words.join(" "));
1132:         }
1133: 
1134:         let context = parts.join("\n\n");
1135:         let msg = Message::user(context);
1136:         self.flash("Renaming session…".into());
1137:         vec![Action::RenameSession(vec![msg])]
1138:     }
1139: 
1140:     pub(crate) fn apply_rename(&mut self, title: String) {
1141:         let old_name = self.state.session.title.clone();
1142:         let session_id = self.state.session.id.clone();
1143:         self.state.session.title = title.clone();
1144:         *maki_config::CURRENT_SESSION_NAME.lock().unwrap() = Some(title.clone());
1145:         self.save_session();
1146:         // Logs stay keyed by session id; point a friendly <title>.mlog symlink at it.
1147:         maki_providers::update_api_log_symlink(
1148:             &session_id,
1149:             Some(&old_name),
1150:             &title,
1151:             self.state.session.created_at,
1152:         );
1153:         self.status_bar.flash(format!("Session renamed to: {title}"));
1154:     }
1155: 
1156:     pub(crate) fn handle_submit(&mut self, sub: Submission) -> Vec<Action> {
1157:         match std::mem::take(&mut self.pending_input) {
1158:             PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id } => {
1159:                 self.send_to_agent(subagent_id.as_deref(), String::new());
1160:                 return vec![];
1161:             }
1162:             PendingInput::None => {}
1163:         }
1164:         if sub.is_empty() {
1165:             return vec![];
1166:         }
1167:         if sub.text.trim() == "exit" {
1168:             return self.quit();
1169:         }
1170: 
1171:         if let Some(prefix) = shell::parse_shell_prefix(&sub.text) {
1172:             let cmd = prefix.command.trim();
1173:             if cmd == "cd" || cmd.starts_with("cd ") {
1174:                 self.flash("Only /cd can change the working directory".into());
1175:             }
1176:             let id = self.shell.next_id();
1177:             let sigil = if prefix.visible { "!" } else { "!!" };
1178:             let display = format!("{sigil} {}", prefix.command);
1179:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display);
1180:             return vec![Action::ShellCommand {
1181:                 id,
1182:                 command: prefix.command,
1183:                 visible: prefix.visible,
1184:             }];
1185:         }
1186:         let msg: QueuedMessage = sub.into();
1187:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1188:             self.queue_and_notify(msg);
1189:             vec![]
1190:         } else {
1191:             self.run_id += 1;
1192:             self.start_from_queue(&msg)
1193:         }
1194:     }
1195: 
1196:     fn handle_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1197:         let cancelled_run = self.run_id;
1198:         self.run_id += 1;
1199:         self.retry_info = None;
1200:         self.close_all_overlays();
1201:         self.pending_input = PendingInput::None;
1202:         self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
1203:         self.subagent_answers.clear();
1204:         self.shell.cancel_all();
1205:         for chat in &mut self.chats {
1206:             chat.flush();
1207:             chat.cancel_in_progress();
1208:         }
1209:         self.main_chat()
1210:             .push(DisplayMessage::new(DisplayRole::Error, CANCEL_MSG.into()));
1211:         self.queue.clear();
1212:         self.status = Status::Idle;
1213:         vec![Action::CancelAgent {
1214:             run_id: cancelled_run,
1215:         }]
1216:     }
1217: 
1218:     fn handle_subagent_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1219:         let tool_use_id = self
1220:             .chat_index
1221:             .iter()
1222:             .find(|&(_, &idx)| idx == self.active_chat)
1223:             .map(|(id, _)| id.clone());
1224: 
1225:         let Some(tool_use_id) = tool_use_id else {
1226:             return vec![];
1227:         };
1228: 
1229:         self.chats[self.active_chat].flush();
1230:         self.chats[self.active_chat].cancel_in_progress();
1231:         self.chats[self.active_chat].mark_finished(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
1232:         self.subagent_answers.remove(&tool_use_id);
1233: 
1234:         vec![Action::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id }]
1235:     }
1236: 
1237:     fn handle_agent_event(&mut self, envelope: Envelope) -> Vec<Action> {
1238:         if let AgentEvent::RenameResult { title } = envelope.event {
1239:             self.apply_rename(title);
1240:             return vec![];
1241:         }
1242: 
1243:         if envelope.run_id == RESTORE_RUN_ID {
1244:             let (id, snapshot, theme_gen, is_header) = match envelope.event {
1245:                 AgentEvent::ToolSnapshot {
1246:                     id,
1247:                     snapshot,
1248:                     theme_gen,
1249:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, false),
1250:                 AgentEvent::ToolHeaderSnapshot {
1251:                     id,
1252:                     snapshot,
1253:                     theme_gen,
1254:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, true),
1255:                 _ => return vec![],
1256:             };
1257:             for chat in &mut self.chats {
1258:                 if is_header {
1259:                     chat.tool_header_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1260:                 } else {
1261:                     chat.tool_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1262:                 }
1263:             }
1264:             return vec![];
1265:         }
1266:         if envelope.run_id != self.run_id {
1267:             // Stale run_id after cancel: agent updates shared_history before sending
1268:             // Done/Error, so this is the first moment the full conversation is available.
1269:             if matches!(
1270:                 envelope.event,
1271:                 AgentEvent::Done { .. } | AgentEvent::Error { .. }
1272:             ) {
1273:                 self.save_session();
1274:             }
1275:             return vec![];
1276:         }
1277: 
1278:         if let AgentEvent::SubagentHistory {
1279:             tool_use_id,
1280:             messages,
1281:         } = envelope.event
1282:         {
1283:             self.state
1284:                 .session
1285:                 .subagent_messages
1286:                 .insert(tool_use_id, messages);
1287:             return vec![];
1288:         }
1289: 
1290:         let chat_idx = match envelope.subagent {
1291:             Some(ref subagent) => self.resolve_or_create_chat(subagent),
1292:             None => 0,
1293:         };
1294: 
1295:         let subagent_id = envelope
1296:             .subagent
1297:             .as_ref()
1298:             .map(|s| s.parent_tool_use_id.clone());
1299: 
1300:         if let AgentEvent::SystemPrompt { text } = envelope.event {
1301:             self.state.session.meta.system_prompt = Some(text.clone());
1302:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1303:                 let estimated_tokens = (text.len() / 4) as u32;
1304:                 self.active_run_input_tokens = self.active_run_input_tokens.max(estimated_tokens);
1305:             }
1306:             self.chats[chat_idx].set_system_prompt(
1307:                 self.state.session.meta.show_system_prompt,
1308:                 Some(text),
1309:             );
1310:             return vec![];
1311:         }
1312: 
1313:         if let AgentEvent::ToolDone(ref e) = envelope.event {
1314:             if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan
1315:                 && self.state.plan.path().is_some_and(|pp| e.wrote_to(pp))
1316:             {
1317:                 self.transition_plan(PlanTrigger::WriteDone);
1318:             }
1319:             if let Some(ref outputs) = self.shared_tool_outputs {
1320:                 outputs
1321:                     .lock()
1322:                     .unwrap()
1323:                     .insert(e.id.clone(), e.output.clone());
1324:             }
1325:             if let Some(&sub_idx) = self.chat_index.get(&e.id) {
1326:                 let (role, text) = if e.is_error {
1327:                     (DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT)
1328:                 } else {
1329:                     (DisplayRole::Done, DONE_TEXT)
1330:                 };
1331:                 self.chats[sub_idx].mark_finished(role, text);
1332:             }
1333:         }
1334: 
1335:         if let AgentEvent::Retry {
1336:             attempt,
1337:             message,
1338:             delay_ms,
1339:         } = envelope.event
1340:         {
1341:             self.chats[chat_idx].stream_reset();
1342:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1343:                 self.retry_info = Some(RetryInfo {
1344:                     attempt,
1345:                     message,
1346:                     deadline: Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(delay_ms),
1347:                 });
1348:             }
1349:             return vec![];
1350:         }
1351: 
1352:         self.retry_info = None;
1353: 
1354:         match &envelope.event {
1355:             AgentEvent::ThinkingDelta { text } | AgentEvent::TextDelta { text } => {
1356:                 if chat_idx == 0 {
1357:                     let chars = text.chars().count();
1358:                     self.active_run_output_chars += chars as u32;
1359:                     if self.turn_first_token_at.is_none() {
1360:                         self.turn_first_token_at = Some(Instant::now());
1361:                     }
1362:                 }
1363:             }
1364:             AgentEvent::ToolResultsSubmitted { message } => {
1365:                 if chat_idx == 0 {
1366:                     self.active_run_start = Some(Instant::now());
1367:                     let message_len: usize = message.content.iter().map(|block| {
1368:                         match block {
1369:                             maki_providers::ContentBlock::Text { text } => text.len(),
1370:                             maki_providers::ContentBlock::Thinking { thinking, .. } => thinking.len(),
1371:                             maki_providers::ContentBlock::RedactedThinking { data } => data.len(),
1372:                             maki_providers::ContentBlock::ToolResult { content, .. } => content.len(),
1373:                             _ => 0,
1374:                         }
1375:                     }).sum();
1376:                     self.active_run_input_tokens = self.chats[0].context_size + (message_len / 4) as u32;
1377:                     self.active_run_output_chars = 0;
1378:                     self.turn_api_sent_at = Some(Instant::now());
1379:                     self.turn_first_token_at = None;
1380:                 }
1381:             }
1382:             AgentEvent::ToolStart(_) => {
1383:                 if chat_idx == 0 {
1384:                     self.active_run_start = Some(Instant::now());
1385:                 }
1386:             }
1387:             AgentEvent::Done { .. } | AgentEvent::Error { .. } if chat_idx == 0 => {
1388:                 if let Some(start) = self.active_run_start {
1389:                     self.active_run_duration = Some(start.elapsed());
1390:                 }
1391:                 self.active_run_start = None;
1392:             }
1393:             _ => {}
1394:         }
1395: 
1396:         let plan_path = if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan {
1397:             self.state.plan.path()
1398:         } else {
1399:             None
1400:         };
1401: 
1402:         if let AgentEvent::TurnComplete(ref tc) = envelope.event {
1403:             self.state.token_usage += tc.usage;
1404:             self.chats[chat_idx].token_usage += tc.usage;
1405:             let ctx_size = tc.context_size.unwrap_or_else(|| tc.usage.context_tokens());
1406:             self.chats[chat_idx].context_size = ctx_size;
1407:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1408:                 self.state.context_size = ctx_size;
1409:                 if let (Some(sent_at), Some(first_token_at)) =
1410:                     (self.turn_api_sent_at, self.turn_first_token_at)
1411:                 {
1412:                     let now = Instant::now();
1413:                     let ttft = first_token_at.duration_since(sent_at).as_secs_f64();
1414:                     let gen_time = now.duration_since(first_token_at).as_secs_f64();
1415:                     let total_input =
1416:                         tc.usage.input + tc.usage.cache_creation + tc.usage.cache_read;
1417:                     let pp_tps = if ttft > 0.0 {
1418:                         total_input as f64 / ttft
1419:                     } else {
1420:                         0.0
1421:                     };
1422:                     let tg_tps = if gen_time > 0.0 {
1423:                         tc.usage.output as f64 / gen_time
1424:                     } else {
1425:                         0.0
1426:                     };
1427:                     let cache_rate = if total_input > 0 {
1428:                         tc.usage.cache_read as f64 / total_input as f64
1429:                     } else {
1430:                         0.0
1431:                     };
1432:                     self.last_turn_stats = Some(crate::components::status_bar::TurnStats {
1433:                         pp_tps,
1434:                         tg_tps,
1435:                         cache_rate,
1436:                     });
1437:                 }
1438:                 self.turn_api_sent_at = None;
1439:                 self.turn_first_token_at = None;
1440:             }
1441:             let formatted =
1442:                 format_turn_usage(&tc.usage, &self.state.model.pricing, self.state.fast);
1443:             self.chats[chat_idx].set_pending_turn_usage(formatted);
1444:         }
1445: 
1446:         let result = self.chats[chat_idx].handle_event(envelope.event, plan_path);
1447: 
1448:         if let ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { text, image_count } = result {
1449:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1450:                 self.on_queue_item_consumed(&text, image_count);
1451:             }
1452:             return vec![];
1453:         }
1454: 
1455:         if let ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { id, tool, scopes } = result {
1456:             self.permission_prompt.open(id, tool, scopes, subagent_id);
1457:             return vec![];
1458:         }
1459: 
1460:         if let ChatEventResult::AuthRequired = result {
1461:             self.chats[chat_idx].push(DisplayMessage::new(
1462:                 DisplayRole::Error,
1463:                 AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1464:             ));
1465:             if chat_idx != 0 {
1466:                 self.main_chat().push(DisplayMessage::new(
1467:                     DisplayRole::Error,
1468:                     AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1469:                 ));
1470:             }
1471:             self.pending_input = PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id };
1472:             return vec![];
1473:         }
1474: 
1475:         if chat_idx == 0 {
1476:             match result {
1477:                 ChatEventResult::Done => {
1478:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1479:                     self.save_session();
1480:                     self.chat_index.clear();
1481:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1482:                     self.status = Status::Idle;
1483:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1484:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnEnd", serde_json::json!({}));
1485:                     }
1486:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1487:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Success;
1488:                     }
1489:                     if self.state.session.title == maki_storage::sessions::DEFAULT_TITLE {
1490:                         return self.start_rename();
1491:                     }
1492:                 }
1493:                 ChatEventResult::Error(message) => {
1494:                     self.status = Status::error(message.clone());
1495:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1496:                     self.save_session();
1497:                     self.queue.clear();
1498:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1499:                     self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT);
1500:                     for chat in &mut self.chats {
1501:                         chat.fail_in_progress_with_message(message.clone());
1502:                     }
1503:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1504:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnError", serde_json::json!({ "message": message }));
1505:                     }
1506:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1507:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Error;
1508:                     }
1509:                 }
1510:                 ChatEventResult::AuthRequired
1511:                 | ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { .. }
1512:                 | ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { .. } => unreachable!(),
1513:                 ChatEventResult::Continue => {}
1514:             }
1515:         }
1516:         vec![]
1517:     }
1518: 
1519:     fn resolve_or_create_chat(&mut self, subagent: &SubagentInfo) -> usize {
1520:         let id = &subagent.parent_tool_use_id;
1521:         if let Some(&idx) = self.chat_index.get(id.as_str()) {
1522:             return idx;
1523:         }
1524:         let idx = self.chats.len();
1525:         self.chat_index.insert(id.clone(), idx);
1526:         if let Some(ref tx) = subagent.answer_tx {
1527:             self.subagent_answers.insert(id.clone(), tx.clone());
1528:         }
1529:         self.chats[0].update_tool_summary(id, &subagent.name);
1530:         if let Some(ref model) = subagent.model {
1531:             self.chats[0].update_tool_model(id, model);
1532:         }
1533:         let mut chat = Chat::new(subagent.name.clone(), self.ui_config);
1534:         chat.set_restore_channel(self.lua_event_handle.clone(), self.restore_event_tx.clone());
1535:         chat.model_id = subagent.model.clone();
1536:         chat.set_show_reasoning(self.state.session.meta.show_reasoning);
1537:         chat.set_verbose(self.verbose);
1538:         if let Some(ref prompt) = subagent.prompt {
1539:             chat.push_user_message(prompt);
1540:         }
1541:         self.chats.push(chat);
1542:         idx
1543:     }
1544: 
1545:     fn execute_command(&mut self, cmd: ParsedCommand) -> Vec<Action> {
1546:         self.input_box.discard();
1547:         match cmd.name.as_str() {
1548:             "/tasks" => {
1549:                 self.open_tasks();
1550:                 vec![]
1551:             }
1552:             "/compact" => {
1553:                 let target = if cmd.args.trim().is_empty() {
1554:                     let settings = UserSettings::load();
1555:                     settings.compact_tokens
1556:                 } else {
1557:                     cmd.args.trim().parse::<usize>().ok()
1558:                 };
1559:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1560:                     self.queue_compact(target);
1561:                     return vec![];
1562:                 }
1563:                 self.status = Status::Streaming;
1564:                 self.active_run_start = Some(Instant::now());
1565:                 self.active_run_duration = None;
1566:                 self.active_run_input_tokens = self.main_chat().context_size;
1567:                 self.active_run_output_chars = 0;
1568:                 self.turn_api_sent_at = Some(Instant::now());
1569:                 self.turn_first_token_at = None;
1570:                 vec![Action::Compact(target)]
1571:             }
1572:             "/checkpoint" => {
1573:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1574:                     self.queue_checkpoint();
1575:                     return vec![];
1576:                 }
1577:                 self.status = Status::Streaming;
1578:                 self.active_run_start = Some(Instant::now());
1579:                 self.active_run_duration = None;
1580:                 self.active_run_input_tokens = self.main_chat().context_size;
1581:                 self.active_run_output_chars = 0;
1582:                 self.turn_api_sent_at = Some(Instant::now());
1583:                 self.turn_first_token_at = None;
1584:                 vec![Action::Checkpoint]
1585:             }
1586:             "/help" => {

1723:     fn execute_mcp_prompt(&mut self, name: &str, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1724:         let prompt = self.command_palette.find_mcp_prompt(name).unwrap().clone();
1725: 
1726:         let arguments = Self::parse_prompt_args(&prompt, args);
1727:         let missing: Vec<_> = prompt
1728:             .arguments
1729:             .iter()
1730:             .filter(|a| a.required && !arguments.contains_key(&a.name))
1731:             .map(|a| format!("<{}>", a.name))
1732:             .collect();
1733:         if !missing.is_empty() {
1734:             self.flash(format!("Usage: {} {}", name, missing.join(" ")));
1735:             return vec![];
1736:         }
1737: 
1738:         let prompt_ref = maki_agent::McpPromptRef {
1739:             qualified_name: prompt.qualified_name.clone(),
1740:             arguments,
1741:         };
1742:         let display_text = if args.trim().is_empty() {
1743:             name.to_string()
1744:         } else {
1745:             format!("{name} {args}")
1746:         };
1747:         let mut input = self.build_agent_input(&QueuedMessage {
1748:             text: display_text.clone(),
1749:             images: Vec::new(),
1750:         });
1751:         input.prompt = Some(Box::new(prompt_ref));
1752: 
1753:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1754:             self.flash("Agent is busy, try again later".into());
1755:             vec![]
1756:         } else {
1757:             self.run_id += 1;
1758:             self.status = Status::Streaming;
1759:             self.active_run_start = Some(Instant::now());
1760:             self.active_run_duration = None;
1761:             let mut input_tokens = self.main_chat().context_size;
1762:             if input_tokens == 0 {
1763:                 if let Some(ref sys) = self.state.session.meta.system_prompt {
1764:                     input_tokens = (sys.len() / 4) as u32;
1765:                 }
1766:             }
1767:             self.active_run_input_tokens = input_tokens + (display_text.len() / 4) as u32;
1768:             self.active_run_output_chars = 0;
1769:             self.turn_api_sent_at = Some(Instant::now());
1770:             self.turn_first_token_at = None;
1771:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display_text);
1772:             vec![Action::SendMessage(Box::new(input))]
1773:         }
1774:     }

1776:     fn parse_prompt_args(prompt: &McpPromptInfo, args: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {
1777:         let mut result = HashMap::new();
1778:         let mut remaining = args.trim();
1779:         if remaining.is_empty() || prompt.arguments.is_empty() {
1780:             return result;
1781:         }
1782:         let last_idx = prompt.arguments.len() - 1;
1783:         for (i, arg) in prompt.arguments.iter().enumerate() {
1784:             if remaining.is_empty() {
1785:                 break;
1786:             }
1787:             if i == last_idx {
1788:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1789:             } else if let Some((word, rest)) = remaining.split_once(char::is_whitespace) {
1790:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), word.to_string());
1791:                 remaining = rest.trim_start();
1792:             } else {
1793:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1794:                 break;
1795:             }
1796:         }
1797:         result
1798:     }

1: //! Queue of work handed from the UI to the agent loop.
2: //!
3: //! Shutdown rides on `Drop`: when the last [`QueueSender`] goes away, flume
4: //! closes the notify channel, so the receiver's `recv_notify` wakes with an
5: //! `Err` and the agent loop falls out of its main loop on its own. That way
6: //! nobody needs a separate "please stop" flag, and callers can't forget to

45:         /// `false` when the user typed while the agent was busy: the UI waits

54: impl QueueItem {

110: pub(crate) fn queue() -> (QueueSender, QueueReceiver) {
111:     let (notify_tx, notify_rx) = flume::bounded(1);
112:     let items: Items = Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::new()));
113:     (
114:         QueueSender {
115:             items: Arc::clone(&items),
116:             notify_tx,
117:         },
118:         QueueReceiver { items, notify_rx },
119:     )
120: }

122: impl QueueSender {
123:     pub(crate) fn push(&self, entry: QueueItem) {
124:         lock(&self.items).push_back(entry);
125:         let _ = self.notify_tx.try_send(());
126:     }

128:     pub(crate) fn remove(&self, index: usize) -> Option<QueueItem> {
129:         let mut items = lock(&self.items);
130:         (index < items.len()).then(|| items.remove(index)).flatten()
131:     }

134:         lock(&self.items).len()

205: /// If `vars` is provided, a final pass substitutes any remaining `{key}` placeholders
206: /// (e.g. `{date}`) so custom system.md templates can use them directly.
207: pub fn assemble(id: PromptId, slots: &ResolvedSlots, instructions: &str, vars: Option<&Vars>) -> String {
208:     let mut out = id.template();
209:     for slot in Slot::iter() {
210:         out = fill_marker(&out, slot.marker(), &render_slot(slots, id, slot));
211:     }
212:     let mut out = out.replace(INSTRUCTIONS_MARKER, instructions);
213:     if let Some(vars) = vars {
214:         out = vars.apply(&out).into_owned();
215:     }
216:     out
217: }
218: 
219: /// Replace a slot marker with its content. When the content is empty, also drop
220: /// the marker's own line (the trailing newline) so empty slots leave no blank
221: /// gap, without touching any other whitespace in the prompt.
222: fn fill_marker(template: &str, marker: &str, content: &str) -> String {
223:     if content.is_empty() {
224:         return template
225:             .replace(&format!("{marker}\n"), "")
226:             .replace(marker, "");
227:     }
228:     template.replace(marker, content)
229: }

The checkpoint compaction system has been ported successfully. Here's a summary of everything that was changed:

## Summary of changes

### New files
- `maki-agent/src/prompts/checkpoint_user.md` — LLM prompt for checkpoint mode summary generation
- `maki-agent/src/prompts/session_name.md` — LLM prompt for auto-generating session titles

### maki-agent changes (core agent)
- **compaction.rs**: Refactored inline summary logic into shared `run_summary_stream()` with `strip` flag and `target_tokens`. Added `checkpoint_history()` (append-only, no strip), `checkpoint()`, and `rename_session()` public functions. Added `CHECKPOINT_INTRO` constant.
- **types.rs**: Added `CompactionStart { checkpoint: bool }` and `RenameResult { title: String }` to `AgentEvent`
- **lib.rs**: Added `Checkpoint(u64)` to `ExtractedCommand`
- **agent/mod.rs**: Exported `checkpoint` and `rename_session` from compaction module
- **agent/run.rs**: Added `do_checkpoint()` method, dispatching to `compaction::checkpoint_history`, and handled `ExtractedCommand::Checkpoint` in `handle_queued_command`
- **prompt.rs**: Added `CHECKPOINT_USER` const

### maki-ui changes (UI)
- **components/mod.rs**: Added `Action::Checkpoint`, `Action::RenameSession(Vec<Message>)`, and `DisplayRole::Compaction { checkpoint: bool }`
- **shared_queue.rs**: Added `QueueItem::Checkpoint` and `QueueItem::Rename` variants with full `as_queue_entry`, `into_extracted_command`, `visible_in_panel` support
- **agent_loop.rs**: Added `do_checkpoint()` and `do_rename()` handlers dispatching to agent
- **app/mod.rs**: Added `/checkpoint` and `/rename` commands, `RenameResult` handler, `start_rename()` and `apply_rename()` methods, auto-rename on first turn when session title is default
- **app/queue.rs**: Added `queue_checkpoint()` method
- **chat.rs**: Added `CompactionStart` event handler (calls `begin_compaction`), `RenameResult` no-op handler, `ToolSnapshot`/`ToolHeaderSnapshot` wildcards
- **messages/mod.rs**: Added `streaming_role` field, `begin_compaction()` method, updated `flush()` to use `streaming_role`, cleared it in `stream_reset`, added `Compaction` style mapping (reuses `assistant_style`)

### src/ changes (binary crate)
- **print.rs**: Added wildcard arms for `CompactionStart` and `RenameResult`
- **sdk_mode.rs**: Added wildcard arms for `CompactionStart` and `RenameResult`

### Build & test
- `cargo build` succeeds
- `cargo test --workspace`: 431 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing `command_matches_its_own_generalized_rule::edit_path`)
- Pre-existing clippy warnings remain unchanged

#[test]
    fn cache_invalidates_on_width_change() {
        let style = Style::default();
        let mut cache = StreamingCache::default();
        let mut renderer = fresh_renderer();
        let text = "```rust\nfn extremely_long_function_name_that_definitely_will_not_fit(arg_one: &str, arg_two: usize) {}\n```";

        cache.get_or_update(&mut renderer, text, "", style, style, 200);
        let wide = cache.lines.len();
        cache.get_or_update(&mut renderer, text, "", style, style, 30);
        let narrow = cache.lines.len();
        assert!(
            narrow > wide,
            "narrower width must produce more wrapped lines (wide={wide}, narrow={narrow})"
        );
    }

## Report

### 1. UserSettings vs upstream Config — completely different structs

**Fork's `UserSettings`** (`maki-ui/src/components/settings_picker.rs:14-35`):
```rust
pub struct UserSettings {
    pub show_system_prompt: bool,
    pub api_logging: bool,
    pub show_reasoning: bool,
    pub show_token_stats: bool,
    pub log_command: Option<String>,
    pub compact_tokens: Option<usize>,
    pub skills_dirs: Vec<String>,
    pub export_path: Option<String>,
    pub disabled_plugins: Vec<String>,
    pub global_sessions: bool,
}
```
Flat, key-value config for UI toggles.

**Upstream `Config`** (`maki-config/src/lib.rs:709-720`):
```rust
pub struct Config {
    pub always_yolo: bool,
    pub always_fast: bool,
    pub always_workflow: bool,
    pub always_thinking: Option<StoredThinking>,
    pub ui: UiConfig,
    pub agent: AgentConfig,
    pub provider: ProviderConfig,
    pub storage: StorageConfig,
    pub permissions: PermissionsConfig,
    pub plugins: PluginsConfig,
}
```
Rich nested TOML-based config with sub-sections, validation, and many fields like `show_thinking`, `splash_animation`, `scrollbar`, `flash_duration_ms`, etc. None of the `UserSettings` fields (show_system_prompt, api_logging, etc.) exist in upstream `Config` in any form.

**Conclusion:** Zero overlap. 100% fork-specific.

---

### 2. Fork-specific APIs `settings_picker.rs` depends on

These are the external APIs `settings_picker.rs` calls that are **missing or different** on upstream:

| Line | Call | Status upstream |
|------|------|----------------|
| 39 | `crate::config::load_config()` | File exists but **not registered as a module** — it's a fork-only file `maki-ui/src/config.rs` (not in `lib.rs` or `components/mod.rs`) |
| 43 | `crate::config::save_config(self)` | Same — only in fork's `config.rs` |
| 151 | `crate::config::config_path()` | Same — only in fork's `config.rs` |
| 157 | `crate::components::hint_line(...)` | ✅ **Exists** upstream (`mod.rs:55`) |
| 160 | `self.picker.set_static_footer(Line::from(...))` | ❌ **Removed** during merge — upstream only has `with_footer(static_hints)` and `with_footer_builder(fn)` at construction time |
| 158 | `theme::current().tool_dim` | ✅ Exists (`theme.rs:355`) |
| 159 | `theme::current().item_desc` | ✅ Exists (`theme.rs:381`) |
| 162 | `self.picker.open_toggleable(...)` | ✅ Exists (`list_picker.rs:304`) |
| 106 | `ListPicker::new().with_max_visible(...)` | ✅ Exists (`list_picker.rs:289`) |

The `config.rs` file (`maki-ui/src/config.rs`) itself depends on `keybindings::update_bind` (line 105) and `keybindings::get_configured_bind` (line 187) — both of which were **removed from `keybindings.rs` during the merge**. Only `key_event_to_string` survives.

### 3. Is `settings_picker` independent or tied to fork APIs?

**Deeply tied.** It cannot compile on upstream without substantial rework because:

1. **`config.rs` is unreachable** — `maki-ui/src/config.rs` is not declared as a module anywhere. Even though the file exists on disk, `crate::config` doesn't resolve.
2. **`UserSettings` is its own struct** — it has no relationship to upstream `Config`.
3. **`set_static_footer` was removed from `list_picker.rs`** — settings_picker uses it to display the config path in the footer. Upstream only supports static pair hints or a builder closure, not a mutable `Line<'static>` setter.
4. **`update_bind`/`get_configured_bind` were removed from `keybindings.rs`** — `config.rs` calls both when parsing/saving keybind lines.
5. **`settings_picker` is not in `components/mod.rs`** — the file exists but isn't registered.

Other fork files that also depend on `UserSettings` (also orphaned):
- `maki-ui/src/components/export_picker.rs:3`
- `maki-ui/src/components/plugins_modal.rs:100`
- `maki-ui/src/components/skills_modal.rs:10`

---

### 4. What would need to change to compile on upstream

Minimum changes:

| # | File | Change |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | `maki-ui/src/components/settings_picker.rs` | Replace `UserSettings` with either (a) upstream's `Config` + `UiConfig` fields, or (b) a new TOML-based config section added to `maki-config`. All `UserSettings` fields are fork concepts — upstream has no equivalent. |
| 2 | `maki-ui/src/components/settings_picker.rs` | Replace `crate::config::load_config()` / `save_config()` / `config_path()` with upstream's `maki_config::load()` / path logic from `maki-config`. |
| 3 | `maki-ui/src/components/settings_picker.rs` | Replace `self.picker.set_static_footer(line)` with `self.picker.with_footer_builder(|| line.clone())` moved to construction time (or add `set_static_footer` back to list_picker). |
| 4 | `maki-ui/src/config.rs` | Delete entirely — it's fork-only, deeply tied to `UserSettings`. None of its functionality exists upstream. |
| 5 | `maki-ui/src/components/keybindings.rs` | Either add `update_bind`/`get_configured_bind` back, or delete the `keybind =` parsing path from wherever calls it. |
| 6 | `maki-ui/src/components/mod.rs` | If keeping the picker, add `pub(crate) mod settings_picker;` — though note it conflicts with `settings_picker` not being upstream's convention. |

**Architectural verdict:** The entire `settings_picker` + `config.rs` subsystem is a fork overlay with zero common ground with upstream's config model. Porting would mean either:
- **Rebuilding it** as a new UI tab/section driven by upstream's `Config` struct (reading/writing `show_thinking`, `typewriter_ms_per_char`, etc.), or
- **Keeping it fork-only** and registering it as an unmerged module gated behind a feature flag.

1: //! Mouse selection + clipboard copy.
2: //!
3: //! Enabling mouse capture (for scroll) kills the terminal's native text
4: //! selection, so we reimplement it here. A few things that are easy to get
5: //! wrong:
6: //!
7: //! Positions are stored in doc space (`DocPos`), not screen space, because
8: //! screen coords go stale the moment the user scrolls.
9: //!
10: //! Copy runs inside `view()`, not on mouse-up. The terminal buffer only
11: //! holds valid cell data during rendering, so that is the only moment we
12: //! can scrape the text. Code bar prefixes (`│ `) are stripped during
13: //! scraping so you get clean source.
14: //!
15: //! While a selection is active, `has_selection` freezes auto-scroll in the
16: //! messages panel so the viewport stays put while the user drags.
17: //!
18: //! The rightmost column of each area is reserved for the scrollbar, so
19: //! `highlight_area()` / `msg_area()` are 1 column narrower than the full
20: //! area and all column math uses `width - 1`.
21: //!
22: //! When text is word-wrapped, ratatui eats the space at the break point,
23: //! so the copied text would lose that space unless we put it back. But we
24: //! should only add a space for word-boundary wraps, not mid-word ones
25: //! (where a long token just overflows the column). `LineBreaks` tracks
26: //! both line starts and wrap types: `compute_wrap_types()` walks each
27: //! line the same way ratatui does and classifies every break, then
28: //! `append_rows` calls `needs_space()` to decide.
29:

43: /// Position in doc space (full logical document, not just visible window).

46: pub struct DocPos {

48:     pub col: u16,
49: }
50: 
51: impl DocPos {
52:     fn new(row: u32, col: u16) -> Self {

54:     }
55: }

57: impl PartialOrd for DocPos {
58:     fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> {
59:         Some(self.cmp(other))
60:     }
61: }

63: impl Ord for DocPos {
64:     fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering {

77: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
78: pub struct SelectableZone {

80:     pub zone: SelectionZone,
81: }

83: const ZONE_CAP: usize = 12;
84: 
85: const EMPTY_ZONE: SelectableZone = SelectableZone {
86:     area: Rect::new(0, 0, 0, 0),

90: pub struct ZoneRegistry {

93: }

95: impl ZoneRegistry {
96:     pub fn new() -> Self {
97:         Self {
98:             entries: [EMPTY_ZONE; ZONE_CAP],
99:             len: 0,
100:         }
101:     }
102: 
103:     pub fn push(&mut self, zone: SelectableZone) {
104:         let i = self.len as usize;
105:         if i >= ZONE_CAP {
106:             return;
107:         }
108:         self.entries[i] = zone;
109:         self.len += 1;
