965:     fn start_rename(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
966:         let user_texts: Vec<String> = self
967:             .state
968:             .session
969:             .messages
970:             .iter()
971:             .filter_map(|m| m.user_text().map(str::to_string))
972:             .take(3)
973:             .collect();
974: 
975:         if user_texts.is_empty() {
976:             self.flash("Nothing to rename yet — send a message first".into());
977:             return vec![];
978:         }
979: 
980:         let mut total_words = 0usize;
981:         let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
982:         'outer: for text in &user_texts {
983:             let mut words: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
984:             for word in text.split_whitespace() {
985:                 if total_words >= 200 {
986:                     break 'outer;
987:                 }
988:                 words.push(word);
989:                 total_words += 1;
990:             }
991:             parts.push(words.join(" "));
992:         }
993: 
994:         let context = parts.join("\n\n");
995:         let msg = Message::user(context);
996:         self.flash("Renaming session…".into());
997:         vec![Action::RenameSession(vec![msg])]
998:     }
999: 
1000:     pub(crate) fn apply_rename(&mut self, title: String) {
1001:         self.state.session.title = title.clone();
1002:         self.save_session();
1003:         self.status_bar.flash(format!("Session renamed to: {title}"));
1004:     }
1005: 
1006:     pub(crate) fn handle_submit(&mut self, sub: Submission) -> Vec<Action> {
1007:         match std::mem::take(&mut self.pending_input) {
1008:             PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id } => {
1009:                 self.send_to_agent(subagent_id.as_deref(), String::new());
1010:                 return vec![];
1011:             }
1012:             PendingInput::None => {}
1013:         }
1014:         if sub.is_empty() {
1015:             return vec![];
1016:         }
1017:         if sub.text.trim() == "exit" {
1018:             return self.quit();
1019:         }
1020: 
1021:         if let Some(prefix) = shell::parse_shell_prefix(&sub.text) {
1022:             let cmd = prefix.command.trim();
1023:             if cmd == "cd" || cmd.starts_with("cd ") {
1024:                 self.flash("Only /cd can change the working directory".into());
1025:             }
1026:             let id = self.shell.next_id();
1027:             let sigil = if prefix.visible { "!" } else { "!!" };
1028:             let display = format!("{sigil} {}", prefix.command);
1029:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display);
1030:             return vec![Action::ShellCommand {
1031:                 id,
1032:                 command: prefix.command,
1033:                 visible: prefix.visible,
1034:             }];
1035:         }
1036:         let msg: QueuedMessage = sub.into();
1037:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1038:             self.queue_and_notify(msg);
1039:             vec![]
1040:         } else {
1041:             self.run_id += 1;
1042:             self.start_from_queue(&msg)
1043:         }
1044:     }
1045: 
1046:     fn handle_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1047:         let cancelled_run = self.run_id;
1048:         self.run_id += 1;
1049:         self.retry_info = None;
1050:         self.close_all_overlays();
1051:         self.pending_input = PendingInput::None;
1052:         self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
1053:         self.subagent_answers.clear();
1054:         self.shell.cancel_all();
1055:         for chat in &mut self.chats {
1056:             chat.flush();
1057:             chat.cancel_in_progress();
1058:         }
1059:         self.main_chat()
1060:             .push(DisplayMessage::new(DisplayRole::Error, CANCEL_MSG.into()));
1061:         self.queue.clear();
1062:         self.status = Status::Idle;
1063:         vec![Action::CancelAgent {
1064:             run_id: cancelled_run,
1065:         }]
1066:     }
1067: 
1068:     fn handle_subagent_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1069:         let tool_use_id = self
1070:             .chat_index
1071:             .iter()
1072:             .find(|&(_, &idx)| idx == self.active_chat)
1073:             .map(|(id, _)| id.clone());
1074: 
1075:         let Some(tool_use_id) = tool_use_id else {
1076:             return vec![];
1077:         };
1078: 
1079:         self.chats[self.active_chat].flush();
1080:         self.chats[self.active_chat].cancel_in_progress();
1081:         self.chats[self.active_chat].mark_finished(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
1082:         self.subagent_answers.remove(&tool_use_id);
1083: 
1084:         vec![Action::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id }]
1085:     }
1086: 
1087:     fn handle_agent_event(&mut self, envelope: Envelope) -> Vec<Action> {
1088:         if let AgentEvent::RenameResult { title } = envelope.event {
1089:             self.apply_rename(title);
1090:             return vec![];
1091:         }
1092: 
1093:         if envelope.run_id == RESTORE_RUN_ID {
1094:             let (id, snapshot, theme_gen, is_header) = match envelope.event {
1095:                 AgentEvent::ToolSnapshot {
1096:                     id,
1097:                     snapshot,
1098:                     theme_gen,
1099:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, false),
1100:                 AgentEvent::ToolHeaderSnapshot {
1101:                     id,
1102:                     snapshot,
1103:                     theme_gen,
1104:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, true),
1105:                 _ => return vec![],
1106:             };
1107:             for chat in &mut self.chats {
1108:                 if is_header {
1109:                     chat.tool_header_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1110:                 } else {
1111:                     chat.tool_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1112:                 }
1113:             }
1114:             return vec![];
1115:         }
1116:         if envelope.run_id != self.run_id {
1117:             // Stale run_id after cancel: agent updates shared_history before sending
1118:             // Done/Error, so this is the first moment the full conversation is available.
1119:             if matches!(
1120:                 envelope.event,
1121:                 AgentEvent::Done { .. } | AgentEvent::Error { .. }
1122:             ) {
1123:                 self.save_session();
1124:             }
1125:             return vec![];
1126:         }
1127: 
1128:         if let AgentEvent::SubagentHistory {
1129:             tool_use_id,
1130:             messages,
1131:         } = envelope.event
1132:         {
1133:             // Workflow sessions use synthetic ids that no ToolDone will match,
1134:             // so we finish them here on SubagentHistory.
1135:             if let Some(&sub_idx) = self.chat_index.get(tool_use_id.as_str()) {
1136:                 self.chats[sub_idx].mark_finished(DisplayRole::Done, DONE_TEXT);
1137:             }
1138:             self.state
1139:                 .session
1140:                 .subagent_messages
1141:                 .insert(tool_use_id, messages);
1142:             return vec![];
1143:         }
1144: 
1145:         let subagent_id = envelope
1146:             .subagent
1147:             .as_ref()
1148:             .map(|s| s.parent_tool_use_id.clone());
1149: 
1150:         let chat_idx = match envelope.subagent {
1151:             Some(ref subagent) => self.resolve_or_create_chat(subagent),
1152:             None => 0,
1153:         };
1154: 
1155:         if let AgentEvent::ToolDone(ref e) = envelope.event {
1156:             if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan
1157:                 && self.state.plan.path().is_some_and(|pp| e.wrote_to(pp))
1158:             {
1159:                 self.transition_plan(PlanTrigger::WriteDone);
1160:             }
1161:             if let Some(ref outputs) = self.shared_tool_outputs {
1162:                 outputs
1163:                     .lock()
1164:                     .unwrap()
1165:                     .insert(e.id.clone(), e.output.clone());
1166:             }
1167:             if let Some(&sub_idx) = self.chat_index.get(&e.id) {
1168:                 let (role, text) = if e.is_error {
1169:                     (DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT)
1170:                 } else {
1171:                     (DisplayRole::Done, DONE_TEXT)
1172:                 };
1173:                 self.chats[sub_idx].mark_finished(role, text);
1174:             }
1175:         }
1176: 
1177:         if let AgentEvent::Retry {
1178:             attempt,
1179:             message,
1180:             delay_ms,
1181:         } = envelope.event
1182:         {
1183:             self.chats[chat_idx].stream_reset();
1184:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1185:                 self.retry_info = Some(RetryInfo {
1186:                     attempt,
1187:                     message,
1188:                     deadline: Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(delay_ms),
1189:                 });
1190:             }
1191:             return vec![];
1192:         }
1193: 
1194:         self.retry_info = None;
1195: 
1196:         let plan_path = if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan {
1197:             self.state.plan.path()
1198:         } else {
1199:             None
1200:         };
1201: 
1202:         if let AgentEvent::TurnComplete(ref tc) = envelope.event {
1203:             self.state.token_usage += tc.usage;
1204:             self.chats[chat_idx].token_usage += tc.usage;
1205:             *self
1206:                 .state
1207:                 .session
1208:                 .meta
1209:                 .usage_by_model
1210:                 .entry(tc.model.clone())
1211:                 .or_default() += tc.usage.into();
1212:             let ctx_size = tc.context_size.unwrap_or_else(|| tc.usage.context_tokens());
1213:             self.chats[chat_idx].context_size = ctx_size;
1214:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1215:                 self.state.context_size = ctx_size;
1216:                 if let Some(start) = self.turn_start.take() {
1217:                     let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
1218:                     let total = tc.usage.input + tc.usage.cache_creation + tc.usage.cache_read;
1219:                     let (pp_tps, tg_tps) = if elapsed > 0.0 {
1220:                         (total as f64 / elapsed, tc.usage.output as f64 / elapsed)
1221:                     } else {
1222:                         (0.0, 0.0)
1223:                     };
1224:                     let cache_rate = if total > 0 {
1225:                         tc.usage.cache_read as f64 / total as f64
1226:                     } else {
1227:                         0.0
1228:                     };
1229:                     self.last_turn_stats = Some(
1230:                         crate::components::status_bar::TurnStats {
1231:                             pp_tps,
1232:                             tg_tps,
1233:                             cache_rate,
1234:                         },
1235:                     );
1236:                 }
1237:             }
1238:             *maki_config::CURRENT_SESSION_NAME.lock().unwrap() = Some(self.state.session.title.clone());
1239:             let formatted =
1240:                 format_turn_usage(&tc.usage, &self.state.model.pricing, self.state.fast);
1241:             self.chats[chat_idx].set_pending_turn_usage(formatted);
1242:         }
1243: 
1244:         let result = self.chats[chat_idx].handle_event(envelope.event, plan_path);
1245: 
1246:         if let ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { text, image_count } = result {
1247:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1248:                 self.on_queue_item_consumed(&text, image_count);
1249:             }
1250:             return vec![];
1251:         }
1252: 
1253:         if let ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { id, tool, scopes } = result {
1254:             self.permission_prompt
1255:                 .open(id, tool, scopes, subagent_id.clone());
1256:             return vec![];
1257:         }
1258: 
1259:         if let ChatEventResult::AuthRequired = result {
1260:             self.chats[chat_idx].push(DisplayMessage::new(
1261:                 DisplayRole::Error,
1262:                 AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1263:             ));
1264:             if chat_idx != 0 {
1265:                 self.main_chat().push(DisplayMessage::new(
1266:                     DisplayRole::Error,
1267:                     AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1268:                 ));
1269:             }
1270:             self.pending_input = PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id };
1271:             return vec![];
1272:         }
1273: 
1274:         if chat_idx == 0 {
1275:             match result {
1276:                 ChatEventResult::Done => {
1277:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1278:                     self.save_session();
1279:                     self.chat_index.clear();
1280:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1281:                     self.status = Status::Idle;
1282:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1283:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnEnd", serde_json::json!({}));
1284:                     }
1285:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1286:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Success;
1287:                     }
1288:                     if self.state.session.title == "New session" {
1289:                         return self.start_rename();
1290:                     }
1291:                 }
1292:                 ChatEventResult::Error(message) => {
1293:                     self.status = Status::error(message.clone());
1294:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1295:                     self.save_session();
1296:                     self.queue.clear();
1297:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1298:                     self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT);
1299:                     for chat in &mut self.chats {
1300:                         chat.fail_in_progress_with_message(message.clone());
1301:                     }
1302:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1303:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnError", serde_json::json!({ "message": message }));
1304:                     }
1305:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1306:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Error;
1307:                     }
1308:                 }
1309:                 ChatEventResult::AuthRequired
1310:                 | ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { .. }
1311:                 | ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { .. } => unreachable!(),
1312:                 ChatEventResult::Continue => {}
1313:             }
1314:         }
1315:         vec![]
1316:     }
1317: 
1318:     fn resolve_or_create_chat(&mut self, subagent: &SubagentInfo) -> usize {
1319:         let id = &subagent.parent_tool_use_id;
1320:         if let Some(&idx) = self.chat_index.get(id.as_str()) {
1321:             return idx;
1322:         }
1323:         let idx = self.chats.len();
1324:         self.chat_index.insert(id.clone(), idx);
1325:         if let Some(ref tx) = subagent.answer_tx {
1326:             self.subagent_answers.insert(id.clone(), tx.clone());
1327:         }

1521:     fn execute_mcp_prompt(&mut self, name: &str, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1522:         let prompt = self.command_palette.find_mcp_prompt(name).unwrap().clone();
1523: 
1524:         let arguments = Self::parse_prompt_args(&prompt, args);
1525:         let missing: Vec<_> = prompt
1526:             .arguments
1527:             .iter()
1528:             .filter(|a| a.required && !arguments.contains_key(&a.name))
1529:             .map(|a| format!("<{}>", a.name))
1530:             .collect();
1531:         if !missing.is_empty() {
1532:             self.flash(format!("Usage: {} {}", name, missing.join(" ")));
1533:             return vec![];
1534:         }
1535: 
1536:         let prompt_ref = maki_agent::McpPromptRef {
1537:             qualified_name: prompt.qualified_name.clone(),
1538:             arguments,
1539:         };
1540:         let display_text = if args.trim().is_empty() {
1541:             name.to_string()
1542:         } else {
1543:             format!("{name} {args}")
1544:         };
1545:         let mut input = self.build_agent_input(&QueuedMessage {
1546:             text: display_text.clone(),
1547:             images: Vec::new(),
1548:         });
1549:         input.prompt = Some(Box::new(prompt_ref));
1550: 
1551:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1552:             self.flash("Agent is busy, try again later".into());
1553:             vec![]
1554:         } else {
1555:             self.run_id += 1;
1556:             self.status = Status::Streaming;
1557:             self.turn_start = Some(Instant::now());
1558:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display_text);
1559:             vec![Action::SendMessage(Box::new(input))]
1560:         }
1561:     }

1563:     fn parse_prompt_args(prompt: &McpPromptInfo, args: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {
1564:         let mut result = HashMap::new();
1565:         let mut remaining = args.trim();
1566:         if remaining.is_empty() || prompt.arguments.is_empty() {
1567:             return result;
1568:         }
1569:         let last_idx = prompt.arguments.len() - 1;
1570:         for (i, arg) in prompt.arguments.iter().enumerate() {
1571:             if remaining.is_empty() {
1572:                 break;
1573:             }
1574:             if i == last_idx {
1575:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1576:             } else if let Some((word, rest)) = remaining.split_once(char::is_whitespace) {
1577:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), word.to_string());
1578:                 remaining = rest.trim_start();
1579:             } else {
1580:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1581:                 break;
1582:             }
1583:         }
1584:         result
1585:     }

1593:         let msg = QueuedMessage {

1597:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {

1606:     fn cmd_cd(&mut self, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1607:         let path = if args.is_empty() {
1608:             maki_storage::paths::home().unwrap_or_default()
1609:         } else {
1610:             match args.strip_prefix('~') {
1611:                 Some(rest) => {
1612:                     let home = maki_storage::paths::home().unwrap_or_default();
1613:                     if rest.is_empty() {
1614:                         home
1615:                     } else {
1616:                         home.join(rest.trim_start_matches('/'))
1617:                     }
1618:                 }
1619:                 None => PathBuf::from(args),
1620:             }
1621:         };
1622:         match std::env::set_current_dir(&path) {
1623:             Ok(()) => {
1624:                 if let Ok(canonical) = std::env::current_dir() {
1625:                     self.state.session.cwd = canonical.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
1626:                 }
1627:                 self.status_bar.refresh_cwd();
1628:                 self.flash(format!("cd {}", path.display()))
1629:             }
1630:             Err(e) => self.flash(format!("cd: {e}")),
1631:         }
1632:         vec![]
1633:     }

1731:             sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, chat);

1734:         macro_rules! try_picker {

1737:                     return;
1738:                 }
1739:             };
1740:         }
1741:         try_picker!(self.file_picker);

1744:         try_picker!(self.rewind_picker);
1745:         try_picker!(self.goto_picker);

1758:     fn handle_plan_form_action(&mut self, action: PlanFormAction) -> Vec<Action> {
1759:         match action {

1761:             PlanFormAction::Hide => {
1762:                 self.plan_form.hide();
1763:                 vec![]
1764:             }
1765:             PlanFormAction::OpenEditor => match self.state.plan.path() {
1766:                 Some(p) => vec![Action::OpenEditor(p.to_path_buf())],
1767:                 None => {
1768:                     self.flash(FLASH_NO_PLAN.into());
1769:                     vec![]
1770:                 }
1771:             },
1772:             PlanFormAction::Implement => self.implement_plan(false),
1773:             PlanFormAction::ClearAndImplement => self.implement_plan(true),
1774:         }
1775:     }

1777:     fn implement_plan(&mut self, clear_context: bool) -> Vec<Action> {
1778:         let parallel = self.plan_form.parallel();
1779:         self.plan_form.reset();
1780:         let plan_snapshot = match std::mem::take(&mut self.state.plan) {
1781:             PlanState::Ready(p) => Some((
1782:                 std::fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap_or_default(),
1783:                 p.display().to_string(),
1784:             )),
1785:             _ => None,
1786:         };
1787: 
1788:         self.state.mode = Mode::Build;
1789: 
1790:         let mut actions = if clear_context {
1791:             self.reset_session()
1792:         } else {
1793:             vec![]
1794:         };
1795: 
1796:         let text = if let Some((content, path_str)) = plan_snapshot {
1797:             let text = if parallel {
1798:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`. {IMPLEMENT_PARALLEL_HINT}")
1799:             } else {
1800:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`.")
1801:             };
1802:             self.main_chat()
1803:                 .push(DisplayMessage::plan(content, path_str));
1804:             text
1805:         } else {
1806:             format!("{}.", IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX)
1807:         };
1808:         self.run_id += 1;
1809:         let msg = QueuedMessage {
1810:             text,
1811:             images: vec![],
1812:         };
1813:         actions.extend(self.start_from_queue(&msg));
1814:         actions
1815:     }
1816: }

83: const FLASH_REWIND: &str = "Press esc again to rewind...";
84: const AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG: &str =
85:     "Token expired. Run `maki auth login` in another terminal, then press Enter to retry.";

87: const FAST_UNSUPPORTED_MSG: &str = "Fast mode requires an Anthropic Opus 4.6+ model (API only)";

89: const FAST_OFF_MSG: &str = "Fast mode: off";

93: const IMPLEMENT_PARALLEL_HINT: &str = "Use batch+task to parallelize, assign each subagent a separate module and restrict its tests to that module to avoid interference.";

95: const TASK_DONE_DETAIL: &str = "✓ ";
96: 
97: #[derive(Clone)]
98: pub(super) struct TaskEntry {
99:     name: String,
100:     finished: Option<bool>,
101: }
102: 
103: impl PickerItem for TaskEntry {
104:     fn label(&self) -> &str {
105:         &self.name
106:     }
107:     fn detail(&self) -> Option<&str> {
108:         matches!(self.finished, Some(true)).then_some(TASK_DONE_DETAIL)
109:     }
110:     fn is_spinning(&self) -> bool {
111:         matches!(self.finished, Some(false))
112:     }
113: }
114: 
115: #[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
116: pub(super) enum PendingInput {
117:     #[default]
118:     None,
119:     AuthRetry {
120:         subagent_id: Option<String>,
121:     },
122: }

125:     Key(KeyEvent),
126:     Paste(String),
127:     Mouse(MouseEvent),
128:     Scroll { column: u16, row: u16, delta: i32 },
129:     Agent(Box<Envelope>),
130: }

281:     pub(crate) fn main_chat(&mut self) -> &mut Chat {
282:         &mut self.chats[0]
283:     }
284: 
285:     fn is_main_chat(&self) -> bool {
286:         self.active_chat == 0
287:     }
288: 
289:     fn plan_form_active(&self) -> bool {
290:         self.state.mode == Mode::Plan && self.plan_form.is_visible()
291:     }
292: 
293:     pub(crate) fn update_model(&mut self, model: &Model) {
294:         self.state.update_model(model);
295:         persist_model(&self.storage, &self.state.session.model);
296:     }
297: 
298:     pub(crate) fn record_recent_model(&mut self, spec: &str) {
299:         let recents = maki_storage::model::push_recent(&self.storage, spec);
300:         self.model_picker.set_recents(recents);
301:     }
302: 
303:     pub(crate) fn flash(&mut self, msg: String) {
304:         self.status_bar.flash(msg);
305:     }
306: 
307:     pub fn tick_error_expiry(&mut self) {
308:         if self.status.is_error_expired() {
309:             self.status = Status::Idle;
310:         }
311:     }
312: 
313:     fn active_chat(&mut self) -> &mut Chat {
314:         &mut self.chats[self.active_chat]
315:     }
316: 
317:     fn clear_selection_unless_pending_copy(&mut self) {
318:         if !self
319:             .selection_state
320:             .as_ref()
321:             .is_some_and(|s| s.is_pending_copy())
322:         {
323:             self.selection_state = None;
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pub fn update(&mut self, msg: Msg) -> Vec<Action> {
328:         match msg {
329:             Msg::Key(key) => self.handle_key(key),
330:             Msg::Paste(text) => {
331:                 let text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace('\r', "\n");
332:                 if text.is_empty() {
333:                     if self.is_main_chat() && self.image_paste_rx.is_empty() {
334:                         self.start_image_paste();
335:                     }
336:                 } else {
337:                     let mut any_image = false;
338:                     if self.is_main_chat() {
339:                         for line in text.lines() {
340:                             if let Some((path, mt)) = image::try_parse_image_path(line) {
341:                                 self.start_file_image_paste(path, mt);
342:                                 any_image = true;
343:                             }
344:                         }
345:                     }
346:                     if !any_image {
347:                         self.route_text_paste(&text);
348:                     }
349:                 }
350:                 vec![]
351:             }
352:             Msg::Mouse(event) => {
353:                 self.handle_mouse(event);
354:                 vec![]
355:             }
356:             Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta } => {
357:                 self.clear_selection_unless_pending_copy();
358:                 self.handle_scroll(column, row, delta);
359:                 vec![]
360:             }
361:             Msg::Agent(envelope) => self.handle_agent_event(*envelope),
362:         }
363:     }
364: 
365:     fn send_answer(&self, answer: String) {
366:         if let Some(tx) = &self.answer_tx {
367:             let _ = tx.try_send(answer);
368:         }
369:     }
370: 
371:     fn send_to_agent(&self, subagent_id: Option<&str>, answer: String) {
372:         let routed = subagent_id.and_then(|id| self.subagent_answers.get(id));
373:         if let Some(tx) = routed {
374:             let _ = tx.try_send(answer);
375:         } else {
376:             self.send_answer(answer);
377:         }
378:     }
379: 
380:     fn handle_scroll(&mut self, column: u16, row: u16, delta: i32) {
381:         if self.btw_modal.is_open() {
382:             self.btw_modal.scroll(delta);
383:             return;
384:         }
385:         if self.help_modal.is_open() {
386:             self.help_modal.scroll(delta);
387:             return;
388:         }
389:         if self.usage_modal.is_open() {
390:             self.usage_modal.scroll(delta);
391:             return;
392:         }
393:         let pos = Position::new(column, row);
394:         if self.float_mgr.is_open() && self.float_mgr.contains(pos) {
395:             self.float_mgr.scroll(delta);
396:             return;
397:         }
398:         macro_rules! try_picker {
399:             ($picker:expr) => {
400:                 if $picker.is_open() {
401:                     if $picker.contains(pos) {
402:                         $picker.scroll(delta);
403:                     }
404:                     return;
405:                 }
406:             };
407:         }
408:         try_picker!(self.session_picker);
409:         try_picker!(self.rewind_picker);
410:         try_picker!(self.task_picker);
411:         try_picker!(self.model_picker);
412:         try_picker!(self.file_picker);
413:         if let Some(zone) = self.zone_at(row, column) {
414:             self.scroll_zone(zone.zone, delta);
415:         }
416:     }
417: 
418:     fn open_tasks(&mut self) {
419:         let entries: Vec<TaskEntry> = self
420:             .chats
421:             .iter()
422:             .enumerate()
423:             .map(|(i, c)| TaskEntry {
424:                 name: c.name.clone(),
425:                 finished: (i > 0).then_some(c.is_finished()),
426:             })
427:             .collect();
428:         self.task_picker_original = Some(self.active_chat);
429:         self.task_picker.open(entries, " Tasks ");
430:         self.task_picker.select(self.active_chat);
431:     }
432: 
433:     fn handle_ctrl(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Option<Vec<Action>> {
434:         if !is_ctrl(&key) {
435:             return None;
436:         }
437:         if key::QUIT.matches(key) {
438:             self.command_palette.close();
439:             return Some(if !self.is_main_chat() || self.input_box.is_empty() {
440:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
441:                     return Some(self.handle_cancel());
442:                 }
443:                 self.quit()
444:             } else {
445:                 self.input_box.discard();
446:                 vec![]
447:             });
448:         }
449:         if key::HELP.matches(key) {
450:             self.help_modal.toggle();
451:             return Some(vec![]);
452:         }
453:         if key::TASKS.matches(key) {
454:             self.open_tasks();
455:             return Some(vec![]);
456:         }
457:         if key::PREV_CHAT.matches(key) {
458:             self.active_chat = self.active_chat.saturating_sub(1);
459:             return Some(vec![]);
460:         }
461:         if key::NEXT_CHAT.matches(key) {
462:             self.active_chat = (self.active_chat + 1).min(self.chats.len() - 1);
463:             return Some(vec![]);
464:         }
465:         if key::SCROLL_HALF_UP.matches(key) {
466:             let half = self.chats[self.active_chat].half_page();
467:             self.active_chat().scroll(half);
468:             return Some(vec![]);
469:         }
470:         if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key) {
471:             let half = self.chats[self.active_chat].half_page();
472:             self.active_chat().scroll(-half);
473:             return Some(vec![]);
474:         }
475:         if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key) {
476:             self.active_chat().scroll_to_top();
477:             return Some(vec![]);
478:         }
479:         if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key) {
480:             self.active_chat().enable_auto_scroll();
481:             return Some(vec![]);
482:         }
483:         if key::PLAN_TOGGLE.matches(key)
484:             && self.state.mode == Mode::Plan
485:             && self.state.plan.is_ready()
486:         {
487:             self.plan_form.toggle();
488:             return Some(vec![]);
489:         }
490:         None
491:     }
492: 
493:     fn dispatch_overlay(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Option<Vec<Action>> {
494:         if self.permission_prompt.is_open() {
495:             if let Some(answer) = self.permission_prompt.handle_key(key) {
496:                 let subagent_id = self.permission_prompt.subagent_id().map(str::to_owned);
497:                 let encoded = answer.encode();
498:                 self.permission_prompt.close();
499:                 self.send_to_agent(subagent_id.as_deref(), encoded);
500:             }
501:             return Some(vec![]);
502:         }
503: 
504:         // plan_form is non-modal: Passthrough falls through to the rest of dispatch
505:         if self.plan_form_active() {
506:             let action = self.plan_form.handle_key(key);
507:             if action != PlanFormAction::Passthrough {
508:                 return Some(self.handle_plan_form_action(action));
509:             }
510:         }
511: 
512:         if self.help_modal.is_open() {
513:             self.help_modal.handle_key(key);
514:             return Some(vec![]);
515:         }
516: 
517:         if self.usage_modal.is_open() {
518:             if key::REFRESH.matches(key) {
519:                 return Some(vec![Action::RefreshUsage]);
520:             }
521:             self.usage_modal.handle_key(key);
522:             return Some(vec![]);
523:         }
524: 
525:         if self.btw_modal.is_open() {
526:             self.btw_modal.handle_key(key);
527:             return Some(vec![]);
528:         }
529: 
530:         if self.float_mgr.handle_key(key) {
531:             return Some(vec![]);
532:         }
533: 
534:         if self.search_modal.is_open() {
535:             match self.search_modal.handle_key(key) {
536:                 SearchAction::Consumed => {
537:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
538:                     let texts = chat.segment_search_texts();
539:                     self.search_modal.update_matches(&texts);
540:                     sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, chat);
541:                 }
542:                 SearchAction::Navigate => {
543:                     sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, &mut self.chats[self.active_chat]);
544:                 }
545:                 SearchAction::Select(idx) => {
546:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
547:                     chat.scroll_to_segment(idx);
548:                     chat.set_highlight_segment(None);
549:                     self.search_modal.close();
550:                 }
551:                 SearchAction::Close(saved) => {
552:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
553:                     chat.set_highlight_segment(None);
554:                     if let Some((top, auto)) = saved {
555:                         chat.restore_scroll(top, auto);
556:                     }
557:                     self.search_modal.close();
558:                 }
559:             }
560:             return Some(vec![]);
561:         }
562: 
563:         if self.file_picker.is_open() {
564:             return Some(match self.file_picker.handle_key(key) {
565:                 FilePickerModalAction::Consumed => vec![],
566:                 FilePickerModalAction::Select(path) => {
567:                     self.file_picker.close();
568:                     if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) =
569:                         self.input_box.handle_paste_with_spaces(&path)
570:                     {
571:                         self.command_palette.sync(&val);
572:                     }
573:                     vec![]
574:                 }
575:                 FilePickerModalAction::Close => {
576:                     self.file_picker.close();
577:                     vec![]
578:                 }
579:             });
580:         }
581: 
582:         if self.queue.focus().is_some() {
583:             match key.code {
584:                 KeyCode::Up => self.queue.move_focus_up(),
585:                 KeyCode::Down => self.queue.move_focus_down(),
586:                 KeyCode::Enter => {
587:                     self.queue.remove_focused();
588:                 }
589:                 KeyCode::Esc => self.queue.unfocus(),
590:                 _ if key::QUIT.matches(key) => self.queue.unfocus(),
591:                 _ if key::POP_QUEUE.matches(key) => {
592:                     self.queue.remove(0);
593:                 }
594:                 _ => {}
595:             }
596:             return Some(vec![]);
597:         }
598: 
599:         if self.task_picker.is_open() {
600:             if key::TASKS.matches(key) {
601:                 self.task_picker.close();
602:                 return Some(vec![]);
603:             }
604:             return Some(match self.task_picker.handle_key(key) {
605:                 PickerAction::Consumed | PickerAction::Toggle(..) => vec![],
606:                 PickerAction::Select(idx, _) => {
607:                     self.task_picker_original = None;
608:                     self.active_chat = idx;
609:                     vec![]
610:                 }
611:                 PickerAction::Close => {
612:                     self.active_chat = self.task_picker_original.take().unwrap_or(0);
613:                     vec![]
614:                 }
615:             });
616:         }
617: 
618:         if self.session_picker.is_open() {
619:             return Some(match self.session_picker.handle_key(key) {
620:                 SessionPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
621:                 SessionPickerAction::Select(id) => self.load_session(id),
622:                 SessionPickerAction::ConfirmDelete => {
623:                     self.status_bar.flash(format!(
624:                         "Press {} again to confirm delete",
625:                         key::DELETE.label
626:                     ));
627:                     vec![]
628:                 }
629:                 SessionPickerAction::Delete(id) => self.delete_session(id),
630:                 SessionPickerAction::Close => vec![],
631:             });
632:         }
633: 
634:         if self.rewind_picker.is_open() {
635:             return Some(match self.rewind_picker.handle_key(key) {
636:                 RewindPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
637:                 RewindPickerAction::Select(entry) => self.rewind_to(entry),
638:                 RewindPickerAction::Close => vec![],
639:             });
640:         }
641: 
642:         if self.theme_picker.is_open() {
643:             return Some(match self.theme_picker.handle_key(key) {
644:                 ThemePickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
645:                 ThemePickerAction::Closed => vec![],
646:             });
647:         }
648: 
649:         if self.model_picker.is_open() {
650:             return Some(match self.model_picker.handle_key(key) {
651:                 ModelPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
652:                 ModelPickerAction::Select(spec) => {
653:                     vec![Action::ChangeModel(spec)]
654:                 }
655:                 ModelPickerAction::AssignTier(spec, tier) => {
656:                     vec![Action::AssignTier(spec, tier)]
657:                 }
658:                 ModelPickerAction::UnassignTier(spec, tier) => {
659:                     vec![Action::UnassignTier(spec, tier)]
660:                 }
661:                 ModelPickerAction::Close => vec![],
662:             });
663:         }
664: 
665:         if self.settings_picker.is_open() {
666:             return Some(match self.settings_picker.handle_key(key) {
667:                 SettingsPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
668:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowSystemPrompt(val) => {
669:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
670:                     settings.show_system_prompt = val;
671:                     settings.save();
672:                     vec![]
673:                 }
674:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleApiLogging(val) => {
675:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
676:                     settings.api_logging = val;
677:                     settings.save();
678:                     vec![]
679:                 }
680:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowReasoning(val) => {
681:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
682:                     settings.show_reasoning = val;
683:                     settings.save();
684:                     vec![]
685:                 }
686:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowTokenStats(val) => {
687:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
688:                     settings.show_token_stats = val;
689:                     settings.save();
690:                     self.show_token_stats = val;
691:                     vec![]
692:                 }
693:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleGlobalSessions(val) => {
694:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
695:                     settings.global_sessions = val;
696:                     settings.save();
697:                     if val {
698:                         self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions enabled".into());
699:                     } else {
700:                         self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions disabled".into());
701:                     }
702:                     vec![]
703:                 }
704:                 SettingsPickerAction::EditLogCommand => {
705:                     self.settings_picker.close();
706:                     if let Ok(path) = crate::config::config_path() {
707:                         vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]
708:                     } else {
709:                         vec![]
710:                     }
711:                 }
712:                 SettingsPickerAction::Closed => vec![],
713:             });
714:         }
715: 
716:         if self.login_picker.is_open() {
717:             return Some(match self.login_picker.handle_key(key) {
718:                 LoginPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
719:                 LoginPickerAction::Close => vec![],
720:                 LoginPickerAction::Authenticated { model_spec } => {
721:                     vec![Action::ChangeModel(model_spec), Action::RefreshModels]
722:                 }
723:                 LoginPickerAction::Configured { slug } => {
724:                     vec![Action::RefreshProvider { slug }, Action::RefreshModels]
725:                 }
726:             });
727:         }
728: 
729:         if self.mcp_picker.is_open() {
730:             return Some(match self.mcp_picker.handle_key(key) {
731:                 McpPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
732:                 McpPickerAction::Toggle {
733:                     server_name,
734:                     enabled,
735:                 } => {
736:                     vec![Action::ToggleMcp(server_name, enabled)]
737:                 }
738:                 McpPickerAction::Close => vec![],
739:             });
740:         }
741: 
742:         None
743:     }
744: 
745:     fn handle_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Vec<Action> {
746:         self.clear_selection_unless_pending_copy();
747: 
748:         if key::SUSPEND.matches(key) && cfg!(unix) {
749:             return self.suspend();
750:         }
751: 
752:         if let Some(actions) = self.dispatch_overlay(key) {
753:             return actions;
754:         }
755: 
756:         if let Some(actions) = self.handle_ctrl(key) {
757:             return actions;
758:         }
759: 
760:         if self.dispatch_plugin_keymap(key) {
761:             return vec![];
762:         }
763: 
764:         if !self.is_main_chat() {
765:             return match key.code {
766:                 KeyCode::Tab if !self.is_bash_input() => self.toggle_mode(),
767:                 KeyCode::Esc if !self.chats[self.active_chat].is_finished() => {
768:                     if let Some(t) = self.last_esc.take()
769:                         && t.elapsed() < self.status_bar.flash_duration
770:                     {
771:                         self.handle_subagent_cancel()
772:                     } else {
773:                         self.last_esc = Some(Instant::now());
774:                         self.status_bar.flash(FLASH_CANCEL.into());
775:                         vec![]
776:                     }
777:                 }
778:                 _ => vec![],
779:             };
780:         }
781: 
782:         self.handle_main_chat_key(key)
783:     }
784: 
785:     fn dispatch_plugin_keymap(&self, key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
786:         let snap = self.keymap_reader.load();
787:         for entry in &snap.entries {
788:             if entry.key == key.code && entry.modifiers == key.modifiers {
789:                 if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
790:                     handle.run_keybind_callback(entry.id);
791:                 }
792:                 return true;
793:             }
794:         }
795:         false
796:     }
797: 
798:     fn handle_main_chat_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Vec<Action> {
799:         if key::EDIT_INPUT.matches(key) {
800:             return vec![Action::EditInputInEditor];
801:         }
802:         if is_ctrl(&key) {
803:             if key::POP_QUEUE.matches(key) {
804:                 self.queue.remove(0);
805:             } else if key::OPEN_EDITOR.matches(key) {
806:                 return match self.state.plan.path() {
807:                     Some(p) => vec![Action::OpenEditor(p.to_path_buf())],
808:                     None => {
809:                         self.flash(FLASH_NO_PLAN.into());
810:                         vec![]
811:                     }
812:                 };
813:             } else if key::SEARCH.matches(key) {
814:                 let top = self.chats[self.active_chat].scroll_top();
815:                 let auto = self.chats[self.active_chat].auto_scroll();
816:                 self.search_modal.open(top, auto);
817:             } else if key::FILE_PICKER.matches(key) {
818:                 self.file_picker.open(&self.state.session.cwd);
819:             } else if key.code == KeyCode::Char('v') && self.image_paste_rx.is_empty() {
820:                 self.start_image_paste();
821:             } else if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) = self.input_box.handle_key(key) {
822:                 self.command_palette.sync(&val);
823:             }
824:             return vec![];
825:         }
826: 
827:         match self
828:             .command_palette
829:             .handle_key(key, &self.input_box.buffer.value())
830:         {
831:             CommandAction::Consumed => return vec![],
832:             CommandAction::Execute(cmd) => return self.execute_command(cmd),
833:             CommandAction::Complete(text) => {
834:                 self.command_palette.sync(&text);
835:                 self.input_box.set_input(text);
836:                 self.input_box.buffer.move_to_end();
837:                 return vec![];
838:             }
839:             CommandAction::Passthrough => {}
840:         }
841: 
842:         let streaming = self.status == Status::Streaming;
843:         match self.input_box.handle_key(key) {
844:             InputAction::Submit(sub) => self.handle_submit(sub),
845:             InputAction::PaletteSync(val) => {
846:                 self.command_palette.sync(&val);
847:                 vec![]
848:             }
849:             InputAction::Passthrough(key) => {
850:                 if key.code != KeyCode::Esc {
851:                     self.last_esc = None;
852:                 }
853:                 match key.code {
854:                     KeyCode::Up if streaming => {
855:                         self.active_chat().scroll(1);
856:                         vec![]
857:                     }
858:                     KeyCode::Down if streaming => {
859:                         self.active_chat().scroll(-1);
860:                         vec![]
861:                     }
862:                     KeyCode::Tab if !self.is_bash_input() => self.toggle_mode(),
863:                     KeyCode::Esc => {
864:                         if let Some(t) = self.last_esc.take()
865:                             && t.elapsed() < self.status_bar.flash_duration
866:                         {
867:                             if streaming {
868:                                 self.handle_cancel()
869:                             } else {
870:                                 self.open_rewind_picker()
871:                             }
872:                         } else {
873:                             self.last_esc = Some(Instant::now());
874:                             self.status_bar.flash(
875:                                 if streaming {
876:                                     FLASH_CANCEL
877:                                 } else {
878:                                     FLASH_REWIND
879:                                 }
880:                                 .into(),
881:                             );
882:                             vec![]
883:                         }
884:                     }
885:                     _ => vec![],
886:                 }
887:             }
888:             InputAction::ContinueLine | InputAction::None => vec![],
889:         }
890:     }
891: 
892:     fn suspend(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {

894:     }

899:         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Success;

903:     pub fn reload_config(&mut self) {
904:         let settings = UserSettings::load();
905:         self.show_token_stats = settings.show_token_stats;
906:         self.status_bar.flash("Configuration reloaded".to_string());

909:     fn start_rename(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
910:         let user_texts: Vec<String> = self
911:             .state
912:             .session
913:             .messages
914:             .iter()
915:             .filter_map(|m| m.user_text().map(str::to_string))
916:             .take(3)
917:             .collect();
918: 
919:         if user_texts.is_empty() {
920:             self.flash("Nothing to rename yet — send a message first".into());
921:             return vec![];
922:         }
923: 
924:         let mut total_words = 0usize;
925:         let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
926:         'outer: for text in &user_texts {
927:             let mut words: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
928:             for word in text.split_whitespace() {
929:                 if total_words >= 200 {
930:                     break 'outer;
931:                 }
932:                 words.push(word);
933:                 total_words += 1;
934:             }
935:             parts.push(words.join(" "));
936:         }
937: 
938:         let context = parts.join("\n\n");
939:         let msg = Message::user(context);
940:         self.flash("Renaming session…".into());
941:         vec![Action::RenameSession(vec![msg])]
942:     }
943: 
944:     pub(crate) fn apply_rename(&mut self, title: String) {
945:         self.state.session.title = title.clone();
946:         self.save_session();
947:         self.status_bar.flash(format!("Session renamed to: {title}"));
948:     }
949: 
950:     pub(crate) fn handle_submit(&mut self, sub: Submission) -> Vec<Action> {
951:         match std::mem::take(&mut self.pending_input) {
952:             PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id } => {
953:                 self.send_to_agent(subagent_id.as_deref(), String::new());
954:                 return vec![];
955:             }
956:             PendingInput::None => {}
957:         }
958:         if sub.is_empty() {
959:             return vec![];
960:         }
961:         if sub.text.trim() == "exit" {
962:             return self.quit();
963:         }
964: 
965:         if let Some(prefix) = shell::parse_shell_prefix(&sub.text) {
966:             let cmd = prefix.command.trim();
967:             if cmd == "cd" || cmd.starts_with("cd ") {
968:                 self.flash("Only /cd can change the working directory".into());
969:             }
970:             let id = self.shell.next_id();
971:             let sigil = if prefix.visible { "!" } else { "!!" };
972:             let display = format!("{sigil} {}", prefix.command);
973:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display);
974:             return vec![Action::ShellCommand {
975:                 id,
976:                 command: prefix.command,
977:                 visible: prefix.visible,
978:             }];
979:         }
980:         let msg: QueuedMessage = sub.into();
981:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
982:             self.queue_and_notify(msg);
983:             vec![]
984:         } else {
985:             self.run_id += 1;
986:             self.start_from_queue(&msg)
987:         }
988:     }
989: 
990:     fn handle_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
991:         let cancelled_run = self.run_id;
992:         self.run_id += 1;
993:         self.retry_info = None;
994:         self.close_all_overlays();
995:         self.pending_input = PendingInput::None;
996:         self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
997:         self.subagent_answers.clear();
998:         self.shell.cancel_all();
999:         for chat in &mut self.chats {
1000:             chat.flush();
1001:             chat.cancel_in_progress();
1002:         }
1003:         self.main_chat()
1004:             .push(DisplayMessage::new(DisplayRole::Error, CANCEL_MSG.into()));
1005:         self.queue.clear();
1006:         self.status = Status::Idle;
1007:         vec![Action::CancelAgent {
1008:             run_id: cancelled_run,
1009:         }]
1010:     }
1011: 
1012:     fn handle_subagent_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1013:         let tool_use_id = self
1014:             .chat_index
1015:             .iter()
1016:             .find(|&(_, &idx)| idx == self.active_chat)
1017:             .map(|(id, _)| id.clone());
1018: 
1019:         let Some(tool_use_id) = tool_use_id else {
1020:             return vec![];
1021:         };
1022: 
1023:         self.chats[self.active_chat].flush();
1024:         self.chats[self.active_chat].cancel_in_progress();
1025:         self.chats[self.active_chat].mark_finished(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
1026:         self.subagent_answers.remove(&tool_use_id);
1027: 
1028:         vec![Action::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id }]
1029:     }
1030: 
1031:     fn handle_agent_event(&mut self, envelope: Envelope) -> Vec<Action> {
1032:         if let AgentEvent::RenameResult { title } = envelope.event {
1033:             self.apply_rename(title);
1034:             return vec![];
1035:         }
1036: 
1037:         if envelope.run_id == RESTORE_RUN_ID {
1038:             let (id, snapshot, theme_gen, is_header) = match envelope.event {
1039:                 AgentEvent::ToolSnapshot {
1040:                     id,
1041:                     snapshot,
1042:                     theme_gen,
1043:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, false),
1044:                 AgentEvent::ToolHeaderSnapshot {
1045:                     id,
1046:                     snapshot,
1047:                     theme_gen,
1048:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, true),
1049:                 _ => return vec![],
1050:             };
1051:             for chat in &mut self.chats {
1052:                 if is_header {
1053:                     chat.tool_header_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1054:                 } else {
1055:                     chat.tool_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1056:                 }
1057:             }
1058:             return vec![];
1059:         }
1060:         if envelope.run_id != self.run_id {
1061:             // Stale run_id after cancel: agent updates shared_history before sending
1062:             // Done/Error, so this is the first moment the full conversation is available.
1063:             if matches!(
1064:                 envelope.event,
1065:                 AgentEvent::Done { .. } | AgentEvent::Error { .. }
1066:             ) {
1067:                 self.save_session();
1068:             }
1069:             return vec![];
1070:         }
1071: 
1072:         if let AgentEvent::SubagentHistory {
1073:             tool_use_id,
1074:             messages,
1075:         } = envelope.event
1076:         {
1077:             // Workflow sessions use synthetic ids that no ToolDone will match,
1078:             // so we finish them here on SubagentHistory.
1079:             if let Some(&sub_idx) = self.chat_index.get(tool_use_id.as_str()) {
1080:                 self.chats[sub_idx].mark_finished(DisplayRole::Done, DONE_TEXT);
1081:             }
1082:             self.state
1083:                 .session
1084:                 .subagent_messages
1085:                 .insert(tool_use_id, messages);
1086:             return vec![];
1087:         }
1088: 
1089:         let subagent_id = envelope
1090:             .subagent
1091:             .as_ref()
1092:             .map(|s| s.parent_tool_use_id.clone());
1093: 
1094:         let chat_idx = match envelope.subagent {
1095:             Some(ref subagent) => self.resolve_or_create_chat(subagent),
1096:             None => 0,
1097:         };
1098: 
1099:         if let AgentEvent::ToolDone(ref e) = envelope.event {
1100:             if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan
1101:                 && self.state.plan.path().is_some_and(|pp| e.wrote_to(pp))
1102:             {
1103:                 self.transition_plan(PlanTrigger::WriteDone);
1104:             }
1105:             if let Some(ref outputs) = self.shared_tool_outputs {
1106:                 outputs
1107:                     .lock()
1108:                     .unwrap()
1109:                     .insert(e.id.clone(), e.output.clone());
1110:             }
1111:             if let Some(&sub_idx) = self.chat_index.get(&e.id) {
1112:                 let (role, text) = if e.is_error {
1113:                     (DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT)
1114:                 } else {
1115:                     (DisplayRole::Done, DONE_TEXT)
1116:                 };
1117:                 self.chats[sub_idx].mark_finished(role, text);
1118:             }
1119:         }
1120: 
1121:         if let AgentEvent::Retry {
1122:             attempt,
1123:             message,
1124:             delay_ms,
1125:         } = envelope.event
1126:         {
1127:             self.chats[chat_idx].stream_reset();
1128:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1129:                 self.retry_info = Some(RetryInfo {
1130:                     attempt,
1131:                     message,
1132:                     deadline: Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(delay_ms),
1133:                 });
1134:             }
1135:             return vec![];
1136:         }
1137: 
1138:         self.retry_info = None;
1139: 
1140:         let plan_path = if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan {
1141:             self.state.plan.path()
1142:         } else {
1143:             None
1144:         };
1145: 
1146:         if let AgentEvent::TurnComplete(ref tc) = envelope.event {
1147:             self.state.token_usage += tc.usage;
1148:             self.chats[chat_idx].token_usage += tc.usage;
1149:             *self
1150:                 .state
1151:                 .session
1152:                 .meta
1153:                 .usage_by_model
1154:                 .entry(tc.model.clone())
1155:                 .or_default() += tc.usage.into();
1156:             let ctx_size = tc.context_size.unwrap_or_else(|| tc.usage.context_tokens());
1157:             self.chats[chat_idx].context_size = ctx_size;
1158:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1159:                 self.state.context_size = ctx_size;
1160:                 if let Some(start) = self.turn_start.take() {
1161:                     let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
1162:                     let total = tc.usage.input + tc.usage.cache_creation + tc.usage.cache_read;
1163:                     let (pp_tps, tg_tps) = if elapsed > 0.0 {
1164:                         (total as f64 / elapsed, tc.usage.output as f64 / elapsed)
1165:                     } else {
1166:                         (0.0, 0.0)
1167:                     };
1168:                     let cache_rate = if total > 0 {
1169:                         tc.usage.cache_read as f64 / total as f64
1170:                     } else {
1171:                         0.0
1172:                     };
1173:                     self.last_turn_stats = Some(
1174:                         crate::components::status_bar::TurnStats {
1175:                             pp_tps,
1176:                             tg_tps,
1177:                             cache_rate,
1178:                         },
1179:                     );
1180:                 }
1181:             }
1182:             *maki_config::CURRENT_SESSION_NAME.lock().unwrap() = Some(self.state.session.title.clone());
1183:             let formatted =
1184:                 format_turn_usage(&tc.usage, &self.state.model.pricing, self.state.fast);
1185:             self.chats[chat_idx].set_pending_turn_usage(formatted);
1186:         }
1187: 
1188:         let result = self.chats[chat_idx].handle_event(envelope.event, plan_path);
1189: 
1190:         if let ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { text, image_count } = result {
1191:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1192:                 self.on_queue_item_consumed(&text, image_count);
1193:             }
1194:             return vec![];
1195:         }
1196: 
1197:         if let ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { id, tool, scopes } = result {
1198:             self.permission_prompt
1199:                 .open(id, tool, scopes, subagent_id.clone());
1200:             return vec![];
1201:         }
1202: 
1203:         if let ChatEventResult::AuthRequired = result {
1204:             self.chats[chat_idx].push(DisplayMessage::new(
1205:                 DisplayRole::Error,
1206:                 AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1207:             ));
1208:             if chat_idx != 0 {
1209:                 self.main_chat().push(DisplayMessage::new(
1210:                     DisplayRole::Error,
1211:                     AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1212:                 ));
1213:             }
1214:             self.pending_input = PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id };
1215:             return vec![];
1216:         }
1217: 
1218:         if chat_idx == 0 {
1219:             match result {
1220:                 ChatEventResult::Done => {
1221:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1222:                     self.save_session();
1223:                     self.chat_index.clear();
1224:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1225:                     self.status = Status::Idle;
1226:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1227:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnEnd", serde_json::json!({}));
1228:                     }
1229:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1230:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Success;
1231:                     }
1232:                     if self.state.session.title == "New session" {
1233:                         return self.start_rename();
1234:                     }
1235:                 }
1236:                 ChatEventResult::Error(message) => {
1237:                     self.status = Status::error(message.clone());
1238:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1239:                     self.save_session();
1240:                     self.queue.clear();
1241:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1242:                     self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT);
1243:                     for chat in &mut self.chats {
1244:                         chat.fail_in_progress_with_message(message.clone());
1245:                     }
1246:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1247:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnError", serde_json::json!({ "message": message }));
1248:                     }
1249:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1250:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Error;
1251:                     }
1252:                 }
1253:                 ChatEventResult::AuthRequired
1254:                 | ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { .. }
1255:                 | ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { .. } => unreachable!(),
1256:                 ChatEventResult::Continue => {}
1257:             }
1258:         }
1259:         vec![]
1260:     }
1261: 
1262:     fn resolve_or_create_chat(&mut self, subagent: &SubagentInfo) -> usize {
1263:         let id = &subagent.parent_tool_use_id;
1264:         if let Some(&idx) = self.chat_index.get(id.as_str()) {
1265:             return idx;
1266:         }
1267:         let idx = self.chats.len();
1268:         self.chat_index.insert(id.clone(), idx);
1269:         if let Some(ref tx) = subagent.answer_tx {
1270:             self.subagent_answers.insert(id.clone(), tx.clone());
1271:         }
1272:         self.chats[0].update_tool_summary(id, &subagent.name);
1273:         if let Some(ref model) = subagent.model {
1274:             self.chats[0].update_tool_model(id, model);
1275:         }
1276:         let mut chat = Chat::new(subagent.name.clone(), self.ui_config);
1277:         chat.set_restore_channel(self.lua_event_handle.clone(), self.restore_event_tx.clone());
1278:         chat.model_id = subagent.model.clone();
1279:         if let Some(ref prompt) = subagent.prompt {
1280:             chat.push_user_message(prompt);
1281:         }
1282:         self.chats.push(chat);
1283:         idx
1284:     }
1285: 
1286:     fn execute_command(&mut self, cmd: ParsedCommand) -> Vec<Action> {
1287:         self.input_box.discard();
1288:         match cmd.name.as_str() {
1289:             "/tasks" => {
1290:                 self.open_tasks();
1291:                 vec![]
1292:             }
1293:             "/compact" => {
1294:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1295:                     self.queue_compact();
1296:                     return vec![];
1297:                 }
1298:                 self.status = Status::Streaming;
1299:                 vec![Action::Compact]
1300:             }
1301:             "/checkpoint" => {

1448:     fn execute_mcp_prompt(&mut self, name: &str, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1449:         let prompt = self.command_palette.find_mcp_prompt(name).unwrap().clone();
1450: 
1451:         let arguments = Self::parse_prompt_args(&prompt, args);
1452:         let missing: Vec<_> = prompt
1453:             .arguments
1454:             .iter()
1455:             .filter(|a| a.required && !arguments.contains_key(&a.name))
1456:             .map(|a| format!("<{}>", a.name))
1457:             .collect();
1458:         if !missing.is_empty() {
1459:             self.flash(format!("Usage: {} {}", name, missing.join(" ")));
1460:             return vec![];
1461:         }
1462: 
1463:         let prompt_ref = maki_agent::McpPromptRef {
1464:             qualified_name: prompt.qualified_name.clone(),
1465:             arguments,
1466:         };
1467:         let display_text = if args.trim().is_empty() {
1468:             name.to_string()
1469:         } else {
1470:             format!("{name} {args}")
1471:         };
1472:         let mut input = self.build_agent_input(&QueuedMessage {
1473:             text: display_text.clone(),
1474:             images: Vec::new(),
1475:         });
1476:         input.prompt = Some(Box::new(prompt_ref));
1477: 
1478:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1479:             self.flash("Agent is busy, try again later".into());
1480:             vec![]
1481:         } else {
1482:             self.run_id += 1;
1483:             self.status = Status::Streaming;
1484:             self.turn_start = Some(Instant::now());
1485:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display_text);
1486:             vec![Action::SendMessage(Box::new(input))]
1487:         }
1488:     }

1490:     fn parse_prompt_args(prompt: &McpPromptInfo, args: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {
1491:         let mut result = HashMap::new();
1492:         let mut remaining = args.trim();
1493:         if remaining.is_empty() || prompt.arguments.is_empty() {
1494:             return result;
1495:         }
1496:         let last_idx = prompt.arguments.len() - 1;
1497:         for (i, arg) in prompt.arguments.iter().enumerate() {
1498:             if remaining.is_empty() {
1499:                 break;
1500:             }
1501:             if i == last_idx {
1502:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1503:             } else if let Some((word, rest)) = remaining.split_once(char::is_whitespace) {
1504:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), word.to_string());
1505:                 remaining = rest.trim_start();
1506:             } else {
1507:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1508:                 break;
1509:             }
1510:         }
1511:         result
1512:     }

1519:         let rendered = cmd.render(args);
1520:         let msg = QueuedMessage {
1521:             text: rendered,

1524:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {

1529:             self.start_from_queue(&msg)

1540:                     if rest.is_empty() {
1541:                         home

1543:                         home.join(rest.trim_start_matches('/'))
1544:                     }
1545:                 }
1546:                 None => PathBuf::from(args),
1547:             }
1548:         };
1549:         match std::env::set_current_dir(&path) {
1550:             Ok(()) => {
1551:                 if let Ok(canonical) = std::env::current_dir() {
1552:                     self.state.session.cwd = canonical.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
1553:                 }
1554:                 self.status_bar.refresh_cwd();
1555:                 self.flash(format!("cd {}", path.display()))
1556:             }
1557:             Err(e) => self.flash(format!("cd: {e}")),
1558:         }
1559:         vec![]
1560:     }

1641:     fn route_text_paste(&mut self, text: &str) {
1642:         if self.plan_form_active() {

1644:         }
1645:         if self.permission_prompt.handle_paste(text) {
1646:             return;

1652:             self.search_modal.handle_paste(text);
1653:             let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
1654:             let texts = chat.segment_search_texts();
1655:             self.search_modal.update_matches(&texts);
1656:             sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, chat);
1657:             return;
1658:         }
1659:         macro_rules! try_picker {
1660:             ($picker:expr) => {
1661:                 if $picker.handle_paste(text) {
1662:                     return;
1663:                 }
1664:             };
1665:         }
1666:         try_picker!(self.file_picker);
1667:         try_picker!(self.task_picker);
1668:         try_picker!(self.session_picker);
1669:         try_picker!(self.rewind_picker);
1670:         try_picker!(self.theme_picker);
1671:         try_picker!(self.model_picker);
1672:         try_picker!(self.mcp_picker);
1673:         try_picker!(self.login_picker);
1674:         if !self.is_main_chat() {
1675:             return;
1676:         }
1677:         if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) = self.input_box.handle_paste(text) {
1678:             self.command_palette.sync(&val);
1679:         }
1680:     }

1689:             PlanFormAction::OpenEditor => match self.state.plan.path() {

1691:                 None => {
1692:                     self.flash(FLASH_NO_PLAN.into());
1693:                     vec![]
1694:                 }
1695:             },

1698:         }

1701:     fn implement_plan(&mut self, clear_context: bool) -> Vec<Action> {
1702:         let parallel = self.plan_form.parallel();
1703:         self.plan_form.reset();
1704:         let plan_snapshot = match std::mem::take(&mut self.state.plan) {
1705:             PlanState::Ready(p) => Some((
1706:                 std::fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap_or_default(),
1707:                 p.display().to_string(),
1708:             )),
1709:             _ => None,
1710:         };
1711: 
1712:         self.state.mode = Mode::Build;
1713: 
1714:         let mut actions = if clear_context {
1715:             self.reset_session()
1716:         } else {
1717:             vec![]
1718:         };
1719: 
1720:         let text = if let Some((content, path_str)) = plan_snapshot {
1721:             let text = if parallel {
1722:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`. {IMPLEMENT_PARALLEL_HINT}")
1723:             } else {
1724:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`.")
1725:             };
1726:             self.main_chat()
1727:                 .push(DisplayMessage::plan(content, path_str));
1728:             text
1729:         } else {
1730:             format!("{}.", IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX)
1731:         };
1732:         self.run_id += 1;
1733:         let msg = QueuedMessage {
1734:             text,
1735:             images: vec![],
1736:         };
1737:         actions.extend(self.start_from_queue(&msg));
1738:         actions
1739:     }
1740: }

154:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-self.half_page()),
155:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(1),
156:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-1),
157:             _ if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key_event) => {
158:                 self.offset = 0;
159:                 self.auto_scroll = false;
160:             }
161:             _ if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key_event) => {
162:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
163:                 self.offset = self.max_offset;
164:             }
165:             _ => return false,
166:         }
167:         true
168:     }
169: 
170:     fn half_page(&self) -> i32 {
171:         (self.viewport_h / 2).max(1) as i32
172:     }
173: 
174:     fn clamp(&mut self) {
175:         self.offset = self.offset.min(self.max_offset);
176:     }
177: }

224: pub enum ExitRequest {

240: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
241: pub enum Status {
242:     Idle,
243:     Streaming,
244:     Error { message: String, since: Instant },
245: }
246: 
247: impl Status {
248:     pub fn error(message: String) -> Self {
249:         Self::Error {
250:             message,
251:             since: Instant::now(),
252:         }
253:     }
254: 
255:     pub fn is_error_expired(&self) -> bool {
256:         matches!(self, Self::Error { since, .. } if since.elapsed() >= ERROR_DISPLAY)
257:     }
258: }
259: 
260: impl PartialEq for Status {
261:     fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
262:         matches!(
263:             (self, other),
264:             (Self::Idle, Self::Idle)
265:                 | (Self::Streaming, Self::Streaming)
266:                 | (Self::Error { .. }, Self::Error { .. })
267:         )
268:     }
269: }

79: 
80: fn merge_batch(
81:     available: &Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>>,
82:     batch: maki_providers::provider::ModelBatch,
83:     warn_tx: &flume::Sender<String>,
84: ) {
85:     for w in batch.warnings {
86:         let _ = warn_tx.try_send(w);
87:     }
88:     if batch.models.is_empty() {
89:         return;
90:     }
91:     let mut merged = available.load().as_deref().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
92:     for spec in &batch.models {
93:         if !merged.contains(spec) {
94:             merged.push(spec.clone());
95:         }
96:     }
97:     available.store(Some(Arc::new(merged)));
98: }
99: 
100: fn spawn_model_fetch(model_slot: &Arc<ArcSwap<ModelSlot>>, timeouts: Timeouts) -> BackgroundModels {
101:     let available: Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>> = Arc::new(ArcSwapOption::empty());
102:     let bg = Arc::clone(&available);
103:     let (warn_tx, warn_rx) = flume::unbounded::<String>();
104:     let warn_tx_bg = warn_tx.clone();
105:     let model_slot = Arc::clone(model_slot);
106:     let task = smol::spawn(async move {
107:         let warn_tx = warn_tx_bg;
108:         let done = Box::new(move || {
109:             let spec = model_slot.load().model.spec();
110:             let mut resolved = match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
111:                 Ok(m) => m,
112:                 Err(e) => {
113:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to resolve model after discovery");
114:                     return;
115:                 }
116:             };
117:             let provider = match from_model(&mut resolved, timeouts) {
118:                 Ok(p) => p,
119:                 Err(e) => {
120:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to create provider after discovery");
121:                     return;
122:                 }
123:             };
124:             model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
125:                 model: resolved,
126:                 provider: Arc::from(provider),
127:             }));
128:         });
129:         fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&bg, batch, &warn_tx), Some(done)).await;
130:     });
131:     BackgroundModels {
132:         available,
133:         warn_rx,
134:         warn_tx,
135:         task,
136:     }
137: }

352:                             .open(buf, config, focus, event_tx, cmd_rx);
353:                         if focus {
354:                             self.app
355:                                 .transition_plan(crate::app::mode::PlanTrigger::InteractivePrompt);
356:                         }
357:                     }
358:                 }
359:             }
360:         }
361: 
362:         had_agent_msg
