365:     fn poll_and_handle_input(&mut self, had_agent_msg: bool) -> Result<()> {
366:         let has_pending_ui_action = self.ui_action_rx.as_ref().is_some_and(|rx| !rx.is_empty());
367:         let poll_duration = if had_agent_msg || has_pending_ui_action {
368:             Duration::ZERO
369:         } else if self.app.is_animating() {
370:             Duration::from_millis(ANIMATION_INTERVAL_MS)
371:         } else {
372:             Duration::from_millis(IDLE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
373:         };
374: 
375:         if !event::poll(poll_duration)? {
376:             return Ok(());
377:         }
378: 
379:         if let Some(msg) = self.translate_input()? {
380:             let actions = self.app.update(msg);
381:             self.dispatch(actions);
382:         }
383:         Ok(())
384:     }
385: 
386:     fn translate_input(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Msg>> {
387:         let raw = event::read()?;
388:         match raw {
389:             Event::Key(key) if key.kind == KeyEventKind::Press => Ok(Some(Msg::Key(key))),
390:             Event::Key(_) => Ok(None),
391:             Event::Paste(text) => Ok(Some(Msg::Paste(text))),
392:             Event::Mouse(mouse) => Ok(self.translate_mouse(mouse)),
393:             _ => Ok(None),
394:         }
395:     }
396: 
397:     fn translate_mouse(&mut self, mouse: CtMouseEvent) -> Option<Msg> {
398:         match mouse.kind {
399:             MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
400:                 let (scroll, extra) = aggregate_scroll(
401:                     mouse.column,
402:                     mouse.row,
403:                     scroll_delta(mouse.kind, self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines),
404:                     self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines,
405:                 );
406:                 if let Some(extra) = extra {
407:                     let actions = self.app.update(scroll);
408:                     self.dispatch(actions);
409:                     Some(extra)
410:                 } else {
411:                     Some(scroll)
412:                 }
413:             }
414:             MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left) => {
415:                 let (drag, extra) = coalesce_drag(mouse);
416:                 let actions = self.app.update(Msg::Mouse(drag));
417:                 self.dispatch(actions);
418:                 extra
419:             }
420:             _ => Some(Msg::Mouse(mouse)),
421:         }
422:     }
423: 
424:     fn dispatch(&mut self, actions: Vec<Action>) {
425:         for action in actions {
426:             self.handle_action(action);
427:         }
428:     }

430:     fn respawn_agent(&mut self, history: Vec<Message>) {
431:         let lua_handle = self.app.lua_event_handle.clone();
432:         self.handles.respawn(
433:             history,
434:             &self.model_slot,
435:             self.config.clone(),
436:             self.app.ui_config.tool_output_lines,
437:             &self.permissions,
438:             &mut self.app,
439:             lua_handle,
440:         );
441:     }

443:     fn handle_action(&mut self, action: Action) {
444:         match action {
445:             Action::SendMessage(input) => {
446:                 let mut input = *input;
447:                 input.preamble = self.app.shell.drain_results();
448:                 let run_id = self.app.run_id;
449:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Message {
450:                     text: input.message.clone(),
451:                     image_count: input.images.len(),
452:                     input,
453:                     run_id,
454:                     displayed: true,
455:                 });
456:             }
457:             Action::CancelAgent { run_id } => {
458:                 let _ = self
459:                     .handles
460:                     .cmd_tx
461:                     .try_send(AgentCommand::Cancel { run_id });
462:             }
463:             Action::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id } => {
464:                 let _ = self
465:                     .handles
466:                     .cmd_tx
467:                     .try_send(AgentCommand::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id });
468:             }
469:             Action::NewSession => {
470:                 self.respawn_agent(Vec::new());
471:             }
472:             Action::LoadSession(loaded) => {
473:                 let loaded = *loaded;
474:                 if loaded.model_spec != self.model_slot.load().model.spec()
475:                     && let Ok(mut new_model) = Model::from_spec(&loaded.model_spec)
476:                     && let Ok(new_provider) = from_model(&mut new_model, self.timeouts)
477:                 {
478:                     self.app.usage_slot.store(None);
479:                     self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
480:                         model: new_model,
481:                         provider: Arc::from(new_provider),
482:                     }));
483:                 }
484:                 self.respawn_agent(loaded.messages);
485:                 *self
486:                     .handles
487:                     .tool_outputs
488:                     .lock()
489:                     .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = loaded.tool_outputs;
490:             }
491:             Action::ChangeModel(spec) => self.change_model(spec),
492:             Action::RefreshProvider { slug } => self.refresh_provider(slug),
493:             Action::AssignTier(spec, tier) => {
494:                 maki_providers::model_registry::set_and_persist(spec, tier, &self.app.storage);
495:             }
496:             Action::UnassignTier(spec, tier) => {
497:                 maki_providers::model_registry::unset_and_persist(&spec, tier, &self.app.storage);
498:             }
499:             Action::Compact => {
500:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Compact {
501:                     run_id: self.app.run_id,
502:                 });
503:             }
504:             Action::Checkpoint => {
505:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Checkpoint {
506:                     run_id: self.app.run_id,
507:                 });
508:             }
509:             Action::ToggleMcp(server_name, enabled) => {
510:                 self.handles.send_mcp(McpCommand::Toggle {
511:                     server: server_name,
512:                     enabled,
513:                 });
514:             }
515:             Action::ShellCommand {
516:                 id,
517:                 command,
518:                 visible,
519:             } => {
520:                 let (trigger, cancel) = CancelToken::new();
521:                 self.app.shell.add_trigger(trigger);
522:                 spawn_shell(
523:                     command,
524:                     id,
525:                     visible,
526:                     self.shell_tx.clone(),
527:                     cancel,
528:                     self.config.clone(),
529:                 );
530:             }
531:             Action::OpenEditor(path) => {
532:                 if let Err(e) = terminal::open_in_editor(&path, self.terminal) {
533:                     self.app.flash(e);
534:                 }
535:             }
536:             Action::EditInputInEditor => {
537:                 let current_text = self.app.input_box.buffer.value();
538:                 match terminal::edit_temp_content(&current_text, self.terminal) {
539:                     Ok(edited) => self.app.input_box.set_input(edited),
540:                     Err(e) => self.app.flash(e),
541:                 }
542:             }
543:             Action::Btw(question) => {
544:                 let slot = self.model_slot.load();
545:                 self.app
546:                     .start_btw(question, Arc::clone(&slot.provider), slot.model.clone());
547:             }
548:             Action::RenameSession(messages) => {
549:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Rename {
550:                     messages,
551:                     run_id: self.app.run_id,
552:                 });
553:             }
554:             Action::Suspend => terminal::suspend(self.terminal),
555:             Action::RefreshModels => self.refresh_models(),
556:             Action::RefreshUsage => self.refresh_usage(),
557:             Action::Quit => {}
558:         }
559:     }

561:     fn change_model(&mut self, spec: String) {
562:         match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
563:             Ok(mut new_model) => match from_model(&mut new_model, self.timeouts) {
564:                 Ok(new_provider) => {
565:                     self.app.update_model(&new_model);
566:                     self.app.record_recent_model(&spec);
567:                     self.app.usage_slot.store(None);
568:                     self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
569:                         model: new_model,
570:                         provider: Arc::from(new_provider),
571:                     }));
572:                 }
573:                 Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Failed to create provider: {e}")),
574:             },
575:             Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Invalid model: {e}")),
576:         }
577:     }

579:     fn refresh_models(&self) {
580:         let available = Arc::clone(&self.available_models);
581:         let warn_tx = self.warn_tx.clone();
582:         available.store(None);
583:         smol::spawn(async move {
584:             fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&available, batch, &warn_tx), None).await;
585:         })
586:         .detach();
587:     }
588: 
589:     fn refresh_usage(&self) {
590:         let provider = Arc::clone(&self.model_slot.load().provider);
591:         let slot = Arc::clone(&self.app.usage_slot);
592:         slot.store(Some(Arc::new(UsageFetchState::Loading)));
593:         smol::spawn(async move {
594:             let state = match provider.fetch_usage().await {
595:                 Ok(Some(usage)) => UsageFetchState::Ready(usage),
596:                 Ok(None) => UsageFetchState::Unsupported,
597:                 Err(e) => UsageFetchState::Error(e.user_message()),
598:             };
599:             slot.store(Some(Arc::new(state)));
600:         })
601:         .detach();
602:     }
603: 
604:     fn refresh_provider(&mut self, slug: String) {
605:         let current = self.model_slot.load();
606:         let current_model = &current.model;
607: 
608:         if current_model.provider.to_string() == slug {
609:             let mut m = current_model.clone();
610:             if let Ok(provider) = maki_providers::provider::from_model(&mut m, self.timeouts) {
611:                 self.app.usage_slot.store(None);
612:                 self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
613:                     model: m,
614:                     provider: Arc::from(provider),
615:                 }));
616:             }
617:         } else if let Some(builtin) = maki_config::providers::builtin_provider(&slug) {
618:             let spec = builtin.default_model.to_string();
619:             self.change_model(spec);
620:         }
621:     }

623:     fn shutdown(mut self) -> (Option<String>, i32) {
624:         let exit_code = self.app.exit_request.code();
625:         let session_id = self
626:             .app
627:             .has_content()
628:             .then(|| self.app.state.session.id.clone());
629:         maki_agent::mcp::kill_process_groups(&self.handles.mcp_reader().load().pids);
630:         self.app.cmd_tx = None;
631:         self.app.answer_tx = None;
632:         drop(self.app);
633:         self.handles.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3));
634:         match Arc::try_unwrap(self.storage_writer) {
635:             Ok(writer) => writer.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3)),
636:             Err(_) => {
637:                 warn!("storage writer has outstanding references, skipping graceful shutdown")
638:             }
639:         }
640:         (session_id, exit_code)
641:     }
642: }

644: fn scroll_delta(kind: MouseEventKind, lines: u32) -> i32 {
645:     if kind == MouseEventKind::ScrollUp {
646:         lines as i32
647:     } else {
648:         -(lines as i32)
649:     }
650: }
651: 
652: fn aggregate_scroll(
653:     column: u16,
654:     row: u16,
655:     mut delta: i32,
656:     scroll_lines: u32,
657: ) -> (Msg, Option<Msg>) {
658:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
659:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
660:             match next.kind {
661:                 MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
662:                     delta += scroll_delta(next.kind, scroll_lines);
663:                 }
664:                 _ => return (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, Some(Msg::Mouse(next))),
665:             }
666:         } else {
667:             break;
668:         }
669:     }
670:     (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, None)
671: }
672: 
673: fn coalesce_drag(mut latest: CtMouseEvent) -> (CtMouseEvent, Option<Msg>) {
674:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
675:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
676:             if matches!(next.kind, MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left)) {
677:                 latest = next;
678:             } else {
679:                 return (latest, Some(Msg::Mouse(next)));
680:             }
681:         } else {
682:             break;
683:         }
684:     }
685:     (latest, None)
686: }

273:     pub fn handle_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent, input: &str) -> CommandAction {
274:         if !self.is_active() {
275:             return CommandAction::Passthrough;
276:         }
277:         match key.code {
278:             KeyCode::Up => {
279:                 self.move_up();
280:                 CommandAction::Consumed
281:             }
282:             KeyCode::Down => {
283:                 self.move_down();
284:                 CommandAction::Consumed
285:             }
286:             KeyCode::Esc => {
287:                 self.close();
288:                 CommandAction::Consumed
289:             }
290:             KeyCode::Enter => match self.confirm(input) {
291:                 Some(cmd) => {
292:                     self.close();
293:                     CommandAction::Execute(cmd)
294:                 }
295:                 None => CommandAction::Consumed,
296:             },
297:             KeyCode::Tab => {
298:                 if let Some(item) = self.filtered.get(self.selected) {
299:                     let name = self.item_name(item);
300:                     let text = if self.item_has_args(item) {
301:                         format!("{name} ")
302:                     } else {
303:                         name
304:                     };
305:                     CommandAction::Complete(text)
306:                 } else {
307:                     CommandAction::Consumed
308:                 }
309:             }
310:             _ => CommandAction::Passthrough,
311:         }
312:     }

331:             self.current_arg_count = 0;
332:             return;
333:         };
334: 
335:         let parts: Vec<&str> = stripped.split_whitespace().collect();
336:         let cmd_word = parts.first().copied().unwrap_or(stripped);
337:         let trailing_space = stripped.ends_with(char::is_whitespace);
338: 
339:         self.current_arg_count = if trailing_space {
340:             parts.len()
341:         } else {
342:             parts.len().saturating_sub(1)
343:         };
344: 
345:         self.nucleo.pattern.reparse(
346:             0,
347:             cmd_word,
348:             CaseMatching::Ignore,
349:             Normalization::Smart,
350:             false,
351:         );
352: 
353:         // Tick to get matches
354:         self.tick();
355:     }
356: 
357:     fn tick(&mut self) {
358:         let status = self.nucleo.tick(100);
359:         if status.changed {
360:             self.refresh_matches();
361:         }
362:     }
363: 
364:     fn refresh_matches(&mut self) {
365:         let snapshot = self.nucleo.snapshot();
366:         let pattern = snapshot.pattern();
367:         let has_pattern = !pattern.column_pattern(0).atoms.is_empty();
368: 
369:         self.filtered.clear();
370:         let count = snapshot.matched_item_count();
371:         for item in snapshot.matched_items(0..count) {
372:             let cmd_item = &item.data;
373:             let col = &item.matcher_columns[0];
374: 
375:             if self.current_arg_count > cmd_item.max_args {
376:                 continue;
377:             }
378: 
379:             let indices = if has_pattern {
380:                 let mut indices_buf = vec![];
381:                 pattern.column_pattern(0).indices(
382:                     col.slice(..),
383:                     &mut self.matcher,
384:                     &mut indices_buf,
385:                 );
386:                 indices_buf
387:             } else {
388:                 Vec::new()
389:             };
390: 
391:             self.filtered.push(Match {
392:                 command_type: cmd_item.command_type.clone(),
393:                 indices,
394:             });
395:         }
396: 
397:         self.selected = self.selected.min(self.filtered.len().saturating_sub(1));
398:     }
399: 
400:     pub fn close(&mut self) {
401:         self.filtered.clear();
402:         self.current_arg_count = 0;
403:     }
404: 
405:     pub fn move_up(&mut self) {
406:         if self.filtered.is_empty() {
407:             return;
408:         }
409:         self.selected = if self.selected == 0 {
410:             self.filtered.len() - 1
411:         } else {
412:             self.selected - 1
413:         };
414:     }
415: 
416:     pub fn move_down(&mut self) {
417:         if self.filtered.is_empty() {
418:             return;
419:         }
420:         self.selected = if self.selected == self.filtered.len() - 1 {
421:             0
422:         } else {
423:             self.selected + 1
424:         };
425:     }
426: 
427:     fn item_name(&self, m: &Match) -> String {
428:         match &m.command_type {
429:             CommandType::Builtin(cmd) => cmd.name.to_string(),
430:             CommandType::Custom(i) => self.custom[*i].display_name(),
431:             CommandType::McpPrompt(i) => format!("/{}", self.mcp_prompts[*i].display_name),
432:             CommandType::Lua(i) => self.lua_commands[*i].name.to_string(),
433:         }
434:     }
435: 
436:     fn item_has_args(&self, m: &Match) -> bool {
437:         match &m.command_type {
438:             CommandType::Builtin(cmd) => cmd.max_args > 0,
439:             CommandType::Custom(i) => self.custom[*i].has_args(),
440:             CommandType::McpPrompt(i) => !self.mcp_prompts[*i].arguments.is_empty(),
441:             CommandType::Lua(_) => false,
442:         }
443:     }
444: 
445:     fn item_description(&self, m: &Match) -> &str {
446:         match &m.command_type {
447:             CommandType::Builtin(cmd) => cmd.description,
448:             CommandType::Custom(i) => &self.custom[*i].description,
449:             CommandType::McpPrompt(i) => &self.mcp_prompts[*i].description,
450:             CommandType::Lua(i) => &self.lua_commands[*i].description,
451:         }
452:     }
453: 
454:     pub fn confirm(&self, input: &str) -> Option<ParsedCommand> {
455:         let item = self.filtered.get(self.selected)?;
456:         let name = self.item_name(item);
457:         let args = input
458:             .strip_prefix('/')
459:             .and_then(|s| s.split_once(char::is_whitespace))
460:             .map(|(_, a)| a.trim())
461:             .unwrap_or("");
462:         Some(ParsedCommand {
463:             name,
464:             args: args.to_string(),
465:         })
466:     }
467: 
468:     pub fn find_custom_command(&self, display_name: &str) -> Option<&CustomCommand> {
469:         self.custom
470:             .iter()
471:             .find(|c| c.display_name() == display_name)
472:     }
473: 
474:     pub fn find_mcp_prompt(&self, slash_name: &str) -> Option<&McpPromptInfo> {
475:         let name = slash_name.strip_prefix('/')?;
476:         self.mcp_prompts.iter().find(|p| p.display_name == name)
477:     }
478: 
479:     pub fn find_lua_command(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&LuaCommandInfo> {
480:         self.lua_commands.iter().find(|c| c.name.as_ref() == name)
481:     }
482: 
483:     pub fn view(&self, frame: &mut Frame, input_area: Rect) -> Option<Rect> {
484:         let filtered = &self.filtered;
485:         if filtered.is_empty() {
486:             return None;
487:         }
488: 
489:         let popup_height = (filtered.len() as u16).min(input_area.y);
490:         if popup_height == 0 {
491:             return None;
492:         }
493: 
494:         const GAP: usize = 2;
495:         let max_name = filtered
496:             .iter()
497:             .map(|item| self.item_name(item).len())
498:             .max()
499:             .unwrap_or(0);
500:         let max_desc = filtered
501:             .iter()
502:             .map(|item| self.item_description(item).len())
503:             .max()
504:             .unwrap_or(0);
505:         const PAD: usize = 1;
506:         let popup_width = (PAD + max_name + GAP + max_desc + PAD) as u16;
507: 
508:         let popup = Rect {
509:             x: input_area.x,
510:             y: input_area.y.saturating_sub(popup_height),
511:             width: popup_width.min(input_area.width),
512:             height: popup_height,
513:         };
514: 
515:         let t = theme::current();
516:         let lines: Vec<Line> = filtered
517:             .iter()
518:             .enumerate()
519:             .map(|(i, m)| {
520:                 let name = self.item_name(m);
521:                 let desc = self.item_description(m);
522:                 let selected = i == self.selected;
523:                 let name_pad = max_name - name.len() + GAP;
524: 
525:                 if selected {
526:                     let s = t.item_selected;
527:                     let highlighted_name = self.build_highlighted_spans(&name, &m.indices, s);
528:                     let mut spans = vec![Span::styled(" ".repeat(PAD), s)];
529:                     spans.extend(highlighted_name);
530:                     spans.push(Span::styled(" ".repeat(name_pad), s));
531:                     spans.push(Span::styled(desc, s));
532:                     spans.push(Span::styled(" ".repeat(PAD), s));
533:                     Line::from(spans)
534:                 } else {
535:                     let highlighted_name = self.build_highlighted_spans(&name, &m.indices, t.item);
536:                     let mut spans = vec![Span::raw(" ".repeat(PAD))];
537:                     spans.extend(highlighted_name);
538:                     spans.push(Span::raw(" ".repeat(name_pad)));
539:                     spans.push(Span::styled(desc, t.item_desc));
540:                     spans.push(Span::raw(" ".repeat(PAD)));
541:                     Line::from(spans)
542:                 }
543:             })
544:             .collect();
545: 
546:         frame.render_widget(Clear, popup);
547:         frame.render_widget(
548:             Paragraph::new(lines).style(Style::new().bg(t.background)),
549:             popup,
550:         );
551: 
552:         Some(popup)
553:     }
554: 
555:     fn build_highlighted_spans(&self, text: &str, indices: &[u32], base: Style) -> Vec<Span<'_>> {
556:         if indices.is_empty() {
557:             return vec![Span::styled(text.to_string(), base)];
558:         }
559: 
560:         let t = theme::current();
561:         let highlight = base
562:             .fg(t.accent.fg.unwrap_or_default())
563:             .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
564: 
565:         let mut spans = Vec::new();
566:         let mut in_match = false;
567:         let mut run = String::new();
568: 
569:         for (i, ch) in text.chars().enumerate() {
570:             let is_match = indices.binary_search(&(i as u32)).is_ok();
571:             if is_match != in_match && !run.is_empty() {
572:                 spans.push(Span::styled(
573:                     mem::take(&mut run),
574:                     if in_match { highlight } else { base },
575:                 ));
576:             }
577:             in_match = is_match;
578:             run.push(ch);
579:         }
580: 
581:         if !run.is_empty() {
582:             spans.push(Span::styled(run, if in_match { highlight } else { base }));
583:         }
584: 
585:         spans
586:     }
587: }

852: 
853:         let updated_reader = McpSnapshotReader::from_snapshot(McpSnapshot {

879:         let prompt = &p

886:                 assert_eq!(p.mcp_prompts[*i].display_name, "myserver:new-prompt");

335:     fn register_zones(&mut self, layout: &ViewLayout, overlay_rect: Rect) {
336:         // Push order = z-order. zone_at() walks in reverse, so later entries win.
337:         self.zones = ZoneRegistry::new();
338: 
339:         self.zones.push(SelectableZone {
340:             area: layout.msg_area,
341:             zone: SelectionZone::Messages,
342:         });
343: 
344:         if layout.input_area.height > 0 && !layout.bottom_takeover && self.is_main_chat() {
345:             let input_inner = Rect::new(
346:                 layout.input_area.x,
347:                 layout.input_area.y + 1,
348:                 layout.input_area.width,
349:                 layout.input_area.height.saturating_sub(2),
350:             );
351:             self.zones.push(SelectableZone {
352:                 area: input_inner,
353:                 zone: SelectionZone::Input,
354:             });
355:         }
356: 
357:         self.zones.push_overlay(layout.status_area);
358: 
359:         if self.permission_prompt.is_open() || self.plan_form_active() {
360:             self.zones.push_overlay(layout.bottom_area);
361:         }
362: 
363:         for &(_, rect) in &layout.panel_windows {
364:             self.zones.push_overlay(selection::inset_border(rect));
365:         }
366: 
367:         if !self.is_main_chat() && layout.bottom_area.height > 0 {
368:             self.zones.push_overlay(layout.bottom_area);
369:         }
370: 
371:         if layout.queue_area.height > 0 && !layout.bottom_takeover {
372:             self.zones.push_overlay(layout.queue_area);
373:         }
374: 
375:         for dir in Split::ALL {
376:             if let Some(rect) = layout.splits.rect(dir) {
377:                 self.zones.push_overlay(selection::inset_border(rect));
378:             }
379:         }
380: 
381:         if overlay_rect.width > 0 {
382:             self.zones
383:                 .push_overlay(selection::inset_border(overlay_rect));
384:         }
385: 
386:         // Overlay zone was removed (e.g. dialog closed), drop the dangling selection
387:         if let Some(ref state) = self.selection_state
388:             && state.sel().zone == SelectionZone::Overlay
389:             && self.zones.find_area(state.sel().area).is_none()
390:         {
391:             self.selection_state = None;
392:         }
393:     }

395:     fn apply_selection(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, render_chat: usize) {
396:         let Some(ref state) = self.selection_state else {
397:             return;
398:         };
399: 
400:         let sel = state.sel();
401:         let scroll = self.scroll_offset(sel.zone);
402:         if let Some(screen_sel) = sel.to_screen(scroll) {
403:             selection::apply_highlight(frame.buffer_mut(), sel.highlight_area(), &screen_sel);
404:         }
405:         if state.is_pending_copy() {
406:             let sel = *sel;
407:             self.copy_selection(frame.buffer_mut(), &sel, render_chat);
408:         }
409:     }

256: pub fn get_bind_label(name: &str) -> String {
257:     if let Some(bind) = get_configured_bind(name) {
258:         bind.label().to_string()
259:     } else {
260:         "".to_string()
261:     }
262: }
263: 
264: pub fn get_bind<F, R>(f: F) -> R
265: where
266:     F: FnOnce(&ConfiguredKeybindings) -> R,
267: {
268:     let binds = CURRENT_BINDS.get_or_init(|| std::sync::RwLock::new(ConfiguredKeybindings::default()));
269:     let read = binds.read().unwrap();
270:     f(&read)
271: }
272: 
273: pub fn parse_keybind(s: &str) -> Option<Bind> {
274:     let s = s.trim().to_lowercase();
275:     let parts: Vec<&str> = s.split('+').collect();
276:     let mut modifiers = KeyModifiers::empty();
277:     let mut code = None;
278: 
279:     for part in parts {
280:         match part {
281:             "ctrl" | "control" => modifiers.insert(KeyModifiers::CONTROL),
282:             "alt" | "option" => modifiers.insert(KeyModifiers::ALT),
283:             "shift" => modifiers.insert(KeyModifiers::SHIFT),
284:             "super" | "cmd" | "command" | "win" => modifiers.insert(KeyModifiers::SUPER),
285:             "space" => code = Some(KeyCode::Char(' ')),
286:             "enter" | "return" => code = Some(KeyCode::Enter),
287:             "esc" | "escape" => code = Some(KeyCode::Esc),
288:             "tab" => code = Some(KeyCode::Tab),
289:             "backspace" => code = Some(KeyCode::Backspace),
290:             "delete" | "del" => code = Some(KeyCode::Delete),
291:             "up" => code = Some(KeyCode::Up),
292:             "down" => code = Some(KeyCode::Down),
293:             "left" => code = Some(KeyCode::Left),
294:             "right" => code = Some(KeyCode::Right),
295:             "home" => code = Some(KeyCode::Home),
296:             "end" => code = Some(KeyCode::End),
297:             "pageup" | "pgup" => code = Some(KeyCode::PageUp),
298:             "pagedown" | "pgdn" => code = Some(KeyCode::PageDown),
299:             "insert" | "ins" => code = Some(KeyCode::Insert),
300:             other => {
301:                 if let Some(stripped) = other.strip_prefix('f')
302:                     && let Ok(n) = stripped.parse::<u8>()
303:                 {
304:                     code = Some(KeyCode::F(n));
305:                     continue;
306:                 }
307:                 if other.chars().count() == 1 {
308:                     code = Some(KeyCode::Char(other.chars().next().unwrap()));
309:                 } else {
310:                     return None;
311:                 }
312:             }
313:         }
314:     }
315: 
316:     let code = code?;
317:     let mut label_parts = Vec::new();
318:     if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
319:         label_parts.push("Ctrl");
320:     }
321:     if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {
322:         label_parts.push("Alt");
323:     }
324:     if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) {
325:         label_parts.push("Shift");
326:     }
327:     if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SUPER) {
328:         label_parts.push("Super");
329:     }
330: 
331:     let key_name = match code {
332:         KeyCode::Char(' ') => "Space".to_string(),
333:         KeyCode::Char(c) => c.to_uppercase().to_string(),
334:         KeyCode::Enter => "Enter".to_string(),
335:         KeyCode::Esc => "Esc".to_string(),
336:         KeyCode::Tab => "Tab".to_string(),
337:         KeyCode::Backspace => "Backspace".to_string(),
338:         KeyCode::Delete => "Delete".to_string(),
339:         KeyCode::Up => "Up".to_string(),
340:         KeyCode::Down => "Down".to_string(),
341:         KeyCode::Left => "Left".to_string(),
342:         KeyCode::Right => "Right".to_string(),
343:         KeyCode::Home => "Home".to_string(),
344:         KeyCode::End => "End".to_string(),
345:         KeyCode::PageUp => "PageUp".to_string(),
346:         KeyCode::PageDown => "PageDown".to_string(),
347:         KeyCode::Insert => "Insert".to_string(),
348:         KeyCode::F(n) => format!("F{}", n),
349:         _ => "".to_string(),
350:     };
351:     label_parts.push(&key_name);
352:     let label = label_parts.join("+");
353: 
354:     Some(Bind {
355:         code,
356:         modifiers,
357:         label: Box::leak(label.into_boxed_str()),
358:         name: None,
359:     })
360: }
361: 
362: pub fn update_bind(action: &str, bind_str: &str) -> bool {
363:     if let Some(mut bind) = parse_keybind(bind_str) {
364:         let binds = CURRENT_BINDS.get_or_init(|| std::sync::RwLock::new(ConfiguredKeybindings::default()));
365:         if let Ok(mut write) = binds.write() {
366:             bind.name = Some(Box::leak(action.to_string().into_boxed_str()));
367:             match action {
368:                 "quit" => write.quit = bind,
369:                 "help" => write.help = bind,
370:                 "prev_chat" => write.prev_chat = bind,
371:                 "next_chat" => write.next_chat = bind,
372:                 "scroll_half_up" => write.scroll_half_up = bind,
373:                 "scroll_half_down" => write.scroll_half_down = bind,
374:                 "scroll_line_up" => write.scroll_line_up = bind,
375:                 "scroll_line_down" => write.scroll_line_down = bind,
376:                 "scroll_top" => write.scroll_top = bind,
377:                 "scroll_bottom" => write.scroll_bottom = bind,
378:                 "pop_queue" => write.pop_queue = bind,
379:                 "delete_word" => write.delete_word = bind,
380:                 "search" => write.search = bind,
381:                 "file_picker" => write.file_picker = bind,
382:                 "toggle_verbose" => write.toggle_verbose = bind,
383:                 "open_editor" => write.open_editor = bind,
384:                 "edit_system_prompt" => write.edit_system_prompt = bind,
385:                 "plan_toggle" => write.plan_toggle = bind,
386:                 "tasks" => write.tasks = bind,
387:                 "suspend" => write.suspend = bind,
388:                 "delete" => write.delete = bind,
389:                 "kill_line" => write.kill_line = bind,
390:                 "line_start" => write.line_start = bind,
391:                 "line_end" => write.line_end = bind,
392:                 "edit_input" => write.edit_input = bind,
393:                 "sessions" => write.sessions = bind,
394:                 "shift_session_down" => write.shift_session_down = bind,
395:                 "shift_session_up" => write.shift_session_up = bind,
396:                 _ => return false,
397:             }
398:             return true;
399:         }
400:     }
401:     false
402: }

546: }

548: impl Platform {

550:         match self {

558: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
559: pub enum KeyLabel {
560:     Single(&'static str),
561:     Alt(&'static str, &'static str),
562:     /// Alt on Mac, Single (first) on other platforms
563:     MacAlt(&'static str, &'static str),
564:     /// Multi on Mac, Multi (first slice) on other platforms
565:     MacMulti(&'static [&'static str], &'static [&'static str]),
566:     Action(&'static str),
567:     ActionAlt(&'static str, &'static str),
568:     ActionMacAlt(&'static str, &'static str),
569: }
570: 
571: pub const ALT_SEP: &str = " / ";
572: 
573: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
574: pub enum ResolvedLabel {
575:     Single(String),
576:     Alt(String, String),
577:     Multi(Vec<String>),
578: }
579: 
580: impl ResolvedLabel {
581:     pub fn display_width(&self) -> usize {
582:         match self {
583:             Self::Single(s) => UnicodeWidthStr::width(s.as_str()),
584:             Self::Alt(a, b) => {
585:                 let sep_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(ALT_SEP);
586:                 UnicodeWidthStr::width(a.as_str()) + sep_w + UnicodeWidthStr::width(b.as_str())
587:             }
588:             Self::Multi(keys) => {
589:                 let sep_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(ALT_SEP);
590:                 keys.iter()
591:                     .map(|k| UnicodeWidthStr::width(k.as_str()))
592:                     .sum::<usize>()
593:                     + sep_w * keys.len().saturating_sub(1)
594:             }
595:         }
596:     }
597: }
598: 
599: impl KeyLabel {
600:     pub fn resolve(self) -> ResolvedLabel {
601:         match self {
602:             Self::Single(s) => ResolvedLabel::Single(s.to_string()),
603:             Self::Alt(a, b) => ResolvedLabel::Alt(a.to_string(), b.to_string()),
604:             Self::MacAlt(a, b) => {
605:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
606:                     ResolvedLabel::Alt(a.to_string(), b.to_string())
607:                 } else {
608:                     ResolvedLabel::Single(a.to_string())
609:                 }
610:             }
611:             Self::MacMulti(normal, mac) => {
612:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
613:                     ResolvedLabel::Multi(mac.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect())
614:                 } else {
615:                     ResolvedLabel::Multi(normal.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect())
616:                 }
617:             }
618:             Self::Action(name) => {
619:                 ResolvedLabel::Single(get_bind_label(name))
620:             }
621:             Self::ActionAlt(name1, name2) => {
622:                 ResolvedLabel::Alt(get_bind_label(name1), get_bind_label(name2))
623:             }
624:             Self::ActionMacAlt(name, mac_label) => {
625:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
626:                     ResolvedLabel::Alt(get_bind_label(name), mac_label.to_string())
627:                 } else {
628:                     ResolvedLabel::Single(get_bind_label(name))
629:                 }
630:             }
631:         }
632:     }
633: 
634:     #[cfg(test)]
635:     fn flat_str(&self) -> String {
636:         match self.resolve() {
637:             ResolvedLabel::Single(s) => s,
638:             ResolvedLabel::Alt(a, b) => format!("{a}/{b}"),
639:             ResolvedLabel::Multi(keys) => keys.join("/"),
640:         }
641:     }
642: }
643:

917: pub(crate) fn key_event_to_string(key: &KeyEvent) -> String {
918:     let mut s = String::new();
919:     let mods = key.modifiers;
920:     let is_char = matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Char(_));
921:     if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
922:         s.push_str("ctrl+");
923:     }
924:     if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {
925:         s.push_str("alt+");
926:     }
927:     if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) && (!is_char || mods.intersects(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT | KeyModifiers::SUPER)) {
928:         s.push_str("shift+");
929:     }
930:     match key.code {
931:         KeyCode::Char(' ') => s.push_str("space"),
932:         KeyCode::Char(c) => s.push(c),
933:         KeyCode::Enter => s.push_str("enter"),
934:         KeyCode::Esc => s.push_str("esc"),
935:         KeyCode::Tab => s.push_str("tab"),
936:         KeyCode::BackTab => {
937:             if !s.contains("shift+") {
938:                 s.insert_str(0, "shift+");
939:             }
940:             s.push_str("tab");
941:         }
942:         KeyCode::Backspace => s.push_str("backspace"),
943:         KeyCode::Delete => s.push_str("delete"),
944:         KeyCode::Up => s.push_str("up"),
945:         KeyCode::Down => s.push_str("down"),
946:         KeyCode::Left => s.push_str("left"),
947:         KeyCode::Right => s.push_str("right"),
948:         KeyCode::Home => s.push_str("home"),
949:         KeyCode::End => s.push_str("end"),
950:         KeyCode::PageUp => s.push_str("pageup"),
951:         KeyCode::PageDown => s.push_str("pagedown"),
952:         KeyCode::F(n) => write!(s, "f{n}").unwrap(),
953:         KeyCode::Insert => s.push_str("insert"),
954:         _ => {}
955:     }
956:     s
957: }

244:     pub(super) fn goto_turn(&mut self, turn_str: &str) -> Vec<Action> {

246:             Ok(n) if n > 0 => n,
247:             _ => {

249:                 return vec![];

257:                     let display_idx = display_msg_index_for_turn(
258:                         &self.state.session.messages,

694:             }
695:         } else {
696:             break;
697:         }
698:     }
699:     (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, None)

702: fn coalesce_drag(mut latest: CtMouseEvent) -> (CtMouseEvent, Option<Msg>) {

705:             if matches!(next.kind, MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left)) {

709:             }

711:             break;
712:         }
713:     }
714:     (latest, None)
715: }

    fn handle_action(&mut self, action: Action) {
        match action {
            Action::SendMessage(input) => {
                let mut input = *input;
                input.preamble = self.app.shell.drain_results();
                let run_id = self.app.run_id;
                self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Message {
                    text: input.message.clone(),
                    image_count: input.images.len(),
                    input,
                    run_id,
                    displayed: true,
                });
            }

                    .cmd_tx

            }
            Action::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id } => {
                let _ = self
                    .handles

                    .try_send(AgentCommand::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id });
            }
            Action::NewSession => {
                self.respawn_agent(Vec::new());
            }
            Action::LoadSession(loaded) => {
                let loaded = *loaded;
                if loaded.model_spec != self.model_slot.load().model.spec()
                    && let Ok(mut new_model) = Model::from_spec(&loaded.model_spec)
                    && let Ok(new_provider) = from_model(&mut new_model, self.timeouts)
                {
                    self.app.usage_slot.store(None);

1: //! Session persistence with append-only JSONL log format.
2: //!
3: //! Each session is stored as `{uuid}.jsonl`, one JSON record per line. The format is
4: //! crash-safe: on load, any trailing run of unparseable lines is discarded (a partial
5: //! flush may corrupt multiple trailing records). `SessionLog` tracks cursor state to
6: //! enable O(delta) incremental saves.
7: //!
8: //! Legacy `.json` files are loaded transparently and converted to `.jsonl` on next save.

45: #[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]

47:     #[serde(default)]

167: impl StoredThinking {

200: pub trait TitleSource {
201:     fn first_user_text(&self) -> Option<&str>;
202: }
203: 
204: pub fn generate_title<M: TitleSource>(messages: &[M]) -> String {
205:     let first_user_text = messages.iter().find_map(|m| m.first_user_text());
206: 
207:     let Some(text) = first_user_text.map(str::trim).filter(|t| !t.is_empty()) else {
208:         return DEFAULT_TITLE.into();
209:     };
210: 
211:     if text.len() <= MAX_TITLE_LEN {
212:         return text.to_string();
213:     }
214: 
215:     let boundary = text.floor_char_boundary(MAX_TITLE_LEN);
216:     let truncated = &text[..boundary];
217:     match truncated.rfind(' ') {
218:         Some(pos) if pos > MAX_TITLE_LEN / 2 => format!("{}…", &truncated[..pos]),
219:         _ => format!("{truncated}…"),
220:     }
221: }

252: // -- SessionLog: append-only persistence --
253: 
254: pub struct SessionLog {
255:     session_id: String,
256:     file: File,
257:     saved_msg_count: usize,
258:     saved_tool_ids: HashSet<String>,
259:     saved_sub_msg_counts: HashMap<String, usize>,
260: }
261: 
262: fn sub_msg_snapshot<M>(map: &HashMap<String, Vec<M>>) -> HashMap<String, usize> {
263:     map.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.len())).collect()
264: }
265: 
266: impl SessionLog {
267:     pub fn create<M, U, T>(dir: &Path, session: &Session<M, U, T>) -> Result<Self, SessionError>
268:     where
269:         M: Serialize,
270:         U: Serialize,
271:         T: Serialize,
272:     {
273:         fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
274:         let path = dir.join(format!("{}.jsonl", session.id));
275:         let mut file = File::create(&path).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
276:         write_full_session(&mut file, session)?;
277:         file.sync_data().map_err(StorageError::from)?;
278: 
279:         update_cwd_index(dir, &session.cwd, &session.id)?;
280: 
281:         Ok(Self::cursor_from(session, file))
282:     }
283: 
284:     pub fn open<M, U, T>(
285:         dir: &Path,
286:         session_id: &str,
287:     ) -> Result<(Session<M, U, T>, Self), SessionError>
288:     where
289:         M: Serialize + DeserializeOwned,
290:         U: Serialize + DeserializeOwned + Default,
291:         T: Serialize + DeserializeOwned,
292:     {
293:         let path = dir.join(format!("{session_id}.jsonl"));
294:         let session = load_jsonl::<M, U, T>(&path)?;
295: 
296:         let file = OpenOptions::new()
297:             .append(true)
298:             .open(&path)
299:             .map_err(StorageError::from)?;
300: 
301:         let log = Self::cursor_from(&session, file);
302:         Ok((session, log))
303:     }
304: 
305:     pub fn session_id(&self) -> &str {
306:         &self.session_id
307:     }
308: 
309:     pub fn append<M, U, T>(&mut self, session: &Session<M, U, T>) -> Result<(), SessionError>
310:     where
311:         M: Serialize,
312:         U: Serialize,
313:         T: Serialize,
314:     {
315:         if session.id != self.session_id {
316:             return Err(SessionError::IdMismatch {
317:                 log_id: self.session_id.clone(),
318:                 given_id: session.id.clone(),
319:             });
320:         }
321: 
322:         if self.saved_msg_count > session.messages.len()
323:             || self
324:                 .saved_tool_ids
325:                 .iter()
326:                 .any(|id| !session.tool_outputs.contains_key(id))
327:             || self.saved_sub_msg_counts.iter().any(|(sub, &count)| {
328:                 session
329:                     .subagent_messages
330:                     .get(sub)
331:                     .is_none_or(|msgs| count > msgs.len())
332:             })
333:         {
334:             return Err(SessionError::CursorAhead {
335:                 saved: self.saved_msg_count,
336:                 actual: session.messages.len(),
337:             });
338:         }
339: 
340:         let mut buf = Vec::new();
341:         let mut new_msg_count = self.saved_msg_count;
342:         let mut new_tool_ids = Vec::new();
343: 
344:         for msg in &session.messages[self.saved_msg_count..] {
345:             append_record(&mut buf, &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::Msg { d: msg })?;
346:             new_msg_count += 1;
347:         }
348: 
349:         for (id, output) in &session.tool_outputs {
350:             if !self.saved_tool_ids.contains(id) {
351:                 append_record(
352:                     &mut buf,
353:                     &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::Out {
354:                         id: id.clone(),
355:                         d: output,
356:                     },
357:                 )?;
358:                 new_tool_ids.push(id.clone());
359:             }
360:         }
361: 
362:         let mut new_sub_counts: Vec<(String, usize)> = Vec::new();
363:         for (sub_id, msgs) in &session.subagent_messages {
364:             let saved = self.saved_sub_msg_counts.get(sub_id).copied().unwrap_or(0);
365:             for msg in &msgs[saved..] {
366:                 append_record(
367:                     &mut buf,
368:                     &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::SubMsg {
369:                         sub: sub_id.clone(),
370:                         d: msg,
371:                     },
372:                 )?;
373:             }
374:             if msgs.len() > saved {
375:                 new_sub_counts.push((sub_id.clone(), msgs.len()));
376:             }
377:         }
378: 
379:         if buf.is_empty() {
380:             return Ok(());
381:         }
382: 
383:         append_record(
384:             &mut buf,
385:             &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::Meta {
386:                 title: session.title.clone(),
387:                 token_usage: &session.token_usage,
388:                 updated_at: session.updated_at,
389:                 meta: session.meta.clone(),
390:             },
391:         )?;
392: 
393:         self.file.write_all(&buf).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
394:         self.file.sync_data().map_err(StorageError::from)?;
395: 
396:         self.saved_msg_count = new_msg_count;
397:         self.saved_tool_ids.extend(new_tool_ids);
398:         for (sub_id, count) in new_sub_counts {
399:             self.saved_sub_msg_counts.insert(sub_id, count);
400:         }
401: 
402:         Ok(())
403:     }
404: 
405:     pub fn compact<M, U, T>(
406:         &mut self,
407:         dir: &Path,
408:         session: &Session<M, U, T>,
409:     ) -> Result<(), SessionError>
410:     where
411:         M: Serialize,
412:         U: Serialize,
413:         T: Serialize,
414:     {
415:         if session.id != self.session_id {
416:             return Err(SessionError::IdMismatch {
417:                 log_id: self.session_id.clone(),
418:                 given_id: session.id.clone(),
419:             });
420:         }
421: 
422:         let path = dir.join(format!("{}.jsonl", session.id));
423:         let tmp = path.with_extension("jsonl.tmp");
424: 
425:         let mut tmp_file = File::create(&tmp).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
426:         write_full_session(&mut tmp_file, session)?;
427:         tmp_file.sync_data().map_err(StorageError::from)?;
428: 
429:         fs::rename(&tmp, &path).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
430: 
431:         self.file = OpenOptions::new()
432:             .append(true)
433:             .open(&path)
434:             .map_err(StorageError::from)?;
435:         self.saved_msg_count = session.messages.len();
436:         self.saved_tool_ids = session.tool_outputs.keys().cloned().collect();
437:         self.saved_sub_msg_counts = sub_msg_snapshot(&session.subagent_messages);
438: 
439:         Ok(())
440:     }
441: 
442:     fn cursor_from<M, U, T>(session: &Session<M, U, T>, file: File) -> Self {
443:         Self {
444:             session_id: session.id.clone(),
445:             file,
446:             saved_msg_count: session.messages.len(),
447:             saved_tool_ids: session.tool_outputs.keys().cloned().collect(),
448:             saved_sub_msg_counts: sub_msg_snapshot(&session.subagent_messages),
449:         }
450:     }
451: }
452: 
453: fn write_full_session<M, U, T>(
454:     file: &mut File,
455:     session: &Session<M, U, T>,
456: ) -> Result<(), SessionError>
457: where
458:     M: Serialize,
459:     U: Serialize,
460:     T: Serialize,
461: {
462:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
463:     append_record(
464:         &mut buf,
465:         &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::Header {
466:             v: LOG_FORMAT_VERSION,
467:             id: session.id.clone(),
468:             model: session.model.clone(),
469:             cwd: session.cwd.clone(),
470:             created_at: session.created_at,
471:         },
472:     )?;
473:     file.write_all(&buf).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
474:     for msg in &session.messages {
475:         buf.clear();
476:         append_record(&mut buf, &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::Msg { d: msg })?;
477:         file.write_all(&buf).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
478:     }
479:     for (id, output) in &session.tool_outputs {
480:         buf.clear();
481:         append_record(
482:             &mut buf,
483:             &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::Out {
484:                 id: id.clone(),
485:                 d: output,
486:             },
487:         )?;
488:         file.write_all(&buf).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
489:     }
490:     for (sub_id, msgs) in &session.subagent_messages {
491:         for msg in msgs {
492:             buf.clear();
493:             append_record(
494:                 &mut buf,
495:                 &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::SubMsg {
496:                     sub: sub_id.clone(),
497:                     d: msg,
498:                 },
499:             )?;
500:             file.write_all(&buf).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
501:         }
502:     }
503:     buf.clear();
504:     append_record(
505:         &mut buf,
506:         &LogRecord::<&M, &U, &T>::Meta {
507:             title: session.title.clone(),
508:             token_usage: &session.token_usage,
509:             updated_at: session.updated_at,
510:             meta: session.meta.clone(),
511:         },
512:     )?;
513:     file.write_all(&buf).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
514:     Ok(())
515: }
516: 
517: fn append_record<R: Serialize>(buf: &mut Vec<u8>, record: &R) -> Result<(), SessionError> {
518:     serde_json::to_writer(&mut *buf, record).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
519:     buf.push(b'\n');
520:     Ok(())
521: }
522: 
523: fn load_jsonl<M, U, T>(path: &Path) -> Result<Session<M, U, T>, SessionError>
524: where
525:     M: DeserializeOwned,
526:     U: DeserializeOwned + Default,
527:     T: DeserializeOwned,
528: {
529:     let file = File::open(path).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
530:     let reader = BufReader::new(file);
531:     let mut line_count = 0usize;
532: 
533:     let mut id = String::new();
534:     let mut model = String::new();
535:     let mut cwd = String::new();
536:     let mut created_at = 0u64;
537:     let mut messages = Vec::new();
538:     let mut tool_outputs = HashMap::new();
539:     let mut subagent_messages: HashMap<String, Vec<M>> = HashMap::new();
540:     let mut title = DEFAULT_TITLE.to_string();
541:     let mut token_usage = U::default();
542:     let mut updated_at = 0u64;
543:     let mut meta = SessionMeta::default();
544:     let mut got_header = false;
545: 
546:     for line_result in reader.lines() {
547:         let line = line_result.map_err(StorageError::from)?;
548:         line_count += 1;
549:         if line.is_empty() {
550:             continue;
551:         }
552:         let record: LogRecord<M, U, T> = match serde_json::from_str(&line) {
553:             Ok(r) => r,
554:             Err(e) => {
555:                 warn!(
556:                     path = %path.display(),
557:                     error = %e,
558:                     line = line_count,
559:                     "skipping unrecognized JSONL record",
560:                 );
561:                 continue;
562:             }
563:         };
564:         match record {
565:             LogRecord::Header {
566:                 v,
567:                 id: h_id,
568:                 model: h_model,
569:                 cwd: h_cwd,
570:                 created_at: h_created,
571:             } => {
572:                 if v != LOG_FORMAT_VERSION {
573:                     return Err(SessionError::VersionMismatch {
574:                         found: v,
575:                         expected: LOG_FORMAT_VERSION,
576:                     });
577:                 }
578:                 id = h_id;
579:                 model = h_model;
580:                 cwd = h_cwd;
581:                 created_at = h_created;
582:                 got_header = true;
583:             }
584:             LogRecord::Msg { d } => messages.push(d),
585:             LogRecord::Out { id: out_id, d } => {
586:                 tool_outputs.insert(out_id, d);
587:             }
588:             LogRecord::SubMsg { sub, d } => {
589:                 subagent_messages.entry(sub).or_default().push(d);
590:             }
591:             LogRecord::Meta {
592:                 title: m_title,
593:                 token_usage: m_usage,
594:                 updated_at: m_updated,
595:                 meta: m_meta,
596:             } => {
597:                 title = m_title;
598:                 token_usage = m_usage;
599:                 updated_at = m_updated;
600:                 meta = m_meta;
601:             }
602:         }
603:     }
604: 
605:     if !got_header {
606:         return Err(StorageError::NotFound(path.display().to_string()).into());
607:     }
608: 
609:     Ok(Session {
610:         version: SESSION_VERSION,
611:         id,
612:         title,
613:         cwd,
614:         model,
615:         messages,
616:         token_usage,
617:         tool_outputs,
618:         subagent_messages,
619:         meta,
620:         created_at,
621:         updated_at,
622:     })
623: }
624: 
625: // -- CWD index --
626: 
627: fn load_cwd_index(dir: &Path) -> HashMap<String, String> {
628:     fs::read(dir.join(CWD_INDEX_FILE))
629:         .ok()
630:         .and_then(|data| serde_json::from_slice(&data).ok())
631:         .unwrap_or_default()
632: }
633: 
634: fn update_cwd_index(dir: &Path, cwd: &str, session_id: &str) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
635:     let mut index = load_cwd_index(dir);
636:     index.insert(cwd.to_string(), session_id.to_string());
637:     atomic_write(&dir.join(CWD_INDEX_FILE), &serde_json::to_vec(&index)?)
638: }
639: 
640: fn try_remove(path: &Path) -> Result<bool, StorageError> {
641:     match fs::remove_file(path) {
642:         Ok(()) => Ok(true),
643:         Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(false),
644:         Err(e) => Err(e.into()),
645:     }
646: }
647: 
648: fn remove_from_cwd_index(dir: &Path, session_id: &str) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
649:     let mut index = load_cwd_index(dir);
650:     let before = index.len();
651:     index.retain(|_, v| v != session_id);
652:     if index.len() != before {
653:         atomic_write(&dir.join(CWD_INDEX_FILE), &serde_json::to_vec(&index)?)?;
654:     }
655:     Ok(())
656: }
657: 
658: // -- Header scanning for session list --
659: 
660: #[derive(Deserialize)]
661: struct JsonlHeader {
662:     v: u32,
663:     id: String,
664:     cwd: String,
665: }
666: 
667: #[derive(Deserialize)]
668: #[serde(tag = "t", rename_all = "snake_case")]
669: enum ScanRecord {
670:     Meta {
671:         title: String,
672:         updated_at: u64,
673:     },
674:     #[serde(other)]
675:     Other,
676: }
677: 
678: fn scan_headers(cwd: &str, dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<SessionSummary>, StorageError> {
679:     let mut out = Vec::new();
680:     for path in session_entries(dir)? {
681:         let ext = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()).unwrap_or("");
682:         match ext {
683:             "jsonl" => {
684:                 if let Some(summary) = scan_jsonl_header(cwd, &path) {
685:                     out.push(summary);
686:                 }
687:             }
688:             "json" => {
689:                 if let Some(summary) = scan_legacy_header(cwd, &path) {
690:                     out.push(summary);
691:                 }
692:             }
693:             _ => {}
694:         }
695:     }
696:     Ok(out)
697: }
698: 
699: const TAIL_BUF: u64 = 4096;
700: 
701: fn scan_jsonl_header(cwd: &str, path: &Path) -> Option<SessionSummary> {
702:     let mut file = File::open(path).ok()?;
703:     let header: JsonlHeader = {
704:         let mut reader = BufReader::new(&file);
705:         let mut line = String::new();
706:         reader.read_line(&mut line).ok()?;
707:         serde_json::from_str(line.trim_end()).ok()?
708:     };
709:     if header.v != LOG_FORMAT_VERSION || header.cwd != cwd {
710:         return None;
711:     }
712: 
713:     let (title, updated_at) =
714:         read_last_meta(&mut file).unwrap_or_else(|| (DEFAULT_TITLE.to_string(), 0));
715: 
716:     Some(SessionSummary {
717:         id: header.id,
718:         title,
719:         updated_at,
720:     })
721: }
722: 
723: fn read_last_meta(file: &mut File) -> Option<(String, u64)> {
724:     let len = file.seek(SeekFrom::End(0)).ok()?;
725:     let mut tail = TAIL_BUF.min(len);
726:     loop {
727:         file.seek(SeekFrom::End(-(tail as i64))).ok()?;
728:         let mut buf = vec![0u8; tail as usize];
729:         file.read_exact(&mut buf).ok()?;
730: 
731:         let content = buf.strip_suffix(b"\n").unwrap_or(&buf);
732:         if let Some(nl) = content.iter().rposition(|&b| b == b'\n') {
733:             let last_line = &content[nl + 1..];
734:             if let Ok(ScanRecord::Meta { title, updated_at }) = serde_json::from_slice(last_line) {
735:                 return Some((title, updated_at));
736:             }
737:             return None;
738:         }
739: 
740:         if tail >= len {
741:             return None;
742:         }
743:         tail = (tail * 2).min(len);
744:     }
745: }
746: 
747: fn scan_legacy_header(cwd: &str, path: &Path) -> Option<SessionSummary> {
748:     let data = fs::read(path).ok()?;
749:     let h: LegacyHeader = serde_json::from_slice(&data).ok()?;
750:     if h.version != SESSION_VERSION || h.cwd != cwd {
751:         return None;
752:     }
753:     Some(SessionSummary {
754:         id: h.id,
755:         title: h.title,
756:         updated_at: h.updated_at,
757:     })
758: }
759: 
760: fn session_entries(dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, StorageError> {
761:     let mut entries = Vec::new();
762:     for entry in fs::read_dir(dir)? {
763:         let entry = entry?;
764:         let path = entry.path();
765:         let Some(stem) = path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) else {
766:             continue;
767:         };
768:         if stem == CWD_INDEX_FILE.trim_end_matches(".json") {
769:             continue;
770:         }
771:         if path
772:             .extension()
773:             .is_some_and(|e| e == "json" || e == "jsonl")
774:         {
775:             entries.push(path);
776:         }
777:     }
778:     Ok(entries)
779: }

781: // -- Session impl --
782: 
783: impl<M, U, T> Session<M, U, T>
784: where
785:     M: Serialize + DeserializeOwned + TitleSource,
786:     U: Serialize + DeserializeOwned + Default,
787:     T: Serialize + DeserializeOwned,
788: {
789:     pub fn new(model: &str, cwd: &str) -> Self {
790:         let now = now_epoch();
791:         Self {
792:             version: SESSION_VERSION,
793:             id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
794:             title: DEFAULT_TITLE.into(),
795:             cwd: cwd.into(),
796:             model: model.into(),
797:             messages: Vec::new(),
798:             token_usage: U::default(),
799:             tool_outputs: HashMap::new(),
800:             subagent_messages: HashMap::new(),
801:             meta: SessionMeta {
802:                 mode: Some(StoredMode::Build),
803:                 ..Default::default()
804:             },
805:             created_at: now,
806:             updated_at: now,
807:         }
808:     }
809: 
810:     /// After `messages` is truncated (rewind), state keyed by tool_use_id can
811:     /// point at calls that no longer exist. On restore that shows up as ghost
812:     /// subagent tabs and leaked tool outputs, so this drops everything not
813:     /// reachable from `messages`.
814:     ///
815:     /// If you add another field keyed by tool_use_id, prune it here too.
816:     pub fn prune_orphans(&mut self, tool_ids: impl Fn(&M) -> Vec<String>) {
817:         let main_ids: HashSet<String> = self.messages.iter().flat_map(&tool_ids).collect();
818:         self.subagent_messages.retain(|id, _| main_ids.contains(id));
819:         self.meta
820:             .subagents
821:             .retain(|sa| main_ids.contains(&sa.tool_use_id));
822: 
823:         let live: HashSet<String> = self
824:             .subagent_messages
825:             .values()
826:             .flatten()
827:             .flat_map(&tool_ids)
828:             .chain(main_ids)
829:             .collect();
830:         self.tool_outputs.retain(|id, _| live.contains(id));
831:     }
832: 
833:     pub fn save(&mut self, dir: &StateDir) -> Result<(), SessionError> {
834:         let sessions_dir = dir.ensure_subdir(SESSIONS_DIR)?;
835:         self.save_to(&sessions_dir)
836:     }
837: 
838:     pub fn save_to(&mut self, dir: &Path) -> Result<(), SessionError> {
839:         self.updated_at = now_epoch();
840:         let _log = SessionLog::create(dir, self)?;
841:         Ok(())
842:     }
843: 
844:     pub fn load(id: &str, dir: &StateDir) -> Result<Self, SessionError> {
845:         let sessions_dir = dir.ensure_subdir(SESSIONS_DIR)?;
846:         Self::load_from(id, &sessions_dir)
847:     }
848: 
849:     pub fn load_from(id: &str, dir: &Path) -> Result<Self, SessionError> {
850:         let jsonl_path = dir.join(format!("{id}.jsonl"));
851:         if jsonl_path.exists() {
852:             return load_jsonl(&jsonl_path);
853:         }
854: 
855:         let json_path = dir.join(format!("{id}.json"));
856:         if !json_path.exists() {
857:             return Err(StorageError::NotFound(id.into()).into());
858:         }
859:         let data = fs::read(&json_path).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
860:         let session: Self = serde_json::from_slice(&data).map_err(StorageError::from)?;
861:         if session.version != SESSION_VERSION {
862:             return Err(SessionError::VersionMismatch {
863:                 found: session.version,
864:                 expected: SESSION_VERSION,
865:             });
866:         }
867:         Ok(session)
868:     }
869: 
870:     pub fn list(cwd: &str, dir: &StateDir) -> Result<Vec<SessionSummary>, SessionError> {
871:         let sessions_dir = dir.ensure_subdir(SESSIONS_DIR)?;
872:         Self::list_in(cwd, &sessions_dir)
873:     }
874: 
875:     pub fn list_in(cwd: &str, dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<SessionSummary>, SessionError> {
876:         let mut summaries = scan_headers(cwd, dir)?;
877:         summaries.sort_unstable_by_key(|s| Reverse(s.updated_at));
878:         Ok(summaries)
879:     }
880: 
881:     pub fn latest(cwd: &str, dir: &StateDir) -> Result<Option<Self>, SessionError> {
882:         let sessions_dir = dir.ensure_subdir(SESSIONS_DIR)?;
883:         Self::latest_in(cwd, &sessions_dir)
884:     }
885: 
886:     pub fn latest_in(cwd: &str, dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<Self>, SessionError> {
887:         let index = load_cwd_index(dir);
888:         if let Some(id) = index.get(cwd)
889:             && let Ok(s) = Self::load_from(id, dir)
890:         {
891:             return Ok(Some(s));
892:         }
893:         let summaries = scan_headers(cwd, dir)?;
894:         let latest = summaries.into_iter().max_by_key(|s| s.updated_at);
895:         match latest {
896:             Some(s) => Self::load_from(&s.id, dir).map(Some),
897:             None => Ok(None),
898:         }
899:     }
900: 
901:     pub fn update_title_if_default(&mut self) {
902:         if self.title == DEFAULT_TITLE {
903:             self.title = generate_title(&self.messages);
904:         }
905:     }
906: 
907:     pub fn delete(id: &str, dir: &StateDir) -> Result<(), SessionError> {
908:         let sessions_dir = dir.ensure_subdir(SESSIONS_DIR)?;
909:         Self::delete_from(id, &sessions_dir)
910:     }
911: 
912:     pub fn delete_from(id: &str, dir: &Path) -> Result<(), SessionError> {
913:         let jsonl_gone = try_remove(&dir.join(format!("{id}.jsonl")))?;
914:         let json_gone = try_remove(&dir.join(format!("{id}.json")))?;
915: 
916:         if !jsonl_gone && !json_gone {
917:             return Err(StorageError::NotFound(id.into()).into());
918:         }
919: 
920:         remove_from_cwd_index(dir, id)?;
921:         Ok(())
922:     }
923: 
924:     pub fn migrate_to_jsonl(dir: &Path, session: &Self) -> Result<SessionLog, SessionError> {
925:         let log = SessionLog::create(dir, session)?;
926:         let _ = fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!("{}.json", session.id)));
927:         Ok(log)
928:     }
929: }

955:             self.get("content")?.as_array()?.iter().find_map(|b| {
956:                 if b.get("type")?.as_str()? == "text" {

980:     #[test]
981:     fn prune_orphans_drops_unreachable_tool_state() {
982:         fn ids(m: &Value) -> Vec<String> {
983:             vec![m.as_str().unwrap().to_owned()]
984:         }
985:         fn subagent(id: &str) -> StoredSubagent {
986:             StoredSubagent {
987:                 tool_use_id: id.into(),
988:                 name: "sub".into(),
989:                 prompt: None,
990:                 model: None,
991:             }
992:         }
993: 
994:         let mut session: TestSession = Session::new("model", "/p");
995:         session.messages.push("task-live".into());
996:         session
997:             .subagent_messages
998:             .insert("task-live".into(), vec!["sub-tool".into()]);
999:         session
1000:             .subagent_messages
1001:             .insert("task-stale".into(), vec!["stale-sub-tool".into()]);
1002:         session.meta.subagents = vec![subagent("task-live"), subagent("task-stale")];
1003:         for id in ["task-live", "sub-tool", "stale-sub-tool", "orphan"] {
1004:             session.tool_outputs.insert(id.into(), Value::Null);
1005:         }
1006: 
1007:         session.prune_orphans(ids);
1008: 
1009:         assert_eq!(
1010:             session.subagent_messages.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1011:             ["task-live"]
1012:         );
1013:         let subagent_ids: Vec<_> = session
1014:             .meta
1015:             .subagents
1016:             .iter()
1017:             .map(|sa| sa.tool_use_id.as_str())
1018:             .collect();
1019:         assert_eq!(subagent_ids, ["task-live"]);
1020:         let mut outputs: Vec<_> = session.tool_outputs.keys().cloned().collect();
1021:         outputs.sort();
1022:         assert_eq!(outputs, ["sub-tool", "task-live"]);
1023:     }

7: const MODEL_FILE: &str = "model";
8: const RECENT_FILE: &str = "recent-models";
9: const MAX_RECENTS: usize = 4;
10: 
11: pub fn persist_model(dir: &StateDir, spec: &str) {
12:     let _ = atomic_write(&dir.path().join(MODEL_FILE), spec.as_bytes());
13: }
14: 
15: pub fn read_model(dir: &StateDir) -> Option<String> {
16:     let raw = fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join(MODEL_FILE)).ok()?;
17:     let spec = raw.trim();
18:     (!spec.is_empty()).then(|| spec.to_owned())
19: }
20: 
21: #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
22: struct RecentList(Vec<String>);
23: 
24: pub fn push_recent(dir: &StateDir, spec: &str) -> Vec<String> {
25:     let mut recents = read_recents(dir);
26:     recents.retain(|s| s != spec);
27:     recents.insert(0, spec.to_owned());
28:     recents.truncate(MAX_RECENTS);
29:     write_recents(dir, &recents);
30:     recents
31: }
32: 
33: pub fn read_recents(dir: &StateDir) -> Vec<String> {
34:     let Ok(raw) = fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join(RECENT_FILE)) else {
35:         return Vec::new();
36:     };
37:     let trimmed = raw.trim();
38:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
39:         return Vec::new();
40:     }
41:     match serde_json::from_str::<RecentList>(trimmed) {
42:         Ok(list) => list.0,
43:         Err(_) => Vec::new(),
44:     }
45: }
46: 
47: fn write_recents(dir: &StateDir, recents: &[String]) {
48:     let json = match serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&RecentList(recents.to_vec())) {
49:         Ok(v) => v,
50:         Err(_) => return,
51:     };
52:     let _ = atomic_write(&dir.path().join(RECENT_FILE), &json);
53: }

26: impl ImageMediaType {
27:     pub const ALL: [Self; 4] = [Self::Png, Self::Jpeg, Self::Gif, Self::Webp];
28: 
29:     /// Single source of truth for media-type strings: serde, data URLs,
30:     /// wire formats, and the Lua bridge all go through here.
31:     pub const fn mime(self) -> &'static str {
32:         match self {
33:             Self::Png => "image/png",
34:             Self::Jpeg => "image/jpeg",
35:             Self::Gif => "image/gif",
36:             Self::Webp => "image/webp",
37:         }
38:     }
39: 
40:     pub fn from_mime(mime: &str) -> Option<Self> {
41:         Self::ALL.into_iter().find(|m| m.mime() == mime)
42:     }
43: }

45: impl Serialize for ImageMediaType {

51: impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for ImageMediaType {
52:     fn deserialize<D: serde::Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {

82:         format!("data:{};base64,{}", self.media_type.mime(), self.data)
83:     }
84: }
85: 
86: pub const IMAGE_OMITTED_NOTE: &str =
87:     "[image omitted: the current model does not support image input]";
88: 
89: /// For models without vision, image blocks become a text note instead of a
90: /// wire block the API would reject. History keeps the pixels, so switching
91: /// back to a vision-capable model restores them.
92: pub fn adapt_images_for_model<'a>(model: &Model, messages: &'a [Message]) -> Cow<'a, [Message]> {
93:     let has_image = |m: &Message| {
94:         m.content
95:             .iter()
96:             .any(|b| matches!(b, ContentBlock::Image { .. }))
97:     };
98:     if model.vision || !messages.iter().any(has_image) {
99:         return Cow::Borrowed(messages);
100:     }
101:     let adapted = messages
102:         .iter()
103:         .map(|m| {
104:             let mut m = m.clone();
105:             for block in &mut m.content {
106:                 if matches!(block, ContentBlock::Image { .. }) {
107:                     *block = ContentBlock::Text {
108:                         text: IMAGE_OMITTED_NOTE.into(),
109:                     };
110:                 }
111:             }
112:             m
113:         })
114:         .collect();
115:     Cow::Owned(adapted)
116: }

162: #[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
163: pub struct Message {
164:     pub role: Role,
165:     pub content: Vec<ContentBlock>,
166:     #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
167:     pub display_text: Option<String>,
168: }
169: 
170: impl Message {
171:     pub fn user(text: String) -> Self {
172:         Self {
173:             role: Role::User,
174:             content: vec![ContentBlock::Text { text }],
175:             ..Default::default()
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:     pub fn user_display(ai_text: String, display: String) -> Self {
180:         Self {
181:             role: Role::User,
182:             content: vec![ContentBlock::Text { text: ai_text }],
183:             display_text: Some(display),
184:         }
185:     }
186: 
187:     pub fn user_with_images(text: String, images: Vec<ImageSource>) -> Self {
188:         let mut content: Vec<ContentBlock> = images
189:             .into_iter()
190:             .map(|source| ContentBlock::Image { source })
191:             .collect();
192:         if !text.is_empty() {
193:             content.push(ContentBlock::Text { text });
194:         }
195:         Self {
196:             role: Role::User,
197:             content,
198:             ..Default::default()
199:         }
200:     }
201: 
202:     pub fn synthetic(text: String) -> Self {
203:         Self {
204:             role: Role::User,
205:             content: vec![ContentBlock::Text { text }],
206:             display_text: Some(String::new()),
207:         }
208:     }
209: 
210:     pub fn user_text(&self) -> Option<&str> {
211:         match &self.display_text {
212:             Some(t) if t.is_empty() => None,
213:             Some(t) => Some(t),
214:             None => self.first_text_content(),
215:         }
216:     }
217: 
218:     pub fn first_text_content(&self) -> Option<&str> {
219:         self.content.iter().find_map(|b| match b {
220:             ContentBlock::Text { text } if !text.is_empty() => Some(text.as_str()),
221:             _ => None,
222:         })
223:     }
224: 
225:     pub fn tool_uses(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (&str, &str, &Value)> {
226:         self.content.iter().filter_map(|b| match b {
227:             ContentBlock::ToolUse { id, name, input } => Some((id.as_str(), name.as_str(), input)),
228:             _ => None,
229:         })
230:     }
231: 
232:     pub fn has_tool_calls(&self) -> bool {
233:         self.content
234:             .iter()
235:             .any(|b| matches!(b, ContentBlock::ToolUse { .. }))
236:     }
237: }
238: 
239: impl TitleSource for Message {
240:     fn first_user_text(&self) -> Option<&str> {
241:         if !self.role.is_user() {
242:             return None;
243:         }
244:         self.user_text()
245:     }
246: }

264: impl StopReason {
265:     pub fn from_anthropic(s: &str) -> Self {

267:             "end_turn" => Self::EndTurn,
268:             "tool_use" => Self::ToolUse,
269:             "max_tokens" => Self::MaxTokens,
270:             _ => Self::EndTurn,

272:     }

274:     pub fn from_openai(s: &str) -> Self {
275:         match s {
276:             "stop" => Self::EndTurn,
277:             "tool_calls" => Self::ToolUse,
278:             "length" => Self::MaxTokens,

283:     pub fn from_google(s: &str) -> Self {
284:         match s {
285:             "STOP" => Self::EndTurn,
286:             "MAX_TOKENS" => Self::MaxTokens,
287:             "SAFETY" | "RECITATION" => {
288:                 warn!("Gemini stop reason: {s}, treating as end_turn");
289:                 Self::EndTurn
290:             }
291:             _ => Self::EndTurn,
292:         }
293:     }
