1819:     fn cmd_cd(&mut self, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1820:         let path = if args.is_empty() {
1821:             maki_storage::paths::home().unwrap_or_default()
1822:         } else {
1823:             match args.strip_prefix('~') {
1824:                 Some(rest) => {
1825:                     let home = maki_storage::paths::home().unwrap_or_default();
1826:                     if rest.is_empty() {
1827:                         home
1828:                     } else {
1829:                         home.join(rest.trim_start_matches('/'))
1830:                     }
1831:                 }
1832:                 None => PathBuf::from(args),
1833:             }
1834:         };
1835:         match std::env::set_current_dir(&path) {
1836:             Ok(()) => {
1837:                 if let Ok(canonical) = std::env::current_dir() {
1838:                     self.state.session.cwd = canonical.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
1839:                 }
1840:                 self.status_bar.refresh_cwd();
1841:                 self.flash(format!("cd {}", path.display()))
1842:             }
1843:             Err(e) => self.flash(format!("cd: {e}")),
1844:         }
1845:         vec![]
1846:     }

94: const WORKFLOW_ON_MSG: &str = "Workflow mode: on";
95: const WORKFLOW_OFF_MSG: &str = "Workflow mode: off";
96: const IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX: &str = "Implement the plan";
97: const IMPLEMENT_PARALLEL_HINT: &str = "Use batch+task to parallelize, assign each subagent a separate module and restrict its tests to that module to avoid interference.";

99: const TASK_DONE_DETAIL: &str = "✓ ";
100: 
101: #[derive(Clone)]
102: pub(super) struct TaskEntry {
103:     name: String,
104:     finished: Option<bool>,
105: }
106: 
107: impl PickerItem for TaskEntry {
108:     fn label(&self) -> &str {
109:         &self.name
110:     }
111:     fn detail(&self) -> Option<&str> {
112:         matches!(self.finished, Some(true)).then_some(TASK_DONE_DETAIL)
113:     }
114:     fn is_spinning(&self) -> bool {
115:         matches!(self.finished, Some(false))
116:     }
117: }

295:     pub(crate) fn main_chat(&mut self) -> &mut Chat {
296:         &mut self.chats[0]
297:     }

299:     fn is_main_chat(&self) -> bool {
300:         self.active_chat == 0
301:     }

303:     fn plan_form_active(&self) -> bool {
304:         self.state.mode == Mode::Plan && self.plan_form.is_visible()
305:     }

307:     pub(crate) fn update_model(&mut self, model: &Model) {
308:         self.state.update_model(model);
309:         persist_model(&self.storage, &self.state.session.model);
310:     }

312:     pub(crate) fn record_recent_model(&mut self, spec: &str) {

314:         self.model_picker.set_recents(recents);
315:     }

317:     pub(crate) fn flash(&mut self, msg: String) {
318:         self.status_bar.flash(msg);
319:     }
320: 
321:     pub fn tick_error_expiry(&mut self) {
322:         if self.status.is_error_expired() {
323:             self.status = Status::Idle;
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     fn active_chat(&mut self) -> &mut Chat {
328:         &mut self.chats[self.active_chat]
329:     }
330: 
331:     fn clear_selection_unless_pending_copy(&mut self) {
332:         if !self
333:             .selection_state
334:             .as_ref()
335:             .is_some_and(|s| s.is_pending_copy())
336:         {
337:             self.selection_state = None;
338:         }
339:     }
340: 
341:     pub fn update(&mut self, msg: Msg) -> Vec<Action> {
342:         match msg {
343:             Msg::Key(key) => self.handle_key(key),
344:             Msg::Paste(text) => {
345:                 let text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace('\r', "\n");
346:                 if text.is_empty() {
347:                     if self.is_main_chat() && self.image_paste_rx.is_empty() {
348:                         self.start_image_paste();
349:                     }
350:                 } else {
351:                     let mut any_image = false;
352:                     if self.is_main_chat() {
353:                         for line in text.lines() {
354:                             if let Some((path, mt)) = image::try_parse_image_path(line) {
355:                                 self.start_file_image_paste(path, mt);
356:                                 any_image = true;
357:                             }
358:                         }
359:                     }
360:                     if !any_image {
361:                         self.route_text_paste(&text);
362:                     }
363:                 }
364:                 vec![]
365:             }
366:             Msg::Mouse(event) => {
367:                 self.handle_mouse(event);
368:                 vec![]
369:             }
370:             Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta } => {
371:                 self.clear_selection_unless_pending_copy();
372:                 self.handle_scroll(column, row, delta);
373:                 vec![]
374:             }
375:             Msg::Agent(envelope) => self.handle_agent_event(*envelope),
376:         }
377:     }
378: 
379:     fn send_answer(&self, answer: String) {
380:         if let Some(tx) = &self.answer_tx {
381:             let _ = tx.try_send(answer);
382:         }
383:     }
384: 
385:     fn send_to_agent(&self, subagent_id: Option<&str>, answer: String) {
386:         let routed = subagent_id.and_then(|id| self.subagent_answers.get(id));
387:         if let Some(tx) = routed {
388:             let _ = tx.try_send(answer);
389:         } else {
390:             self.send_answer(answer);
391:         }
392:     }
393: 
394:     fn handle_scroll(&mut self, column: u16, row: u16, delta: i32) {
395:         if self.btw_modal.is_open() {
396:             self.btw_modal.scroll(delta);
397:             return;
398:         }
399:         if self.help_modal.is_open() {
400:             self.help_modal.scroll(delta);
401:             return;
402:         }
403:         if self.usage_modal.is_open() {
404:             self.usage_modal.scroll(delta);
405:             return;
406:         }
407:         let pos = Position::new(column, row);
408:         if self.float_mgr.is_open() && self.float_mgr.contains(pos) {
409:             self.float_mgr.scroll(delta);
410:             return;
411:         }
412:         macro_rules! try_picker {
413:             ($picker:expr) => {
414:                 if $picker.is_open() {
415:                     if $picker.contains(pos) {
416:                         $picker.scroll(delta);
417:                     }
418:                     return;
419:                 }
420:             };
421:         }
422:         try_picker!(self.session_picker);
423:         try_picker!(self.rewind_picker);
424:         try_picker!(self.task_picker);
425:         try_picker!(self.model_picker);
426:         try_picker!(self.file_picker);
427:         if let Some(zone) = self.zone_at(row, column) {
428:             self.scroll_zone(zone.zone, delta);
429:         }
430:     }
431: 
432:     fn open_tasks(&mut self) {
433:         let entries: Vec<TaskEntry> = self
434:             .chats
435:             .iter()
436:             .enumerate()
437:             .map(|(i, c)| TaskEntry {
438:                 name: c.name.clone(),
439:                 finished: (i > 0).then_some(c.is_finished()),
440:             })
441:             .collect();
442:         self.task_picker_original = Some(self.active_chat);
443:         self.task_picker.open(entries, " Tasks ");
444:         self.task_picker.select(self.active_chat);
445:     }
446: 
447:     fn handle_ctrl(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Option<Vec<Action>> {
448:         if !is_ctrl(&key) {
449:             return None;
450:         }
451:         if key::DELETE_CURRENT_SESSION.matches(key) {
452:             let session_id = self.state.session.id.clone();
453: 
454:             // 1. Delete the session from storage
455:             if let Err(e) = AppSession::delete(&session_id, &self.storage) {
456:                 self.status_bar.flash(format!("Failed to delete session: {e}"));
457:             } else {
458:                 self.status_bar.flash("Session deleted".into());
459:                 self.session_picker.remove_entry(&session_id);
460: 
461:                 // 2. Open the sessions list popup window directly
462:                 self.open_session_picker();
463:             }
464:             return Some(vec![]);
465:         }
466:         if key::TOGGLE_GLOBAL_SESSIONS.matches(key) {
467:             let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
468:             settings.global_sessions = !settings.global_sessions;
469:             settings.save();
470:             self.status_bar.flash(
471:                 if settings.global_sessions { "Global sessions enabled" } else { "Global sessions disabled" }.into(),
472:             );
473:             if self.session_picker.is_open() {
474:                 self.open_session_picker();
475:             }
476:             return Some(vec![]);
477:         }
478:         if key::QUIT.matches(key) {
479:             self.command_palette.close();
480:             return Some(if !self.is_main_chat() || self.input_box.is_empty() {
481:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
482:                     return Some(self.handle_cancel());
483:                 }
484:                 self.quit()
485:             } else {
486:                 self.input_box.discard();
487:                 vec![]
488:             });
489:         }
490:         if key::HELP.matches(key) {
491:             self.help_modal.toggle();
492:             return Some(vec![]);
493:         }
494:         if key::TASKS.matches(key) {
495:             self.open_tasks();
496:             return Some(vec![]);
497:         }
498:         if key::PREV_CHAT.matches(key) {
499:             self.active_chat = self.active_chat.saturating_sub(1);
500:             return Some(vec![]);
501:         }
502:         if key::NEXT_CHAT.matches(key) {
503:             self.active_chat = (self.active_chat + 1).min(self.chats.len() - 1);
504:             return Some(vec![]);
505:         }
506:         if key::SCROLL_HALF_UP.matches(key) {
507:             let half = self.chats[self.active_chat].half_page();
508:             self.active_chat().scroll(half);
509:             return Some(vec![]);
510:         }
511:         if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key) {
512:             let half = self.chats[self.active_chat].half_page();
513:             self.active_chat().scroll(-half);
514:             return Some(vec![]);
515:         }
516:         if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key) {
517:             self.active_chat().scroll_to_top();
518:             return Some(vec![]);
519:         }
520:         if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key) {
521:             self.active_chat().enable_auto_scroll();
522:             return Some(vec![]);
523:         }
524:         if key::PLAN_TOGGLE.matches(key)
525:             && self.state.mode == Mode::Plan
526:             && self.state.plan.is_ready()
527:         {
528:             self.plan_form.toggle();
529:             return Some(vec![]);
530:         }
531:         if key::TOGGLE_VERBOSE.matches(key) {
532:             self.verbose = !self.verbose;
533:             return Some(vec![]);
534:         }
535:         None
536:     }
537: 
538:     fn dispatch_overlay(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Option<Vec<Action>> {
539:         if self.permission_prompt.is_open() {
540:             if let Some(answer) = self.permission_prompt.handle_key(key) {
541:                 let subagent_id = self.permission_prompt.subagent_id().map(str::to_owned);
542:                 let encoded = answer.encode();
543:                 self.permission_prompt.close();
544:                 self.send_to_agent(subagent_id.as_deref(), encoded);
545:             }
546:             return Some(vec![]);
547:         }
548: 
549:         // plan_form is non-modal: Passthrough falls through to the rest of dispatch
550:         if self.plan_form_active() {
551:             let action = self.plan_form.handle_key(key);
552:             if action != PlanFormAction::Passthrough {
553:                 return Some(self.handle_plan_form_action(action));
554:             }
555:         }
556: 
557:         if self.help_modal.is_open() {
558:             self.help_modal.handle_key(key);
559:             return Some(vec![]);
560:         }
561: 
562:         if self.plugins_modal.is_open() {
563:             match self.plugins_modal.handle_key(key) {
564:                 PluginsAction::EditPlugin(path) => {
565:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
566:                 }
567:                 PluginsAction::None => {
568:                     return Some(vec![]);
569:                 }
570:             }
571:         }
572: 
573:         if self.skills_modal.is_open() {
574:             match self.skills_modal.handle_key(key) {
575:                 SkillsAction::CreateSkill(path) => {
576:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
577:                 }
578:                 SkillsAction::EditSkillsJson(path) => {
579:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
580:                 }
581:                 SkillsAction::EditSkill(path) => {
582:                     return Some(vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]);
583:                 }
584:                 SkillsAction::None => {
585:                     return Some(vec![]);
586:                 }
587:             }
588:         }
589: 
590:         if self.export_picker.is_open() {
591:             match self.export_picker.handle_key(key) {
592:                 ExportPickerAction::Select(entry) => {
593:                     let settings = UserSettings::load();
594:                     let base_path = settings.resolved_export_path(std::path::Path::new(&self.state.session.cwd));
595:                     match entry.export_type {
596:                         ExportType::MarkdownClipboard => {
597:                             let text = self.export_session_to_markdown();
598:                             match self.clipboard.copy_text(&text) {
599:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Copied) => {
600:                                     self.flash("Copied transcript to clipboard".into());
601:                                 }
602:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Noop) => {}
603:                                 Err(e) => {
604:                                     self.flash(format!("Copy failed: {e}"));
605:                                 }
606:                             }
607:                         }
608:                         ExportType::MarkdownSave => {
609:                             let text = self.export_session_to_markdown();
610:                             let filepath = if base_path.is_file() {
611:                                 base_path
612:                             } else {
613:                                 let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&base_path);
614:                                 base_path.join(format!("session-{}.md", self.state.session.id))
615:                             };
616:                             match std::fs::write(&filepath, text) {
617:                                 Ok(_) => self.flash(format!("Saved transcript to {}", filepath.display())),
618:                                 Err(e) => self.flash(format!("Failed to save transcript: {e}")),
619:                             }
620:                         }
621:                         ExportType::JsonClipboard => {
622:                             let text = self.export_session_to_json();
623:                             match self.clipboard.copy_text(&text) {
624:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Copied) => {
625:                                     self.flash("Copied JSON session to clipboard".into());
626:                                 }
627:                                 Ok(crate::clipboard::CopyResult::Noop) => {}
628:                                 Err(e) => {
629:                                     self.flash(format!("Copy failed: {e}"));
630:                                 }
631:                             }
632:                         }
633:                         ExportType::JsonSave => {
634:                             let text = self.export_session_to_json();
635:                             let filepath = if base_path.is_file() {
636:                                 base_path
637:                             } else {
638:                                 let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&base_path);
639:                                 base_path.join(format!("session-{}.json", self.state.session.id))
640:                             };
641:                             match std::fs::write(&filepath, text) {
642:                                 Ok(_) => self.flash(format!("Saved JSON session to {}", filepath.display())),
643:                                 Err(e) => self.flash(format!("Failed to save JSON session: {e}")),
644:                             }
645:                         }
646:                     }
647:                 }
648:                 ExportPickerAction::Consumed => {}
649:                 ExportPickerAction::Close => {}
650:             }
651:             return Some(vec![]);
652:         }
653: 
654:         if self.usage_modal.is_open() {
655:             if key::REFRESH.matches(key) {
656:                 return Some(vec![Action::RefreshUsage]);
657:             }
658:             self.usage_modal.handle_key(key);
659:             return Some(vec![]);
660:         }
661: 
662:         if self.btw_modal.is_open() {
663:             self.btw_modal.handle_key(key);
664:             return Some(vec![]);
665:         }
666: 
667:         if self.float_mgr.handle_key(key) {
668:             return Some(vec![]);
669:         }
670: 
671:         if self.search_modal.is_open() {
672:             match self.search_modal.handle_key(key) {
673:                 SearchAction::Consumed => {
674:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
675:                     let texts = chat.segment_search_texts();
676:                     self.search_modal.update_matches(&texts);
677:                     sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, chat);
678:                 }
679:                 SearchAction::Navigate => {
680:                     sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, &mut self.chats[self.active_chat]);
681:                 }
682:                 SearchAction::Select(idx) => {
683:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
684:                     chat.scroll_to_segment(idx);
685:                     chat.set_highlight_segment(None);
686:                     self.search_modal.close();
687:                 }
688:                 SearchAction::Close(saved) => {
689:                     let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
690:                     chat.set_highlight_segment(None);
691:                     if let Some((top, auto)) = saved {
692:                         chat.restore_scroll(top, auto);
693:                     }
694:                     self.search_modal.close();
695:                 }
696:             }
697:             return Some(vec![]);
698:         }
699: 
700:         if self.file_picker.is_open() {
701:             return Some(match self.file_picker.handle_key(key) {
702:                 FilePickerModalAction::Consumed => vec![],
703:                 FilePickerModalAction::Select(path) => {
704:                     self.file_picker.close();
705:                     if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) =
706:                         self.input_box.handle_paste_with_spaces(&path)
707:                     {
708:                         self.command_palette.sync(&val);
709:                     }
710:                     vec![]
711:                 }
712:                 FilePickerModalAction::Close => {
713:                     self.file_picker.close();
714:                     vec![]
715:                 }
716:             });
717:         }
718: 
719:         if self.queue.focus().is_some() {
720:             match key.code {
721:                 KeyCode::Up => self.queue.move_focus_up(),
722:                 KeyCode::Down => self.queue.move_focus_down(),
723:                 KeyCode::Enter => {
724:                     self.queue.remove_focused();
725:                 }
726:                 KeyCode::Esc => self.queue.unfocus(),
727:                 _ if key::QUIT.matches(key) => self.queue.unfocus(),
728:                 _ if key::POP_QUEUE.matches(key) => {
729:                     self.queue.remove(0);
730:                 }
731:                 _ => {}
732:             }
733:             return Some(vec![]);
734:         }
735: 
736:         if self.task_picker.is_open() {
737:             if key::TASKS.matches(key) {
738:                 self.task_picker.close();
739:                 return Some(vec![]);
740:             }
741:             return Some(match self.task_picker.handle_key(key) {
742:                 PickerAction::Consumed | PickerAction::Toggle(..) => vec![],
743:                 PickerAction::Select(idx, _) => {
744:                     self.task_picker_original = None;
745:                     self.active_chat = idx;
746:                     vec![]
747:                 }
748:                 PickerAction::Close => {
749:                     self.active_chat = self.task_picker_original.take().unwrap_or(0);
750:                     vec![]
751:                 }
752:             });
753:         }
754: 
755:         if self.session_picker.is_open() {
756:             return Some(match self.session_picker.handle_key(key) {
757:                 SessionPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
758:                 SessionPickerAction::Select(id) => self.load_session(id),
759:                 SessionPickerAction::ConfirmDelete => {
760:                     self.status_bar.flash(format!(
761:                         "Press {} again to confirm delete",
762:                         key::DELETE.label
763:                     ));
764:                     vec![]
765:                 }
766:                 SessionPickerAction::Delete(id) => self.delete_session(id),
767:                 SessionPickerAction::Close => vec![],
768:             });
769:         }
770: 
771:         if self.rewind_picker.is_open() {
772:             return Some(match self.rewind_picker.handle_key(key) {
773:                 RewindPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
774:                 RewindPickerAction::Select(entry) => self.rewind_to(entry),
775:                 RewindPickerAction::Close => vec![],
776:             });
777:         }
778: 
779:         if self.theme_picker.is_open() {
780:             return Some(match self.theme_picker.handle_key(key) {
781:                 ThemePickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
782:                 ThemePickerAction::Closed => vec![],
783:             });
784:         }
785: 
786:         if self.goto_picker.is_open() {
787:             return Some(match self.goto_picker.handle_key(key) {
788:                 GotoPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
789:                 GotoPickerAction::Select(entry) => self.scroll_to_turn(entry),
790:                 GotoPickerAction::Close => vec![],
791:             });
792:         }
793: 
794:         if self.model_picker.is_open() {
795:             return Some(match self.model_picker.handle_key(key) {
796:                 ModelPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
797:                 ModelPickerAction::Select(spec) => {
798:                     vec![Action::ChangeModel(spec)]
799:                 }
800:                 ModelPickerAction::AssignTier(spec, tier) => {
801:                     vec![Action::AssignTier(spec, tier)]
802:                 }
803:                 ModelPickerAction::UnassignTier(spec, tier) => {
804:                     vec![Action::UnassignTier(spec, tier)]
805:                 }
806:                 ModelPickerAction::Close => vec![],
807:             });
808:         }
809: 
810:         if self.settings_picker.is_open() {
811:             return Some(match self.settings_picker.handle_key(key) {
812:                 SettingsPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
813:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowSystemPrompt(val) => {
814:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
815:                     settings.show_system_prompt = val;
816:                     settings.save();
817:                     vec![]
818:                 }
819:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleApiLogging(val) => {
820:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
821:                     settings.api_logging = val;
822:                     settings.save();
823:                     vec![]
824:                 }
825:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowReasoning(val) => {
826:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
827:                     settings.show_reasoning = val;
828:                     settings.save();
829:                     vec![]
830:                 }
831:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleShowTokenStats(val) => {
832:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
833:                     settings.show_token_stats = val;
834:                     settings.save();
835:                     self.show_token_stats = val;
836:                     vec![]
837:                 }
838:                 SettingsPickerAction::ToggleGlobalSessions(val) => {
839:                     let mut settings = UserSettings::load();
840:                     settings.global_sessions = val;
841:                     settings.save();
842:                     if val {
843:                         self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions enabled".into());
844:                     } else {
845:                         self.status_bar.flash("Global sessions disabled".into());
846:                     }
847:                     vec![]
848:                 }
849:                 SettingsPickerAction::EditLogCommand => {
850:                     self.settings_picker.close();
851:                     if let Ok(path) = crate::config::config_path() {
852:                         vec![Action::OpenEditor(path)]
853:                     } else {
854:                         vec![]
855:                     }
856:                 }
857:                 SettingsPickerAction::Closed => vec![],
858:             });
859:         }

861:         if self.login_picker.is_open() {
862:             return Some(match self.login_picker.handle_key(key) {
863:                 LoginPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],
864:                 LoginPickerAction::Close => vec![],
865:                 LoginPickerAction::Authenticated { model_spec } => {
866:                     vec![Action::ChangeModel(model_spec), Action::RefreshModels]
867:                 }
868:                 LoginPickerAction::Configured { slug } => {

870:                 }
871:             });

874:         if self.mcp_picker.is_open() {
875:             return Some(match self.mcp_picker.handle_key(key) {
876:                 McpPickerAction::Consumed => vec![],

878:                     server_name,
879:                     enabled,
880:                 } => {
881:                     vec![Action::ToggleMcp(server_name, enabled)]
882:                 }
883:                 McpPickerAction::Close => vec![],
884:             });
885:         }
886: 
887:         None
888:     }

890:     fn handle_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Vec<Action> {
891:         self.clear_selection_unless_pending_copy();
892: 
893:         if key::SUSPEND.matches(key) && cfg!(unix) {
894:             return self.suspend();
895:         }
896: 
897:         if let Some(actions) = self.dispatch_overlay(key) {
898:             return actions;
899:         }
900: 
901:         if let Some(actions) = self.handle_ctrl(key) {
902:             return actions;
903:         }
904: 
905:         if self.dispatch_plugin_keymap(key) {
906:             return vec![];
907:         }
908: 
909:         if !self.is_main_chat() {
910:             return match key.code {
911:                 KeyCode::Tab if !self.is_bash_input() => self.toggle_mode(),
912:                 KeyCode::Esc if !self.chats[self.active_chat].is_finished() => {
913:                     if let Some(t) = self.last_esc.take()
914:                         && t.elapsed() < self.status_bar.flash_duration
915:                     {
916:                         self.handle_subagent_cancel()
917:                     } else {
918:                         self.last_esc = Some(Instant::now());
919:                         self.status_bar.flash(FLASH_CANCEL.into());
920:                         vec![]
921:                     }
922:                 }
923:                 _ => vec![],
924:             };
925:         }
926: 
927:         self.handle_main_chat_key(key)
928:     }
929: 
930:     fn dispatch_plugin_keymap(&self, key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
931:         let snap = self.keymap_reader.load();
932:         for entry in &snap.entries {
933:             if entry.key == key.code && entry.modifiers == key.modifiers {
934:                 if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
935:                     handle.run_keybind_callback(entry.id);
936:                 }
937:                 return true;
938:             }
939:         }
940:         false
941:     }
942: 
943:     fn handle_main_chat_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> Vec<Action> {
944:         if key::EDIT_SYSTEM_PROMPT.matches(key) {
945:             return vec![Action::EditSystemPrompt];
946:         }
947:         if key::SESSIONS.matches(key) {
948:             return self.open_session_picker();
949:         }
950:         if key::SHIFT_SESSION_DOWN.matches(key) {
951:             return self.shift_session(-1);
952:         }
953:         if key::SHIFT_SESSION_UP.matches(key) {
954:             return self.shift_session(1);
955:         }
956:         if key::EDIT_INPUT.matches(key) {
957:             return vec![Action::EditInputInEditor];
958:         }
959:         if key::OPEN_EDITOR.matches(key) {
960:             return match self.state.plan.path() {
961:                 Some(p) => vec![Action::OpenEditor(p.to_path_buf())],
962:                 None => {
963:                     self.flash(FLASH_NO_PLAN.into());
964:                     vec![]
965:                 }
966:             };
967:         }
968:         if is_ctrl(&key) {
969:             if key::POP_QUEUE.matches(key) {
970:                 self.queue.remove(0);
971:             } else if key::SEARCH.matches(key) {
972:                 let top = self.chats[self.active_chat].scroll_top();
973:                 let auto = self.chats[self.active_chat].auto_scroll();
974:                 self.search_modal.open(top, auto);
975:             } else if key::FILE_PICKER.matches(key) {
976:                 self.file_picker.open(&self.state.session.cwd);
977:             } else if key.code == KeyCode::Char('v') && self.image_paste_rx.is_empty() {
978:                 self.start_image_paste();
979:             } else if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) = self.input_box.handle_key(key) {
980:                 self.command_palette.sync(&val);
981:             }
982:             return vec![];
983:         }
984: 
985:         match self
986:             .command_palette
987:             .handle_key(key, &self.input_box.buffer.value())
988:         {
989:             CommandAction::Consumed => return vec![],
990:             CommandAction::Execute(cmd) => return self.execute_command(cmd),
991:             CommandAction::Complete(text) => {
992:                 self.command_palette.sync(&text);
993:                 self.input_box.set_input(text);
994:                 self.input_box.buffer.move_to_end();
995:                 return vec![];
996:             }
997:             CommandAction::Passthrough => {}
998:         }
999: 
1000:         let streaming = self.status == Status::Streaming;
1001:         match self.input_box.handle_key(key) {
1002:             InputAction::Submit(sub) => self.handle_submit(sub),
1003:             InputAction::PaletteSync(val) => {
1004:                 self.command_palette.sync(&val);
1005:                 vec![]
1006:             }
1007:             InputAction::Passthrough(key) => {
1008:                 if key.code != KeyCode::Esc {
1009:                     self.last_esc = None;
1010:                 }
1011:                 match key.code {
1012:                     KeyCode::Up if streaming => {
1013:                         self.active_chat().scroll(1);
1014:                         vec![]
1015:                     }
1016:                     KeyCode::Down if streaming => {
1017:                         self.active_chat().scroll(-1);
1018:                         vec![]
1019:                     }
1020:                     KeyCode::Tab if !self.is_bash_input() => self.toggle_mode(),
1021:                     KeyCode::Esc => {
1022:                         if let Some(t) = self.last_esc.take()
1023:                             && t.elapsed() < self.status_bar.flash_duration
1024:                         {
1025:                             if streaming {
1026:                                 self.handle_cancel()
1027:                             } else {
1028:                                 self.open_rewind_picker()
1029:                             }
1030:                         } else {
1031:                             self.last_esc = Some(Instant::now());
1032:                             self.status_bar.flash(
1033:                                 if streaming {
1034:                                     FLASH_CANCEL
1035:                                 } else {
1036:                                     FLASH_REWIND
1037:                                 }
1038:                                 .into(),
1039:                             );
1040:                             vec![]
1041:                         }
1042:                     }
1043:                     _ => vec![],
1044:                 }
1045:             }
1046:             InputAction::ContinueLine | InputAction::None => vec![],
1047:         }
1048:     }

1051:         vec![Action::Suspend]
1052:     }

1054:     fn quit(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1055:         self.save_session();
1056:         self.save_input_history();
1057:         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Success;
1058:         vec![Action::Quit]

1064:         self.status_bar.flash("Configuration reloaded".to_string());

1067:     fn start_rename(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1068:         let user_texts: Vec<String> = self
1069:             .state
1070:             .session
1071:             .messages
1072:             .iter()
1073:             .filter_map(|m| m.user_text().map(str::to_string))
1074:             .take(3)
1075:             .collect();
1076: 
1077:         if user_texts.is_empty() {
1078:             self.flash("Nothing to rename yet — send a message first".into());
1079:             return vec![];
1080:         }
1081: 
1082:         let mut total_words = 0usize;
1083:         let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
1084:         'outer: for text in &user_texts {
1085:             let mut words: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
1086:             for word in text.split_whitespace() {
1087:                 if total_words >= 200 {
1088:                     break 'outer;
1089:                 }
1090:                 words.push(word);
1091:                 total_words += 1;
1092:             }
1093:             parts.push(words.join(" "));
1094:         }
1095: 
1096:         let context = parts.join("\n\n");
1097:         let msg = Message::user(context);
1098:         self.flash("Renaming session…".into());
1099:         vec![Action::RenameSession(vec![msg])]
1100:     }
1101: 
1102:     pub(crate) fn apply_rename(&mut self, title: String) {
1103:         self.state.session.title = title.clone();
1104:         self.save_session();
1105:         self.status_bar.flash(format!("Session renamed to: {title}"));
1106:     }
1107: 
1108:     pub(crate) fn handle_submit(&mut self, sub: Submission) -> Vec<Action> {
1109:         match std::mem::take(&mut self.pending_input) {
1110:             PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id } => {
1111:                 self.send_to_agent(subagent_id.as_deref(), String::new());
1112:                 return vec![];
1113:             }
1114:             PendingInput::None => {}
1115:         }
1116:         if sub.is_empty() {
1117:             return vec![];
1118:         }
1119:         if sub.text.trim() == "exit" {
1120:             return self.quit();
1121:         }
1122: 
1123:         if let Some(prefix) = shell::parse_shell_prefix(&sub.text) {
1124:             let cmd = prefix.command.trim();
1125:             if cmd == "cd" || cmd.starts_with("cd ") {
1126:                 self.flash("Only /cd can change the working directory".into());
1127:             }
1128:             let id = self.shell.next_id();
1129:             let sigil = if prefix.visible { "!" } else { "!!" };
1130:             let display = format!("{sigil} {}", prefix.command);
1131:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display);
1132:             return vec![Action::ShellCommand {
1133:                 id,
1134:                 command: prefix.command,
1135:                 visible: prefix.visible,
1136:             }];
1137:         }
1138:         let msg: QueuedMessage = sub.into();
1139:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1140:             self.queue_and_notify(msg);
1141:             vec![]
1142:         } else {
1143:             self.run_id += 1;
1144:             self.start_from_queue(&msg)
1145:         }
1146:     }
1147: 
1148:     fn handle_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1149:         let cancelled_run = self.run_id;
1150:         self.run_id += 1;
1151:         self.retry_info = None;
1152:         self.close_all_overlays();
1153:         self.pending_input = PendingInput::None;
1154:         self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
1155:         self.subagent_answers.clear();
1156:         self.shell.cancel_all();
1157:         for chat in &mut self.chats {
1158:             chat.flush();
1159:             chat.cancel_in_progress();
1160:         }
1161:         self.main_chat()
1162:             .push(DisplayMessage::new(DisplayRole::Error, CANCEL_MSG.into()));
1163:         self.queue.clear();
1164:         self.status = Status::Idle;
1165:         vec![Action::CancelAgent {
1166:             run_id: cancelled_run,
1167:         }]
1168:     }
1169: 
1170:     fn handle_subagent_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<Action> {
1171:         let tool_use_id = self
1172:             .chat_index
1173:             .iter()
1174:             .find(|&(_, &idx)| idx == self.active_chat)
1175:             .map(|(id, _)| id.clone());
1176: 
1177:         let Some(tool_use_id) = tool_use_id else {
1178:             return vec![];
1179:         };
1180: 
1181:         self.chats[self.active_chat].flush();
1182:         self.chats[self.active_chat].cancel_in_progress();
1183:         self.chats[self.active_chat].mark_finished(DisplayRole::Error, CANCELLED_TEXT);
1184:         self.subagent_answers.remove(&tool_use_id);
1185: 
1186:         vec![Action::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id }]
1187:     }
1188: 
1189:     fn handle_agent_event(&mut self, envelope: Envelope) -> Vec<Action> {
1190:         if let AgentEvent::RenameResult { title } = envelope.event {
1191:             self.apply_rename(title);
1192:             return vec![];
1193:         }
1194: 
1195:         if envelope.run_id == RESTORE_RUN_ID {
1196:             let (id, snapshot, theme_gen, is_header) = match envelope.event {
1197:                 AgentEvent::ToolSnapshot {
1198:                     id,
1199:                     snapshot,
1200:                     theme_gen,
1201:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, false),
1202:                 AgentEvent::ToolHeaderSnapshot {
1203:                     id,
1204:                     snapshot,
1205:                     theme_gen,
1206:                 } => (id, snapshot, theme_gen, true),
1207:                 _ => return vec![],
1208:             };
1209:             for chat in &mut self.chats {
1210:                 if is_header {
1211:                     chat.tool_header_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1212:                 } else {
1213:                     chat.tool_snapshot(&id, snapshot.clone(), theme_gen);
1214:                 }
1215:             }
1216:             return vec![];
1217:         }
1218:         if envelope.run_id != self.run_id {
1219:             // Stale run_id after cancel: agent updates shared_history before sending
1220:             // Done/Error, so this is the first moment the full conversation is available.
1221:             if matches!(
1222:                 envelope.event,
1223:                 AgentEvent::Done { .. } | AgentEvent::Error { .. }
1224:             ) {
1225:                 self.save_session();
1226:             }
1227:             return vec![];
1228:         }
1229: 
1230:         if let AgentEvent::SubagentHistory {
1231:             tool_use_id,
1232:             messages,
1233:         } = envelope.event
1234:         {
1235:             // Workflow sessions use synthetic ids that no ToolDone will match,
1236:             // so we finish them here on SubagentHistory.
1237:             if let Some(&sub_idx) = self.chat_index.get(tool_use_id.as_str()) {
1238:                 self.chats[sub_idx].mark_finished(DisplayRole::Done, DONE_TEXT);
1239:             }
1240:             self.state
1241:                 .session
1242:                 .subagent_messages
1243:                 .insert(tool_use_id, messages);
1244:             return vec![];
1245:         }
1246: 
1247:         let subagent_id = envelope
1248:             .subagent
1249:             .as_ref()
1250:             .map(|s| s.parent_tool_use_id.clone());
1251: 
1252:         let chat_idx = match envelope.subagent {
1253:             Some(ref subagent) => self.resolve_or_create_chat(subagent),
1254:             None => 0,
1255:         };
1256: 
1257:         if let AgentEvent::ToolDone(ref e) = envelope.event {
1258:             if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan
1259:                 && self.state.plan.path().is_some_and(|pp| e.wrote_to(pp))
1260:             {
1261:                 self.transition_plan(PlanTrigger::WriteDone);
1262:             }
1263:             if let Some(ref outputs) = self.shared_tool_outputs {
1264:                 outputs
1265:                     .lock()
1266:                     .unwrap()
1267:                     .insert(e.id.clone(), e.output.clone());
1268:             }
1269:             if let Some(&sub_idx) = self.chat_index.get(&e.id) {
1270:                 let (role, text) = if e.is_error {
1271:                     (DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT)
1272:                 } else {
1273:                     (DisplayRole::Done, DONE_TEXT)
1274:                 };
1275:                 self.chats[sub_idx].mark_finished(role, text);
1276:             }
1277:         }
1278: 
1279:         if let AgentEvent::Retry {
1280:             attempt,
1281:             message,
1282:             delay_ms,
1283:         } = envelope.event
1284:         {
1285:             self.chats[chat_idx].stream_reset();
1286:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1287:                 self.retry_info = Some(RetryInfo {
1288:                     attempt,
1289:                     message,
1290:                     deadline: Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(delay_ms),
1291:                 });
1292:             }
1293:             return vec![];
1294:         }
1295: 
1296:         self.retry_info = None;
1297: 
1298:         let plan_path = if self.state.mode == Mode::Plan {
1299:             self.state.plan.path()
1300:         } else {
1301:             None
1302:         };
1303: 
1304:         if let AgentEvent::TurnComplete(ref tc) = envelope.event {
1305:             self.state.token_usage += tc.usage;
1306:             self.chats[chat_idx].token_usage += tc.usage;
1307:             *self
1308:                 .state
1309:                 .session
1310:                 .meta
1311:                 .usage_by_model
1312:                 .entry(tc.model.clone())
1313:                 .or_default() += tc.usage.into();
1314:             let ctx_size = tc.context_size.unwrap_or_else(|| tc.usage.context_tokens());
1315:             self.chats[chat_idx].context_size = ctx_size;
1316:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1317:                 self.state.context_size = ctx_size;
1318:                 if let Some(start) = self.turn_start.take() {
1319:                     let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
1320:                     let total = tc.usage.input + tc.usage.cache_creation + tc.usage.cache_read;
1321:                     let (pp_tps, tg_tps) = if elapsed > 0.0 {
1322:                         (total as f64 / elapsed, tc.usage.output as f64 / elapsed)
1323:                     } else {
1324:                         (0.0, 0.0)
1325:                     };
1326:                     let cache_rate = if total > 0 {
1327:                         tc.usage.cache_read as f64 / total as f64
1328:                     } else {
1329:                         0.0
1330:                     };
1331:                     self.last_turn_stats = Some(
1332:                         crate::components::status_bar::TurnStats {
1333:                             pp_tps,
1334:                             tg_tps,
1335:                             cache_rate,
1336:                         },
1337:                     );
1338:                 }
1339:             }
1340:             *maki_config::CURRENT_SESSION_NAME.lock().unwrap() = Some(self.state.session.title.clone());
1341:             let formatted =
1342:                 format_turn_usage(&tc.usage, &self.state.model.pricing, self.state.fast);
1343:             self.chats[chat_idx].set_pending_turn_usage(formatted);
1344:         }
1345: 
1346:         let result = self.chats[chat_idx].handle_event(envelope.event, plan_path);
1347: 
1348:         if let ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { text, image_count } = result {
1349:             if chat_idx == 0 {
1350:                 self.on_queue_item_consumed(&text, image_count);
1351:             }
1352:             return vec![];
1353:         }
1354: 
1355:         if let ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { id, tool, scopes } = result {
1356:             self.permission_prompt
1357:                 .open(id, tool, scopes, subagent_id.clone());
1358:             return vec![];
1359:         }
1360: 
1361:         if let ChatEventResult::AuthRequired = result {
1362:             self.chats[chat_idx].push(DisplayMessage::new(
1363:                 DisplayRole::Error,
1364:                 AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1365:             ));
1366:             if chat_idx != 0 {
1367:                 self.main_chat().push(DisplayMessage::new(
1368:                     DisplayRole::Error,
1369:                     AUTH_EXPIRED_MSG.into(),
1370:                 ));
1371:             }
1372:             self.pending_input = PendingInput::AuthRetry { subagent_id };
1373:             return vec![];
1374:         }
1375: 
1376:         if chat_idx == 0 {
1377:             match result {
1378:                 ChatEventResult::Done => {
1379:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1380:                     self.save_session();
1381:                     self.chat_index.clear();
1382:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1383:                     self.status = Status::Idle;
1384:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1385:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnEnd", serde_json::json!({}));
1386:                     }
1387:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1388:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Success;
1389:                     }
1390:                     if self.state.session.title == "New session" {
1391:                         return self.start_rename();
1392:                     }
1393:                 }
1394:                 ChatEventResult::Error(message) => {
1395:                     self.status = Status::error(message.clone());
1396:                     self.status_bar.clear_flash();
1397:                     self.save_session();
1398:                     self.queue.clear();
1399:                     self.subagent_answers.clear();
1400:                     self.finish_subagents(DisplayRole::Error, ERROR_TEXT);
1401:                     for chat in &mut self.chats {
1402:                         chat.fail_in_progress_with_message(message.clone());
1403:                     }
1404:                     if let Some(ref handle) = self.lua_event_handle {
1405:                         handle.fire_autocmd("TurnError", serde_json::json!({ "message": message }));
1406:                     }
1407:                     if self.exit_on_done {
1408:                         self.exit_request = ExitRequest::Error;
1409:                     }
1410:                 }
1411:                 ChatEventResult::AuthRequired
1412:                 | ChatEventResult::PermissionRequest { .. }
1413:                 | ChatEventResult::QueueItemConsumed { .. } => unreachable!(),
1414:                 ChatEventResult::Continue => {}
1415:             }
1416:         }
1417:         vec![]
1418:     }

1420:     fn resolve_or_create_chat(&mut self, subagent: &SubagentInfo) -> usize {
1421:         let id = &subagent.parent_tool_use_id;
1422:         if let Some(&idx) = self.chat_index.get(id.as_str()) {
1423:             return idx;
1424:         }
1425:         let idx = self.chats.len();
1426:         self.chat_index.insert(id.clone(), idx);
1427:         if let Some(ref tx) = subagent.answer_tx {
1428:             self.subagent_answers.insert(id.clone(), tx.clone());
1429:         }
1430:         self.chats[0].update_tool_summary(id, &subagent.name);
1431:         if let Some(ref model) = subagent.model {
1432:             self.chats[0].update_tool_model(id, model);
1433:         }
1434:         let mut chat = Chat::new(subagent.name.clone(), self.ui_config);
1435:         chat.set_restore_channel(self.lua_event_handle.clone(), self.restore_event_tx.clone());
1436:         chat.model_id = subagent.model.clone();
1437:         if let Some(ref prompt) = subagent.prompt {
1438:             chat.push_user_message(prompt);
1439:         }
1440:         self.chats.push(chat);
1441:         idx
1442:     }

1444:     fn execute_command(&mut self, cmd: ParsedCommand) -> Vec<Action> {
1445:         self.input_box.discard();
1446:         match cmd.name.as_str() {
1447:             "/tasks" => {
1448:                 self.open_tasks();
1449:                 vec![]
1450:             }
1451:             "/compact" => {
1452:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1453:                     self.queue_compact();
1454:                     return vec![];
1455:                 }
1456:                 self.status = Status::Streaming;
1457:                 vec![Action::Compact]
1458:             }
1459:             "/checkpoint" => {
1460:                 if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1461:                     self.queue_checkpoint();
1462:                     return vec![];
1463:                 }
1464:                 self.status = Status::Streaming;
1465:                 vec![Action::Checkpoint]
1466:             }
1467:             "/help" => {
1468:                 self.help_modal.toggle();
1469:                 vec![]
1470:             }
1471:             "/plugins" => {
1472:                 self.plugins_modal.open(&self.lua_event_handle);
1473:                 vec![]
1474:             }
1475:             "/skills" => {
1476:                 self.skills_modal.open(std::path::PathBuf::from(&self.state.session.cwd));
1477:                 vec![]
1478:             }
1479:             "/export" => {
1480:                 self.export_picker.open(std::path::Path::new(&self.state.session.cwd));
1481:                 vec![]
1482:             }
1483:             "/usage" => {
1484:                 self.usage_modal.toggle();
1485:                 if self.usage_modal.is_open() {
1486:                     vec![Action::RefreshUsage]
1487:                 } else {
1488:                     vec![]
1489:                 }
1490:             }
1491:             "/btw" => {
1492:                 let question = cmd.args.trim().to_string();
1493:                 if question.is_empty() {
1494:                     self.flash("Usage: /btw <question>".into());
1495:                     vec![]
1496:                 } else {
1497:                     vec![Action::Btw(question)]
1498:                 }
1499:             }
1500:             "/new" => self.reset_session(),
1501:             "/queue" => {
1502:                 self.queue.set_focus();
1503:                 vec![]
1504:             }
1505:             "/sessions" => self.open_session_picker(),
1506:             "/settings" => {
1507:                 let settings = UserSettings::load();
1508:                 self.settings_picker.open(&settings);
1509:                 vec![]
1510:             }
1511:             "/model" => {
1512:                 self.model_picker.open(&self.state.model.spec());
1513:                 vec![Action::RefreshModels]
1514:             }
1515:             "/theme" => {
1516:                 self.theme_picker.open();
1517:                 vec![]
1518:             }
1519:             "/goto" => {
1520:                 if cmd.args.trim().is_empty() {
1521:                     self.open_goto_picker()
1522:                 } else {
1523:                     self.goto_turn(cmd.args.trim())
1524:                 }
1525:             }
1526:             "/mcp" => {
1527:                 self.mcp_picker.open();
1528:                 vec![]
1529:             }
1530:             "/login" => {
1531:                 self.login_picker.open(self.storage.clone());
1532:                 vec![]
1533:             }
1534:             "/cd" => self.cmd_cd(&cmd.args),
1535:             "/yolo" => {
1536:                 let enabled = self.permissions.toggle_yolo();
1537:                 let msg = if enabled {
1538:                     "YOLO mode enabled"
1539:                 } else {
1540:                     "YOLO mode disabled"
1541:                 };
1542:                 self.flash(msg.into());
1543:                 vec![]
1544:             }
1545:             "/thinking" => {
1546:                 if !self.state.model.supports_thinking() {
1547:                     self.flash("Thinking requires a model that supports it".into());
1548:                     return vec![];
1549:                 }
1550:                 match ThinkingConfig::parse(cmd.args.trim(), self.state.thinking) {
1551:                     Ok(thinking) => {
1552:                         self.state.thinking = thinking;
1553:                         self.flash(format!("Thinking: {thinking}"));
1554:                     }
1555:                     Err(msg) => self.flash(msg.into()),
1556:                 }
1557:                 vec![]
1558:             }
1559:             "/fast" => {
1560:                 if !self.state.model.supports_fast() {
1561:                     self.flash(FAST_UNSUPPORTED_MSG.into());
1562:                     return vec![];
1563:                 }
1564:                 self.state.fast = !self.state.fast;
1565:                 self.flash(
1566:                     if self.state.fast {
1567:                         FAST_ON_MSG
1568:                     } else {
1569:                         FAST_OFF_MSG
1570:                     }
1571:                     .into(),
1572:                 );
1573:                 vec![]
1574:             }
1575:             "/workflow" => {
1576:                 self.state.workflow = !self.state.workflow;
1577:                 self.flash(
1578:                     if self.state.workflow {
1579:                         WORKFLOW_ON_MSG
1580:                     } else {
1581:                         WORKFLOW_OFF_MSG
1582:                     }
1583:                     .into(),
1584:                 );
1585:                 vec![]
1586:             }
1587:             "/verbose" => {
1588:                 self.verbose = !self.verbose;
1589:                 self.flash(
1590:                     if self.verbose {
1591:                         "Verbose mode on"
1592:                     } else {
1593:                         "Verbose mode off"
1594:                     }
1595:                     .into(),
1596:                 );
1597:                 vec![]
1598:             }
1599:             "/system_prompt" => {
1600:                 vec![Action::EditSystemPrompt]
1601:             }
1602:             "/logs" => {
1603:                 vec![Action::RunLogsCommand]
1604:             }
1605:             "/exit" | "/q" => self.quit(),
1606:             "/reload" | "/reload_config" => {
1607:                 self.reload_config();
1608:                 vec![]
1609:             }
1610:             "/rename" => self.start_rename(),
1611:             name if name.starts_with("/project:") || name.starts_with("/user:") => {
1612:                 self.execute_custom_command(name, &cmd.args)
1613:             }
1614:             name if self.command_palette.find_mcp_prompt(name).is_some() => {
1615:                 self.execute_mcp_prompt(name, &cmd.args)
1616:             }
1617:             name if self.command_palette.find_lua_command(name).is_some() => {
1618:                 self.run_lua_command(name, cmd.args);
1619:                 vec![]
1620:             }
1621:             _ => vec![],
1622:         }
1623:     }

1625:     fn run_lua_command(&self, name: &str, args: String) {
1626:         let Some(lua_cmd) = self.command_palette.find_lua_command(name) else {
1627:             return;
1628:         };
1629:         let Some(handle) = &self.lua_event_handle else {
1630:             return;
1631:         };
1632:         handle.run_command(Arc::clone(&lua_cmd.plugin), Arc::clone(&lua_cmd.name), args);
1633:     }

1635:     fn execute_mcp_prompt(&mut self, name: &str, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1636:         let prompt = self.command_palette.find_mcp_prompt(name).unwrap().clone();
1637: 
1638:         let arguments = Self::parse_prompt_args(&prompt, args);
1639:         let missing: Vec<_> = prompt
1640:             .arguments
1641:             .iter()
1642:             .filter(|a| a.required && !arguments.contains_key(&a.name))
1643:             .map(|a| format!("<{}>", a.name))
1644:             .collect();
1645:         if !missing.is_empty() {
1646:             self.flash(format!("Usage: {} {}", name, missing.join(" ")));
1647:             return vec![];
1648:         }
1649: 
1650:         let prompt_ref = maki_agent::McpPromptRef {
1651:             qualified_name: prompt.qualified_name.clone(),
1652:             arguments,
1653:         };
1654:         let display_text = if args.trim().is_empty() {
1655:             name.to_string()
1656:         } else {
1657:             format!("{name} {args}")
1658:         };
1659:         let mut input = self.build_agent_input(&QueuedMessage {
1660:             text: display_text.clone(),
1661:             images: Vec::new(),
1662:         });
1663:         input.prompt = Some(Box::new(prompt_ref));
1664: 
1665:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1666:             self.flash("Agent is busy, try again later".into());
1667:             vec![]
1668:         } else {
1669:             self.run_id += 1;
1670:             self.status = Status::Streaming;
1671:             self.turn_start = Some(Instant::now());
1672:             self.main_chat().show_user_message(display_text);
1673:             vec![Action::SendMessage(Box::new(input))]
1674:         }
1675:     }
1676: 
1677:     fn parse_prompt_args(prompt: &McpPromptInfo, args: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {
1678:         let mut result = HashMap::new();
1679:         let mut remaining = args.trim();
1680:         if remaining.is_empty() || prompt.arguments.is_empty() {
1681:             return result;
1682:         }
1683:         let last_idx = prompt.arguments.len() - 1;
1684:         for (i, arg) in prompt.arguments.iter().enumerate() {
1685:             if remaining.is_empty() {
1686:                 break;
1687:             }
1688:             if i == last_idx {
1689:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1690:             } else if let Some((word, rest)) = remaining.split_once(char::is_whitespace) {
1691:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), word.to_string());
1692:                 remaining = rest.trim_start();
1693:             } else {
1694:                 result.insert(arg.name.clone(), remaining.to_string());
1695:                 break;
1696:             }
1697:         }
1698:         result
1699:     }

1701:     fn execute_custom_command(&mut self, name: &str, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1702:         let Some(cmd) = self.command_palette.find_custom_command(name) else {
1703:             self.flash(format!("Unknown command: {name}"));
1704:             return vec![];
1705:         };
1706:         let rendered = cmd.render(args);
1707:         let msg = QueuedMessage {
1708:             text: rendered,
1709:             images: Vec::new(),
1710:         };
1711:         if self.status == Status::Streaming {
1712:             self.queue_and_notify(msg);
1713:             vec![]
1714:         } else {
1715:             self.run_id += 1;
1716:             self.start_from_queue(&msg)
1717:         }
1718:     }

1720:     fn cmd_cd(&mut self, args: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
1721:         let path = if args.is_empty() {
1722:             maki_storage::paths::home().unwrap_or_default()
1723:         } else {
1724:             match args.strip_prefix('~') {
1725:                 Some(rest) => {
1726:                     let home = maki_storage::paths::home().unwrap_or_default();
1727:                     if rest.is_empty() {
1728:                         home
1729:                     } else {
1730:                         home.join(rest.trim_start_matches('/'))
1731:                     }
1732:                 }
1733:                 None => PathBuf::from(args),
1734:             }
1735:         };
1736:         match std::env::set_current_dir(&path) {
1737:             Ok(()) => {
1738:                 if let Ok(canonical) = std::env::current_dir() {
1739:                     self.state.session.cwd = canonical.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
1740:                 }
1741:                 self.status_bar.refresh_cwd();
1742:                 self.flash(format!("cd {}", path.display()))
1743:             }
1744:             Err(e) => self.flash(format!("cd: {e}")),
1745:         }
1746:         vec![]
1747:     }

1810:         !self.image_paste_rx.is_empty()
1811:             || self.btw_modal.is_animating()
1812:             || self.session_picker.is_loading()
1813:             || self.file_picker.is_loading()

1815:             || self
1816:                 .selection_state
1817:                 .as_ref()
1818:                 .is_some_and(|s| s.is_edge_scrolling())

1836:     fn route_text_paste(&mut self, text: &str) {
1837:         if self.plan_form_active() {
1838:             return;
1839:         }
1840:         if self.permission_prompt.handle_paste(text) {
1841:             return;
1842:         }
1843:         if self.float_mgr.handle_paste(text) {
1844:             return;
1845:         }
1846:         if self.search_modal.is_open() {
1847:             self.search_modal.handle_paste(text);
1848:             let chat = &mut self.chats[self.active_chat];
1849:             let texts = chat.segment_search_texts();
1850:             self.search_modal.update_matches(&texts);
1851:             sync_search_highlight(&self.search_modal, chat);
1852:             return;
1853:         }
1854:         macro_rules! try_picker {
1855:             ($picker:expr) => {
1856:                 if $picker.handle_paste(text) {
1857:                     return;
1858:                 }
1859:             };
1860:         }
1861:         try_picker!(self.file_picker);
1862:         try_picker!(self.task_picker);
1863:         try_picker!(self.session_picker);
1864:         try_picker!(self.rewind_picker);
1865:         try_picker!(self.goto_picker);
1866:         try_picker!(self.theme_picker);
1867:         try_picker!(self.model_picker);
1868:         try_picker!(self.mcp_picker);
1869:         try_picker!(self.login_picker);
1870:         if !self.is_main_chat() {
1871:             return;
1872:         }
1873:         if let InputAction::PaletteSync(val) = self.input_box.handle_paste(text) {
1874:             self.command_palette.sync(&val);
1875:         }
1876:     }
1877: 
1878:     fn handle_plan_form_action(&mut self, action: PlanFormAction) -> Vec<Action> {
1879:         match action {
1880:             PlanFormAction::Consumed | PlanFormAction::Passthrough => vec![],
1881:             PlanFormAction::Hide => {
1882:                 self.plan_form.hide();
1883:                 vec![]
1884:             }
1885:             PlanFormAction::OpenEditor => match self.state.plan.path() {
1886:                 Some(p) => vec![Action::OpenEditor(p.to_path_buf())],
1887:                 None => {
1888:                     self.flash(FLASH_NO_PLAN.into());
1889:                     vec![]
1890:                 }
1891:             },
1892:             PlanFormAction::Implement => self.implement_plan(false),
1893:             PlanFormAction::ClearAndImplement => self.implement_plan(true),
1894:         }
1895:     }
1896: 
1897:     fn implement_plan(&mut self, clear_context: bool) -> Vec<Action> {
1898:         let parallel = self.plan_form.parallel();
1899:         self.plan_form.reset();
1900:         let plan_snapshot = match std::mem::take(&mut self.state.plan) {
1901:             PlanState::Ready(p) => Some((
1902:                 std::fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap_or_default(),
1903:                 p.display().to_string(),
1904:             )),
1905:             _ => None,
1906:         };
1907: 
1908:         self.state.mode = Mode::Build;
1909: 
1910:         let mut actions = if clear_context {
1911:             self.reset_session()
1912:         } else {
1913:             vec![]
1914:         };
1915: 
1916:         let text = if let Some((content, path_str)) = plan_snapshot {
1917:             let text = if parallel {
1918:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`. {IMPLEMENT_PARALLEL_HINT}")
1919:             } else {
1920:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`.")
1921:             };
1922:             self.main_chat()
1923:                 .push(DisplayMessage::plan(content, path_str));
1924:             text
1925:         } else {
1926:             format!("{}.", IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX)
1927:         };
1928:         self.run_id += 1;
1929:         let msg = QueuedMessage {
1930:             text,
1931:             images: vec![],
1932:         };
1933:         actions.extend(self.start_from_queue(&msg));
1934:         actions
1935:     }
1936: }

1938: fn sync_search_highlight(modal: &SearchModal, chat: &mut Chat) {
1939:     let idx = modal.current_segment_index();
1940:     if let Some(i) = idx {
1941:         chat.scroll_to_segment(i);
1942:     }
1943:     chat.set_highlight_segment(idx);
1944: }

1946: fn format_with_images(text: &str, image_count: usize) -> String {
1947:     match image_count {
1948:         0 => text.to_string(),
1949:         1 => format!("{text} [1 image]"),
1950:         n => format!("{text} [{n} images]"),
1951:     }
1952: }

95: pub(crate) struct ModalScroll {
96:     offset: u16,
97:     max_offset: u16,
98:     viewport_h: u16,
99:     auto_scroll: bool,
100: }
101: 
102: impl ModalScroll {
103:     pub fn new() -> Self {
104:         Self {
105:             offset: 0,
106:             max_offset: 0,
107:             viewport_h: 0,
108:             auto_scroll: true,
109:         }
110:     }
111: 
112:     pub fn new_top() -> Self {
113:         Self {
114:             auto_scroll: false,
115:             ..Self::new()
116:         }
117:     }
118: 
119:     pub fn reset(&mut self) {
120:         let auto_scroll = self.auto_scroll;
121:         *self = Self::new();
122:         self.auto_scroll = auto_scroll;
123:     }
124: 
125:     pub fn offset(&self) -> u16 {
126:         self.offset
127:     }
128: 
129:     pub fn update_dimensions(&mut self, total: u16, viewport_h: u16) {
130:         self.viewport_h = viewport_h;
131:         self.max_offset = total.saturating_sub(viewport_h);
132:         if self.auto_scroll {
133:             self.offset = self.max_offset;
134:         } else {
135:             self.clamp();
136:             if self.offset >= self.max_offset {
137:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
138:             }
139:         }
140:     }
141: 
142:     pub fn scroll(&mut self, delta: i32) {
143:         self.offset = apply_scroll_delta(self.offset, delta);
144:         self.clamp();
145:         self.auto_scroll = self.offset >= self.max_offset;
146:     }
147: 
148:     pub fn handle_key(&mut self, key_event: KeyEvent) -> bool {
149:         use keybindings::key;
150:         match key_event.code {
151:             KeyCode::Up => self.scroll(1),
152:             KeyCode::Down => self.scroll(-1),
153:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(self.half_page()),
154:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-self.half_page()),
155:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(1),
156:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-1),
157:             _ if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key_event) => {
158:                 self.offset = 0;
159:                 self.auto_scroll = false;
160:             }
161:             _ if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key_event) => {
162:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
163:                 self.offset = self.max_offset;
164:             }
165:             _ => return false,
166:         }
167:         true
168:     }
169: 
170:     fn half_page(&self) -> i32 {
171:         (self.viewport_h / 2).max(1) as i32
172:     }
173: 
174:     fn clamp(&mut self) {
175:         self.offset = self.offset.min(self.max_offset);
176:     }
177: }

242: pub enum Status {
243:     Idle,
244:     Streaming,
245:     Error { message: String, since: Instant },
246: }
247: 
248: impl Status {
249:     pub fn error(message: String) -> Self {
250:         Self::Error {
251:             message,
252:             since: Instant::now(),
253:         }
254:     }
255: 
256:     pub fn is_error_expired(&self) -> bool {
257:         matches!(self, Self::Error { since, .. } if since.elapsed() >= ERROR_DISPLAY)
258:     }
259: }

261: impl PartialEq for Status {
262:     fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
263:         matches!(
264:             (self, other),
265:             (Self::Idle, Self::Idle)
266:                 | (Self::Streaming, Self::Streaming)
267:                 | (Self::Error { .. }, Self::Error { .. })
268:         )
269:     }

470:     fn apply_scroll_delta_cases(offset: u16, delta: i32, expected: u16) {

152:             KeyCode::Up => self.scroll(1),
153:             KeyCode::Down => self.scroll(-1),
154:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(self.half_page()),
155:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-self.half_page()),
156:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(1),
157:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-1),
158:             _ if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key_event) => {
159:                 self.offset = 0;
160:                 self.auto_scroll = false;
161:             }
162:             _ if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key_event) => {
163:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
164:                 self.offset = self.max_offset;
165:             }
166:             _ => return false,
167:         }
168:         true
169:     }
170: 
171:     fn half_page(&self) -> i32 {
172:         (self.viewport_h / 2).max(1) as i32
173:     }
174: 
175:     fn clamp(&mut self) {
176:         self.offset = self.offset.min(self.max_offset);
177:     }
178: }

224: const ERROR_DISPLAY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);

226: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
227: pub enum ExitRequest {
228:     #[default]
229:     None,
230:     Success,
231:     Error,
232: }
233: 
234: impl ExitRequest {
235:     pub fn code(&self) -> i32 {
236:         match self {
237:             Self::None | Self::Success => 0,
238:             Self::Error => 1,
239:         }
240:     }
241: }
242: 
243: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
244: pub enum Status {
245:     Idle,
246:     Streaming,
247:     Error { message: String, since: Instant },
248: }
249: 
250: impl Status {
251:     pub fn error(message: String) -> Self {
252:         Self::Error {
253:             message,
254:             since: Instant::now(),
255:         }
256:     }
257: 
258:     pub fn is_error_expired(&self) -> bool {
259:         matches!(self, Self::Error { since, .. } if since.elapsed() >= ERROR_DISPLAY)
260:     }
261: }
262: 
263: impl PartialEq for Status {
264:     fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
265:         matches!(
266:             (self, other),
267:             (Self::Idle, Self::Idle)
268:                 | (Self::Streaming, Self::Streaming)
269:                 | (Self::Error { .. }, Self::Error { .. })
270:         )
271:     }
272: }

75: struct BackgroundModels {
76:     available: Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>>,
77:     warn_rx: flume::Receiver<String>,
78:     warn_tx: flume::Sender<String>,
79:     task: smol::Task<()>,
80: }
81: 
82: fn merge_batch(
83:     available: &Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>>,
84:     batch: maki_providers::provider::ModelBatch,
85:     warn_tx: &flume::Sender<String>,
86: ) {
87:     for w in batch.warnings {
88:         let _ = warn_tx.try_send(w);
89:     }
90:     if batch.models.is_empty() {
91:         return;
92:     }
93:     let mut merged = available.load().as_deref().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
94:     for spec in &batch.models {
95:         if !merged.contains(spec) {
96:             merged.push(spec.clone());
97:         }
98:     }
99:     available.store(Some(Arc::new(merged)));
100: }
101: 
102: fn spawn_model_fetch(model_slot: &Arc<ArcSwap<ModelSlot>>, timeouts: Timeouts) -> BackgroundModels {
103:     let available: Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>> = Arc::new(ArcSwapOption::empty());
104:     let bg = Arc::clone(&available);
105:     let (warn_tx, warn_rx) = flume::unbounded::<String>();
106:     let warn_tx_bg = warn_tx.clone();
107:     let model_slot = Arc::clone(model_slot);
108:     let task = smol::spawn(async move {
109:         let warn_tx = warn_tx_bg;
110:         let done = Box::new(move || {
111:             let spec = model_slot.load().model.spec();
112:             let mut resolved = match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
113:                 Ok(m) => m,
114:                 Err(e) => {
115:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to resolve model after discovery");
116:                     return;
117:                 }
118:             };
119:             let provider = match from_model(&mut resolved, timeouts) {
120:                 Ok(p) => p,
121:                 Err(e) => {
122:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to create provider after discovery");
123:                     return;
124:                 }
125:             };
126:             model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
127:                 model: resolved,
128:                 provider: Arc::from(provider),
129:             }));
130:         });
131:         fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&bg, batch, &warn_tx), Some(done)).await;
132:     });
133:     BackgroundModels {
134:         available,
135:         warn_rx,
136:         warn_tx,
137:         task,
138:     }
139: }

141: fn restore_session(app: &mut App, handles: &AgentHandles) {
142:     app.permissions
143:         .load_session_rules(crate::app::session_state::stored_to_rules(
144:             &app.state.session.meta.session_rules,
145:         ));
146:     *handles
147:         .tool_outputs
148:         .lock()
149:         .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = app.state.session.tool_outputs.clone();
150:     app.restore_display();
151:     for w in app.state.warnings.drain(..) {
152:         app.status_bar.flash(w);
153:     }
154: }
