156: impl<'t> EventLoop<'t> {
157:     pub(crate) fn new(
158:         terminal: &'t mut ratatui::DefaultTerminal,
159:         params: EventLoopParams,
160:     ) -> Result<Self> {
161:         let EventLoopParams {
162:             mut model,
163:             needs_login,
164:             commands,
165:             session,
166:             storage,
167:             config,
168:             ui_config,
169:             input_history_size,
170:             permissions,
171:             timeouts,
172:             exit_on_done,
173:             lua_command_reader,
174:             keymap_reader,
175:             hint_reader,
176:             ui_action_rx,
177:             lua_event_handle,
178:             buf_click,
179:         } = params;
180: 
181:         std::thread::spawn(crate::highlight::warmup);
182:         crate::update::spawn_check();
183: 
184:         let storage_writer = Arc::new(StorageWriter::new(storage.clone()));
185:         let (shell_tx, shell_rx) = flume::unbounded::<ShellEvent>();
186: 
187:         let resumed = !session.messages.is_empty();
188:         let initial_history = session.messages.clone();
189:         let cwd = std::env::current_dir().unwrap_or_else(|_| ".".into());
190: 
191:         let provider: Arc<dyn Provider> = if needs_login {
192:             Arc::from(maki_providers::provider::from_model_fallback(
193:                 &mut model, timeouts,
194:             ))
195:         } else {
196:             Arc::from(from_model(&mut model, timeouts).context("create provider")?)
197:         };
198:         let model_slot = Arc::new(ArcSwap::from_pointee(ModelSlot {
199:             model: model.clone(),
200:             provider,
201:         }));
202:         let bg = spawn_model_fetch(&model_slot, timeouts);
203:         let handles = AgentHandles::spawn(
204:             &model_slot,
205:             initial_history,
206:             config.clone(),
207:             ui_config.tool_output_lines,
208:             &permissions,
209:             cwd,
210:             Some(session.id.clone()),
211:             Some(session.created_at),
212:             timeouts,
213:             lua_event_handle.clone(),
214:         );
215: 
216:         let custom_commands: Arc<[CustomCommand]> = Arc::from(commands);
217:         let mut app = App::new(
218:             &model,
219:             session,
220:             storage,
221:             bg.available.clone(),
222:             handles.mcp_reader(),
223:             handles.mcp_config_errors.clone(),
224:             lua_command_reader,
225:             keymap_reader,
226:             hint_reader,
227:             Arc::clone(&storage_writer),
228:             ui_config,
229:             input_history_size,
230:             Arc::clone(&permissions),
231:             custom_commands,
232:         );
233:         app.exit_on_done = exit_on_done;
234:         app.buf_click = buf_click;
235:         app.lua_event_handle = lua_event_handle;
236: 
237:         if needs_login {
238:             app.login_picker.open(app.storage.clone());
239:         }
240: 
241:         handles.apply_to_app(&mut app);
242: 
243:         if !handles.mcp_config_errors.is_empty() {
244:             app.flash(format!("MCP config error: {}", handles.mcp_config_errors));
245:         }
246: 
247:         if resumed {
248:             restore_session(&mut app, &handles);
249:         }
250: 
251:         Ok(Self {
252:             terminal,
253:             app,
254:             handles,
255:             model_slot,
256:             config,
257:             permissions,
258:             shell_tx,
259:             shell_rx,
260:             warn_rx: bg.warn_rx,
261:             warn_tx: bg.warn_tx,
262:             available_models: bg.available,
263:             storage_writer,
264:             timeouts,
265:             ui_action_rx,
266:             _model_fetch_task: bg.task,
267:         })
268:     }

270:     pub(crate) fn run(mut self, initial_prompt: Option<String>) -> Result<(Option<String>, i32)> {
271:         if let Some(prompt) = initial_prompt {
272:             let sub = Submission {
273:                 text: prompt,
274:                 images: Vec::new(),
275:             };
276:             let actions = self.app.handle_submit(sub);
277:             self.dispatch(actions);
278:         }
279:         loop {
280:             self.tick();
281:             let had_agent_msg = self.drain_channels();
282:             self.terminal.draw(|f| self.app.view(f))?;
283: 
284:             if self.app.exit_request != ExitRequest::None {
285:                 return Ok(self.shutdown());
286:             }
287: 
288:             self.poll_and_handle_input(had_agent_msg)?;
289:         }
290:     }
291: 
292:     fn tick(&mut self) {
293:         self.app.tick_edge_scroll();
294:         self.app.tick_error_expiry();
295:         self.app.poll_image_paste();
296:         self.app.btw_modal.poll();
297:         self.app.status_bar.poll_branch_update();
298:         self.app.mcp_picker.refresh();
299:         self.app.float_mgr.tick();
300:     }
301: 
302:     fn drain_channels(&mut self) -> bool {
303:         while let Ok(event) = self.shell_rx.try_recv() {
304:             self.app.handle_shell_event(event);
305:         }
306: 
307:         let mut had_agent_msg = false;
308:         loop {
309:             match self.handles.agent_rx.try_recv() {
310:                 Ok(envelope) => {
311:                     had_agent_msg = true;
312:                     let actions = self.app.update(Msg::Agent(Box::new(envelope)));
313:                     self.dispatch(actions);
314:                 }
315:                 Err(flume::TryRecvError::Disconnected) if self.app.status == Status::Streaming => {
316:                     self.app.status = Status::error("agent stopped unexpectedly".into());
317:                     break;
318:                 }
319:                 Err(_) => break,
320:             }
321:         }
322: 
323:         while let Ok(warning) = self.warn_rx.try_recv() {
324:             self.app.flash(warning);
325:         }
326: 
327:         let slot_model = self.model_slot.load();
328:         if slot_model.model.context_window != self.app.state.model.context_window {
329:             self.app.update_model(&slot_model.model);
330:         }
331: 
332:         if let Some(rx) = &self.ui_action_rx {
333:             while let Ok(action) = rx.try_recv() {
334:                 match action {
335:                     UiAction::Flash(msg) => {
336:                         self.app.flash(msg);
337:                     }
338:                     UiAction::OpenEditor { path, reply_tx } => {
339:                         let code = match crate::terminal::open_in_editor(&path, self.terminal) {
340:                             Ok(code) => code,
341:                             Err(e) => {
342:                                 self.app.flash(e);
343:                                 -1
344:                             }
345:                         };
346:                         let _ = reply_tx.send(code);
347:                     }
348:                     UiAction::OpenWin {

350:                         config,

358:                         if focus {

362:                     }
363:                 }

372:     fn poll_and_handle_input(&mut self, had_agent_msg: bool) -> Result<()> {
373:         let has_pending_ui_action = self.ui_action_rx.as_ref().is_some_and(|rx| !rx.is_empty());
374:         let poll_duration = if had_agent_msg || has_pending_ui_action {
375:             Duration::ZERO
376:         } else if self.app.is_animating() {
377:             Duration::from_millis(ANIMATION_INTERVAL_MS)
378:         } else {
379:             Duration::from_millis(IDLE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
380:         };
381: 
382:         if !event::poll(poll_duration)? {
383:             return Ok(());
384:         }
385: 
386:         if let Some(msg) = self.translate_input()? {
387:             let actions = self.app.update(msg);
388:             self.dispatch(actions);
389:         }
390:         Ok(())
391:     }
392: 
393:     fn translate_input(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Msg>> {
394:         let raw = event::read()?;
395:         match raw {
396:             Event::Key(key) if key.kind == KeyEventKind::Press => Ok(Some(Msg::Key(key))),
397:             Event::Key(_) => Ok(None),
398:             Event::Paste(text) => Ok(Some(Msg::Paste(text))),
399:             Event::Mouse(mouse) => Ok(self.translate_mouse(mouse)),
400:             _ => Ok(None),
401:         }
402:     }
403: 
404:     fn translate_mouse(&mut self, mouse: CtMouseEvent) -> Option<Msg> {
405:         match mouse.kind {
406:             MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
407:                 let (scroll, extra) = aggregate_scroll(
408:                     mouse.column,
409:                     mouse.row,
410:                     scroll_delta(mouse.kind, self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines),
411:                     self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines,
412:                 );
413:                 if let Some(extra) = extra {
414:                     let actions = self.app.update(scroll);
415:                     self.dispatch(actions);
416:                     Some(extra)
417:                 } else {
418:                     Some(scroll)
419:                 }
420:             }
421:             MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left) => {
422:                 let (drag, extra) = coalesce_drag(mouse);
423:                 let actions = self.app.update(Msg::Mouse(drag));
424:                 self.dispatch(actions);
425:                 extra
426:             }
427:             _ => Some(Msg::Mouse(mouse)),
428:         }
429:     }
430: 
431:     fn dispatch(&mut self, actions: Vec<Action>) {
432:         for action in actions {
433:             self.handle_action(action);
434:         }
435:     }
436: 
437:     fn respawn_agent(&mut self, history: Vec<Message>) {
438:         let lua_handle = self.app.lua_event_handle.clone();
439:         self.handles.respawn(
440:             history,
441:             &self.model_slot,
442:             self.config.clone(),
443:             self.app.ui_config.tool_output_lines,
444:             &self.permissions,
445:             &mut self.app,
446:             lua_handle,
447:         );
448:     }

450:     fn handle_action(&mut self, action: Action) {
451:         match action {
452:             Action::SendMessage(input) => {
453:                 let mut input = *input;
454:                 input.preamble = self.app.shell.drain_results();
455:                 let run_id = self.app.run_id;
456:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Message {
457:                     text: input.message.clone(),
458:                     image_count: input.images.len(),
459:                     input,
460:                     run_id,
461:                     displayed: true,
462:                 });
463:             }
464:             Action::CancelAgent { run_id } => {
465:                 let _ = self
466:                     .handles
467:                     .cmd_tx
468:                     .try_send(AgentCommand::Cancel { run_id });
469:             }
470:             Action::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id } => {
471:                 let _ = self
472:                     .handles
473:                     .cmd_tx
474:                     .try_send(AgentCommand::CancelSubagent { tool_use_id });
475:             }
476:             Action::NewSession => {
477:                 self.respawn_agent(Vec::new());
478:             }
479:             Action::LoadSession(loaded) => {
480:                 let loaded = *loaded;
481:                 if loaded.model_spec != self.model_slot.load().model.spec()
482:                     && let Ok(mut new_model) = Model::from_spec(&loaded.model_spec)
483:                     && let Ok(new_provider) = from_model(&mut new_model, self.timeouts)
484:                 {
485:                     self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
486:                         model: new_model,
487:                         provider: Arc::from(new_provider),
488:                     }));
489:                 }
490:                 self.respawn_agent(loaded.messages);
491:                 *self
492:                     .handles
493:                     .tool_outputs
494:                     .lock()
495:                     .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = loaded.tool_outputs;
496:             }
497:             Action::ChangeModel(spec) => self.change_model(spec),
498:             Action::RefreshProvider { slug } => self.refresh_provider(slug),
499:             Action::AssignTier(spec, tier) => {
500:                 maki_providers::model_registry::set_and_persist(spec, tier, &self.app.storage);
501:             }
502:             Action::UnassignTier(spec, tier) => {
503:                 maki_providers::model_registry::unset_and_persist(&spec, tier, &self.app.storage);
504:             }
505:             Action::Compact(target) => {
506:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Compact {
507:                     run_id: self.app.run_id,
508:                     target_tokens: target,
509:                 });
510:             }
511:             Action::Checkpoint => {
512:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Checkpoint {
513:                     run_id: self.app.run_id,
514:                 });
515:             }
516:             Action::ToggleMcp(server_name, enabled) => {
517:                 self.handles.send_mcp(McpCommand::Toggle {
518:                     server: server_name,
519:                     enabled,
520:                 });
521:             }
522:             Action::ShellCommand {
523:                 id,
524:                 command,
525:                 visible,
526:             } => {
527:                 let (trigger, cancel) = CancelToken::new();
528:                 self.app.shell.add_trigger(trigger);
529:                 spawn_shell(
530:                     command,
531:                     id,
532:                     visible,
533:                     self.shell_tx.clone(),
534:                     cancel,
535:                     self.config.clone(),
536:                 );
537:             }
538:             Action::OpenEditor(path) => {
539:                 if let Err(e) = terminal::open_in_editor(&path, self.terminal) {
540:                     self.app.flash(e);
541:                 }
542:             }
543:             Action::EditInputInEditor => {
544:                 let current_text = self.app.input_box.buffer.value();
545:                 match terminal::edit_temp_content(&current_text, self.terminal) {
546:                     Ok(edited) => self.app.input_box.set_input(edited),
547:                     Err(e) => self.app.flash(e),
548:                 }
549:             }
550:             Action::EditSystemPrompt => {
551:                 match maki_storage::paths::config_dir() {
552:                     Ok(config_dir) => {
553:                         let path = config_dir.join("system.md");
554:                         if !path.exists()
555:                             && let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&path, maki_agent::prompt::SYSTEM_PROMPT)
556:                         {
557:                             self.app.flash(format!("Failed to create system.md: {e}"));
558:                             return;
559:                         }
560:                         if let Err(e) = terminal::open_in_editor(&path, self.terminal) {
561:                             self.app.flash(e);
562:                         }
563:                     }
564:                     Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Failed to get config directory: {e}")),
565:                 }
566:             }
567:             Action::RunLogsCommand => {
568:                 let settings = crate::components::settings_picker::UserSettings::load();
569:                 let log_path = self.app.storage.path().join("maki.log");
570:                 let log_path_str = log_path.to_string_lossy();
571:                 let cmd_string = match &settings.log_command {
572:                     Some(cmd) if !cmd.trim().is_empty() => cmd.clone(),
573:                     _ => "less +G {}".to_string(),
574:                 };
575:                 let cmd_string = cmd_string
576:                     .replace("<path>", &log_path_str)
577:                     .replace("alog", &log_path_str)
578:                     .replace("{}", &log_path_str);
579: 
580:                 if let Err(e) = terminal::run_view_log_command(&cmd_string, self.terminal) {
581:                     self.app.flash(e);
582:                 }
583:             }
584:             Action::Btw(question) => {
585:                 let slot = self.model_slot.load();
586:                 self.app
587:                     .start_btw(question, Arc::clone(&slot.provider), slot.model.clone());
588:             }
589:             Action::RenameSession(messages) => {
590:                 self.handles.queue.push(QueueItem::Rename {
591:                     messages,
592:                     run_id: self.app.run_id,
593:                 });
594:             }
595:             Action::Suspend => terminal::suspend(self.terminal),
596:             Action::RefreshModels => self.refresh_models(),
597:             Action::Quit => {}
598:         }
599:     }

601:     fn change_model(&mut self, spec: String) {
602:         match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
603:             Ok(mut new_model) => match from_model(&mut new_model, self.timeouts) {
604:                 Ok(new_provider) => {
605:                     self.app.update_model(&new_model);
606:                     self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
607:                         model: new_model,
608:                         provider: Arc::from(new_provider),
609:                     }));
610:                 }
611:                 Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Failed to create provider: {e}")),
612:             },
613:             Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Invalid model: {e}")),
614:         }
615:     }
616: 
617:     fn refresh_models(&self) {
618:         let available = Arc::clone(&self.available_models);
619:         let warn_tx = self.warn_tx.clone();
620:         available.store(None);
621:         smol::spawn(async move {
622:             fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&available, batch, &warn_tx), None).await;
623:         })
624:         .detach();
625:     }
626: 
627:     fn refresh_provider(&mut self, slug: String) {
628:         let current = self.model_slot.load();
629:         let current_model = &current.model;
630: 
631:         if current_model.provider.to_string() == slug {
632:             let mut m = current_model.clone();
633:             if let Ok(provider) = maki_providers::provider::from_model(&mut m, self.timeouts) {
634:                 self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
635:                     model: m,
636:                     provider: Arc::from(provider),
637:                 }));
638:             }
639:         } else if let Some(builtin) = maki_config::providers::builtin_provider(&slug) {
640:             let spec = builtin.default_model.to_string();
641:             self.change_model(spec);
642:         }
643:     }
644: 
645:     fn shutdown(mut self) -> (Option<String>, i32) {
646:         let settings = crate::components::settings_picker::UserSettings::load();
647:         settings.save();
648: 
649:         let exit_code = self.app.exit_request.code();
650:         let session_id = self
651:             .app
652:             .has_content()
653:             .then(|| self.app.state.session.id.clone());
654:         maki_agent::mcp::kill_process_groups(&self.handles.mcp_reader().load().pids);
655:         self.app.cmd_tx = None;
656:         self.app.answer_tx = None;
657:         drop(self.app);
658:         self.handles.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3));
659:         match Arc::try_unwrap(self.storage_writer) {
660:             Ok(writer) => writer.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3)),
661:             Err(_) => {
662:                 warn!("storage writer has outstanding references, skipping graceful shutdown")
663:             }
664:         }
665:         (session_id, exit_code)
666:     }
667: }

669: fn scroll_delta(kind: MouseEventKind, lines: u32) -> i32 {
670:     if kind == MouseEventKind::ScrollUp {
671:         lines as i32
672:     } else {
673:         -(lines as i32)
674:     }
675: }
676: 
677: fn aggregate_scroll(
678:     column: u16,
679:     row: u16,
680:     mut delta: i32,
681:     scroll_lines: u32,
682: ) -> (Msg, Option<Msg>) {
683:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
684:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
685:             match next.kind {
686:                 MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
687:                     delta += scroll_delta(next.kind, scroll_lines);
688:                 }
689:                 _ => return (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, Some(Msg::Mouse(next))),
690:             }
691:         } else {
692:             break;
693:         }
694:     }
695:     (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, None)
696: }
697: 
698: fn coalesce_drag(mut latest: CtMouseEvent) -> (CtMouseEvent, Option<Msg>) {
699:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
700:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
701:             if matches!(next.kind, MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left)) {
702:                 latest = next;
703:             } else {
704:                 return (latest, Some(Msg::Mouse(next)));
705:             }
706:         } else {
707:             break;
708:         }
709:     }
710:     (latest, None)
711: }

73: struct BackgroundModels {
74:     available: Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>>,
75:     warn_rx: flume::Receiver<String>,
76:     warn_tx: flume::Sender<String>,

79: 
80: fn merge_batch(
81:     available: &Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>>,
82:     batch: maki_providers::provider::ModelBatch,
83:     warn_tx: &flume::Sender<String>,
84: ) {
85:     for w in batch.warnings {
86:         let _ = warn_tx.try_send(w);
87:     }
88:     if batch.models.is_empty() {
89:         return;
90:     }
91:     let mut merged = available.load().as_deref().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
92:     for spec in &batch.models {
93:         if !merged.contains(spec) {
94:             merged.push(spec.clone());
95:         }
96:     }
97:     available.store(Some(Arc::new(merged)));
98: }
99: 
100: fn spawn_model_fetch(model_slot: &Arc<ArcSwap<ModelSlot>>, timeouts: Timeouts) -> BackgroundModels {
101:     let available: Arc<ArcSwapOption<Vec<String>>> = Arc::new(ArcSwapOption::empty());
102:     let bg = Arc::clone(&available);
103:     let (warn_tx, warn_rx) = flume::unbounded::<String>();
104:     let warn_tx_bg = warn_tx.clone();
105:     let model_slot = Arc::clone(model_slot);
106:     let task = smol::spawn(async move {
107:         let warn_tx = warn_tx_bg;
108:         let done = Box::new(move || {
109:             let spec = model_slot.load().model.spec();
110:             let mut resolved = match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
111:                 Ok(m) => m,
112:                 Err(e) => {
113:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to resolve model after discovery");
114:                     return;
115:                 }
116:             };
117:             let provider = match from_model(&mut resolved, timeouts) {
118:                 Ok(p) => p,
119:                 Err(e) => {
120:                     warn!(spec = %spec, error = %e, "failed to create provider after discovery");
121:                     return;
122:                 }
123:             };
124:             model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
125:                 model: resolved,
126:                 provider: Arc::from(provider),
127:             }));
128:         });
129:         fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&bg, batch, &warn_tx), Some(done)).await;
130:     });
131:     BackgroundModels {
132:         available,
133:         warn_rx,
134:         warn_tx,
135:         task,
136:     }
137: }

139: fn restore_session(app: &mut App, handles: &AgentHandles) {
140:     app.permissions
141:         .load_session_rules(crate::app::session_state::stored_to_rules(
142:             &app.state.session.meta.session_rules,
143:         ));
144:     *handles
145:         .tool_outputs
146:         .lock()
147:         .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = app.state.session.tool_outputs.clone();
148:     app.restore_display();
149:     for w in app.state.warnings.drain(..) {
150:         app.status_bar.flash(w);
151:     }
152: }

154: impl<'t> EventLoop<'t> {
155:     pub(crate) fn new(
156:         terminal: &'t mut ratatui::DefaultTerminal,
157:         params: EventLoopParams,
158:     ) -> Result<Self> {
159:         let EventLoopParams {
160:             mut model,
161:             needs_login,
162:             commands,
163:             session,
164:             storage,
165:             config,
166:             ui_config,
167:             input_history_size,
168:             permissions,
169:             timeouts,
170:             exit_on_done,
171:             lua_command_reader,
172:             keymap_reader,
173:             hint_reader,
174:             ui_action_rx,
175:             lua_event_handle,
176:         } = params;
177: 
178:         std::thread::spawn(crate::highlight::warmup);
179:         crate::update::spawn_check();
180: 
181:         let storage_writer = Arc::new(StorageWriter::new(storage.clone()));
182:         let (shell_tx, shell_rx) = flume::unbounded::<ShellEvent>();
183: 
184:         let resumed = !session.messages.is_empty();
185:         let initial_history = session.messages.clone();
186:         let cwd = std::env::current_dir().unwrap_or_else(|_| ".".into());
187: 
188:         let provider: Arc<dyn Provider> = if needs_login {
189:             Arc::from(maki_providers::provider::from_model_fallback(
190:                 &mut model, timeouts,
191:             ))
192:         } else {
193:             Arc::from(from_model(&mut model, timeouts).context("create provider")?)
194:         };
195:         let model_slot = Arc::new(ArcSwap::from_pointee(ModelSlot {
196:             model: model.clone(),
197:             provider,
198:         }));
199:         let bg = spawn_model_fetch(&model_slot, timeouts);
200:         let handles = AgentHandles::spawn(
201:             &model_slot,
202:             initial_history,
203:             config.clone(),
204:             ui_config.tool_output_lines,
205:             &permissions,
206:             cwd,
207:             Some(session.id.clone()),
208:             timeouts,
209:             lua_event_handle.clone(),
210:         );
211: 
212:         let custom_commands: Arc<[CustomCommand]> = Arc::from(commands);
213:         let mut app = App::new(
214:             &model,
215:             session,
216:             storage,
217:             bg.available.clone(),
218:             handles.mcp_reader(),
219:             handles.mcp_config_errors.clone(),
220:             lua_command_reader,
221:             keymap_reader,
222:             hint_reader,
223:             Arc::clone(&storage_writer),
224:             ui_config,
225:             input_history_size,
226:             Arc::clone(&permissions),
227:             custom_commands,
228:         );
229:         app.exit_on_done = exit_on_done;
230:         app.lua_event_handle = lua_event_handle;
231: 
232:         if needs_login {
233:             app.login_picker.open(app.storage.clone());
234:         }
235: 
236:         handles.apply_to_app(&mut app);
237: 
238:         if !handles.mcp_config_errors.is_empty() {
239:             app.flash(format!("MCP config error: {}", handles.mcp_config_errors));
240:         }
241: 
242:         if resumed {
243:             restore_session(&mut app, &handles);
244:         }
245: 
246:         Ok(Self {
247:             terminal,
248:             app,
249:             handles,
250:             model_slot,
251:             config,
252:             permissions,
253:             shell_tx,
254:             shell_rx,
255:             warn_rx: bg.warn_rx,
256:             warn_tx: bg.warn_tx,
257:             available_models: bg.available,
258:             storage_writer,
259:             timeouts,
260:             ui_action_rx,
261:             _model_fetch_task: bg.task,
262:         })
263:     }

265:     pub(crate) fn run(mut self, initial_prompt: Option<String>) -> Result<(Option<String>, i32)> {
266:         if let Some(prompt) = initial_prompt {
267:             let sub = Submission {
268:                 text: prompt,
269:                 images: Vec::new(),
270:             };
271:             let actions = self.app.handle_submit(sub);
272:             self.dispatch(actions);
273:         }
274:         loop {
275:             self.tick();
276:             let had_agent_msg = self.drain_channels();
277:             self.terminal.draw(|f| self.app.view(f))?;
278: 
279:             if self.app.exit_request != ExitRequest::None {
280:                 return Ok(self.shutdown());
281:             }
282: 
283:             self.poll_and_handle_input(had_agent_msg)?;
284:         }
285:     }
286: 
287:     fn tick(&mut self) {
288:         self.app.tick_edge_scroll();
289:         self.app.tick_error_expiry();
290:         self.app.poll_image_paste();
291:         self.app.btw_modal.poll();
292:         self.app.status_bar.poll_branch_update();
293:         self.app.mcp_picker.refresh();
294:         self.app.float_mgr.tick();
295:     }
296: 
297:     fn drain_channels(&mut self) -> bool {
298:         while let Ok(event) = self.shell_rx.try_recv() {
299:             self.app.handle_shell_event(event);
300:         }
301: 
302:         let mut had_agent_msg = false;
303:         loop {
304:             match self.handles.agent_rx.try_recv() {
305:                 Ok(envelope) => {
306:                     had_agent_msg = true;
307:                     let actions = self.app.update(Msg::Agent(Box::new(envelope)));
308:                     self.dispatch(actions);
309:                 }
310:                 Err(flume::TryRecvError::Disconnected) if self.app.status == Status::Streaming => {
311:                     self.app.status = Status::error("agent stopped unexpectedly".into());
312:                     break;
313:                 }
314:                 Err(_) => break,
315:             }
316:         }
317: 
318:         while let Ok(warning) = self.warn_rx.try_recv() {
319:             self.app.flash(warning);
320:         }
321: 
322:         let slot_model = self.model_slot.load();
323:         if slot_model.model.context_window != self.app.state.model.context_window {
324:             self.app.update_model(&slot_model.model);
325:         }
326: 
327:         if let Some(rx) = &self.ui_action_rx {
328:             while let Ok(action) = rx.try_recv() {
329:                 match action {
330:                     UiAction::Flash(msg) => {
331:                         self.app.flash(msg);
332:                     }
333:                     UiAction::OpenEditor { path, reply_tx } => {
334:                         let code = match crate::terminal::open_in_editor(&path, self.terminal) {
335:                             Ok(code) => code,
336:                             Err(e) => {
337:                                 self.app.flash(e);
338:                                 -1
339:                             }
340:                         };
341:                         let _ = reply_tx.send(code);
342:                     }
343:                     UiAction::OpenWin {
344:                         buf,
345:                         config,
346:                         focus,
347:                         event_tx,
348:                         cmd_rx,
349:                     } => {
350:                         self.app
351:                             .float_mgr
352:                             .open(buf, config, focus, event_tx, cmd_rx);
353:                         if focus {
354:                             self.app
355:                                 .transition_plan(crate::app::mode::PlanTrigger::InteractivePrompt);
356:                         }
357:                     }
358:                 }
359:             }
360:         }
361: 
362:         had_agent_msg
363:     }
364: 
365:     fn poll_and_handle_input(&mut self, had_agent_msg: bool) -> Result<()> {
366:         let has_pending_ui_action = self.ui_action_rx.as_ref().is_some_and(|rx| !rx.is_empty());
367:         let poll_duration = if had_agent_msg || has_pending_ui_action {
368:             Duration::ZERO
369:         } else if self.app.is_animating() {
370:             Duration::from_millis(ANIMATION_INTERVAL_MS)
371:         } else {
372:             Duration::from_millis(IDLE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
373:         };
374: 
375:         if !event::poll(poll_duration)? {
376:             return Ok(());
377:         }
378: 
379:         if let Some(msg) = self.translate_input()? {
380:             let actions = self.app.update(msg);
381:             self.dispatch(actions);
382:         }
383:         Ok(())
384:     }
385: 
386:     fn translate_input(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Msg>> {
387:         let raw = event::read()?;
388:         match raw {
389:             Event::Key(key) if key.kind == KeyEventKind::Press => Ok(Some(Msg::Key(key))),
390:             Event::Key(_) => Ok(None),
391:             Event::Paste(text) => Ok(Some(Msg::Paste(text))),
392:             Event::Mouse(mouse) => Ok(self.translate_mouse(mouse)),
393:             _ => Ok(None),
394:         }
395:     }
396: 
397:     fn translate_mouse(&mut self, mouse: CtMouseEvent) -> Option<Msg> {
398:         match mouse.kind {
399:             MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
400:                 let (scroll, extra) = aggregate_scroll(
401:                     mouse.column,
402:                     mouse.row,
403:                     scroll_delta(mouse.kind, self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines),
404:                     self.app.ui_config.mouse_scroll_lines,
405:                 );
406:                 if let Some(extra) = extra {
407:                     let actions = self.app.update(scroll);
408:                     self.dispatch(actions);
409:                     Some(extra)
410:                 } else {
411:                     Some(scroll)
412:                 }
413:             }
414:             MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left) => {
415:                 let (drag, extra) = coalesce_drag(mouse);
416:                 let actions = self.app.update(Msg::Mouse(drag));
417:                 self.dispatch(actions);
418:                 extra
419:             }
420:             _ => Some(Msg::Mouse(mouse)),
421:         }
422:     }
423: 
424:     fn dispatch(&mut self, actions: Vec<Action>) {
425:         for action in actions {
426:             self.handle_action(action);
427:         }
428:     }
429: 
430:     fn respawn_agent(&mut self, history: Vec<Message>) {
431:         let lua_handle = self.app.lua_event_handle.clone();
432:         self.handles.respawn(
433:             history,
434:             &self.model_slot,
435:             self.config.clone(),
436:             self.app.ui_config.tool_output_lines,
437:             &self.permissions,
438:             &mut self.app,
439:             lua_handle,
440:         );
441:     }

588:     fn change_model(&mut self, spec: String) {
589:         match Model::from_spec(&spec) {
590:             Ok(mut new_model) => match from_model(&mut new_model, self.timeouts) {
591:                 Ok(new_provider) => {
592:                     self.app.update_model(&new_model);
593:                     self.app.record_recent_model(&spec);
594:                     self.app.usage_slot.store(None);
595:                     self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
596:                         model: new_model,
597:                         provider: Arc::from(new_provider),
598:                     }));
599:                 }
600:                 Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Failed to create provider: {e}")),
601:             },
602:             Err(e) => self.app.flash(format!("Invalid model: {e}")),
603:         }
604:     }
605: 
606:     fn refresh_models(&self) {
607:         let available = Arc::clone(&self.available_models);
608:         let warn_tx = self.warn_tx.clone();
609:         available.store(None);
610:         smol::spawn(async move {
611:             fetch_all_models(|batch| merge_batch(&available, batch, &warn_tx), None).await;
612:         })
613:         .detach();
614:     }
615: 
616:     fn refresh_usage(&self) {
617:         let provider = Arc::clone(&self.model_slot.load().provider);
618:         let slot = Arc::clone(&self.app.usage_slot);
619:         slot.store(Some(Arc::new(UsageFetchState::Loading)));
620:         smol::spawn(async move {
621:             let state = match provider.fetch_usage().await {
622:                 Ok(Some(usage)) => UsageFetchState::Ready(usage),
623:                 Ok(None) => UsageFetchState::Unsupported,
624:                 Err(e) => UsageFetchState::Error(e.user_message()),
625:             };
626:             slot.store(Some(Arc::new(state)));
627:         })
628:         .detach();
629:     }
630: 
631:     fn refresh_provider(&mut self, slug: String) {
632:         let current = self.model_slot.load();
633:         let current_model = &current.model;
634: 
635:         if current_model.provider.to_string() == slug {
636:             let mut m = current_model.clone();
637:             if let Ok(provider) = maki_providers::provider::from_model(&mut m, self.timeouts) {
638:                 self.app.usage_slot.store(None);
639:                 self.model_slot.store(Arc::new(ModelSlot {
640:                     model: m,
641:                     provider: Arc::from(provider),
642:                 }));
643:             }
644:         } else if let Some(builtin) = maki_config::providers::builtin_provider(&slug) {
645:             let spec = builtin.default_model.to_string();
646:             self.change_model(spec);
647:         }
648:     }
649: 
650:     fn shutdown(mut self) -> (Option<String>, i32) {
651:         let exit_code = self.app.exit_request.code();
652:         let session_id = self
653:             .app
654:             .has_content()
655:             .then(|| self.app.state.session.id.clone());
656:         maki_agent::mcp::kill_process_groups(&self.handles.mcp_reader().load().pids);
657:         self.app.cmd_tx = None;
658:         self.app.answer_tx = None;
659:         drop(self.app);
660:         self.handles.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3));
661:         match Arc::try_unwrap(self.storage_writer) {
662:             Ok(writer) => writer.shutdown(Duration::from_secs(3)),
663:             Err(_) => {
664:                 warn!("storage writer has outstanding references, skipping graceful shutdown")
665:             }
666:         }
667:         (session_id, exit_code)
668:     }
669: }
670: 
671: fn scroll_delta(kind: MouseEventKind, lines: u32) -> i32 {
672:     if kind == MouseEventKind::ScrollUp {
673:         lines as i32
674:     } else {
675:         -(lines as i32)
676:     }
677: }
678: 
679: fn aggregate_scroll(
680:     column: u16,
681:     row: u16,
682:     mut delta: i32,
683:     scroll_lines: u32,
684: ) -> (Msg, Option<Msg>) {
685:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
686:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
687:             match next.kind {
688:                 MouseEventKind::ScrollUp | MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
689:                     delta += scroll_delta(next.kind, scroll_lines);
690:                 }
691:                 _ => return (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, Some(Msg::Mouse(next))),
692:             }
693:         } else {
694:             break;
695:         }
696:     }
697:     (Msg::Scroll { column, row, delta }, None)
698: }
699: 
700: fn coalesce_drag(mut latest: CtMouseEvent) -> (CtMouseEvent, Option<Msg>) {
701:     while event::poll(Duration::ZERO).unwrap_or(false) {
702:         if let Ok(Event::Mouse(next)) = event::read() {
703:             if matches!(next.kind, MouseEventKind::Drag(MouseButton::Left)) {
704:                 latest = next;
705:             } else {
706:                 return (latest, Some(Msg::Mouse(next)));
707:             }
708:         } else {
709:             break;
710:         }
711:     }
712:     (latest, None)
713: }

pub enum ToolOutput {
    Plain(TextOutput),
    Markdown(TextOutput),
    ReadCode {
        path: String,
        start_line: usize,
        lines: Vec<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        total_lines: usize,
        #[serde(default)]
        instructions: Option<Vec<InstructionBlock>>,
    },
    ReadDir(TextOutput),
    Diff {
        path: String,
        before: String,
        after: String,
        summary: String,
    },
    TodoList(Vec<TodoItem>),
    WriteCode {
        path: String,
        byte_count: usize,
        lines: Vec<String>,
    },

    GrepResult {
        entries: Vec<GrepFileEntry>,
    },
    /// Only here so legacy sessions still deserialize. Batch is a Lua
    /// plugin now and stores per-child `entries` plus a `text` payload.
    Batch {
        #[serde(default)]
        entries: Vec<BatchToolEntry>,
        text: String,
    },
    Instructions {
        blocks: Vec<InstructionBlock>,
    },
    Image {
        source: maki_providers::ImageSource,
        /// Caption for the tool_result block, e.g. "[image: slack.jpeg 222KB]";
        /// the pixels ride separately as a `ContentBlock::Image`.
        text: String,
    },
}

182:     pub async fn run(&mut self, input: AgentInput) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
183:         self.rollback_len = self.history.len();
184:         let msg = Message::user_with_images(input.message.clone(), input.images);
185:         self.history.push(msg);
186:         self.mode = input.mode;
187:         self.workflow = input.workflow;
188:         self.opts = RequestOptions {
189:             thinking: input.thinking,
190:             fast: input.fast,
191:         };
192: 
193:         info!(
194:             model = %self.model.id,
195:             mode = ?self.mode,
196:             message_len = input.message.len(),
197:             "agent run started"
198:         );
199: 
200:         let result = self.run_loop().await;
201: 
202:         if matches!(result, Err(AgentError::Cancelled)) {
203:             sanitize_cancelled_history(self.history, self.rollback_len);
204:         }
205: 
206:         result
207:     }
208: 
209:     async fn run_loop(&mut self) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
210:         loop {
211:             if let Some(max) = self.config.max_turns
212:                 && self.num_turns >= max
213:             {
214:                 self.emit_done(None)?;
215:                 return Ok(());
216:             }
217:             match self.turn().await? {
218:                 TurnOutcome::Continue => {}
219:                 TurnOutcome::Done(stop_reason) => {
220:                     self.emit_done(stop_reason)?;
221:                     return Ok(());
222:                 }
223:             }
224:         }
225:     }
226: 
227:     async fn turn(&mut self) -> Result<TurnOutcome, AgentError> {
228:         if self.cancel.is_cancelled() {
229:             return Err(AgentError::Cancelled);
230:         }
231:         let response = match stream_with_retry(
232:             &*self.provider,
233:             &self.model,
234:             self.history.as_slice(),
235:             &self.system,
236:             &self.tools,
237:             &self.event_tx,
238:             &self.cancel,
239:             self.opts,
240:             self.session_id.as_deref(),
241:         )
242:         .await
243:         {
244:             Ok(r) => {
245:                 self.reauth_attempts = 0;
246:                 r
247:             }
248:             Err(e) if e.is_auth_error() => {
249:                 return self.wait_for_reauth(e).await;
250:             }
251:             Err(e) => {
252:                 error!(error = %e, model = %self.model.id, self.num_turns, "stream_message failed");
253:                 return Err(e);
254:             }
255:         };
256:         self.num_turns += 1;
257: 
258:         let has_tools = response.message.has_tool_calls();
259:         let stop_reason = response.stop_reason;
260:         info!(
261:             input_tokens = response.usage.input,
262:             output_tokens = response.usage.output,
263:             cache_creation = response.usage.cache_creation,
264:             cache_read = response.usage.cache_read,
265:             has_tools,
266:             self.num_turns,
267:             model = %self.model.id,
268:             stop_reason = stop_reason.map_or("none", Into::into),
269:             "API response received"
270:         );
271: 
272:         self.emit_turn_complete(&response)?;
273:         let usage = response.usage;
274:         self.total_usage += usage;
275:         self.context_size = usage.total_input();
276: 
277:         if has_tools {
278:             let history_len_before = self.history.len();
279:             self.process_tool_calls(response).await?;
280:             self.context_size +=
281:                 estimate_message_tokens(&self.history.as_slice()[history_len_before..]);
282:         } else {
283:             let has_text = response.message.first_text_content().is_some();
284: 
285:             if !has_text && !self.post_tool_empty_retried && self.history.has_recent_tool_results(5)
286:             {
287:                 self.post_tool_empty_retried = true;
288:                 warn!("empty response after tool calls, nudging model to continue");
289:                 self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::Nudge)?;
290:                 self.history.push(Message {
291:                     role: Role::Assistant,
292:                     content: vec![ContentBlock::Text {
293:                         text: "(empty)".into(),
294:                     }],
295:                     ..Default::default()
296:                 });
297:                 self.history.push(Message::synthetic(NUDGE_PROMPT.into()));
298:                 return Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue);
299:             }
300: 
301:             self.history.push(response.message);
302: 
303:             if stop_reason == Some(StopReason::MaxTokens)
304:                 && self.num_turns <= self.config.max_continuation_turns
305:             {
306:                 warn!(
307:                     self.num_turns,
308:                     "response truncated (max_tokens), re-prompting"
309:                 );
310:                 return Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue);
311:             }
312:         }
313: 
314:         if self.try_auto_compact().await? || self.handle_queued_command().await? {
315:             return Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue);
316:         }
317: 
318:         if has_tools {
319:             Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue)
320:         } else {
321:             Ok(TurnOutcome::Done(stop_reason))
322:         }
323:     }
324: 
325:     async fn wait_for_reauth(&mut self, err: AgentError) -> Result<TurnOutcome, AgentError> {
326:         if self.reauth_attempts >= MAX_REAUTH_ATTEMPTS {
327:             error!(error = %err, attempts = self.reauth_attempts, "max re-auth attempts reached");
328:             return Err(err);
329:         }
330:         let Some(rx) = &self.user_response_rx else {
331:             error!(error = %err, model = %self.model.id, self.num_turns, "stream_message failed");
332:             return Err(err);
333:         };
334:         self.reauth_attempts += 1;
335:         warn!(error = %err, attempt = self.reauth_attempts, "auth error, waiting for re-authentication");
336:         self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::AuthRequired)?;
337:         let rx = rx.lock().await;
338:         match futures_lite::future::race(rx.recv_async(), async {
339:             self.cancel.cancelled().await;
340:             Err(flume::RecvError::Disconnected)
341:         })
342:         .await
343:         {
344:             Ok(_) => {
345:                 self.provider.refresh_auth().await?;
346:                 Ok(TurnOutcome::Continue)
347:             }
348:             Err(_) => Err(AgentError::Cancelled),
349:         }
350:     }
351: 
352:     fn emit_turn_complete(&self, response: &StreamResponse) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
353:         self.event_tx
354:             .send(AgentEvent::TurnComplete(Box::new(TurnCompleteEvent {
355:                 message: response.message.clone(),
356:                 usage: response.usage,
357:                 model: self.model.id.clone(),
358:                 context_size: Some(response.usage.context_tokens()),
359:             })))
360:     }
361: 
362:     fn emit_done(&self, stop_reason: Option<StopReason>) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
363:         info!(
364:             self.num_turns,
365:             total_input = self.total_usage.input,
366:             total_output = self.total_usage.output,
367:             "agent run completed"
368:         );
369:         self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::Done {
370:             usage: self.total_usage,
371:             num_turns: self.num_turns,
372:             stop_reason,
373:         })
374:     }

379:         tool_dispatch::process_tool_calls(
380:             response,

382:             self.mcp.as_ref(),
383:             self.history,
384:             &self.event_tx,
385:             &ctx,
386:         )
387:         .await
388:     }

418:     async fn try_auto_compact(&mut self) -> Result<bool, AgentError> {
419:         if !self.auto_compact
420:             || !compaction::is_overflow(
421:                 &TokenUsage {
422:                     input: self.context_size,
423:                     ..Default::default()
424:                 },
425:                 &self.model,
426:                 self.config.compaction_buffer,
427:             )
428:         {
429:             return Ok(false);
430:         }
431:         info!(context_size = self.context_size, "auto-compacting");
432:         self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::AutoCompacting)?;
433:         self.do_compact().await?;
434:         Ok(true)
435:     }
436: 
437:     async fn do_compact(&mut self) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
438:         let (compact_provider, compact_model) =
439:             resolve_compaction_model(&self.provider, &self.model, self.timeouts);
440:         self.total_usage += compaction::compact_history(
441:             &*compact_provider,
442:             &compact_model,
443:             self.history,
444:             &self.event_tx,
445:             &self.cancel,
446:         )
447:         .await?;
448:         self.rollback_len = self.history.len();
449:         self.history
450:             .push(Message::synthetic(CONTINUE_AFTER_COMPACT.into()));
451:         Ok(())
452:     }
453: 
454:     async fn handle_queued_command(&mut self) -> Result<bool, AgentError> {
455:         let Some(ref source) = self.interrupt_source else {
456:             return Ok(false);
457:         };
458:         let Some(cmd) = source.poll() else {
459:             return Ok(false);
460:         };
461:         match cmd {
462:             ExtractedCommand::Interrupt(mut input, _) => {
463:                 self.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::QueueItemConsumed {
464:                     text: input.message.clone(),
465:                     image_count: input.images.len(),
466:                 })?;
467:                 for msg in std::mem::take(&mut input.preamble) {
468:                     self.history.push(msg);
469:                 }
470:                 self.mode = input.mode.clone();
471:                 let display = input.message.clone();
472:                 let wrapped = format!(
473:                     "<user-interrupt>\nThe user sent a new message while you were working. Address it and continue.\n\n{display}\n</user-interrupt>"
474:                 );
475:                 self.history.push(Message::user_display(wrapped, display));
476:             }
477:             ExtractedCommand::Compact(_) => {
478:                 self.do_compact().await?;
479:             }
480:         }
481:         Ok(true)
482:     }
483: }
484: 
485: const CHARS_PER_TOKEN: usize = 4;
486: 
487: pub fn estimate_message_tokens(messages: &[Message]) -> u32 {
488:     if messages.is_empty() {
489:         return 0;
490:     }
491:     let total_bytes: usize = messages
492:         .iter()
493:         .flat_map(|m| &m.content)
494:         .filter_map(|b| match b {
495:             ContentBlock::Text { text } => Some(text.len()),
496:             ContentBlock::ToolResult { content, .. } => Some(content.len()),
497:             ContentBlock::ToolUse { input, .. } => Some(input.to_string().len()),
498:             _ => None,
499:         })
500:         .sum();
501:     (total_bytes.max(CHARS_PER_TOKEN) / CHARS_PER_TOKEN) as u32
502: }

654:     fn drain_events(rx: &flume::Receiver<Envelope>) -> Vec<Envelope> {
655:         let mut events = Vec::new();

663:         let mut history = History::new(Vec::new());

667:             .into_iter()

669:                 AgentEvent::Done {
670:                     num_turns,
671:                     stop_reason,
672:                     ..
673:                 } => Some((num_turns, stop_reason)),
674:                 _ => None,

9: local STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_DESCRIPTION = "Report your final result. Call it exactly once when your task is complete."
10: local STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_ACK = "Output recorded."
11: local STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_PROMPT_SUFFIX = "\n\nWhen finished, call the structured_output tool with your final result."
12: local MAX_STRUCTURED_RETRIES = 2
13: local MAX_SCHEMA_ERRORS = 3
14: local SCHEMA_COMPILE_ERROR = "invalid output_schema"
15: local STRUCTURED_MISSING_ERROR = "subagent finished without calling structured_output"
16: local STRUCTURED_INVALID_ERROR = "subagent result does not match output_schema"

23: 
24: Subagent types (set via `subagent_type`):
25: - `research` (default): Read-only tools. For codebase exploration or gathering context.
26: - `general`: Full tool access. For delegating implementation work.
27: 
28: Notes:
29: 1. Launch multiple tasks concurrently when possible.
30: 2. The agent's result is not visible to the user. Summarize it in your response.

32: 4. Tell it to return concise summaries with file:line refs, not full file contents.
33: ]]

42:       description = "Short (3-5 words) description of the task",
43:     },

46:       description = "Detailed task prompt for the agent",
47:     },

54:       description = 'Model tier (optional, omit to use current model, capped at current tier):\n- "strong" (e.g. Opus): Deep reasoning, complex architecture, subtle bugs, most critical sections. ~5x cost of medium.\n- "medium" (e.g. Sonnet): Balanced. Refactors, features, multi-file changes.\n- "weak" (e.g. Haiku): Fast/cheap. Search, summarize, boilerplate, simple edits.',

58:     },

66:     model_tier = "weak",
67:   },
68: }

70: local semaphore
71: 
72: local function bounded_errors(errors)
73:   local out = {}
74:   for i = 1, math.min(#errors, MAX_SCHEMA_ERRORS) do
75:     out[i] = errors[i]
76:   end
77:   return table.concat(out, "\n")
78: end

83:     return { llm_output = "unknown subagent type: " .. subagent_type, is_error = true }
84:   end
85: 
86:   -- Compile early: a bad schema costs zero tokens.
87:   local validator
88:   if input.output_schema then

90:     validator, compile_err = maki.json.schema_validator(input.output_schema)
91:     if compile_err then
92:       return { llm_output = SCHEMA_COMPILE_ERROR .. ": " .. compile_err, is_error = true }
93:     end
94:   end
95: 
96:   local model, model_err = maki.agent.resolve_model(ctx, {
97:     tier = input.model_tier,
98:   })
99:   if model_err then
100:     return { llm_output = model_err, is_error = true }
101:   end
102: 
103:   local audience = subagent_type == "research" and "research_sub" or "general_sub"
104:   local prompt_id = subagent_type == "research" and "research" or "general"
105:   local system, system_err = maki.agent.system_prompt(ctx, {
106:     prompt_id = prompt_id,
107:     instructions = true,
108:   })
109:   if system_err then
110:     return { llm_output = system_err, is_error = true }
111:   end
112:

115:     spec = model.spec,
116:     include_mcp = true,
117:   })
118:   if tools_err then
119:     return { llm_output = tools_err, is_error = true }
120:   end
121: 
122:   local captured, last_errors
123:   local local_tools
124:   if validator then
125:     local_tools = {
126:       [STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_NAME] = {
127:         description = STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_DESCRIPTION,
128:         input_schema = input.output_schema,
129:         handler = function(value)
130:           local errs = validator:validate(value)
131:           if errs then
132:             last_errors = bounded_errors(errs)
133:             return nil, INVALID_INPUT_PREFIX .. last_errors
134:           end
135:           captured = value
136:           return STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_ACK
137:         end,
138:       },
139:     }
140:   end
141: 
142:   -- Process-wide cap on concurrent subagents, sized from config on first use.
143:   if not semaphore then
144:     semaphore = maki.async.semaphore(math.max(ctx:config("task_max_concurrent", 1), 1))
145:   end
146:   local permit = semaphore:acquire()
147: 
148:   -- pcall so a raised error cannot leak the permit.
149:   local ok, out = pcall(function()
150:     local sess, sess_err = maki.agent.session(ctx, {
151:       model_spec = model.spec,
152:       system = system,
153:       tools = tool_defs,
154:       local_tools = local_tools,
155:       audience = audience,
156:       name = input.description,
157:     })
158:     if sess_err then
159:       return { llm_output = sess_err, is_error = true }
160:     end
161: 
162:     local message = input.prompt
163:     if validator then
164:       message = message .. STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_PROMPT_SUFFIX
165:     end
166: 
167:     local result, err = sess:prompt(message)
168:     local retries = 0
169:     while not err and validator and not captured and retries < MAX_STRUCTURED_RETRIES do
170:       retries = retries + 1
171:       result, err = sess:prompt(NUDGE_MISSING)
172:     end
173: 
174:     sess:close()
175: 
176:     if err then
177:       return { llm_output = "sub-agent error: " .. err, is_error = true }
178:     end
179:     if validator and not captured then
180:       local msg = last_errors and (STRUCTURED_INVALID_ERROR .. ":\n" .. last_errors) or STRUCTURED_MISSING_ERROR
181:       return { llm_output = msg, is_error = true }
182:     end
183:     return { llm_output = captured and maki.json.encode(captured) or result.text, format = "markdown" }
184:   end)
185: 
186:   permit:release()
187:   if not ok then
188:     error(out, 0)
189:   end
190:   return out
191: end

168: fn exec_tool(reg: &ToolRegistry, name: &str, input: Value) -> Result<String, String> {
169:     let entry = reg
170:         .get(name)
171:         .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("tool {name} not registered"));
172:     let inv = entry.tool.parse(&input).expect("parse failed");
173:     let ctx = stub_ctx(&AgentMode::Build);
174:     smol::block_on(async { inv.execute(&ctx).await })
175:         .output
176:         .map(|out| match out {
177:             ToolOutput::Plain(s) | ToolOutput::Markdown(s) => s.text,
178:             other => panic!("unexpected output: {other:?}"),
179:         })
180: }

23: const DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD: usize = 3;

30: impl RecentCalls {

32:         Self(VecDeque::new())

35:     fn hash_input(input: &Value) -> u64 {
36:         let mut h = DefaultHasher::new();
37:         input.to_string().hash(&mut h);
38:         h.finish()
39:     }

41:     fn is_doom_loop(&self, name: &str, input: &Value) -> bool {
42:         let hash = Self::hash_input(input);
43:         self.0.len() >= DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD - 1
44:             && self
45:                 .0
46:                 .iter()
47:                 .rev()
48:                 .take(DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD - 1)
49:                 .all(|(n, h)| n == name && *h == hash)
50:     }
51: 
52:     fn record(&mut self, name: String, input: &Value) {
53:         self.0.push_back((name, Self::hash_input(input)));
54:         if self.0.len() > DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD {
55:             self.0.pop_front();
56:         }
57:     }
58: }

60: /// Parse errors and unknown tools skip the start event so the UI never
61: /// shows a phantom spinner.
62: pub async fn run(
63:     registry: &ToolRegistry,
64:     mcp: Option<&McpHandle>,
65:     id: String,
66:     name: &str,
67:     input: &Value,
68:     ctx: &ToolContext,
69:     emit: Emit,
70: ) -> ToolDoneEvent {
71:     if let Some(local) = ctx.local_tools.get(name) {
72:         return run_local_tool(local, id, name, input, ctx, emit);
73:     }
74:     let entry = registry.get(name);
75:     // LLM providers send tool names in wire format (server__tool) but our
76:     // internal index uses server.tool. Only convert if the name isn't a
77:     // native tool — avoids mangling native names that happen to contain __.
78:     let mcp_name;
79:     let mcp_lookup = if entry.is_none() && name.contains("__") && mcp.is_some() {
80:         mcp_name = crate::mcp::internal_tool_name(name);
81:         mcp_name.as_str()
82:     } else {
83:         name
84:     };
85:     let tool_id: Arc<str> = entry
86:         .as_ref()
87:         .map(|e| Arc::from(e.tool.name()))
88:         .or_else(|| mcp.map(|m| m.interned_name(mcp_lookup)))
89:         .unwrap_or_else(|| Arc::from(UNKNOWN_MCP));
90:     let started = Instant::now();
91: 
92:     let done_error = |msg: String| ToolDoneEvent {
93:         id: id.clone(),
94:         tool: Arc::clone(&tool_id),
95:         output: ToolOutput::Plain(msg.into()),
96:         is_error: true,
97:         annotation: None,
98:         written_path: None,
99:     };
100: 
101:     if let Some(entry) = entry {
102:         let invocation = match entry.tool.parse(input) {
103:             Ok(inv) => inv,
104:             Err(e) => {
105:                 warn!(
106:                     tool = %name,
107:                     source = %entry.source.as_log_field(),
108:                     input_preview = %crate::tools::schema::preview(&input.to_string()),
109:                     error = %e,
110:                     "tool input parse failed"
111:                 );
112:                 return done_error(e.to_string());
113:             }
114:         };
115: 
116:         if let Some(target) = invocation.mutable_path() {
117:             let is_plan_target = ctx.mode.plan_path().is_some_and(|pp| target == pp);
118:             if !is_plan_target {
119:                 if ctx.mode.plan_path().is_some() {
120:                     warn!(
121:                         tool = %name,
122:                         target = %target.display(),
123:                         "blocked write in plan mode"
124:                     );
125:                     return done_error(crate::tools::PLAN_WRITE_RESTRICTED.into());
126:                 }
127:                 if let Some(reason) = ctx.permissions.boundary_block_reason(target) {
128:                     return done_error(reason);
129:                 }
130:             }
131:         }
132: 
133:         let header_result = invocation.start_header().await;
134:         let start = ToolStartEvent {
135:             id: id.clone(),
136:             tool: Arc::clone(&tool_id),
137:             summary: header_result.text(),
138:             render_header: header_result.snapshot(),
139:             annotation: invocation.start_annotation(),
140:             input: None,
141:             raw_input: Some(input.clone()),
142:             output: invocation.start_output(ctx),
143:         };
144:         if matches!(emit, Emit::Notify) {
145:             let _ = ctx.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::ToolStart(Box::new(start)));
146:         }
147: 
148:         invocation.start(ctx).await;
149: 
150:         if let Err(e) = enforce_permission(invocation.as_ref(), name, ctx, &id).await {
151:             return done_error(e);
152:         }
153: 
154:         let result = invocation.execute(ctx).await;
155: 
156:         let elapsed = started.elapsed();
157:         match result.output {
158:             Ok(output) => {
159:                 debug!(
160:                     tool = %name,
161:                     source = %entry.source.as_log_field(),
162:                     elapsed_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as u64,
163:                     "tool ok"
164:                 );
165:                 ToolDoneEvent {
166:                     id,
167:                     tool: tool_id,
168:                     output,
169:                     is_error: false,
170:                     annotation: result.annotation,
171:                     written_path: result.written_path,
172:                 }
173:             }
174:             Err(message) => {
175:                 warn!(
176:                     tool = %name,
177:                     source = %entry.source.as_log_field(),
178:                     elapsed_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as u64,
179:                     error = %message,
180:                     "tool failed"
181:                 );
182:                 done_error(message)
183:             }
184:         }
185:     } else if mcp.is_some_and(|m| m.has_tool(mcp_lookup)) {
186:         // MCP tools skip parsing, so we assemble the start event manually.
187:         let start = ToolStartEvent {
188:             id: id.clone(),
189:             tool: Arc::clone(&tool_id),
190:             summary: format!("mcp: {mcp_lookup}"),
191:             render_header: None,

201:     } else {

208: fn run_local_tool(

211:     name: &str,

214:     emit: Emit,
215: ) -> ToolDoneEvent {
216:     let tool_id: Arc<str> = Arc::from(name);
217:     if matches!(emit, Emit::Notify) {
218:         let start = ToolStartEvent {
219:             id: id.clone(),
220:             tool: Arc::clone(&tool_id),
221:             summary: name.to_owned(),
222:             render_header: None,
223:             annotation: None,
224:             input: None,
225:             raw_input: Some(input.clone()),
226:             output: None,
227:         };
228:         let _ = ctx.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::ToolStart(Box::new(start)));
229:     }
230:     let (output, is_error) = match local(input) {
231:         Ok(output) => (output, false),
232:         Err(e) => {
233:             warn!(tool = %name, error = %e, "local tool failed");
234:             (e, true)
235:         }
236:     };
237:     ToolDoneEvent {
238:         id,
239:         tool: tool_id,
240:         output: ToolOutput::Plain(output.into()),
241:         is_error,
242:         annotation: None,
243:         written_path: None,
244:     }
245: }
246: 
247: /// Enforce permission for a native tool. MCP tools bypass this — they go
248: /// through `execute_mcp_tool` which handles permission checking internally.
249: ///
250: /// Returns an error if `name` contains dots (not a valid native tool name).
251: async fn enforce_permission(
252:     inv: &dyn ToolInvocation,
253:     name: &str,
254:     ctx: &ToolContext,
255:     id: &str,
256: ) -> Result<(), String> {
257:     if name.contains('.') {
258:         return Err(format!(
259:             "enforce_permission called with dotted name: {name}"
260:         ));
261:     }
262:     if let Some(scopes) = inv.permission_scopes().await {
263:         let tool_key = ToolKey::native(name);
264:         ctx.permissions
265:             .enforce(
266:                 &tool_key,
267:                 &scopes,
268:                 &ctx.event_tx,
269:                 ctx.user_response_rx.as_deref(),
270:                 id,
271:                 &ctx.cancel,
272:                 ctx.mode.plan_path(),
273:             )
274:             .await
275:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
276:     }
277:     Ok(())
278: }
279: 
280: async fn execute_mcp_tool(
281:     ctx: &ToolContext,
282:     id: &str,
283:     tool_id: Arc<str>,
284:     tool_name: &str,
285:     input: &Value,
286: ) -> ToolDoneEvent {
287:     let done = |output: String, is_error: bool| ToolDoneEvent {
288:         id: id.to_owned(),
289:         tool: Arc::clone(&tool_id),
290:         output: ToolOutput::Plain(output.into()),
291:         is_error,
292:         annotation: None,
293:         written_path: None,
294:     };
295: 
296:     if ctx.mode.plan_path().is_some() {
297:         return done(MCP_BLOCKED_IN_PLAN.into(), true);
298:     }
299: 
300:     let perm_tool = match ToolKey::parse(tool_name) {
301:         Ok(k) => k,
302:         Err(e) => {
303:             return done(format!("invalid MCP tool key '{tool_name}': {e}"), true);
304:         }
305:     };
306:     let perm_scope = {
307:         let json = input.to_string();
308:         if json.len() > 200 {
309:             format!("{}\u{2026}", &json[..200])
310:         } else {
311:             json
312:         }
313:     };
314:     let perm_scopes = crate::tools::PermissionScopes::single(perm_scope);
315: 
316:     if let Err(e) = ctx
317:         .permissions
318:         .enforce(
319:             &perm_tool,
320:             &perm_scopes,
321:             &ctx.event_tx,
322:             ctx.user_response_rx.as_deref(),
323:             id,
324:             &ctx.cancel,
325:             ctx.mode.plan_path(),
326:         )
327:         .await
328:     {
329:         return done(e.to_string(), true);
330:     }
331: 
332:     let Some(mcp) = &ctx.mcp else {
333:         return done(format!("MCP manager not available for {tool_name}"), true);
334:     };
335: 
336:     match mcp.call_tool(tool_name, input).await {
337:         Ok(text) => done(text, false),
338:         Err(e) => done(e.to_string(), true),
339:     }
340: }
341: 
342: /// Deduplicates doom-loop repeats, then runs remaining calls in parallel.
343: pub(super) async fn process_tool_calls(
344:     response: maki_providers::StreamResponse,
345:     recent_calls: &mut RecentCalls,
346:     mcp: Option<&McpHandle>,
347:     history: &mut super::history::History,
348:     event_tx: &crate::EventSender,
349:     ctx: &ToolContext,
350: ) -> Result<(), AgentError> {
351:     let tool_uses: Vec<(String, String, Value)> = response
352:         .message
353:         .tool_uses()
354:         .map(|(id, name, input)| (id.to_owned(), name.to_owned(), input.clone()))
355:         .collect();
356: 
357:     history.push(response.message);
358: 
359:     let mut immediate_errors: Vec<ToolDoneEvent> = Vec::new();
360:     let mut runnable: Vec<(String, String, Value)> = Vec::new();
361: 
362:     for (id, name, input) in tool_uses {
363:         debug!(
364:             tool = %name,
365:             id = %id,
366:             input_preview = %crate::tools::schema::preview(&input.to_string()),
367:             "parsing tool call"
368:         );
369:         if recent_calls.is_doom_loop(&name, &input) {
370:             warn!(tool = %name, "doom loop detected, skipping execution");
371:             immediate_errors.push(ToolDoneEvent::error(id.clone(), DOOM_LOOP_MESSAGE));
372:         } else {
373:             runnable.push((id, name.clone(), input.clone()));
374:         }
375:         recent_calls.record(name, &input);
376:     }
377: 
378:     for err in &immediate_errors {
379:         event_tx.try_send(AgentEvent::ToolDone(Box::new(err.clone())));
380:     }
381: 
382:     let mut set = TaskSet::new();
383:     let mut spawned_ids: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
384:     for (id, name, input) in runnable {
385:         spawned_ids.push(id.clone());
386:         let event_tx_clone = ctx.event_tx.clone();
387:         let tool_ctx = ToolContext {
388:             tool_use_id: Some(id.clone()),
389:             ..ctx.clone()
390:         };
391:         let mcp_owned = mcp.cloned();
392:         set.spawn(async move {
393:             let done = run(
394:                 &tool_ctx.registry,
395:                 mcp_owned.as_ref(),
396:                 id,
397:                 &name,
398:                 &input,
399:                 &tool_ctx,
400:                 Emit::Notify,
401:             )
402:             .await;
403:             event_tx_clone.try_send(AgentEvent::ToolDone(Box::new(done.clone())));
404:             done
405:         });
406:     }
407: 
408:     let results: Vec<ToolDoneEvent> = set
409:         .join_all()
410:         .await
411:         .into_iter()
412:         .zip(spawned_ids)
413:         .map(|(r, id)| match r {
414:             Ok(out) => out,
415:             Err(e) => {
416:                 error!(error = %e, "tool task panicked");
417:                 ToolDoneEvent::error(id, format!("internal error: tool panicked: {e}"))
418:             }
419:         })
420:         .collect();
421: 
422:     let mut all_results = results;
423:     all_results.extend(immediate_errors);
424:     let tool_msg = crate::types::tool_results(all_results);
425:     event_tx.send(AgentEvent::ToolResultsSubmitted {
426:         message: Box::new(tool_msg.clone()),
427:     })?;
428:     history.push(tool_msg);
429:     Ok(())
430: }

432: /// Test-only entry that skips native lookup, letting plan-mode and MCP tests
433: /// exercise the dispatch path without registering a fake native tool.
434: #[cfg(test)]
435: async fn dispatch_mcp(
436:     ctx: &ToolContext,
437:     id: &str,
438:     tool_name: &str,
439:     input: &Value,
440: ) -> ToolDoneEvent {
441:     let tool_id = ctx
442:         .mcp
443:         .as_ref()
444:         .map(|m| m.interned_name(tool_name))
445:         .unwrap_or_else(|| Arc::from(UNKNOWN_MCP));
446:     execute_mcp_tool(ctx, id, tool_id, tool_name, input).await
447: }

671:     const START_PROBE_NAME: &str = "start_probe";

673:     use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
674: 
675:     use crate::tools::{
676:         BoxFuture, DescriptionContext, ExecFuture, HeaderFuture, HeaderResult, ParseError,
677:         PermissionScopes, Tool, ToolExecResult,
678:     };
679: 
680:     #[derive(Default)]
681:     struct StartProbe {
682:         started: Arc<AtomicBool>,
683:         executed: Arc<AtomicBool>,
684:     }
685: 
686:     struct StartProbeInvocation {
687:         started: Arc<AtomicBool>,
688:         executed: Arc<AtomicBool>,
689:     }
690: 
691:     impl ToolInvocation for StartProbeInvocation {
692:         fn start_header(&self) -> HeaderFuture {
693:             HeaderFuture::Ready(HeaderResult::plain("probe".into()))
694:         }
695:         fn start<'a>(&'a self, _ctx: &'a ToolContext) -> BoxFuture<'a, ()> {
696:             self.started.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
697:             Box::pin(std::future::ready(()))
698:         }
699:         fn permission_scopes(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Option<PermissionScopes>> {
700:             Box::pin(std::future::ready(Some(PermissionScopes::single(
701:                 "probe".into(),
702:             ))))
703:         }
704:         fn execute<'a>(self: Box<Self>, _ctx: &'a ToolContext) -> ExecFuture<'a> {
705:             self.executed.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
706:             Box::pin(async {
707:                 ToolExecResult::from(Ok::<_, String>(ToolOutput::Plain("ok".into())))
708:             })
709:         }
710:     }
711: 
712:     impl Tool for StartProbe {
713:         fn name(&self) -> &str {
714:             START_PROBE_NAME
715:         }
716:         fn description(&self, _ctx: &DescriptionContext) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
717:             "start probe".into()
718:         }
719:         fn schema(&self) -> Value {
720:             serde_json::json!({"type": "object", "properties": {}, "additionalProperties": false})
721:         }
722:         fn parse(&self, _input: &Value) -> Result<Box<dyn ToolInvocation>, ParseError> {
723:             Ok(Box::new(StartProbeInvocation {
724:                 started: Arc::clone(&self.started),
725:                 executed: Arc::clone(&self.executed),
726:             }))
727:         }
728:     }

731:     #[test]

733:         smol::block_on(async {
734:             let deny_cfg = PermissionsConfig {
735:                 rules: vec![PermissionRule {

742:             let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();

744:             let ctx = crate::tools::test_support::stub_ctx_with_permissions(
745:                 &AgentMode::Build,
746:                 permissions,
747:             );
748: 
749:             let probe = StartProbe::default();
750:             let (started, executed) = (Arc::clone(&probe.started), Arc::clone(&probe.executed));
751:             let registry = ToolRegistry::new();
752:             registry
753:                 .register(
754:                     Arc::new(probe),
755:                     ToolSource::Lua {
756:                         plugin: "test".into(),
757:                     },
758:                 )
759:                 .unwrap();
760: 
761:             let done = run(
762:                 &registry,

764:                 "t1".into(),
765:                 START_PROBE_NAME,
766:                 &serde_json::json!({}),
767:                 &ctx,
768:                 Emit::Silent,
769:             )
770:             .await;
771: 
772:             assert!(done.is_error, "denial must error");
773:             assert!(
774:                 started.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
775:                 "start must run before permission enforcement"
776:             );
777:             assert!(
778:                 !executed.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
779:                 "execute must not run after denial"
780:             );
781:         });
782:     }
