610: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
611: pub enum KeyLabel {
612:     Single(&'static str),
613:     Alt(&'static str, &'static str),
614:     /// Alt on Mac, Single (first) on other platforms
615:     MacAlt(&'static str, &'static str),
616:     /// Multi on Mac, Multi (first slice) on other platforms
617:     MacMulti(&'static [&'static str], &'static [&'static str]),
618:     Action(&'static str),
619:     ActionAlt(&'static str, &'static str),
620:     ActionMacAlt(&'static str, &'static str),
621: }
622: 
623: pub const ALT_SEP: &str = " / ";
624: 
625: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
626: pub enum ResolvedLabel {
627:     Single(String),
628:     Alt(String, String),
629:     Multi(Vec<String>),
630: }
631: 
632: impl ResolvedLabel {
633:     pub fn display_width(&self) -> usize {
634:         match self {
635:             Self::Single(s) => UnicodeWidthStr::width(s.as_str()),
636:             Self::Alt(a, b) => {
637:                 let sep_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(ALT_SEP);
638:                 UnicodeWidthStr::width(a.as_str()) + sep_w + UnicodeWidthStr::width(b.as_str())
639:             }
640:             Self::Multi(keys) => {
641:                 let sep_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(ALT_SEP);
642:                 keys.iter()
643:                     .map(|k| UnicodeWidthStr::width(k.as_str()))
644:                     .sum::<usize>()
645:                     + sep_w * keys.len().saturating_sub(1)
646:             }
647:         }
648:     }
649: }
650: 
651: impl KeyLabel {
652:     pub fn resolve(self) -> ResolvedLabel {
653:         match self {
654:             Self::Single(s) => ResolvedLabel::Single(s.to_string()),
655:             Self::Alt(a, b) => ResolvedLabel::Alt(a.to_string(), b.to_string()),
656:             Self::MacAlt(a, b) => {
657:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
658:                     ResolvedLabel::Alt(a.to_string(), b.to_string())
659:                 } else {
660:                     ResolvedLabel::Single(a.to_string())
661:                 }
662:             }
663:             Self::MacMulti(normal, mac) => {
664:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
665:                     ResolvedLabel::Multi(mac.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect())
666:                 } else {
667:                     ResolvedLabel::Multi(normal.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect())
668:                 }
669:             }
670:             Self::Action(name) => {
671:                 ResolvedLabel::Single(get_bind_label(name))
672:             }
673:             Self::ActionAlt(name1, name2) => {
674:                 ResolvedLabel::Alt(get_bind_label(name1), get_bind_label(name2))
675:             }
676:             Self::ActionMacAlt(name, mac_label) => {
677:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
678:                     ResolvedLabel::Alt(get_bind_label(name), mac_label.to_string())
679:                 } else {
680:                     ResolvedLabel::Single(get_bind_label(name))
681:                 }
682:             }
683:         }
684:     }
685: 
686:     #[cfg(test)]
687:     fn flat_str(&self) -> String {
688:         match self.resolve() {
689:             ResolvedLabel::Single(s) => s,
690:             ResolvedLabel::Alt(a, b) => format!("{a}/{b}"),
691:             ResolvedLabel::Multi(keys) => keys.join("/"),
692:         }
693:     }
694: }
695:

969: pub(crate) fn key_event_to_string(key: &KeyEvent) -> String {
970:     let mut s = String::new();
971:     let mods = key.modifiers;
972:     let is_char = matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Char(_));
973:     if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
974:         s.push_str("ctrl+");
975:     }
976:     if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {
977:         s.push_str("alt+");
978:     }
979:     if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) && (!is_char || mods.intersects(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT | KeyModifiers::SUPER)) {
980:         s.push_str("shift+");
981:     }
982:     match key.code {
983:         KeyCode::Char(' ') => s.push_str("space"),
984:         KeyCode::Char(c) => s.push(c),
985:         KeyCode::Enter => s.push_str("enter"),
986:         KeyCode::Esc => s.push_str("esc"),
987:         KeyCode::Tab => s.push_str("tab"),
988:         KeyCode::BackTab => {
989:             if !s.contains("shift+") {
990:                 s.insert_str(0, "shift+");
991:             }
992:             s.push_str("tab");
993:         }
994:         KeyCode::Backspace => s.push_str("backspace"),
995:         KeyCode::Delete => s.push_str("delete"),
996:         KeyCode::Up => s.push_str("up"),
997:         KeyCode::Down => s.push_str("down"),
998:         KeyCode::Left => s.push_str("left"),
999:         KeyCode::Right => s.push_str("right"),
1000:         KeyCode::Home => s.push_str("home"),
1001:         KeyCode::End => s.push_str("end"),
1002:         KeyCode::PageUp => s.push_str("pageup"),
1003:         KeyCode::PageDown => s.push_str("pagedown"),
1004:         KeyCode::F(n) => write!(s, "f{n}").unwrap(),
1005:         KeyCode::Insert => s.push_str("insert"),
1006:         _ => {}
1007:     }

248: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
249: pub enum ResolvedLabel {
250:     Single(&'static str),
251:     Alt(&'static str, &'static str),
252:     Multi(&'static [&'static str]),
253: }
254: 
255: impl ResolvedLabel {
256:     pub fn display_width(self) -> usize {
257:         match self {
258:             Self::Single(s) => UnicodeWidthStr::width(s),
259:             Self::Alt(a, b) => {
260:                 let sep_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(ALT_SEP);
261:                 UnicodeWidthStr::width(a) + sep_w + UnicodeWidthStr::width(b)
262:             }
263:             Self::Multi(keys) => {
264:                 let sep_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(ALT_SEP);
265:                 keys.iter()
266:                     .map(|k| UnicodeWidthStr::width(*k))
267:                     .sum::<usize>()
268:                     + sep_w * keys.len().saturating_sub(1)
269:             }
270:         }
271:     }
272: }
273: 
274: impl KeyLabel {
275:     pub fn resolve(self) -> ResolvedLabel {
276:         match self {
277:             Self::Single(s) => ResolvedLabel::Single(s),
278:             Self::Alt(a, b) => ResolvedLabel::Alt(a, b),
279:             Self::MacAlt(a, b) => {
280:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
281:                     ResolvedLabel::Alt(a, b)
282:                 } else {
283:                     ResolvedLabel::Single(a)
284:                 }
285:             }
286:             Self::MacMulti(normal, mac) => {
287:                 if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
288:                     ResolvedLabel::Multi(mac)
289:                 } else {
290:                     ResolvedLabel::Multi(normal)
291:                 }
292:             }
293:         }
294:     }
295: 
296:     #[cfg(test)]
297:     fn flat_str(&self) -> String {
298:         match self.resolve() {
299:             ResolvedLabel::Single(s) => s.to_string(),
300:             ResolvedLabel::Alt(a, b) => format!("{a}/{b}"),
301:             ResolvedLabel::Multi(keys) => keys.join("/"),
302:         }
303:     }
304: }

567: /// Override a bind action (e.g. "quit") to use a shortcut parsed from config.
568: pub fn update_bind(action: &str, shortcut: &str) {
569:     let parts: Vec<&str> = shortcut.split('+').collect();
570:     let mut modifiers = KeyModifiers::NONE;
571:     let mut key_char = None;
572:     for p in &parts {
573:         match *p {
574:             "ctrl" => modifiers |= KeyModifiers::CONTROL,
575:             "alt" => modifiers |= KeyModifiers::ALT,
576:             "shift" => modifiers |= KeyModifiers::SHIFT,
577:             c if c.len() == 1 => key_char = Some(c.chars().next().unwrap()),
578:             "space" => key_char = Some(' '),
579:             _ => {}
580:         }
581:     }
582:     let code = match key_char {
583:         Some(' ') => KeyCode::Char(' '),
584:         Some(c) => KeyCode::Char(c),
585:         None => return,
586:     };
587:     let label = shortcut.to_string();
588:     let bind = Bind {
589:         code,
590:         modifiers,
591:         label: label.leak(),
592:     };
593:     let mut overrides = KEY_OVERRIDES.lock().unwrap();
594:     overrides.insert(action.to_string(), bind);
595: }
596: 
597: /// Look up a user-configured overridden bind for an action.
598: pub fn get_configured_bind(action: &str) -> Option<Bind> {
599:     KEY_OVERRIDES.lock().unwrap().get(action).copied()
600: }
601: 
602: pub(crate) fn key_event_to_string(key: &KeyEvent) -> String {

         \"enter\" | \"return\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Enter),\n            \"esc\" | \"escape\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Esc),\n            \"tab\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Tab),\n            \"backspace\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Backspace),\n            \"delete\" | \"del\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Delete),\n            \"up\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Up),\n            \"down\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Down),\n            \"left\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Left),\n            \"right\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Right),\n            \"home\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Home),\n            \"end\" => code = Some(KeyCode::End),\n            \"pageup\" | \"pgup\" => code = Some(KeyCode::PageUp),\n            \"pagedown\" | \"pgdn\" => code = Some(KeyCode::PageDown),\n            \"insert\" | \"ins\" => code = Some(KeyCode::Insert),\n            other => {\n                if let Some(stripped) = other.strip_prefix('f')\n                    && let Ok(n) = stripped.parse::<u8>()\n                {\n                    code = Some(KeyCode::F(n));\n                    continue;\n                }\n                if other.chars().count() == 1 {\n                    code = Some(KeyCode::Char(other.chars().next().unwrap()));\n                } else {\n                    return None;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let code = code?;\n    let mut label_parts = Vec::new();\n    if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {\n        label_parts.push(\"Ctrl\");\n    }\n    if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {\n        label_parts.push(\"Alt\");\n    }\n    if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) {\n        label_parts.push(\"Shift\");\n    }\n    if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SUPER) {\n        label_parts.push(\"Super\");\n    }\n\n    let key_name = match code {\n        KeyCode::Char(' ') => \"Space\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Char(c) => c.to_uppercase().to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Enter => \"Enter\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Esc => \"Esc\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Tab => \"Tab\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Backspace => \"Backspace\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Delete => \"Delete\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Up => \"Up\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Down => \"Down\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Left => \"Left\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Right => \"Right\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Home => \"Home\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::End => \"End\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::PageUp => \"PageUp\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::PageDown => \"PageDown\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::Insert => \"Insert\".to_string(),\n        KeyCode::F(n) => format!(\"F{}\", n),\n        _ => \"\".to_string(),\n    };\n    label_parts.push(&key_name);\n    let label = label_parts.join(\"+\");\n\n    Some(Bind {\n        code,\n        modifiers,\n        label: Box::leak(label.into_boxed_str()),\n        name: None,\n    })\n}\n\npub fn update_bind(action: &str, bind_str: &str) -> bool {\n    if let Some(mut bind) = parse_keybind(bind_str) {\n        let binds = CURRENT_BINDS.get_or_init(|| false,\n            }\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n    false\n}\n\npub mod key {\n    use super::Bind;\n    use crossterm::event::{KeyCode, KeyModifiers};\n\n    pub const QUIT: Bind =     }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub enum KeyLabel {\n    Single(&'static str),\n    Alt(&'static str, &'static str),\n    /// Alt on Mac, Single (first) on other platforms\n UnicodeWidthStr::width(s.as_str()),\n            Self::Alt(a, b) => {\n                let sep_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(ALT_SEP);\n                UnicodeWidthStr::width(a.as_str()) + sep_w + KeyCode::Char(_));\n    if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {\n        s.push_str(\"ctrl+\");\n    }\n    if mods.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {\n        s.push_str(\"alt+\");\n    }\n    if 1663:                 }

1689:             PlanFormAction::OpenEditor => match self.state.plan.path() {

1691:                 None => {

1694:                 }
1695:             },

1697:             PlanFormAction::ClearAndImplement => self.implement_plan(true),
1698:         }

1701:     fn implement_plan(&mut self, clear_context: bool) -> Vec<Action> {
1702:         let parallel = self.plan_form.parallel();
1703:         self.plan_form.reset();
1704:         let plan_snapshot = match std::mem::take(&mut self.state.plan) {
1705:             PlanState::Ready(p) => Some((
1706:                 std::fs::read_to_string(&p).unwrap_or_default(),
1707:                 p.display().to_string(),
1708:             )),
1709:             _ => None,
1710:         };
1711: 
1712:         self.state.mode = Mode::Build;
1713: 
1714:         let mut actions = if clear_context {
1715:             self.reset_session()
1716:         } else {
1717:             vec![]
1718:         };
1719: 
1720:         let text = if let Some((content, path_str)) = plan_snapshot {
1721:             let text = if parallel {
1722:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`. {IMPLEMENT_PARALLEL_HINT}")
1723:             } else {
1724:                 format!("{IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX} at `{path_str}`.")
1725:             };
1726:             self.main_chat()
1727:                 .push(DisplayMessage::plan(content, path_str));
1728:             text
1729:         } else {
1730:             format!("{}.", IMPLEMENT_MSG_PREFIX)
1731:         };
1732:         self.run_id += 1;
1733:         let msg = QueuedMessage {
1734:             text,
1735:             images: vec![],
1736:         };
1737:         actions.extend(self.start_from_queue(&msg));
1738:         actions
1739:     }
1740: }

1753:         1 => format!("{text} [1 image]"),
1754:         n => format!("{text} [{n} images]"),

307:                 return vec![];

313:             return vec![];

318: 
319:         let target_idx = match current_pos {

322:                     (pos + 1) % summaries.len()
323:                 } else {

325:                 }

408:                     out.push_str(&sub_msgs);
409:                 }

421: fn format_messages(
422:     messages: &[Message],
423:     tool_outputs: &HashMap<String, ToolOutput>,
424: ) -> String {
425:     use std::fmt::Write;
426:     let mut out = String::new();
427:     for message in messages {
428:         match message.role {
429:             Role::User => {
430:                 let has_non_tool_result = message.content.iter().any(|block| {
431:                     !matches!(block, ContentBlock::ToolResult { .. })
432:                 });
433:                 if !has_non_tool_result {
434:                     continue;
435:                 }
436: 
437:                 let _ = writeln!(out, "### User\n");
438:                 for block in &message.content {
439:                     match block {
440:                         ContentBlock::Text { text } => {
441:                             if !text.is_empty() {
442:                                 let _ = writeln!(out, "{}\n", text.trim_end());
443:                             }
444:                         }
445:                         ContentBlock::Image { source } => {
446:                             let _ = writeln!(out, "![Image]({})\n", source.to_data_url());
447:                         }
448:                         _ => {}
449:                     }
450:                 }
451:             }
452:             Role::Assistant => {
453:                 let _ = writeln!(out, "### Assistant\n");
454:                 for block in &message.content {
455:                     match block {
456:                         ContentBlock::Text { text } => {
457:                             if !text.is_empty() {
458:                                 let _ = writeln!(out, "{}\n", text.trim_end());
459:                             }
460:                         }
461:                         ContentBlock::Thinking { thinking, .. } => {
462:                             if !thinking.is_empty() {
463:                                 let _ = writeln!(
464:                                     out,
465:                                     "<details>\n<summary>Thinking</summary>\n\n{}\n</details>\n",
466:                                     thinking.trim()
467:                                 );
468:                             }
469:                         }
470:                         ContentBlock::RedactedThinking { data } => {
471:                             if !data.is_empty() {
472:                                 let _ = writeln!(
473:                                     out,
474:                                     "<details>\n<summary>Thinking (Redacted)</summary>\n\n{}\n</details>\n",
475:                                     data.trim()
476:                                 );
477:                             }
478:                         }
479:                         ContentBlock::ToolUse { id, name, input } => {
480:                             let _ = writeln!(out, "**Tool Call:** `{}`", name);
481:                             let input_pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(input)
482:                                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| input.to_string());
483:                             let _ = writeln!(out, "```json\n{}\n```", input_pretty.trim());
484: 
485:                             if let Some(tool_output) = tool_outputs.get(id) {
486:                                 let output_text = tool_output.as_text();
487:                                 if !output_text.is_empty() {
488:                                     let _ = writeln!(out, "**Output:**");
489:                                     if tool_output.is_markdown() {
490:                                         let _ = writeln!(out, "{}", output_text.trim_end());
491:                                     } else {
492:                                         let _ = writeln!(out, "```\n{}\n```", output_text.trim_end());
493:                                     }
494:                                 }
495:                             } else {
496:                                 let _ = writeln!(out);
497:                             }
498:                         }
499:                         _ => {}
500:                     }
501:                 }
502:             }
503:         }
504:     }
505:     out
506: }
```

103:     pub fn new() -> Self {

109:         }

113:         Self {
114:             auto_scroll: false,
115:             ..Self::new()
116:         }
117:     }
118: 
119:     pub fn reset(&mut self) {
120:         let auto_scroll = self.auto_scroll;
121:         *self = Self::new();
122:         self.auto_scroll = auto_scroll;
123:     }
124: 
125:     pub fn offset(&self) -> u16 {
126:         self.offset
127:     }
128: 
129:     pub fn update_dimensions(&mut self, total: u16, viewport_h: u16) {
130:         self.viewport_h = viewport_h;
131:         self.max_offset = total.saturating_sub(viewport_h);
132:         if self.auto_scroll {
133:             self.offset = self.max_offset;
134:         } else {
135:             self.clamp();
136:             if self.offset >= self.max_offset {
137:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
138:             }
139:         }
140:     }
141: 
142:     pub fn scroll(&mut self, delta: i32) {
143:         self.offset = apply_scroll_delta(self.offset, delta);
144:         self.clamp();
145:         self.auto_scroll = self.offset >= self.max_offset;
146:     }

148:     pub fn handle_key(&mut self, key_event: KeyEvent) -> bool {
149:         use keybindings::key;
150:         match key_event.code {
151:             KeyCode::Up => self.scroll(1),
152:             KeyCode::Down => self.scroll(-1),
153:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(self.half_page()),
154:             _ if key::SCROLL_HALF_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-self.half_page()),
155:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_UP.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(1),
156:             _ if key::SCROLL_LINE_DOWN.matches(key_event) => self.scroll(-1),
157:             _ if key::SCROLL_TOP.matches(key_event) => {
158:                 self.offset = 0;
159:                 self.auto_scroll = false;
160:             }
161:             _ if key::SCROLL_BOTTOM.matches(key_event) => {
162:                 self.auto_scroll = true;
163:                 self.offset = self.max_offset;
164:             }
165:             _ => return false,
166:         }
167:         true
168:     }
169: 
170:     fn half_page(&self) -> i32 {
171:         (self.viewport_h / 2).max(1) as i32
172:     }
173: 
174:     fn clamp(&mut self) {
175:         self.offset = self.offset.min(self.max_offset);
176:     }
177: }

221: const ERROR_DISPLAY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
222: 
223: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
224: pub enum ExitRequest {
225:     #[default]
226:     None,
227:     Success,
228:     Error,
229: }
230: 
231: impl ExitRequest {
232:     pub fn code(&self) -> i32 {
233:         match self {
234:             Self::None | Self::Success => 0,
235:             Self::Error => 1,
236:         }
237:     }
238: }
239: 
240: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
241: pub enum Status {
242:     Idle,
243:     Streaming,
244:     Error { message: String, since: Instant },
245: }
246: 
247: impl Status {
248:     pub fn error(message: String) -> Self {
249:         Self::Error {
250:             message,
251:             since: Instant::now(),
252:         }
253:     }
254: 
255:     pub fn is_error_expired(&self) -> bool {
256:         matches!(self, Self::Error { since, .. } if since.elapsed() >= ERROR_DISPLAY)
257:     }
258: }
259: 
260: impl PartialEq for Status {
261:     fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
262:         matches!(
263:             (self, other),
264:             (Self::Idle, Self::Idle)
265:                 | (Self::Streaming, Self::Streaming)
266:                 | (Self::Error { .. }, Self::Error { .. })
267:         )
268:     }
269: }

272:     pub attempt: u32,
273:     pub message: String,
274:     pub deadline: Instant,
275: }

243:     pub(super) fn goto_turn(&mut self, turn_str: &str) -> Vec<Action> {
244:         let turn_num: usize = match turn_str.parse() {
245:             Ok(n) if n > 0 => n,
246:             _ => {
247:                 self.status_bar.flash("Usage: /goto <turn number>".into());

253:             if matches!(msg.role, Role::User) {
254:                 user_count += 1;
255:                 if user_count == turn_num {
256:                     let display_idx = display_msg_index_for_turn(
257:                         &self.state.session.messages,
258:                         msg_idx,
259:                     );
260:                     self.main_chat().scroll_to_segment(display_idx);
261:                     self.save_session();
262:                     return vec![];
263:                 }
264:             }
265:         }
266:         self.status_bar.flash(format!("Turn {turn_num} not found"));
267:         vec![]
268:     }

//! Python execution bridge for the agent.
//!
//! We run Python in the monty sandbox, and bridge tool calls back to the agent.
//! Async awaits get batched via AsyncResolver so concurrent tool calls actually run in parallel.
//! Stdout streams to the UI every STREAM_FLUSH_INTERVAL so you see output as it happens.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt::Write;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use maki_interpreter::runner::{self, ToolFn};
use maki_interpreter::{AsyncResolver, PendingCall};
use maki_tool_macro::Tool;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::Value;

use std::sync::Arc;

use crate::agent::tool_dispatch::Emit;
use crate::cancel::CancelToken;
use crate::permissions::PermissionManager;
use crate::task_set::TaskSet;
use crate::{AgentConfig, AgentEvent, AgentMode, EventSender, ToolInput, ToolOutput};
use async_lock::Mutex;

use smol::future::block_on;

use super::truncate_output;
use super::{Deadline, FileReadTracker};
use crate::tools::{ToolAudience, ToolRegistry};

const STREAM_FLUSH_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(100);
const PREAMBLE: &str = "import re\nimport asyncio\nimport sys\nimport os\nimport json\n";

struct InterpreterEnv {
    event_tx: EventSender,
    mode: AgentMode,
    cancel: CancelToken,
    deadline: Deadline,
    config: AgentConfig,
    permissions: Arc<PermissionManager>,
    file_tracker: Arc<FileReadTracker>,
    user_response_rx: Option<Arc<Mutex<flume::Receiver<String>>>>,
}

#[derive(Tool, Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
pub struct CodeExecution {
    #[param(
        description = "Python code to execute. Tools are async functions that return strings (not objects). You MUST await every call: `result = await read(path='/file')`. Use `await asyncio.gather(...)` for concurrency."
    )]
    code: String,
    #[param(description = "Timeout in seconds (default 30, max 300)")]
    timeout: Option<u64>,
}

impl CodeExecution {
    pub const NAME: &str = "code_execution";
    pub const DESCRIPTION: &str = include_str!("code_execution.md");
    pub const EXAMPLES: Option<&str> = Some(
        r##"[{"code": "files = (await glob(pattern='**/*.rs')).strip().split('\\n')\nresults = await asyncio.gather(*[read(path=f) for f in files if f.strip()])\nfor f, c in zip(files, results):\n    if 'fn main' in c: print(f)"},
            {"code": "result = await grep(pattern='TODO', include='*.rs')\nprint(f\"{len(result.strip().splitlines())} TODOs found\")"},
            {"code": "content = await webfetch(url='https://example.com/docs')\nfor line in content.splitlines():\n    if 'auth' in line.lower(): print(line)"}]"##,
    );

    pub async fn execute(&self, ctx: &super::ToolContext) -> Result<ToolOutput, String> {
        let timeout = Duration::from_secs(
            ctx.deadline.cap_timeout(
                self.timeout
                    .unwrap_or(ctx.config.code_execution_timeout_secs),
            )?,
        );
        let code = self.code.clone();
        let tool_use_id = ctx.tool_use_id.clone();
        let config = ctx.config.clone();
        let deadline = Deadline::after(timeout);
        let limits = runner::limits(timeout, config.interpreter_max_memory_mb * 1024 * 1024);
        let env = InterpreterEnv {
            event_tx: ctx.event_tx.clone(),
            mode: ctx.mode.clone(),
            cancel: ctx.cancel.clone(),
            deadline,
            config,
            permissions: ctx.permissions.clone(),
            file_tracker: ctx.file_tracker.clone(),
            user_response_rx: ctx.user_response_rx.clone(),
        };

        // We race cancel against the blocking thread. If cancel wins, the Python thread
        // keeps running till it finishes. Threads can not be killed safely.
        ctx.cancel
            .race(smol::unblock(move || {
                let tools = build_tool_fns(&env);
                let resolver = build_async_resolver(&env);
                let code = format!("{PREAMBLE}{code}");

                let result = if let Some(ref id) = tool_use_id {
                    let mut accumulated = String::new();
                    let mut last_flush = Instant::now();
                    runner::run_streaming(&code, &tools, Some(&resolver), limits, &mut |line| {
                        accumulated.push_str(line);
                        if last_flush.elapsed() >= STREAM_FLUSH_INTERVAL {
                            env.event_tx.try_send(AgentEvent::ToolOutput {
                                id: id.to_string(),
                                content: accumulated.clone(),
                            });
                            last_flush = Instant::now();
                        }
                    })
                } else {
                    runner::run(&code, &tools, Some(&resolver), limits)
                }
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

                let mut output = String::new();
                if !result.stdout.is_empty() {
                    output.push_str(result.stdout.trim_end());
                    output.push('\n');
                }
                if let Some(ref val) = result.output {
                    if !output.is_empty() {
                        output.push('\n');
                    }
                    let _ = write!(output, "return: {val}");
                }
                if output.is_empty() {
                    output.push_str("(no output)");
                }

                Ok(ToolOutput::Plain(
                    truncate_output(
                        output,
                        env.config.max_output_lines,
                        env.config.max_output_bytes,
                    )
                    .into(),
                ))
            }))
            .await?
    }

    pub fn start_header(&self) -> String {
        let lines = self.code.lines().count();
        format!("{lines} lines")
    }
}

super::impl_tool!(
    CodeExecution,
    audience = super::ToolAudience::MAIN
        | super::ToolAudience::RESEARCH_SUB
        | super::ToolAudience::GENERAL_SUB,
    augment = |desc: &mut String, ctx: &super::DescriptionContext| {
        desc.push_str(&super::build_interpreter_tools_description(ctx.filter));
    },
);

impl super::ToolInvocation for CodeExecution {
    fn start_header(&self) -> super::HeaderFuture {
        super::HeaderFuture::Ready(super::HeaderResult::plain(CodeExecution::start_header(
            self,
        )))
    }
    fn start_input(&self) -> Option<ToolInput> {
        Some(ToolInput::Script {
            language: "python".into(),
            code: self.code.clone(),
        })
    }
    fn start_annotation(&self) -> Option<String> {
        Some(super::timeout_annotation(self.timeout.unwrap_or(30)))
    }
    fn execute<'a>(self: Box<Self>, ctx: &'a super::ToolContext) -> super::ExecFuture<'a> {
        Box::pin(async move { CodeExecution::execute(&self, ctx).await.into() })
    }
}

fn build_tool_fns(env: &InterpreterEnv) -> HashMap<String, ToolFn> {
    let mut tools: HashMap<String, ToolFn> = HashMap::new();

    for entry in ToolRegistry::native().iter().iter() {
        let tool_name = entry.name();
        if !entry.tool.audience().contains(ToolAudience::INTERPRETER) {
            continue;
        }
        if !super::is_tool_enabled(&env.config, tool_name) {
            continue;
        }
        let name = tool_name.to_string();
        let tx = env.event_tx.clone();
        let mode = env.mode.clone();
        let cancel = env.cancel.clone();
        let deadline = env.deadline;
        let permissions = Arc::clone(&env.permissions);
        let config = env.config.clone();
        let file_tracker = Arc::clone(&env.file_tracker);
        let user_response_rx = env.user_response_rx.clone();

        tools.insert(
            name.clone(),
            Box::new(
                move |fn_name: &str, args: Vec<Value>, kwargs: Vec<(String, Value)>| {
                    deadline.check()?;

                    let input = build_tool_input(&args, &kwargs)?;

                    let mut inner_ctx = super::interpreter_ctx(
                        &mode,
                        &tx,
                        cancel.clone(),
                        Arc::clone(&permissions),
                        Arc::clone(&file_tracker),
                        user_response_rx.clone(),
                    );
                    inner_ctx.deadline = deadline;
                    inner_ctx.config = config.clone();
                    let done = block_on(crate::agent::tool_dispatch::run(
                        ToolRegistry::native(),
                        inner_ctx.mcp.as_ref(),
                        String::new(),
                        fn_name,
                        &input,
                        &inner_ctx,
                        Emit::Silent,
                    ));
                    if done.is_error {
                        Err(done.output.as_text())
                    } else {
                        Ok(Value::String(done.output.as_text()))
                    }
                },
            ),
        );
    }

    tools
}

fn build_async_resolver(env: &InterpreterEnv) -> AsyncResolver {
    let tx = env.event_tx.clone();
    let mode = env.mode.clone();
    let cancel = env.cancel.clone();
    let deadline = env.deadline;
    let config = env.config.clone();
    let permissions = Arc::clone(&env.permissions);
    let file_tracker = Arc::clone(&env.file_tracker);
    let user_response_rx = env.user_response_rx.clone();

    Box::new(move |pending_calls: Vec<PendingCall>| {
        let config = config.clone();
        let file_tracker = Arc::clone(&file_tracker);
        let user_response_rx = user_response_rx.clone();
        smol::future::block_on(async {
            let call_ids: Vec<u32> = pending_calls.iter().map(|pc| pc.call_id).collect();
            let mut set = TaskSet::new();
            for pc in pending_calls {
                let tx = tx.clone();
                let mode = mode.clone();
                let cancel = cancel.clone();
                let permissions = Arc::clone(&permissions);
                let config = config.clone();
                let file_tracker = Arc::clone(&file_tracker);
                let user_response_rx = user_response_rx.clone();

                set.spawn(async move {
                    if let Err(e) = deadline.check() {
                        return (pc.call_id, Err(e));
                    }

                    let input = match build_tool_input(&pc.args, &pc.kwargs) {
                        Ok(v) => v,
                        Err(e) => return (pc.call_id, Err(e)),
                    };

                    let mut inner_ctx = super::interpreter_ctx(
                        &mode,
                        &tx,
                        cancel,
                        Arc::clone(&permissions),
                        file_tracker,
                        user_response_rx,
                    );
                    inner_ctx.deadline = deadline;
                    inner_ctx.config = config;
                    let done = crate::agent::tool_dispatch::run(
                        ToolRegistry::native(),
                        inner_ctx.mcp.as_ref(),
                        String::new(),
                        &pc.name,
                        &input,
                        &inner_ctx,
                        Emit::Silent,
                    )
                    .await;

                    let result = if done.is_error {
                        Err(done.output.as_text())
                    } else {
                        Ok(Value::String(done.output.as_text()))
                    };
                    (pc.call_id, result)
                });
            }

            let results: Vec<_> = set
                .join_all()
                .await
                .into_iter()
                .zip(&call_ids)
                .map(|(r, &call_id)| {
                    r.unwrap_or_else(|msg| {
                        tracing::error!(error = %msg, "code_execution inner tool panicked");
                        (call_id, Err(format!("tool panicked: {msg}")))
                    })
                })
                .collect();

            Ok(results)
        })
    })
}

fn build_tool_input(args: &[Value], kwargs: &[(String, Value)]) -> Result<Value, String> {
    if let Some(first) = args.first()
        && first.is_object()
    {
        return Ok(first.clone());
    }

    if !kwargs.is_empty() {
        let mut obj = serde_json::Map::new();
        for (k, v) in kwargs {
            obj.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
        }
        return Ok(Value::Object(obj));
    }

    if args.is_empty() {
        return Ok(serde_json::json!({}));
    }

    Err("pass arguments as keyword arguments (e.g. read(path='/file'))".into())
}

            assert!(result.is_err());

2: //! a `smol::unblock` thread. Stdout and tool-call batches share one FIFO
3: //! channel so ordering is preserved and cancellation (dropped channel) makes
4: //! the blocked thread unwind instead of leaking.

6: use std::collections::HashMap;
7: use std::time::Duration;

9: use futures::future::join_all;

11: use maki_agent::tools::interpreter_bridge::build_tool_input;
12: use maki_interpreter::error::InterpreterError;
13: use maki_interpreter::runner::{self, ToolFn};

19: use crate::plugin_permissions::{Permission, PluginPermissions};
20: use crate::runtime::{TaskHandle, lock_cell};
21: 
22: const BRIDGE_CLOSED: &str = "tool bridge closed (cancelled)";
23: 
24: type CallResults = Vec<(u32, Result<Value, String>)>;
25: 
26: enum BridgeMsg {
27:     Line(String),
28:     Calls(Vec<PendingCall>, flume::Sender<CallResults>),
29: }
30: 
31: pub(crate) fn create_interpreter_table(lua: &Lua, perms: &PluginPermissions) -> LuaResult<Table> {
32:     let t = lua.create_table()?;
33:     t.set(
34:         "run",
35:         perms.guard_async(Permission::Run, lua, interpreter_run)?,
36:     )?;
37:     Ok(t)
38: }
39: 
40: fn required<T: mlua::FromLua>(opts: &Table, key: &str) -> LuaResult<T> {
41:     opts.get::<Option<T>>(key)?
42:         .ok_or_else(|| mlua::Error::runtime(format!("interpreter.run: '{key}' is required")))
43: }
44: 
45: fn forward_calls(
46:     tx: &flume::Sender<BridgeMsg>,
47:     calls: Vec<PendingCall>,
48: ) -> Result<CallResults, InterpreterError> {
49:     let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = flume::bounded(1);
50:     tx.send(BridgeMsg::Calls(calls, reply_tx))
51:         .map_err(|_| InterpreterError::Runtime(BRIDGE_CLOSED.into()))?;
52:     reply_rx
53:         .recv()
54:         .map_err(|_| InterpreterError::Runtime(BRIDGE_CLOSED.into()))
55: }
56: 
57: async fn call_lua_tool(lua: Lua, f: Option<Function>, pc: &PendingCall) -> Result<Value, String> {
58:     let Some(f) = f else {
59:         return Err(format!("unknown tool: {}", pc.name));
60:     };
61:     let input = build_tool_input(&pc.args, &pc.kwargs)?;
62:     let arg = json_to_lua(&lua, &input).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
63:     let values = f
64:         .call_async::<mlua::MultiValue>(arg)
65:         .await
66:         .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
67:     lua_tool_result(values)
68:         .map(Value::String)
69:         .map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", pc.name))
70: }
71: 
72: async fn interpreter_run(
73:     lua: Lua,
74:     (code, opts): (String, Table),
75: ) -> LuaResult<(Table, Option<String>)> {
76:     let timeout_secs: u64 = required(&opts, "timeout")?;
77:     let max_memory_mb: usize = required(&opts, "max_memory_mb")?;
78:     let on_output: Function = required(&opts, "on_output")?;
79:     let tools_tbl: Option<Table> = opts.get("tools")?;
80: 
81:     let mut fns: HashMap<String, Function> = HashMap::new();
82:     if let Some(t) = tools_tbl {
83:         for pair in t.pairs::<String, Function>() {
84:             let (name, f) = pair?;
85:             fns.insert(name, f);
86:         }
87:     }
88:     let names: Vec<String> = fns.keys().cloned().collect();
89: 
90:     let cancel = lua
91:         .app_data_ref::<TaskHandle>()
92:         .map(|h| lock_cell(&h).cancel.clone())
93:         .unwrap_or_else(CancelToken::none);
94: 
95:     let timeout = Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs);
96:     let limits = runner::limits(timeout, max_memory_mb * 1024 * 1024);
97: 
98:     let (tx, rx) = flume::unbounded::<BridgeMsg>();
99:     let run = smol::unblock(move || {
100:         let tools: HashMap<String, ToolFn> = names
101:             .into_iter()
102:             .map(|name| {
103:                 let tx = tx.clone();
104:                 let f: ToolFn = Box::new(
105:                     move |fn_name: &str, args: Vec<Value>, kwargs: Vec<(String, Value)>| {
106:                         let call = PendingCall {
107:                             call_id: 0,
108:                             name: fn_name.to_owned(),
109:                             args,
110:                             kwargs,
111:                         };
112:                         forward_calls(&tx, vec![call])
113:                             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
114:                             .pop()
115:                             .map(|(_, r)| r)
116:                             .unwrap_or_else(|| Err(BRIDGE_CLOSED.into()))
117:                     },
118:                 );
119:                 (name, f)
120:             })
121:             .collect();
122:         let resolver: AsyncResolver = {
123:             let tx = tx.clone();
124:             Box::new(move |pending| forward_calls(&tx, pending))
125:         };
126: 
127:         let mut flushed = 0usize;
128:         let result = runner::run_streaming(&code, &tools, Some(&resolver), limits, &mut |chunk| {
129:             flushed += chunk.len();
130:             for line in chunk.lines() {
131:                 let _ = tx.send(BridgeMsg::Line(line.to_owned()));
132:             }
133:         })
134:         .map_err(|e| e.to_string());
135:         if let Ok(ir) = &result {
136:             for line in ir.stdout[flushed..].lines() {
137:                 let _ = tx.send(BridgeMsg::Line(line.to_owned()));
138:             }
139:         }
140:         result
141:     });
142: 
143:     let recv_loop = async {
144:         while let Ok(msg) = rx.recv_async().await {
145:             match msg {
146:                 BridgeMsg::Line(line) => on_output.call::<()>(line)?,
147:                 BridgeMsg::Calls(batch, reply) => {
148:                     let futs = batch.into_iter().map(|pc| {
149:                         let f = fns.get(&pc.name).cloned();
150:                         let lua = lua.clone();
151:                         async move { (pc.call_id, call_lua_tool(lua, f, &pc).await) }
152:                     });
153:                     let _ = reply.send(join_all(futs).await);
154:                 }
155:             }
156:         }
157:         Ok::<(), mlua::Error>(())
158:     };
159: 
160:     let (result, cb) = cancel
161:         .race(futures_lite::future::zip(run, recv_loop))
162:         .await
163:         .map_err(mlua::Error::runtime)?;
164:     cb?;
165: 
166:     let tbl = lua.create_table()?;
167:     match result {
168:         Ok(ir) => {
169:             if !ir.stdout.is_empty() {
170:                 tbl.set("stdout", ir.stdout.trim_end())?;
171:             }
172:             if let Some(val) = ir.output {
173:                 tbl.set("output", val.to_string())?;
174:             }
175:             Ok((tbl, None))
176:         }
177:         Err(e) => Ok((tbl, Some(e))),
178:     }
179: }

1: local M = {}

3: local function split_lines(s)
4:   if s:sub(-1) == "\n" then
5:     s = s:sub(1, -2)
6:   end
7:   local lines = {}
8:   for line in (s .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
9:     lines[#lines + 1] = line
10:   end
11:   return lines
12: end
13: 
14: function M.replace_lines(content, start_line, end_line, new_string)
15:   local trailing_nl = content:sub(-1) == "\n"
16:   local lines = split_lines(content)
17:   local inserting = end_line == nil
18: 
19:   if inserting then
20:     if start_line < 1 or start_line > #lines + 1 then
21:       return nil, string.format("start line %d out of range (1-%d)", start_line, #lines + 1)
22:     end
23:   else
24:     if start_line < 1 or start_line > #lines then
25:       return nil, string.format("start line %d out of range (1-%d)", start_line, #lines)
26:     end
27:     if end_line < start_line or end_line > #lines then
28:       return nil, string.format("end line %d out of range (%d-%d)", end_line, start_line, #lines)
29:     end
30:   end
31: 
32:   local skip_from = inserting and start_line or start_line
33:   local skip_to = inserting and start_line - 1 or end_line
34: 
35:   local result = {}
36:   for i = 1, skip_from - 1 do
37:     result[#result + 1] = lines[i]
38:   end
39:   if new_string ~= "" then
40:     for _, line in ipairs(split_lines(new_string)) do
41:       result[#result + 1] = line
42:     end
43:   end
44:   for i = skip_to + 1, #lines do
45:     result[#result + 1] = lines[i]
46:   end
47: 
48:   local joined = table.concat(result, "\n")
49:   return trailing_nl and joined .. "\n" or joined
50: end
51: 
52: return M

38: const TOOL_NAME_MAX: usize = 64;
39: const TOOL_HANDLER_RETURN_ERR: &str =
40:     "tool handler must return string or {output=string, is_error?=bool}";
41: const TIMEOUT_PARSE_ERR: &str = "register_tool: 'timeout' must be a positive number, 0, or false";
42: const MAX_HINT_CONTENT_SIZE: usize = 1024 * 1024;
43: const DESCRIBE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);

46: type DescribeFn = Box<dyn Fn(&str, &str, &Value) -> Option<String>>;
47: 
48: thread_local! {
49:     /// Lives on the Lua runtime thread only. Calling `Request::Describe` from
50:     /// that same thread would self-deadlock, so we resolve in-thread instead.
51:     static LOCAL_DESCRIBE: RefCell<Option<DescribeFn>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
52: }
53: 
54: pub(crate) fn set_local_describe(f: impl Fn(&str, &str, &Value) -> Option<String> + 'static) {
55:     LOCAL_DESCRIBE.with(|c| *c.borrow_mut() = Some(Box::new(f)));
56: }
57: 
58: fn local_describe(plugin: &str, tool: &str, dctx: &Value) -> Option<Option<String>> {
59:     LOCAL_DESCRIBE.with(|c| c.borrow().as_ref().map(|f| f(plugin, tool, dctx)))
60: }
61: 
62: type ToolHandles = (Option<Function>, Option<Function>);
63: type ToolHandlesFn = Box<dyn Fn(&str) -> Option<ToolHandles>>;
64: 
65: thread_local! {
66:     static LOCAL_TOOL_HANDLES: RefCell<Option<ToolHandlesFn>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
67: }
68: 
69: pub(crate) fn set_local_tool_handles(f: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<ToolHandles> + 'static) {
70:     LOCAL_TOOL_HANDLES.with(|c| *c.borrow_mut() = Some(Box::new(f)));
71: }
72: 
73: fn local_tool_handles(tool: &str) -> Option<ToolHandles> {
74:     LOCAL_TOOL_HANDLES.with(|c| c.borrow().as_ref().and_then(|f| f(tool)))
75: }

77: fn dctx_json(ctx: &DescriptionContext) -> Value {
78:     let mut obj = json!({
79:         "audience": ctx.audience.name().unwrap_or("main"),
80:         "workflow": ctx.workflow,
81:     });
82:     match ctx.filter {
83:         ToolFilter::All => {}
84:         ToolFilter::Only(names) => obj["only"] = json!(names),
85:         ToolFilter::AllExcept(names) => obj["except"] = json!(names),
86:     }
87:     obj
88: }

136: pub(crate) struct LuaTool {
137:     pub(crate) name: Arc<str>,
138:     pub(crate) description: String,
139:     pub(crate) schema: &'static ParamSchema,
140:     pub(crate) audience: ToolAudience,
141:     pub(crate) kind: Option<Arc<str>>,
142:     pub(crate) tx: Sender<Request>,
143:     pub(crate) plugin: Arc<str>,
144:     pub(crate) has_header_fn: bool,
145:     pub(crate) has_start_fn: bool,
146:     pub(crate) permission_scope_kind: Option<PermissionScopeKind>,
147:     pub(crate) mutable_path_field: Option<Arc<str>>,
148:     pub(crate) timeout: Option<Duration>,

154: impl Tool for LuaTool {
155:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
156:         &self.name
157:     }
158: 
159:     fn description(&self, ctx: &DescriptionContext) -> Cow<'_, str> {
160:         if !self.has_describe_fn {
161:             return Cow::Borrowed(&self.description);
162:         }
163:         let dctx = dctx_json(ctx);
164:         if let Some(result) = local_describe(&self.plugin, &self.name, &dctx) {
165:             return match result {
166:                 Some(s) => Cow::Owned(s),
167:                 None => Cow::Borrowed(&self.description),
168:             };
169:         }
170:         let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = flume::bounded(1);
171:         let sent = self
172:             .tx
173:             .send(Request::Describe {
174:                 plugin: Arc::clone(&self.plugin),
175:                 tool: Arc::clone(&self.name),
176:                 dctx,
177:                 reply: reply_tx,
178:             })
179:             .is_ok();
180:         if sent {
181:             match reply_rx.recv_timeout(DESCRIBE_TIMEOUT) {
182:                 Ok(Some(s)) => return Cow::Owned(s),
183:                 Ok(None) => {}
184:                 Err(e) => tracing::warn!(
185:                     tool = %self.name,
186:                     error = %e,
187:                     "describe round trip failed; falling back to static description"
188:                 ),
189:             }
190:         }
191:         Cow::Borrowed(&self.description)
192:     }
193: 
194:     fn schema(&self) -> Value {
195:         to_json_schema(self.schema)
196:     }
197: 
198:     fn audience(&self) -> ToolAudience {
199:         self.audience
200:     }
201: 
202:     fn tool_kind(&self) -> Option<&str> {
203:         self.kind.as_deref()
204:     }
205: 
206:     fn examples(&self) -> Option<Value> {
207:         self.examples.clone()
208:     }
209: 
210:     fn parse(&self, input: &Value) -> Result<Box<dyn ToolInvocation>, ParseError> {
211:         let validated = validate(self.schema, input.clone())?;
212:         let permission_state = match &self.permission_scope_kind {
213:             Some(PermissionScopeKind::Field(field)) => {
214:                 let scope = validated.get(field.as_ref()).and_then(|v| v.as_str());
215:                 PermissionState::Ready(Some(match scope {
216:                     Some(s) => PermissionScopes::single(s.to_owned()),
217:                     None => PermissionScopes::force_prompt(validated.to_string()),
218:                 }))
219:             }
220:             Some(PermissionScopeKind::Callback) => PermissionState::NeedsCompute,
221:             None => PermissionState::Ready(None),
222:         };
223:         Ok(Box::new(LuaToolInvocation {
224:             tool: Arc::clone(&self.name),
225:             plugin: Arc::clone(&self.plugin),
226:             has_header_fn: self.has_header_fn,
227:             has_start_fn: self.has_start_fn,
228:             input: validated,
229:             tx: self.tx.clone(),
230:             permission_state,
231:             mutable_path_field: self.mutable_path_field.clone(),
232:             timeout: self.timeout,
233:             start_annotation: self.start_annotation.clone(),
234:         }))
235:     }
236: }
237: 
238: enum PermissionState {
239:     Ready(Option<PermissionScopes>),
240:     NeedsCompute,
241: }
242: 
243: struct LuaToolInvocation {
244:     tool: Arc<str>,
245:     plugin: Arc<str>,
246:     has_header_fn: bool,
247:     has_start_fn: bool,
248:     input: Value,
249:     tx: Sender<Request>,
250:     permission_state: PermissionState,
251:     mutable_path_field: Option<Arc<str>>,
252:     timeout: Option<Duration>,
253:     start_annotation: Option<StartAnnotation>,
254: }
255: 
256: impl ToolInvocation for LuaToolInvocation {
257:     fn start_header(&self) -> HeaderFuture {
258:         if !self.has_header_fn {
259:             return HeaderFuture::Ready(HeaderResult::plain(self.tool.to_string()));
260:         }
261:         let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = flume::bounded::<HeaderResult>(1);
262:         let tool = Arc::clone(&self.tool);
263:         let plugin = Arc::clone(&self.plugin);
264:         let input = self.input.clone();
265:         let tx = self.tx.clone();
266:         let fallback = tool.to_string();
267:         HeaderFuture::Pending {
268:             fallback: fallback.clone(),
269:             fut: Box::pin(async move {
270:                 let sent = tx
271:                     .send_async(Request::ComputeHeader {
272:                         plugin: Arc::clone(&plugin),
273:                         tool: Arc::clone(&tool),
274:                         input,
275:                         reply: reply_tx,
276:                     })
277:                     .await;
278:                 if sent.is_err() {
279:                     return HeaderResult::plain(fallback);
280:                 }
281:                 reply_rx
282:                     .recv_async()
283:                     .await
284:                     .unwrap_or_else(|_| HeaderResult::plain(fallback))
285:             }),
286:         }
287:     }
288: 
289:     fn start_annotation(&self) -> Option<String> {
290:         match self.start_annotation.as_ref()? {
291:             StartAnnotation::Timeout(field) => {
292:                 let secs = self.input.get(field.as_ref())?.as_u64()?;
293:                 Some(timeout_annotation(secs))
294:             }
295:             StartAnnotation::Count(field) => {
296:                 let field = field.as_ref();
297:                 let n = self.input.get(field)?.as_array()?.len();
298:                 let (singular, plural) = if let Some(stem) = field.strip_suffix('s') {
299:                     (stem, field)
300:                 } else {
301:                     (field, &*format!("{field}s"))
302:                 };
303:                 let label = if n == 1 { singular } else { plural };
304:                 Some(format!("{n} {label}"))
305:             }
306:         }
307:     }
308: 
309:     fn start<'a>(&'a self, ctx: &'a ToolContext) -> BoxFuture<'a, ()> {
310:         let id = ctx.tool_use_id.as_ref().filter(|_| self.has_start_fn);
311:         let Some(id) = id else {
312:             return Box::pin(std::future::ready(()));
313:         };
314:         let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = flume::bounded::<()>(1);
315:         let req = Request::StartTool {
316:             plugin: Arc::clone(&self.plugin),
317:             tool: Arc::clone(&self.tool),
318:             input: self.input.clone(),
319:             live: LiveCtx {
320:                 event_tx: ctx.event_tx.clone(),
321:                 tool_use_id: id.clone(),
322:             },
323:             ctx: Box::new(LuaCtx::start(ctx)),
324:             reply: reply_tx,
325:         };
326:         let tx = self.tx.clone();
327:         Box::pin(async move {
328:             if tx.send_async(req).await.is_ok() {
329:                 let _ = reply_rx.recv_async().await;
330:             }
331:         })
332:     }
333: 
334:     fn permission_scopes(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Option<PermissionScopes>> {
335:         match &self.permission_state {
336:             PermissionState::Ready(v) => Box::pin(std::future::ready(v.clone())),
337:             PermissionState::NeedsCompute => {
338:                 let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = flume::bounded(1);
339:                 let tx = self.tx.clone();
340:                 let plugin = Arc::clone(&self.plugin);
341:                 let tool = Arc::clone(&self.tool);
342:                 let input = self.input.clone();
343:                 let fallback = input.to_string();
344:                 Box::pin(async move {
345:                     if tx
346:                         .send_async(Request::ComputePermissionScopes {
347:                             plugin,
348:                             tool,
349:                             input,
350:                             reply: reply_tx,
351:                         })
352:                         .await
353:                         .is_err()
354:                     {
355:                         return Some(PermissionScopes::force_prompt(fallback));
356:                     }
357:                     match reply_rx.recv_async().await {
358:                         Ok(Some(scopes)) => Some(scopes),
359:                         _ => Some(PermissionScopes::force_prompt(fallback)),
360:                     }
361:                 })
362:             }
363:         }
364:     }
365: 
366:     fn mutable_path(&self) -> Option<&Path> {
367:         let field = self.mutable_path_field.as_deref()?;
368:         let val = self.input.get(field)?.as_str()?;
369:         Some(Path::new(val))
370:     }
371: 
372:     fn execute<'a>(self: Box<Self>, ctx: &'a ToolContext) -> ExecFuture<'a> {
373:         let deadline = ctx.deadline;
374:         let plugin = self.plugin;
375:         let tool = self.tool;
376:         let input = self.input;
377:         let tx = self.tx;
378:         let tool_timeout = self.timeout;
379: 
380:         Box::pin(async move {
381:             let effective_secs: Option<u64> = match tool_timeout {
382:                 Some(d) => match deadline.cap_timeout(d.as_secs()) {
383:                     Ok(s) => Some(s),
384:                     Err(e) => return Err(e).into(),
385:                 },
386:                 None => match deadline {
387:                     Deadline::At(_) => match deadline.cap_timeout(u64::MAX) {
388:                         Ok(s) => Some(s),
389:                         Err(e) => return Err(e).into(),
390:                     },
391:                     Deadline::None => None,
392:                 },
393:             };
394: 
395:             let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = flume::bounded::<ToolCallReply>(1);
396:             let live = ctx.tool_use_id.clone().map(|id| LiveCtx {
397:                 event_tx: ctx.event_tx.clone(),
398:                 tool_use_id: id,
399:             });
400:             let lua_ctx = LuaCtx::handler(ctx);
401: 
402:             if tx
403:                 .send_async(Request::CallTool {
404:                     plugin: Arc::clone(&plugin),
405:                     tool: Arc::clone(&tool),
406:                     input,
407:                     ctx: Box::new(lua_ctx),
408:                     deadline: match deadline {
409:                         Deadline::At(t) => Some(t),
410:                         Deadline::None => None,
411:                     },
412:                     reply: reply_tx,
413:                     live,
414:                 })
415:                 .await
416:                 .is_err()
417:             {
418:                 return Err("lua thread disconnected".to_string()).into();
419:             }
420: 
421:             let recv = async { Some(reply_rx.recv_async().await) };
422:             let result = match effective_secs {
423:                 Some(secs) => {
424:                     futures_lite::future::race(recv, async move {
425:                         smol::Timer::after(Duration::from_secs(secs)).await;
426:                         None
427:                     })
428:                     .await
429:                 }
430:                 None => recv.await,
431:             };
432: 
433:             match result {
434:                 None => Err(format!(
435:                     "plugin {} tool {} exceeded timeout ({}s)",
436:                     plugin,
437:                     tool,
438:                     effective_secs.unwrap_or(0)
439:                 ))
440:                 .into(),
441:                 Some(Err(_)) => Err("lua thread disconnected".to_string()).into(),
442:                 Some(Ok(reply)) => {
443:                     if let Some(ref id) = ctx.tool_use_id {
444:                         if let Some(live_buf) = reply.live_buf {
445:                             let _ = ctx.event_tx.send(AgentEvent::LiveToolBuf {
446:                                 id: id.clone(),
447:                                 body: live_buf,
448:                             });
449:                         }
450:                         crate::runtime::RestoreReply {
451:                             body: reply.snapshot,
452:                             header: reply.header,
453:                         }
454:                         .emit(id, None, &ctx.event_tx);
455:                     }
456:                     let format = reply.format;
457:                     let instructions = reply.instructions;
458:                     let image = reply.image;
459:                     let state = reply.state;
460:                     ToolExecResult {
461:                         output: reply.result.map(|s| {
462:                             if let Some(source) = image {
463:                                 ToolOutput::Image { source, text: s }
464:                             } else if let Some(diff) = reply.diff {
465:                                 ToolOutput::Diff {
466:                                     summary: s,
467:                                     path: diff.path,
468:                                     before: diff.before,
469:                                     after: diff.after,
470:                                 }
471:                             } else {
472:                                 let inner = TextOutput {
473:                                     text: s,
474:                                     instructions: instructions.filter(|b| !b.is_empty()),
475:                                     state,
476:                                 };
477:                                 match format {
478:                                     LuaOutputFormat::Markdown => ToolOutput::Markdown(inner),
479:                                     LuaOutputFormat::Plain => ToolOutput::Plain(inner),
480:                                 }
481:                             }
482:                         }),
483:                         annotation: reply.annotation,
484:                         written_path: reply.written_path,
485:                     }
486:                 }
487:             }
488:         })
489:     }
490: }
491: 
492: fn parse_slot(spec: &Table) -> LuaResult<Slot> {
493:     spec.get::<String>("slot")
494:         .map_err(|_| mlua::Error::runtime("'slot' is required"))?
495:         .parse()
496:         .map_err(|_| {
497:             mlua::Error::runtime(format!("unknown 'slot'. Valid: {}", Slot::valid_names()))
498:         })
499: }
500: 
501: fn parse_prompt_field(spec: &Table) -> LuaResult<Option<Vec<PromptId>>> {
502:     let parse_one = |s: &str| -> mlua::Result<PromptId> {
503:         s.parse().map_err(|_| {
504:             mlua::Error::runtime(format!(
505:                 "unknown 'prompt'. Valid: {}",
506:                 PromptId::valid_names()
507:             ))
508:         })
509:     };
510:     match spec.get::<LuaValue>("prompt") {
511:         Ok(LuaValue::String(s)) => Ok(Some(vec![parse_one(&s.to_str()?)?])),
512:         Ok(LuaValue::Table(t)) => {
513:             let mut ids = Vec::new();
514:             for pair in t.sequence_values::<mlua::String>() {
515:                 ids.push(parse_one(&pair?.to_str()?)?);
516:             }
517:             if ids.is_empty() {
518:                 return Err(mlua::Error::runtime(
519:                     "'prompt' table is empty or has no sequence entries; expected a list like {\"system\", \"general\"}",
520:                 ));
521:             }
522:             Ok(Some(ids))
523:         }
524:         Ok(LuaValue::Nil) | Err(_) => Ok(None),
525:         Ok(_) => Err(mlua::Error::runtime(
526:             "'prompt' must be a string or list of strings",
527:         )),
528:     }
529: }
530: 
531: fn validate_slot_prompt_compatibility(
532:     slot: Slot,
533:     prompts: &Option<Vec<PromptId>>,
534: ) -> LuaResult<()> {
535:     if let Some(prompts) = prompts {
536:         for &pid in prompts {
537:             if !pid.has_slot(slot) {
538:                 return Err(mlua::Error::runtime(format!(
539:                     "slot '{}' is not available for prompt '{}'",
540:                     slot, pid
541:                 )));
542:             }
543:         }
544:     }
545:     Ok(())
546: }
547: 
548: fn parse_hint_content(lua: &Lua, spec: &Table) -> LuaResult<HintContent> {
549:     let has_content = spec.contains_key("content")?;
550:     if !has_content {
551:         return Err(mlua::Error::runtime("'content' is required"));
552:     }
553: 
554:     match spec.get("content")? {
555:         LuaValue::String(s) => {
556:             let text = s.to_string_lossy();
557:             if text.is_empty() {
558:                 return Err(mlua::Error::runtime("'content' must not be empty"));
559:             }
560:             if text.len() > MAX_HINT_CONTENT_SIZE {
561:                 return Err(mlua::Error::runtime(format!(
562:                     "content exceeds the {} byte limit",
563:                     MAX_HINT_CONTENT_SIZE
564:                 )));
565:             }
566:             Ok(HintContent::Static(text))
567:         }
568:         LuaValue::Function(f) => Ok(HintContent::Callback(lua.create_registry_value(f)?)),
569:         _ => Err(mlua::Error::runtime(
570:             "'content' must be a string or function",
571:         )),
572:     }
573: }
